ayaṃ sa bhartā saṃgrāme nihato mama sindhunā .
vīralokān imān prāpya kṣaṇaṃ śete yathāsukham ..3.53.20..

ahaṃ devyāḫ prasādena saśarīrainam īdṛśam .
iha prāptavatī dhanyā madanyā nāsti kācana ..3.53.21..

iti sañcintya sā haste gṛhītvā cārucāmaram .
vījayām āsa cāndreṇa taṃ dyaur vāvanimaṇḍalam ..3.53.22..

te bhṛtyās tāś ca vā dāsyas sa rājā vā prabuddhavān .
vakṣyanti vadatāṃ devi kiṃ kayeva kathaṃ dhiyā ..3.53.23..

sa rājā sā ca te bhṛtyās sarva eva parasparam .
cidākāśaikatāyogād āvayoś ca prabhāvataḥ ..3.53.24..

mahācitpratibhāsāś ca mahāniyatiniścayāt .
anyo'nyam evaṃ vetsyanti mithas sampratibimbitam ..3.53.25..

iyaṃ me sahajā bhāryā mameyaṃ sahajā sakhī .
mameyaṃ sahajā rājñī bhṛtyo 'yaṃ sahajo mama ..3.53.26..

kevalaṃ tvam ahaṃ sā ca yathāvṛttam akhaṇḍitam .
jñāsyāma mahadāścaryaṃ na tu kaścid apītaraḥ ..3.53.27..

amunaiva śarīreṇa kimarthaṃ nāgatā patim .
eṣā vare 'pi saṃprāpte līlā lalitavādini ..3.53.28..

aprabuddhadhiyas siddhalokān puṇyavaśoditān .
na samarthās svadehena prāptuṃ chāyā ivātapān ..3.53.29..

ādisarge hi niyatis sthāpiteti prabodhibhiḥ .
yathā satyam alīkena na milaty eva kiñcana ..3.53.30..

yāvad vetālasaṅkalpo bālasya kila vidyate .
nirvetāladhiyas tāvad udayas tasya kaẖ katham ..3.53.31..

avivekajvaroṣṇatvaṃ vidyate yāvad ātmani .
tāvad vivekaśītāṃśuśaityaṃ kuta udety alam ..3.53.32..

ahaṃ pṛthvyādidehaẖ khegatir nāsti mamottamā .
iti niścayavān yo 'ntaẖ kathaṃ syāt so 'nyaniścayaḥ ..3.53.33..

ato jñānavivekena puṇyenātha vareṇa vā .
puṇyadehe na gacchanti paraṃ lokam anena no ..3.53.34..

śuṣkaparṇaṃ kilāṅgāre patad evāśu dahyate .
ayaṃ devamayīṃ dehaḫ prāpta eva viśīryate ..3.53.35..

etāvad eva bhavati varalābhavijṛmbhitaiḥ .
yathā saṃvit sa evāhaṃ tathā smṛta iti sthitiḥ ..3.53.36..

yas sarpapratyayo rajjvāṃ sa kathaṃ sarpakāryakṛt .
ātmany eva hi yo nāsti tasya kā kāryakāritā ..3.53.37..

yat tv etan mṛta ity eva mithyā samanubhūyate .
prāgabhyāsasya puṣṭasya nāmaitat pravijṛmbhitam ..3.53.38..

svānubhūte jagajjāle sugame saṃsṛtibhramaḥ .
nānyasaṅkalpite nāma sargādyabhyāsa īdṛśaḥ ..3.53.39..

antar anubhūyamānās saṃsṛtayo bāhyabhūtajālānām .
aviditavedyadṛśām atidūre puṃsām ivaindavaṃ bimbam ..3.53.40..

tasmād ye vedyavettāro ye vā dharmaṃ paraṃ śritāḥ .
ātivāhikadehatvaṃ prāpnuvanty eva netare ..3.54.1..

ādhibhautikadehatvaṃ mithyā bhramamayātmakam .
katham anye sthitiṃ yātu cchāyās te katham ātape ..3.54.2..

līlā viditavedyā no paramaṃ dharmam āśritā .
kevalaṃ tena sā bhartṛkalpitaṃ nagaraṃ gatā ..3.54.3..

evam eṣā prayātā tu bhartā paśya mamāmbike .
pravṛttaḫ prāṇasantyāge kartavyam kim ihādhunā ..3.54.4..

bhāvābhāveṣu bhāvānāṃ kathaṃ niyatir āgatā .
kathaṃ bhūyo 'py aniyatir mṛtijanmādiṣūcitā ..3.54.5..

kathaṃ svabhāvasaṃsiddhiẖ kathaṃ sattā padārthagā .
katham agnyādiṣūṣṇatvaṃ pṛthvyādau sthiratā katham ..3.54.6..

himādiṣu kathaṃ śaityaṃ kā sattā kālakhādiṣu .
bhāvābhāvagrahotsargas sthūlasūkṣmadṛśaẖ katham ..3.54.7..

katham atyantam ucchrāyaṃ tṛṇagulmāṅkurādikam .
vastunāyāty anaṣṭe 'pi sthite svocchrāyakāraṇe ..3.54.8..

mahāpralayasaṃpattau sargāsthāstamaye sati .
anantākāśam āśāntaṃ sad brahmaivāvatiṣṭhate ..3.54.9..

taccidrūpatayā tejaẖkaṇo 'ham iti cetati .
svapne saṃvid yathā hi tvam ākāśagamanādi vā ..3.54.10..

tejaẖkaṇo sausthūlatvam ātmanātmani vindati .
asatyam eva satyābhaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ tad idaṃ smṛtam ..3.54.11..

tatrāntar brahma tad vetti brahmāham ayam ity atha .
manorājyaṃ sa kurute khātmaiva tad idaṃ jagat ..3.54.12..

tasmin prathamatas sarge yā yathā yatra saṃvidaḥ .
kathitās tās tathā tatra sthitā adyāpi niścalāḥ ..3.54.13..

yad yathā sphuritaṃ cittvaṃ tat tathānyatma cid bhavet .
svayam evāniyamitas tatas syān neha kiñcana ..3.54.14..

na ca nāma nakiñcittvaṃ yujyate citsvarūpiṇaḥ .
tyaktvā samastasaṃsthānaṃ hi saṃtiṣṭhatu vai katham ..3.54.15..

sargādau svayam evāntaś cid yathā kacitātmani .
himāgnyāditayādyāpi sā tathāste svasattayā ..3.54.16..

tasmāt svasattāsantyāgas sataẖ kartuṃ na yujyate .
yadā cidādes teneyaṃ niyatir na vinaśyati ..3.54.17..

yad yathā kacitaṃ yatra vyomarūpy api pārthivam .
sargādau tasya calitum adya yāvan na yujyate ..3.54.18..

yā yathā cit prakacitā pratipakṣavidaṃ vinā .
na sā tataḫ pracalati vedanābhyāsatas svayam ..3.54.19..

jagadādāv anutpannaṃ yac cedam anubhūyate .
tat saṃvidvyomakacanaṃ svapnastrīsurataṃ yathā ..3.54.20..

asatyam eva satyābhaṃ pratibhānam iti sthitam .
iti svabhāvasaṃvittir itthaṃ bhūtānubhūtayaḥ ..3.54.21..

sargādau yā yathā rūḍhā saṃvitkacanasantatiḥ .
sādyāpi cālitānyena sthitā niyatir dṛśyate ..3.54.22..

gṛhītavyomatāsaṃvic cidvyoma vyomatāṃ gatam .
gṛhītakālatāsaṃvic cinnabhaẖ kālatāṃ gatam ..3.54.23..

gṛhītajalasaṃvid cidvyoma vāri vyavasthitam .
svapne tathā hi puruṣaḫ paśyaty ātmani vāritām ..3.54.24..

svamarutsaṃvidā bhāti bhavaty eṣā yathāsthitā .
ciccamatkāracāturyam asad etat samūhate ..3.54.25..

khatvaṃ maruttvam urvītvam aptvam agnitvam apy asat .
vetty antas svapnasaṅkalpadhyāneṣv iva citis svayam ..3.54.26..

maraṇānantaraṃ karmaphalānubhavanakramam .
sarvakarmehaśāntyarthaṃ śrutaṃ śreyaskaraṃ śṛṇu ..3.54.27..

rūḍhādisarge niyatir yaikadvitricaturmitā .
puṣṭyādiṣv āyuṣaḫ puṃsāṃ tasyātha niyatiṃ śṛṇu ..3.54.28..

deśakālakriyādravyaśuddhyaśuddhī svakarmaṇām .
ūnatve cādhikatve ca nṛṇāṃ kāraṇam āyuṣaḥ ..3.54.29..

svakarmadharme hrasati hrasaty āyur nṛṇām iha .
vṛddhe vṛddhim upāyāti samam eva bhavet same ..3.54.30..

bālamṛtyupradair bālo yuvā yauvanamṛtyudaiḥ .
vṛddhamṛtyupradair vṛddhaẖ karmabhir mṛtim ṛcchati ..3.54.31..

yo yathā śāstram ārabdhaṃ svadharmam anutiṣṭhati .
bhājanaṃ bhavati śrīmān sa yathāśāstram āyuṣaḥ ..3.54.32..

evaṃ karmānusāreṇa jantur antyāṃ daśām itaḥ .
bhavaty astaṅgatavaco dṛṅmarmacchedivedanaḥ ..3.54.33..

maraṇaṃ me samāsena kathayendusamānane .
kiṃ sukhaṃ maraṇaṃ kiṃ vā duẖkhaṃ mṛtvā ca kiṃ bhavet ..3.54.34..

trividhāḫ puruṣās santi dehasyānte mumūrṣavaḥ .
mūrkho 'tha dhāraṇābhyāsī yuktimān puruṣas tathā ..3.54.35..

abhyasya dhāraṇāś ceṣṭā dehaṃ tyaktvā yathāsukham .
prayāti dhāraṇābhyāsī yuktiyuktas tathaiva ca ..3.54.36..

dhāraṇā yasya nābhyāsaṃ prāptā naiva sa muktibhāk .
mūrkhas svamṛtikāle 'sau duẖkham ety avaśāśayaḥ ..3.54.37..

vāsanāveśavaivaśyaṃ bhāvayan viṣayāśayaḥ .
dīnatāṃ paramām eti parilūnam ivāmbujam ..3.54.38..

aśāstrasaṃskṛtamatir asajjanaparāyaṇaḥ .
mṛtāv anubhavaty antar dāham agnāv iva cyutaḥ ..3.54.39..

yadā ghargharakaṇṭhatvaṃ vairūpyaṃ dṛṣṭivarṇajam .
gacchaty eṣa vināśātmā tadā bhavati dīnadhīḥ ..3.54.40..

paramaśyāmalāloko divābhyuditarātrikaḥ .
bhramaddiṅmaṇḍalābhogo ghanamecakitāmbaraḥ ..3.54.41..

marmavyathāvidhuritaḫ prabhramadvṛkṣamaṇḍalaḥ .
ākāśībhūtavasudho vasudhībhūtakhāntaraḥ ..3.54.42..

parivṛttakakupcakra uhyamāna ivārṇave .
nīyamāna ivākāśe ghananidronmukhāśayaḥ ..3.54.43..

andhakūpam ivāpannaś śilāntar iva yojitaḥ .
svayaṃ jaḍībhavajjihvo vikartita ivāśaye ..3.54.44..

patatīva nabhomārgād ghuṇāvarta ivārpitaḥ .
rathadruta ivārūḍho himavadgalanonmukhaḥ ..3.54.45..

jyotkurvann iva saṃsāraṃ vahnimadhyaṃ spṛśann iva .
bhramitaẖ kṣepaṇeṇaiva vātayantra iva sthitaḥ ..3.54.46..

bhramito vā bhrama iva kṛṣṭo raśanayeva vā .
bhramann iva jalāvarte śastrayantra ivārpitaḥ ..3.54.47..

prohyamānas tṛṇam iva mahaty arṇavamārute .
dūroḍho vāripūreṇa nipatann iva vāḍave ..3.54.48..

anantagagane śvabhre cakrāvarte patann iva .
adridyūrvīviparyāsadaśām anubhavan sthitaḥ ..3.54.49..

patann ivānavarataṃ protpatann iva vābhitaḥ .
ghūtkārākarṇanodbhrāntaḫ pūrṇasarvendriyavrajaḥ ..3.54.50..

kramāc chyāmalatāṃ yānti tasya sarvārthasaṃvidaḥ .
yathāstaṅgacchanti ravau mandālokatayā diśaḥ ..3.54.51..

pūrvāparaṃ na jānāti smṛtis tānavam āgatā .
yathā pāścātyasandhyānte naṣṭā dṛṣṭir digaṣṭake ..3.54.52..

manaẖkalpanasāmarthyaṃ jahāty asya vimohitaḥ .
avivekena tenāsau mahāmohe nimajjati ..3.54.53..

yadeṣanmoham ādatte nādatte pavanas tadā .
na tv ādatte yathā prāṇān moham āyāty alaṃ tadā ..3.54.54..

anyo'nyaṃ puṣṭatāṃ yātair mohāt saṃvedanabhramaiḥ .
jantuḫ pāṣāṇatām eti sthitam ity ādisargataḥ ..3.54.55..

vyathāṃ vimohaṃ mūrchāṃ ca bhramaṃ vyādhim acetanam .
kim artham ayam āyāti deho khaṇḍāṅgavān api ..3.54.56..

evaṃ saṃviditaṃ karma sargādau spandanaṃ vidaḥ .
yady asmin samaye duẖkhaṃ kālenaitāvatedṛśam ..3.54.57..

syāt kacaty eva viṭapagucchavat tat svabhāvajam .
vetti cittvavijṛmbhotthaṃ nānyad atrāsti kāraṇam ..3.54.58..

yadā vyathāvaśān nāḍyas svasaṅkocavikāsane .
tyajanti maruto dehāt pariyānti nijāṃ sthitim ..3.54.59..

praviṣṭā na viniryānti niryātāḫ praviśanti no .
yadā vātā vināḍitvāt tadāspandān mṛtir bhavet ..3.54.60..

na viśaty eva vā naiva niryāti pavano yadā .
śarīrān nāḍivaidhurye mṛta ity ucyate tadā ..3.54.61..

āgantavyaṃ mayā nāśaṃ kālenaitāvateti yā .
pūrvaṃ saṃviditā saṃvid yāti taccoditā mṛtim ..3.54.62..

īdṛśena mayehetthaṃ bhāvyam ity ādisargajā .
saṃvid bījakalānāśaṃ na kadācana gacchati ..3.54.63..

saṃvido vedanaṃ nāma svabhāvo 'vyatirekavān .
tasmāt svabhāvasaṃvitter nānyan maraṇajanmanī ..3.54.64..

kvacid āvartavad daussthyaṃ kvacin nadyāṃ jalaṃ yathā .
kvacit saumyaṃ kvacij jīvadharmīdaṃ cetanaṃ tathā ..3.54.65..

yathā latāyāḫ parvāṇi dīrghāyā madhyamadhyataḥ .
tathā cetanasattāyā janmāni maraṇāni ca ..3.54.66..

na jāyate na mriyate cetanaṃ puruṣaẖ kvacit .
svapnasambhramavad bhrāntam etat paśyati kevalam ..3.54.67..

puruṣaś cetanāmātraṃ sa kadā kveva naśyati .
cetanavyatiriktaṃ ca vadānyat kiṃ pumān bhavet ..3.54.68..

kvādya yāvan mṛtaṃ brūhi cetanaṃ kasya kiṃ katham .
mriyante dehalakṣāṇi cetanaṃ sthitam akṣayam ..3.54.69..

amariṣyat tu cec cittvam ekasminn eva tanmṛte .
abhaviṣyan sarva eva mṛtā ekamṛtāv iha ..3.54.70..

vāsanāmātravaicitryaṃ yaj jīvo 'nubhavet svayam .
tasyaiva janmamaraṇe nāmanī parikalpite ..3.54.71..

evaṃ na kiñcin mriyate jāyate na ca kaścana .
vāsanāvartagarteṣu jīvo luṭhati kevalam ..3.54.72..

atyantāsambhavād eva dṛśyasyāsau ca vāsanā .
nāsty eveti vicāreṇa dṛḍhajñāne vinaśyati ..3.54.73..

anuditam uditaṃ jagatprabandhaṃ
bhavabhayato vyasanair vilokya samyak .
alam anuditavāsano hi jīvo
bhavati vimukta itīha satyam astu ..3.54.74..

yathaiṣa jantur mriyate jāyate ca yathā punaḥ .
tan me kathaya deveśi punar bodhavivṛddhaye ..3.55.1..

nāḍīpravāhe vidhure yadā vātavisaṃsthatām .
jantuḫ prāpnoti hi tadā śāmyatīvāsya cetanam ..3.55.2..

śuddhaṃ hi cetanaṃ nityaṃ nodeti na ca śāmyati .
sthāvare jaṅgame vyomni śaile 'gnau pavane sthitam ..3.55.3..

kevalaṃ vātasaṃrodhād yadā spandaḫ praśāmyati .
mṛta ity ucyate dehas tadā sa jaḍanāmakaḥ ..3.55.4..

tasmin dehe śavībhūte vāte khānilatāṃ gate .
cetanaṃ vāsanāyuktaṃ khātma tatraiva tiṣṭhati ..3.55.5..

jīva ity ucyate tasya nāmāṇor vāsanāvataḥ .
tatraivāste sa ca śavāgāre gaganake tathā ..3.55.6..

tato 'sau pretaśabdena procyate vyavahāribhiḥ .
cetano vāsanāmiśras sāmodānilavat sthitaḥ ..3.55.7..

idaṃ sarvaṃ parityajya yadāste darśanāntare .
sa svapna iva saṅkalpa iva nānākṛtis tadā ..3.55.8..

tasminn eva pradeśe 'ntaḫ pūrvavat smṛtibhāg bhavet .
tadaiva mṛtimūrchānte paśyaty anyac charīrakam ..3.55.9..

ātmany asthighaṭāpuṣṭam anyasya vyoma kevalam .
ādhāre bhūtale sārkam ākāśajanavāsanam ..3.55.10..

bhavanti yadvidhāḫ pretās teṣāṃ bhedam imaṃ śṛṇu .
sāmānyapāpino madhyapāpinas sthūlapāpinaḥ ..3.55.11..

sāmānyadharmā madhyasthadharmā cottamadharmavān .
eteṣāṃ kasyacid bhedo dvau trayo 'py atha kasyacit ..3.55.12..

kaścin mahāpātakavān vatsarān mṛtimūrchanām .
vimūḍho 'nubhavaty antaḫ pāṣāṇahṛdayopamām ..3.55.13..

tataẖ kālena sambuddho vāsanājaṭharoditam .
anubhūya ciraṃ kālaṃ vāsanāduẖkham akṣatam ..3.55.14..

bhuktvā yoniśatāny uccair duẖkhād duẖkhāntaraṃ gataḥ .
kadācid imam āyāti saṃsārasvapnavibhramam ..3.55.15..

atha vā mṛtimohānte jaḍāṃ duẖkhaśatākulāṃ .
kṣaṇād vṛkṣāditām eva hṛtsthām anubhavanti te ..3.55.16..

svavāsanānurūpāṇi duẖkhāni narake punaḥ .
anubhūyātha yonīṣu jāyante bhūtale cirāt ..3.55.17..

atha madhyamapāpo yo mṛtimohād anantaram .
sa śilājaṭharaṃ jāḍyaṃ kañcit kālaṃ prapaśyati ..3.55.18..

tataḫ prabudhya kālena kenacid vā tathaiva vā .
tiryagādikramair bhuktvā yonīs saṃsāram eṣyati ..3.55.19..

mṛta evānubhavati kaścit sāmānyapātakī .
svavāsanānusāreṇa dehaṃ sampannam akṣatam ..3.55.20..

saṅkalpa iva saṅkalpa iva vetti sa tādṛśam .
tasminn eva kṣaṇe tasya smṛtir ittham udety api ..3.55.21..

ye tūttamamahāpuṇyamṛtimohād anantaram .
svargaṃ vidyādharapuraṃ smṛtyāsv anubhavanti te ..3.55.22..

tato 'nyakarmasadṛśaṃ bhuktvānyatra nijaṃ phalam .
jāyante mānuṣe loke saśrīke sajjanāspade ..3.55.23..

ye 'tha madhyamadharmāṇo mṛtimohād anantaram .
ta ihottāraṃ kurvantas sthitaṃ paśyanti dehakam ..3.55.24..

ye 'tha sāmānyadharmāṇo mṛtimohād anantaram .
te vyomavāyuvalitāḫ prayānty oṣadhipallavān ..3.55.25..

tatra cāruphalaṃ bhūtvā praviśya hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām .
tatas tām adhitiṣṭhanti garbhe jātikramodite ..3.55.26..

svavāsanānusāreṇa pretā etāṃ vyavasthitiṃ .
mūrchānte 'nubhavanty antaẖ krameṇaivākrameṇa ca ..3.55.27..

ādau mṛtā vayam iti budhyante tadanukramāt .
bandhupiṇḍādidānena protpannā iti vedinaḥ ..3.55.28..

tato yamabhaṭā ete kālapāśānvitās tathā .
nīyamāno vrajāmy ebhiẖ kṣaṇād yamapuraṃ tv iti ..3.55.29..

udyānāni vimānāni śobhanāni punaḫ punaḥ .
svakarmabhir upāttāni puṇyānīty eva puṇyavān ..3.55.30..

imāni kaṇṭakaśvabhraśastrapattravanāni ca .
svakarmaduṣkṛtotthāni saṃprāptānīti pāpavān ..3.55.31..

iyaṃ me saumyasaṃpātā dharaṇiś śītaśādvalā .
snigdhacchāyāsavāpīkā purassaṃstheti madhyamaḥ ..3.55.32..

ayaṃ prāpto yamapuram ayam eṣa sa bhūtapaḥ .
ayaṃ karmavicāro me kṛta ity anubhūtimān ..3.55.33..

iti pratyekam abhyeti pṛthus saṃsāraṣaṇḍakaḥ .
yathāsaṃsthitaniśśeṣapadārthācārabhāsuraḥ ..3.55.34..

ākāśa eva niśśūnye śūnyātmaivaṃ vibhodhavān .
deśakālakriyādairghyabhāsuro 'pi na kiñcana ..3.55.35..

ito 'yam aham ādiṣṭas svakarmaphalabhojane .
gacchāmy āśu śubhaṃ svargam ito narakam eva vā ..3.55.36..

ayaṃ svargo mayā bhukto bhukto 'yaṃ narako 'thavā .
imās tā yonayo tyaktā jāye 'haṃ saṃsṛtau punaḥ ..3.55.37..

ayaṃ śālir ahaṃ jātaẖ kramāt phalam iha sthitam .
ity udarkaprabodhena buddhyamāno bhaviṣyati ..3.55.38..

saṃsuptavāsanas tv evaṃ bījatāṃ yāty asau nare .
tadbījaṃ yonigalitaṃ garbho bhavati mātari ..3.55.39..

sa garbho jāyate loke pūrvakarmānusārataḥ .
bhavyo bhavaty abhavyo vā bālako lalitākṛtiḥ ..3.55.40..

tato 'nubhavatīdaṃ hi yauvanaṃ madanonmukham .
tato jarāṃ padmamukhe himāśanim iva cyutām ..3.55.41..

tato 'pi vyādhimaraṇaṃ punar maraṇamūrchanam .
punas svapnavad āyātaṃ piṇḍair dehaparigraham ..3.55.42..

yāmyaṃ yāti punar lokaṃ punar enaṃ bhramakramam .
bhūyo bhūyo 'nubhavati vyomny eva vyomarūpavān ..3.55.43..

ādisarge yathā devi bhrama eva pravartate .
tathā kathaya me bhūyaḫ prasādād bodhavṛddhaye ..3.55.44..

paramārthaghanaṃ śailāḫ paramārthaghanaṃ drumāḥ .
paramārthaghanaṃ pṛthvī paramārthaghanaṃ nabhaḥ ..3.55.45..

sarvātmakatvāt sa yato yathodeti cidīśvaraḥ .
paramākāśaśuddhātmā tathā tatra bhavaty alam ..3.55.46..

sargādau svapnapuruṣanyāyenādiprajāpatiḥ .
yathā sphuratprakacitas tathādyāpi sthitā sthitiḥ ..3.55.47..

prathamo 'sau praticchandaḫ padārthānāṃ hi bimbakam .
pratibimbitam etasmād yat tad adyāpi saṃsthitam ..3.55.48..

yan nāma suśiraṃ sthānaṃ dehānāṃ tadgato 'nilaḥ .
karoty aṅgaparispandaṃ jīvatīty ucyate tataḥ ..3.55.49..

sargādāv eva me vaiṣā jaṅgame 'dhiṣṭhitā sthitiḥ .
cetanā api nisspandās tena te pādapādayaḥ ..3.55.50..

cidākāśo 'yam evāṃśaṃ kurute cetanoditam .
sa eva saṃvid bhavati śeṣaṃ tad api naiva tat ..3.55.51..

naro yadi khuraprāntaṃ cetaty akṣipaṭaṃ na tu .
tat tasya nākṣiṇirjīvaṃ nājīvaty eva sarvataḥ ..3.55.52..

tathā khaṃ khatayā bhūmir bhūmitvenāptayā jalam .
yad yathā cetati svairaṃ tad vetty eva tathāvapuḥ ..3.55.53..

iti sarvaśarīreṇa jaṅgamatvena jaṅgamam .
sthāvaraṃ sthāvaratvena sarvātmā bhāvayan sthitaḥ ..3.55.54..

tasmād yaj jaṅgamaṃ nāma tat sacopanarūpadhṛt .
tena buddhaṃ tatas tadvat tad evādyāpi saṃsthitam ..3.55.55..

yaj jaḍābhidham ābuddhaṃ sthāvaraṃ tena vai punaḥ .
jaḍam adyāpi saṃviddhi śilātarutṛṇādi tat ..3.55.56..

na tu jāḍyaṃ pṛthak kiñcid asti nāpi ca cetanam .
nāsti bhedo 'tra sargādau sattāsāmānyakena tu ..3.55.57..

vṛkṣāṇām upalānāṃ yā nāmāntassthās svasaṃvidaḥ .
buddhyādīnīhitāny eva tāni teṣām iha sthitiḥ ..3.55.58..

vido 'ntas sthāvarāder yās tasyā buddhyādayo hi te .
anyābhidhānās tv anyārthās saṅketair aparais sthitāḥ ..3.55.59..

krimikīṭapataṅgānāṃ yeṣām antas svasaṃvidaḥ .
tāny eva teṣāṃ buddhyādīny anyābhikhyārthakāni tu ..3.55.60..

yathottarābdhijanatā dakṣiṇābdhijanasthitim .
na kiñcid api jānāti nijasaṃvedanād ṛte ..3.55.61..

svasaṃjñānubhave līnās tathā sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ .
parasparajaḍās sarve svasaṅketaparāyaṇāḥ ..3.55.62..

yathā śilāntassaṃsthānāṃ bahissthānāṃ ca vedanam .
asaj jaḍaṃ ca bhekānāṃ mitho'ntas tasthuṣāṃ tathā ..3.55.63..

tatra sarvagataṃ cittvāc cidvyomnā yat pracetitam .
sargādau copanaṃ vāyus sa ihādyāpi saṃsthitaḥ ..3.55.64..

viditaṃ yat tu sauśiryaṃ tan nabhas tatra mārutaḥ .
spandātmetyādi sa mahān padārtheṣv iti copanam ..3.55.65..

cittvaṃ tu paramārthena sthāvare jaṅgame sthitam .
copanāny anilair eva bhavanti na bhavanti ca ..3.55.66..

evaṃ bhrāntimayaṃ viśvaṃ padārthās saṃvidaṃśavaḥ .
sargādiṣu yathaivāsaṃs tathaivādyāpi saṃsthitāḥ ..3.55.67..

yathā viśvapadārthānāṃ svabhāvasya vijṛmbhaṇam .
asatyam eva satyābhaṃ tad etat kathitaṃ tava ..3.55.68..

ayam astaṅgataprāyaḫ paśya rājā vidūrathaḥ .
mālāśavasya padmasya patyus te yāti hṛdguhām ..3.55.69..

kena mārgeṇa deveśi yāntyau vai śavamaṇḍapam .
enam evāśu paśantyāv āvāṃ gacchāva uttame ..3.55.70..

manuṣyavāsanāntassthaṃ mārgam āśritya gacchati .
eṣo 'ham aparaṃ lokaṃ dūraṃ yāmīti cinmayam ..3.55.71..

mārgeṇāvāsanenaiva yā vas tenaiva sammatam .
parasparecchā saṃvittir na hi sauhārdabandhinī ..3.55.72..

iti vihitakathāśamakramāyāṃ
paramadṛśi prasṛte prabodhabhānau .
nṛpativarasutāmanasy udāre
vigalitavij jaraḍho vidūratho 'bhūt ..3.55.73..

etasminn antare rājā parivṛttākṣitārakaḥ .
babhūvaikatanuprāṇas sadyaś śuṣkasitādharaḥ ..3.56.1..

jīrṇaparṇasavarṇābhaẖ kṣīṇapāṇḍumukhacchaviḥ .
bhṛṅgakūjitasacchāyāśvāsakūṭāvikūṇitaḥ ..3.56.2..

mahāmaraṇamūrchāndhakūpe nipatitāśayaḥ .
antarnilīnaniśśeṣanetrādīndriyavṛttimān ..3.56.3..

citranyasta ivākāramātradṛśyo vicetanaḥ .
nisspandasarvāvayavas samutkīrṇa ivopale ..3.56.4..

bahunātra kim uktena tāludeśena taṃ jahau .
prāṇaḫ pipatiṣuṃ vṛkṣaṃ supakṣīvāntarikṣagaḥ ..3.56.5..

taṃ te dadṛśatur bāle divyadṛṣṭī nabhogatam .
jīvaṃ prāṇamayaṃ saṃvidgandhaleśam ivānile ..3.56.6..

sā jīvasaṃvid gaganavātenāvalitā satī .
khe dūraṃ gantum ārebhe vāsanānuvidhāyinī ..3.56.7..

tām evānusasārātha strīdvayaṃ jīvasaṃvidam .
bhramarīyugalaṃ vātalagnāṃ gandhakalām iva ..3.56.8..

tato muhūrtamātreṇa śānte maraṇamūrchane .
sāmbare bubudhe saṃvid gandhalekheva vayunā ..3.56.9..

apaśyat puruṣān yāmyān nīyamānaṃ ca tair vapuḥ .
bandhupiṇḍapradānena śarīraṃ jātam ātmanaḥ ..3.56.10..

mārge karmaphalollāsavati dūratare sthitam .
vaivasvatapuraṃ gantuṃ pravṛttam anivāritam ..3.56.11..

prāptaṃ vaivasvatapuram ādiṣṭaṃ ca tato yathā .
asya karmāṇy aśubhrāṇi naiva santi kadācana ..3.56.12..

nityam evāvadātānāṃ kartāyaṃ śubhakarmaṇām .
bhagavatyās sarasvatyā vareṇāyaṃ vivardhitaḥ ..3.56.13..

prāktano 'sya śavībhūto deho 'sti kusumāmbaraḥ .
praviśatv eṣa taṃ gatvā tyajyatām ity avekṣya saḥ ..3.56.14..

tatas tyakto nabhomārgaṃ yantropala iva plutaḥ .
atha jīvakalā līlā jñaptiś ceti trayaṃ nabhaḥ ..3.56.15..

pupluve jīvalekhā tv arūpiṇy ete na paśyati .
tam evānusarantyau te samullaṅghya nabhastalam ..3.56.16..

lokāntarāṇy atītyātha vinirgatya jagadgṛhāt .
dvitīyaṃ jagad āsādya bhūmaṇḍalam upetya ca ..3.56.17..

kānte saṅkalparūpiṇyau saṅgate jīvalekhayā .
padmarājapuraṃ prāpya līlāntaḫpuramaṇḍapam ..3.56.18..

kṣaṇād viviśatus svairaṃ vāyulekhe yathāmbudam .
sūryātapo yathāmbhojaṃ sugandhaḫ pavanaṃ yathā ..3.56.19..

brahman prāptaḫ katham asau śavasya nikaṭaṃ gṛham .
kathaṃ tena parijñāto mārgo mṛtaśarīriṇā ..3.56.20..

tasya svavāsanāntasstham avaśyaṃ kila rāghava .
tat sarvaṃ hṛdgataṃ tasmān māsau prāpnotu tat katham ..3.56.21..

bhrāntimātram asaṅkhyeyaṃ jagajjīvakaṇodare .
bīje vaṭatarum iva sthitaṃ ko vai na paśyati ..3.56.22..

svabhāvabhūtaṃ cidaṇus trailokyanicayaṃ tathā .
naro yathaikadeśastho dūradeśāntarasthitam ..3.56.23..

saṃpaśyati nidhānaṃ svaṃ manasānārataṃ sadā .
yathā jīvadvapur jīvamakuraṃ hṛdi paśyati ..3.56.24..

tathā svavāsanāntasstham abhīṣṭhaṃ paripaśyati .
jīvo jātiśatāḍhyo 'pi bhrame parigato 'pi vā ..3.56.25..

bhagavan piṇḍadānādivāsanārahitākṛtiḥ .
kīdṛk saṃpadyate dehaḫ piṇḍo yasmai na dīyate ..3.56.26..

piṇḍo 'tha dīyatāṃ mātre piṇḍo datto mameti cet .
vāsanā hṛdi saṃrūḍhā tat piṇḍaphalabhāṅ naraḥ ..3.56.27..

yaccittas tanmayo jantur bhavatīty anubhūtayaḥ .
sadeheṣu videheṣu na bhavanty anyathā kvacit ..3.56.28..

sapiṇḍo 'smīti saṃvittyā niṣpiṇḍo 'pi hi piṇḍavān .
niṣpiṇḍo 'smīti saṃvittyā sapiṇḍo 'pi na piṇḍavān ..3.56.29..

yathābhāvanam eteṣāṃ padārthānāṃ hi satyatā .
bhāvanā ca padārthebhyaẖ kāraṇebhya udeti hi ..3.56.30..

yathā vāsanayā jantor viṣam apy amṛtāyate .
asatyas satyatām eti padārtho bhāvanāt tathā ..3.56.31..

kāraṇena vinodeti na kadācana kasyacit .
kāryatā kācid api bho iti niścayavān bhava ..3.56.32..

kāraṇena vinā kāryam ā mahāpralayaṃ kvacit .
na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ kiñcit svayaṃ svaikatayā ṛte ..3.56.33..

vid eva vāsanā saiva dhatte svapna ivārthatām .
kāryakāraṇatām eti saivam anyeva tiṣṭhati ..3.56.34..

dharmo nāsti mamety eva yaḫ preto vāsanānvitaḥ .
tasya cet suhṛdā bhūridharmā kṛtvā samarpitaḥ ..3.56.35..

tatra cātra sa kiṃ dharmo naṣṭas syād uta bhāvanam .
satyārthād vāpy asatyārthād bhāvanāt kiṃ balādhikam ..3.56.36..

deśakālakriyādravyasampadbhyaś ceti bhāvanā .
yatraivābhyuditā sāmyāt sa dvayor adhiko jayī ..3.56.37..

dharmadātuḫ pravṛddhā ced vāsanā tat tayā kṣaṇāt .
āpūryate pretamatir no cet pretadhiyāśu sā ..3.56.38..

evaṃ parasparajayo jayaty atrātivīryavān .
tasmāc chubhena yatnena śubhābhyāsam upāharet ..3.56.39..

deśakālādhikā brahman vāsanā samudeti cet .
tan mahākalpasargādau deśakālodayaẖ kutaḥ ..3.56.40..

kāraṇais samudetīdaṃ kais tadā sahakāribhiḥ .
sahakārikāraṇānām abhāve vāsanā kutaḥ ..3.56.41..

evam etan mahābhāga satyātmani kadācana .
mahāpralayasargādau deśakālādi kiñcana ..3.56.42..

sahakārikāraṇānām abhāve sati dṛśyadhīḥ .
neyam asti na cotpannā na ca sphurati kācana ..3.56.43..

dṛśyasyāsambhavād dhetoẖ kiñcid yad dṛśyate tv idam .
tad brahmaiva kacadrūpaṃ sthitam ittham anāmayam ..3.56.44..

etac cāgre yuktiśataiẖ kathayiṣyāma eva te .
etadarthaṃ prayatno 'yaṃ vartamānakathāṃ śṛṇu ..3.56.45..

tat te dadṛśatuḫ prāpte mandiraṃ sundarodaram .
kīrṇaṃ puṣpopakāreṇa vasantam iva śītalam ..3.56.46..

prabhātācārasārambharājadhānyāṃ samaṃ sthitam .
mandārakundasragdāmavṛndāmbaravalacchavam ..3.56.47..

śavaśayyāśirassthāgryapūrṇakumbhādimaṅgalam .
anivṛttagṛhadvāragavākṣakaṭhinārgalam ..3.56.48..

praśāmyaddīpikālokaśyāmalāmalabhittikam .
gṛhaikadeśasaṃsuptamukhaśvāsasasītkṛtam ..3.56.49..

sampūrṇacandraśakalodarakāntikānta-
saundaryanirjitapurandaramandirarddhi .
vairiñcapadmamukulāntaracāruśobhā
niśśabdam abdam iva nirmalam indukāntam ..3.56.50..

tato dadṛśatus tatra śavaśayyaikapārśvagām .
līlāṃ vidūrathasyāgre mṛtāṃ tāṃ prathamāgatām ..3.57.1..

prāgveṣāṃ prāksamācārāṃ prāgdehāṃ prāksvavāsanām .
prāktanākārasadṛśasarvarūpāṅgasundarīm ..3.57.2..

prāksmṛtyavayavaspandāṃ prāgambaraparāvṛtām .
prāgbhūṣaṇabharacchannāṃ kevalaṃ tatra saṃsthitām ..3.57.3..

gṛhītacāmarāṃ cāru vījayantīṃ mahīpatim .
maunasthāṃ vāmahastasthavadanendutayānatām ..3.57.4..

bhūṣaṇāṃśulatāpuṣpaiḫ phullām iva vanasthalīm .
kurvāṇāṃ vīkṣaṇair dikṣu mālatyutpalavarṣaṇam ..3.57.5..

sṛjantīm ātmalāvaṇyād bindūn indūn ivoditān .
narādhipātmano viṣṇor lakṣmīm iva samāgatām ..3.57.6..

uditāṃ puṣpasambhārād iva puṣpākaraśriyam .
bhartur vadanavinyastadṛṣṭim iva viceṣṭitām ..3.57.7..

kiñcitpramlānavadanāṃ mlānacandrāṃ niśām iva .
tābhyāṃ sā lalanā dṛṣṭā tayā te tu na lakṣite .
yasmāt te satyasaṅkalpe sā na tāvat tathoditā ..3.57.8..

tasmin pradeśe sā pūrvalīlā saṃsthāpya dehakam .
dhyānena jñaptisahitā gatābhūd iti varṇitam ..3.57.9..

kim idānīṃ ca līlā yā dehas tatra na varṇitaḥ .
kiṃ sampannaẖ kva vāyāta iti me kathaya prabho ..3.57.10..

kvāsīl līlāśarīraṃ tat kutas tasya hi satyatā .
sā kila bhrāntir evābhūj jalabuddhir marāv iva ..3.57.11..

yathaiva bodhe līlāsau pariṇāmam itā kramāt .
pare tathaiva tasyās tad dhimavadgalitaṃ vapuḥ ..3.57.12..

ātivāhikadehasya kālenābhyudito bhramaḥ .
ādhibhautikadeho 'ham iti rajjubhujaṅgavat ..3.57.13..

ātivāhikadehena dṛśyaṃ yad avakalpitam .
bhūmyādi nāma tasyaiva kṛtaṃ tat tv ādhibhautikam ..3.57.14..

vāstavena tu rūpeṇa bhūmyādyātmādhibhautikaḥ .
na śabdena na cārthena śabdārthau śaśaśṛṅgavat ..3.57.15..

puṃso hariṇako 'smīti svapne yasyoditā matiḥ .
sa kim anviṣyati mṛgaṃ svamṛgatvaparikṣaye ..3.57.16..

udety asatyam evāśu tathāsatyam pralīyate .
bhrāntir hi bhramato rajjvām iva sarpatvasaṅgrahe ..3.57.17..

samastasyāprabuddhasya manojātasya kasyacit .
viḍambena dṛg eveyaṃ mithyārūḍhim upāgatā ..3.57.18..

svapnopalambhaṃ sargākhyaṃ svaṃ sarvo 'nubhavan sthitaḥ .
ciram āvṛttadehātmā bhūcakrasphuraṇaṃ yathā ..3.57.19..

brahmaṃl lokaiḫ purassthasya gacchato yogino nijām .
ātivāhikatāṃ dehaẖ kīdṛśo 'yaṃ vilokyate ..3.57.20..

dehād dehāntaraprāptiḫ pūrvadehavināśadā .
ātivāhikadehe hi svapneṣv iva vikasvarā ..3.57.21..

yathātāpe himakaṇaś śaradvyomni sito 'mbudaḥ .
dṛśyamāno 'py adṛśyatvam ety evaṃ yogidehakaḥ ..3.57.22..

jhagity evāthavā kaścid yogideho na lakṣyate .
sayogibhiḫ puro vegāt proḍḍīna iva khe khagaḥ ..3.57.23..

svavāsanākrameṇaiva kvacit kecit kadācana .
mṛto 'yam iti paśyanti kaṃcid yoginam agragāḥ ..3.57.24..

bhrāntimātraṃ tu dehātma teṣāṃ tad upaśāmyati .
satyabodhena rajjūnāṃ sarpabuddhir ivātmani ..3.57.25..

ko dehaẖ kasya vā sattā kasya nāśaẖ kathaṃ kutaḥ .
sthiraṃ tad evaṃ yad abhūd abodhaẖ kevalaṃ gataḥ ..3.57.26..

ātivāhikatāṃ yāti ādhibhautika eva kim .
utānya iti me brūhi yenohya iva na prabho ..3.57.27..

bahuśo 'py uktam etan me na gṛhṇāsi kim uttaram .
ātivāhika evāsti nāsty evehādhibhautikaḥ ..3.57.28..

tasyaivābhyāsato 'bhyeti sādhibhautikatāmatiḥ .
yadā śāmyati saivāsya tadā pūrvā pravartate ..3.57.29..

tadā gurutvaṃ kāṭhinyaṃ bhittimattvaṃ mudhāgrahaḥ .
śāmyet svapne narasyeva boddhur bodhān nirāmayāt ..3.57.30..

laghutūlasamāpattis tatas samupajāyate .
svapne svapnaparijñānād yathā deho laghūbhavet ..3.57.31..

tathā bodhād ayaṃ dehas sthūlavat plutimān bhavet .
anekadinasaṅkalpadehe pariṇatātmanām ..3.57.32..

asmin dehe śave dagdhe tatraiva sthitim īyuṣām .
laghudehānubhavanam avaśyaṃbhāvi vai tathā ..3.57.33..

prabodhātiśayād eti jīvatām api yoginām .
uditāyāṃ smṛtau tatra saṅkalpātmāham ity alam ..3.57.34..

yādṛśas sa bhaved dehas tādṛśo 'yaṃ prabodhinaḥ .
bhrāntir evam iyaṃ bhāti rajjvām iva bhujaṅgatā .
kiṃ naṣṭam asyāṃ naṣṭāyāṃ jātāyāṃ kiṃ prajāyate ..3.57.35..

anantaraṃ te vāstavyā līle paśyanti te yadi .
tat satyasaṅkalpatayā budhyante kiṃ tataḫ prabho ..3.57.36..

evaṃ jñāsyanti te rājñī duẖkhiteyam iha sthitā .
vayasyā kācid anyeyaṃ kuto 'py asyā upāgatā ..3.57.37..

sandehaẖ ka ivātraiṣāṃ paśavo hy avivekinaḥ .
yathādṛṣṭaṃ viceṣṭante kuta eṣāṃ vicāraṇā ..3.57.38..

yathā loṣṭo luṭhan vṛkṣaṃ vañcayitvāśu gacchati .
ajñātvaivājñajanatā tathādryagnisurādikam ..3.57.39..

yathā svapnavapur bodhena jāne kveva gacchati .
asatyam eva tad yasmāt tathaivehādhibhautikam ..3.57.40..

bhagavan svapnaśikharī prabodhe kveva gacchati .
iti me saṃśayaṃ chindhi śaradabhram ivānilaḥ ..3.57.41..

svapne bhrame 'tha saṅkalpe padārthāḫ parvatādayaḥ .
saṃvido 'ntar milanty ete spandanāny anilaṃ yathā ..3.57.42..

aspandasya yathā vāyos svaspando 'ntar viśaty alam .
asphurantī tu tenaiva yāty ekatvaṃ tadātmikā ..3.57.43..

saṃvitsvapnārthayor dvitvaṃ na kadācana labhyate .
yathā dravatvapayasor yathā vā spandavātayoḥ ..3.57.44..

yas tv atra syād dvitābodhas tad ajñānam anuttamam .
saiṣā saṃsṛtir ity uktā mithyājñānātmikoditā ..3.57.45..

sahakārikāraṇānām abhāve kila kīdṛśī .
saṃvit svapnapadārthānāṃ dvitvaṃ svapne nirarthakam ..3.57.46..

yathā svapnas tathā jāgrad idaṃ nātrāsti saṃśayaḥ .
svapne puram asad bhāti sargādau bhāti asaj jagat ..3.57.47..

na cārtho bhavituṃ śaktas satyatve svapnacoditaḥ .
saṃvido nityasatyatvaṃ svapnārthānām asatyatā ..3.57.48..

jhagity eva yathākāśaṃ bhavati svapnaparvataḥ .
krameṇa vā tathā bodhe khaṃ bhavaty ādhibhautikaḥ ..3.57.49..

uḍḍīno 'yaṃ mṛto veti paśyanti nikaṭe sthitāḥ .
jñānātivāhikībhūtasvasvabhāvahatā yataḥ ..3.57.50..

mithyādṛṣṭaya evemās sṛṣṭayo mohadṛṣṭayaḥ .
māyāmātradṛśo bhānti śūnyās svapnānubhūtayaḥ ..3.57.51..

svapnānubhūtaya imā maraṇāntarbodha-
bhātetarabhramadṛśas sphuṭasargabhāsaḥ .
bhānty ātivāhikaśarīragatās samastā
mithyoditā mṛganadīmaraṇakrameṇa ..3.57.52..

etasminn antare jñaptir jīvaṃ vaidūrathaṃ puraḥ .
saṅkalpena rurodhāśu manasas spandanaṃ yathā ..3.58.1..

vada devi kiyat kālo gato 'yam iha mandire .
samādhau mayi līnāyāṃ mahīpālaśave sthite ..3.58.2..

iha māsas tv atikrānta iha dāsyāv ime ubhe .
rakṣārthaṃ vāsakagṛhe svapato vahite sthite ..3.58.3..

śṛṇu dehasya kiṃ vṛttaṃ taveha varavarṇini .
śarīraṃ kila pakṣeṇa cotklinnasnāyutāṃ gatam ..3.58.4..

nirjīvaṃ patitaṃ bhūmau saṃśuṣkam iva pallavam .
kāṣṭhakuḍyopasaṃjātaṃ śavaṃ tuhinaśītalam ..3.58.5..

tato mantribhir āgatya mṛtaiveyam iti svayam .
kledalokād vinirṇīya bhītyā niṣkālitaṃ gṛhāt ..3.58.6..

bahunātra kim uktena nītvā candanadārubhiḥ .
citau prakṣipya saghṛtaṃ sahasā bhasmasātkṛtam ..3.58.7..

tato rājñī mṛte 'tyuccaiẖ kṛtvā rodanam ākulaḥ .
parivāras tavāśeṣaẖ kṛtavān aurdhvadehikam ..3.58.8..

idānīṃ tvām ihālokya saśarīrām ihāgatām .
paralokād āgateti mahac citraṃ bhaviṣyati ..3.58.9..

tvaṃ tu tenaiva dehena satyasaṅkalpatas sute .
dṛśyase svavadātena tena cittaṃ tavopari ..3.58.10..

yadvāsanā tvam abhavo dehaṃ prati tad eva te .
rūpam abhyuditaṃ bāle tena prāksadṛśaṃ tava ..3.58.11..

svavāsanānusāreṇa sarvas sarvaṃ hi paśyati .
dṛṣṭānto 'trāvisaṃvādī bālavetāladarśanam ..3.58.12..

ātivāhakadehāsi sampannā siddhasundarī .
vismṛtas tava deho 'sau prāktano nayatas svayam ..3.58.13..

dṛḍhātivāhikadṛśaḫ praśāmyaty ādhibhautikaḥ .
buddhasya dṛśyamāno 'pi śaranmegha ivāmbare ..3.58.14..

rūḍhātivāhikībhāvaś śavo bhavati dehakaḥ .
nirjalāmbhodasadṛśo nirgandhakusumopamaḥ ..3.58.15..

adyārabhya prarūḍhāyām ātivāhikasaṃvidi .
deho vismṛtim āyāti garbhasaṃstheva yauvane ..3.58.16..

ekatriṃśe 'dya divase prāptā vayam ihāmbaram .
prabhāte mohite dāsyau mayaite nidrayādhunā ..3.58.17..

tad ehi yāval līlāyai līle saṅkalpalīlayā .
ātmānaṃ darśayāvo 'syai vyavahāraḫ pravartatām ..3.58.18..

āvāṃ tāvad ime līlā paśyatv ity eva cintite .
jñaptyā devyau tatas tatra dṛśye dīpte babhūvatuḥ ..3.58.19..

sā vidūrathalīlātha samākulavilocanā .
gṛham ālokayām āsa tat tejaḫpuñjabhāsuram ..3.58.20..

candrabimbād ivotkīrṇaṃ dhautaṃ hemadravair iva .
jvālāyā iva śītāyās sumadhyam iva bhittimat ..3.58.21..

gṛham ālokya purato līlājñaptī vilokyate .
utthāya sambhramavatī tayoḫ pādeṣu sāpatat ..3.58.22..

majjayāyāgate devyau jayataṃ jīvitaprade .
iha pūrvam ahaṃ prāptā bhavatyor mārgaśodhinī ..3.58.23..

ity uktavatyāṃ tasyāṃ tā māninyo mattayauvanāḥ .
upāviśan viṣṭareṣu latā meruśirassv iva ..3.58.24..

sute vada kathaṃ prāptā tvam imaṃ deśam āditaḥ .
kiṃ vṛttaṃ te tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ kim ivādhvani kutra vā ..3.58.25..

devi tasmin pradeśe sā jātamūrchā tadābhavam .
dvitīyendukalevāhaṃ kalpāntajvālayāvṛtā ..3.58.26..

na cetitaṃ mayā kiñcit samaṃ viṣamam eva vā .
tatas taralapakṣmānte vinimīlya vilocane ..3.58.27..

tato maraṇamūrchānte paśyāmi parameśvari .
yāvad abhyutthitāsmy āśu plutā ca gaganodaram ..3.58.28..

bhūtākāśe 'nilarathaṃ samārūḍhāsmy ahaṃ tathā .
ānītā gandhalekheva tenāham imam ālayam ..3.58.29..

iha paśyāmi sadanaṃ nāyakenābhyalaṅkṛtam .
dīptadīpaṃ viviktaṃ ca mahārhaśayanānvitam ..3.58.30..

patim ālokayāmīmaṃ yāvad eṣa vidūrathaḥ .
śete kusumaguptāṅgo madhuḫ puṣpavane yathā ..3.58.31..

atha saṅgrāmasaṃrambhaśramārto 'yaṃ svapity alam .
iti nidrā mayāsyaivaṃ deveśvari na vāritā ..3.58.32..

anantaram imaṃ deśaṃ prāpte devyāv ime tv iti .
yathānubhūtaṃ kathitaṃ madanugrahakāriṇi ..3.58.33..

he haṃsahārigāminyau līle lalitalocane .
utthāpayāmo nṛpatiṃ śavatalpatalād imam ..3.58.34..

sety uktvā mumuce jīvam āmodam iva padminī .
sa samīralavākāras tannāsānikaṭaṃ yayau ..3.58.35..

ghrāṇakośaṃ viveśāśu vaṃśarandhram ivānilaḥ .
svavāsanāśatāny antar dadhad abdhir maṇīn iva ..3.58.36..

antassthajīvaṃ vadanaṃ tasya tatkāntim āyayau .
padmasyāvagrahe padmaṃ praviṣṭam iva vāriṇi ..3.58.37..

kramād aṅgāni sarvāṇi sarasāni cakāśire .
tasya puṣpākara iva latājālāni būbhṛtaḥ ..3.58.38..

athābabhau kalāpūrṇas sa rākāyām ivoḍurāṭ .
bhāsayan bhavanaṃ bhūri vadanendumarīcibhiḥ ..3.58.39..

sphārayām āsa so 'ṅgāni rasavanti mṛdūni ca .
kanakojjvalakāntīni pallavānīva mādhavaḥ ..3.58.40..

unmīlayam āsa dṛśau vimalālokakāraṇe .
hāriṇyau subhagābhoge candrārkau bhuvanaṃ yathā ..3.58.41..

uttasthau prollasatkāyo vindhyādrir iva vṛddhimān .
uvāca kas sthita iha prabhākapiśitālayaḥ ..3.58.42..

līlādvayam athāsyāgre provācādiśyatām iti .
sa dadarśa puro namraṃ līlādvayam avasthitam ..3.58.43..

samādhāraṃ samākāraṃ samarūpaṃ samasthiti .
samavākyaṃ samodyogaṃ samānandaṃ samodayam ..3.58.44..

kā tvaṃ keyaṃ kutaś ceyam ity āha sa vilokayan .
tasmai līlāha he deva śrūyatāṃ yad vadāmy aham ..3.58.45..

mahilā tava līlāhaṃ prāktanī saha vardhitā .
vāg arthasyeva saṃsaktā sthitā saṃśleṣaśālinī ..3.58.46..

iyaṃ līlā dvitīyā te mahilā helayā mayā .
upārjitā tvadarthena kathayiṣye 'ham īdṛśam ..3.58.47..

śirobhāgopaviṣṭeyaṃ yeha hemamahāsanā .
eṣā sarasvatī devī trailokyajananī śivā ..3.58.48..

asmākaṃ puṇyasaṃbhārair iha sākṣād upāgatā .
anayāsi parāl lokād ihānīto mahīpatiḥ ..3.58.49..

ity ākarṇya samutthāya rājā rājīvalocanaḥ .
lambamālyāmbaradharaḫ papāta jñaptipādayoḥ ..3.58.50..

sarasvati namas tubhyaṃ sarvalokahitaprade .
prayaccha varade medhāṃ dīrgham āyur dhanāni ca ..3.58.51..

ity uktavantaṃ hastena pasparśa jñaptidevatā .
tvaṃ putrābhimatārthāḍhyo bhaveti vacanānvitaḥ ..3.58.52..

sarvāpadas sakaladuṣkṛtadṛṣṭayaś ca
gacchantu vaś śamam anantasukhāni samyak .
āyāntu nityamuditā janatā bhavantu
rāṣṭre sthirāś ca vilasantu sadaiva lakṣmyaḥ ..3.58.53..

sarasvatī tadetyuktvā tatraivāntardhim āyayau .
prabhāte paṅkajais sārdhaṃ bubudhe sakalo janaḥ ..3.59.1..

āliliṅga ghanaṃ līlāṃ līlā ca dayitaṃ kramāt .
punaḫ punar mahānando mṛtaprojjīvito nṛpaḥ ..3.59.2..

tadāsīd rājasadanaṃ madamanmathamantharaṃ .
ānandamattajanataṃ vādyageyaravākulam ..3.59.3..

jayamaṅgalapuṇyāhaghoṣaghuṅghumaghargharam .
hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇarājalokavṛtāṅganam ..3.59.4..

siddhavidyādharonmuktapuṣpavarṣasaśītkṛtam .
dhvananmṛdaṅgamurajakāhalāśaṅkhadundubhi ..3.59.5..

ūrdhvīkṛtabṛhaddhastahāstikastanitotkaṭam .
uttālatāṇḍavastraiṇapūrṇāṅganalasaddhvani ..3.59.6..

mithassaṅghaṭṭanipatannānopāyanadanturam .
puṣpaśekharasambhāramayasragdāmasundaram ..3.59.7..

vikīrṇapāṭitakṣaumaṃ mantrisāmantanāgaraiḥ .
sthalapadmamayaṃ vyoma raktais tāṇḍavinīkaraiḥ ..3.59.8..

mattastrīkandharāvṛttalīlāndolitakuṇḍalam .
pranṛttapādasampātapronnamatpuṣpakardamam ..3.59.9..

paṭavāsaśaranmeghavitānakavitānitam .
varāṅganāmukhair nṛtyaccandralakṣyagṛhājiram ..3.59.10..

paralokād upānīto rājñātmā patir eva ca .
ity evaṃ vṛttagāthābhir jagur deśāntare janāḥ ..3.59.11..

padmo bhūmipatiś śrutvā vṛttāntakathanaṃ manāk .
cakre snānaṃ samānītaiś catussāgaravāribhiḥ ..3.59.12..

tato 'bhiṣiṣicur viprā mantriṇo bhūbhujaś śatam .
labdhodayam ananteham amarendram ivāmarāḥ ..3.59.13..

līlā līlā ca rājātha jīvanmuktā mahādhiyaḥ .
remire pūrvavṛttāntakathanais suratair iva ..3.59.14..

sarasvatyāḫ prasādena svapauruṣakṛtena tat .
prāptaṃ lokadvayaṃ śreyaḫ padmeneti mahībhujā ..3.59.15..

prajñaptijñānasaṃbuddho rājā līlādvayānvitaḥ .
cakre varṣāyutāny aṣṭau tatra rājyam aninditam ..3.59.16..

jīvanmukto jitamanā jitapañcendriyabhramaḥ .
asaṃsaktamanā maunī yathāprāptānuvṛttimān ..3.59.17..

tasya lāvaṇyajaladher bindur indur ivoddhṛtaḥ .
tasya pratāpakalpāgner bhānuẖ kaṇa ivotthitaḥ ..3.59.18..

jīvanmuktās ta ity evaṃ rājyaṃ varṣāyutāṣṭakam .
kṛtvā videhamuktatvam āsedus siddhasaṃvidaḥ ..3.59.19..

yad udayi viśadaṃ vidagdhamugdhaṃ
samuditam ātmahitaṃ ca peśalaṃ ca .
tad akhilajanatoṣadaṃ svarājyaṃ
ciram anupālya sudampatī vimuktau ..3.59.19..

etat te kathitaṃ rāma dṛśyadoṣanivṛttaye .
līlopākhyānam anagha ghanatāṃ jagatas tyaja ..3.60.1..

śāntaiva dṛśyasattāsyāś śamanaṃ nopayujyate .
sato hi mārjanaṃ kleśo nāsatas tu kadācana ..3.60.2..

jñānenākāśarūpeṇa dṛśyaṃ jñeyaṃ kharūpakam .
ity ekībhūtam ālokya jñas tiṣṭhaty ambaropamaḥ ..3.60.3..

pṛthvyādirahitenedaṃ cidbhāsaiva svayambhuvā .
sādhitaṃ yad asiddhena tan na dvyātma na sādhitam ..3.60.4..

saṃvid yathā yā yatate sā tathā bāhyalekhikā .
visṛtā sṛṣṭicinnadyāṃ yāvad yatnān na bodhitā ..3.60.5..

cidākāśāvabhāso 'yaṃ jagad ity eva budhyate .
cidvyomnaivātmani svacche paramāṇukaṇaṃ prati ..3.60.6..

evam asyā mudhābhrānteẖ kā sattā keva vāsanā .
kāsthā kā niyatiẖ kehā kāvaśyambhāvitocyatām ..3.60.7..

sarvaṃ caitad yathādṛṣṭaṃ sthitam ittham akhaṇḍitam .
māyaivaivam ananteyaṃ na ca māyāsti kācana ..3.60.8..

aho nu paramā dṛṣṭir darśitā bhagavaṃs tvayā .
dāvārcirdṛśyakakṣyāṇāṃ dāhaśāntau kalaindavī ..3.60.9..

aho nu sucireṇaitaj jñātaṃ jñātavyam akṣatam .
mayā yathedaṃ yac cedaṃ yādṛk cedaṃ yato yadā ..3.60.10..

śāmyāmīva dvijaśreṣṭha nirvāmīvāvikalpanaḥ .
etad āścaryam ākhyānaṃ vyākhyānaṃ śāstradṛṣṭiṣu ..3.60.11..

idaṃ me bhagavan brūhi saṃśayaṃ sarvakovida .
tava pātuṃ na tṛpto 'smi śrotrapātrair vaco'mṛtam ..3.60.12..

sa sargatritaye kālo līlābhartur hi yogataḥ .
sa kvacit kim ahorātraẖ kvacit kiṃ māsamātrakaḥ ..3.60.13..

kvacit kiṃ bahuvarṣāṇi kasyacit kiṃ supelavaḥ .
kasyacit kiṃ mahādīrghaẖ kasyacit kiṃ kṣaṇasthitaḥ ..3.60.14..

iti me bhagavan brūhi tvaṃ yathāvad anugrahāt .
sakṛc chrutaṃ na viśrāntim eti loṣṭe yathā jalam ..3.60.15..

yena yena yadā yad yad yathā saṃvedyate 'nagha .
tena tena tadā tat tat tathā samanubhūyate ..3.60.16..

amṛtatvaṃ viṣaṃ yāti sadaivāmṛtavedanāt .
śatrur mitratvam āyāti mitrasaṃvittivedanāt ..3.60.17..

yathābhāvitam eteṣāṃ padārthānāṃ nijaṃ vapuḥ .
tad eva hi cirābhyāsān niyater vaśam āgatam ..3.60.18..

kacanaikātmikaiṣā cid yathā kacati yādṛśam .
tathā tatrāśu bhavati tat svabhāvaikakāraṇāt ..3.60.19..

nimeṣe yadi kalpaughaṃ pravidan parivindate .
nimeṣa eva tat kalpībhavaty atra na saṃśayaḥ ..3.60.20..

kalpe yadi nimeṣatvaṃ vetti kalpo 'py asau tataḥ .
nimeṣībhavati kṣipraṃ tādṛgrūpātmikā hi cit ..3.60.21..

duẖkhitasya niśā kalpas sukhinas saiva ca kṣaṇaḥ .
kṣaṇas svapne bhavet kalpaẖ kalpaś ca bhavati kṣaṇaḥ ..3.60.22..

tathā ca mṛtvā jāto 'haṃ taruṇo 'ham avasthitaḥ .
yāto 'smi yojanaśataṃ svapna ity anubhūyate ..3.60.23..

rātriṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi hariścandro 'nubhūtavān .
lavaṇo bhuktavān āyur ekarātryāṃ samāś śatam ..3.60.24..

yo nimeṣaḫ prajeśasya sa manor jīvitaṃ muneḥ .
jīvitaṃ yad viriñcasya tad dinaṃ kila cakriṇaḥ ..3.60.25..

dhyāne prakṣīṇacittasya na dināni na rātrayaḥ .
na padārthā na ca jagat satyaṃ nātmāpi yoginaḥ ..3.60.26..

madhuraṃ kaṭutām eti kaṭubhāvena cintitam .
kaṭv apy āyāti mādhuryaṃ madhuratvena cetitam ..3.60.27..

mitrabuddhyā dviṣan mitraṃ ripubuddhyā ripus suhṛt .
bhavatīti mahābāho yathāsaṃvedanaṃ jagat ..3.60.28..

anabhyastāḫ padārthā ye śāstrapāṭhajapādayaḥ .
eṣāṃ saṃvedanābhyāsān nūnam abhyeti sātmatā ..3.60.29..

naur yāyināṃ bhramārtānāṃ vedanāt tu vivartate .
avedanād bhramārtānām api naiṣā vivartate ..3.60.30..

śūnyam ākīrṇatām eti vedanāt svapnadṛkṣv iva .
vedanāt pītam ānīlaṃ śuklaṃ vāpy anubhūyate ..3.60.31..

āpadvad utsavaẖ khedaṃ karoti parimohinaḥ .
kuḍye 'pi kha ivācāro dṛṣṭo dhātuvikāriṇaḥ ..3.60.32..

asadyakṣo vimūḍhānāṃ prāṇān apy apakarṣati .
vedanāt svapnavanitā jāgratīva ratipradā ..3.60.33..

yad yathābhyāsam āyātaṃ tat tathā sthiratāṃ gatam .
asad eva nabhasy eva nabha eva cidātmani ..3.60.34..

śatahastakhuracchāyānaṭavṛttam ivātatam .
gagane mānasaṃ spandaṃ jagad viddhi na vastu tat ..3.60.35..

mithyājñānapiśācasya sandarśanam anākṛti .
kāyāmātrakam evedam arodhakam abhittimat ..3.60.36..

idaṃ bhāsvaram ābhāsaṃ svapnasandarśanaṃ citaḥ .
apūrvam eva suptāyā narasyevoditaṃ viduḥ ..3.60.37..

akhātāś cetati stambho yādṛśaṃ sālabhañjikāḥ .
paramārthamahāstambhas sṛṣṭīś cetati tādṛśam ..3.60.38..

yādṛśo mānavaḫ pārśve svapne kṣubdho mahābhaṭaiḥ .
tādṛśo brahmaṇas sargo buddha eva suṣuptavat ..3.60.39..

tṛṇagulmalatāyuktaś śiśirānte yathā rasaḥ .
vāsantas saṃsthito bhūmau tathā sargaḫ pare pade ..3.60.40..

yathā dravatvaṃ kanake sthitam antar anunmiṣat .
tathā sthitaḫ pare sargaẖ khātmā valgann aṇāv aṇau ..3.60.41..

sanniveśo yathāṅgānām aṅgino 'nanyad ātmanaḥ .
jagad evam anaṅgasya khātmanaẖ khātma brahmaṇaḥ ..3.60.42..

yādṛg ekanarasvapnayuddham anyanaraṃ prati .
tādṛśaṃ sadasadrūpaṃ khātmedaṃ vyomagaṃ jagat ..3.60.43..

etasmāt kāraṇād evaṃ manaḫ prathamam utthitam .

sarvaṃ śivāt tv ekapadottham etat ..3.65.13..

evam ekaṃ paraṃ vastu rāmānānātvam apy alam .

manastvayogyo jīvo 'yaṃ ko bhavet paramātmanaḥ .
kathaṃ vāsmin samutpannaẖ ko vāyaṃ vada me punaḥ ..3.67.1..

svabhāvakāraṇaṃ dvitve pūrvaṃ saṅkalpya cit svayam .

citaś cittvaṃ bhāvitaṃ sat spanda ity ucyate budhaiḥ .

spandāt sphurantī cit sargo nisspandā brahma śāśvatam .

ya evānubhavātmāyaṃ citspando 'sti sa eva hi .

kṛtadvitvacidābhāsavaśād deha upasthite .

hemnīva kaṭakāditvaṃ kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamasthitau .

śuddhaṃ sarvagataṃ brahmānantam advitīyaṃ duravabodhavaśād aśuddham ivāsad ivānekam ivāsarvagam ivāvabudhyate . jalam anyat taraṅgo 'nyad iti bālakalpanayā bhedaḫ parikalpyata eva na vāstavaḥ . tasmād yo 'yam ābhāti bhedas sa kevalam atattvavidbhiḫ parikalpito rajjvām ahitvam iva . ..3.67.77..

evaṃ bhedābhedaśaktyor abhinnayor eva brahmaṇy eva sambhavāt tenātmanādvitīyenaiva dvitvam ivānītaṃ yathā salilena taraṅgakalpanayā suvarṇena kaṭakaparikalpanayaivam iti atas tena svayam evātmanātmānya iva cetyate . ataẖ kalanā jātā . saiva sphāratāṃ prāpya manas sampannā . tenāhambhāvaẖ kalpitaḥ nirvikalpapratyakṣarūpaṃ yat prathamaṃ tan manaḥ . tad ahaṃ bhavati kṣipram ahaṃśabdārthabhāvanāt . tato mano'haṅkārābhyāṃ smṛtir anusaṃhitā . tais tribhis tadanubhūtatanmātrāṇi kalpitāni . satsu tanmātreṣu jīvena cittātmanā svayam kākatālīyavad dhastapādādimān sanniveśaẖ kalpito dṛśyata eva yad eva manaẖ kalpayati tad eva paśyati sad vā bhavatv asad vā . cittaṃ yat kalpayaty abhiniviṣṭam tat tat paśyati sad iva pratibhāsam upāgataṃ yathā svapne . ..3.67.78..

cinmātrasyāntare sargaś cinmātraṃ sakalāntare .
tattvāt samastasattānāṃ cinmātraṃ sarvam eva vā ..3.67.79..

cinmātram eva bahir antar upary adhastān
mānaprameyam iti mātṛpadaṃ ca dhatte .
nityopaśāntam iti tena samastasattā
