yadā vavuḫ patatsiddhās tadā nākampata drumaḥ ..6.22.10..

yadā śeṣākṛtiṃ karṣann asamāptaikaveṣṭanāt .
yayau garutmān amṛtaṃ tadā nākampata drumaḥ ..6.22.11..

yadā kalpānalaśikhāś śailābdhivalanolbaṇāḥ .
śeṣaḫ phaṇābhis tatyāja tadā nākampata drumaḥ ..6.22.12..

evaṃrūpe drumavare tiṣṭhatām āpadaẖ kutaḥ .
asmākaṃ muniśārdūla daussthityena kilāpadaḥ ..6.22.13..

kalpānteṣu mahābuddhe vahatsv agnyambuvāyuṣu .
pratapatsu tathārkeṣu kathaṃ tiṣṭhasi vijvaram ..6.22.14..

yadopayāti kalpāntavyavahāro jagatsthitau .
kṛtaghna iva sanmitraṃ tadā nīḍaṃ tyajāmy aham ..6.22.15..

ākāśa eva tiṣṭhāmi vigatākhilakalpanam .
stabdhaprasṛtasarvāṅgo mano nirvāsanaṃ yathā ..6.22.16..

pratapanti yadādityās salilīkṛtabhūdharāḥ .
vāruṇīṃ dhāraṇāṃ baddhvā tadā tiṣṭhāmi dhīradhīḥ ..6.22.17..

yadā śakalitādrīndrā vānti pralayavāyavaḥ .
pārvatīṃ dhāraṇāṃ baddhvā khe tiṣṭhāmy acalas tadā ..6.22.18..

jagad galitamervādi yāty ekārṇavatāṃ yadā .
vāyavīṃ dhāraṇāṃ baddhvā khaṃ plave 'caladhīs tadā ..6.22.19..

brahmāṇḍapāram āsādya tattvānte vimale pade .
suṣuptāvasthayā tāvat tiṣṭhāmy acalarūpayā ..6.22.20..

yāvat punaẖ kamalajas sṛṣṭikarmaṇi tiṣṭhati .
tataḫ praviśya brahmāṇḍaṃ tiṣṭhāmi patagālaye ..6.22.21..

yathā tiṣṭhasi pakṣīśa dhāraṇābhir akhaṇḍitaḥ .
kalpānteṣu tathā kasmān nānye tiṣṭhanti yoginaḥ ..6.22.22..

brahman niyatir eṣā hi durlaṅghyā pārameśvarī .
mayedṛśena vai bhāvyaṃ bhāvyam anyais tu tādṛśaiḥ ..6.22.23..

na śakyate tolayitum avaśyabhavitavyatā .
yad yathā tat tathaitad dhi svabhāvasyaiṣa niścayaḥ ..6.22.24..

matsaṅkalpavaśenaiva kalpe kalpe punaḫ punaḥ .
asminn eva gireś śṛṅge tarur itthaṃ bhavaty ayam ..6.22.25..

atyantam eva dīrghāyur bhavān vihaganāyaka .
jñānavijñānavān vīro yogayogyamanogatiḥ ..6.22.26..

dṛṣṭānekavidhānalpasargasaṅghasamāgamaḥ .
kiṃ kiṃ smarasi kalyāṇiṃś citram asmiñ jagattraye ..6.22.27..

bṛhadgiriśilārūkṣām ajātatṛṇavīrudham .
aśailavanavṛkṣaughāṃ smarāmīmāṃ dharām adhaḥ ..6.22.28..

daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca .
bhasmabhārabharāpūrṇāṃ smarāmīmāṃ dharām adhaḥ ..6.22.29..

anutpannadinādhīśām ajātaśaśimaṇḍalām .
avibhaktadinālokāṃ saṃsmarāmi dharām adhaḥ ..6.22.30..

meruratnataṭoddyotair ardhaprakaṭakoṭaram .
lokālokam ivādyādriṃ bhuvanaṃ saṃsmarāmy aham ..6.22.31..

pravṛddhāsurasaṅgrāme mriyamāṇān narān iva .
palāyamānān abhitas saṃsmarāmi surān aham ..6.22.32..

caturyugāni pañcāśad asurair mattakāśibhiḥ .
daityāntaḫpuratāṃ prāptāṃ saṃsmarāmi dharām imām ..6.22.33..

atyantāntaritāntāntasamastāsuramaṇḍalām .
ajadevatrayīśeṣāṃ saṃsmarāmi jagatkuṭīm ..6.22.34..

caturyugārdhaṃ caramaṃ nīrandhrāṃ ghanapādapaiḥ .
adṛṣṭanaranirmāṇāṃ saṃsmarāmi dharām imām ..6.22.35..

evaṃ caturyugaṃ sāgraṃ nīrandhrair acalair yutām .
apravṛttajanācārāṃ saṃsmarāmi dharām imām ..6.22.36..

ajātaṣaṇmukhāṃ mattatārakodvāsitāmarām .
daityapakṣajayodriktāṃ saṃsmarāmi jagatkuṭīm ..6.22.37..

caturyugāni trīṇy ambupūraplutakakummukhīm .
merudaṇḍāṅkitāṃ madhye saṃsmarāmi dharām imām ..6.22.38..

bhayād antarhitāśeṣavaimānikanabhaścarām .
dyāṃ nirṛkṣaniśeśārkāṃ saṃsmarāmi tamomayīm ..6.22.39..

anagastyām agastyāśām ekaparvatatāṃ gatāṃ .
matte vindhyamahāśaile saṃsmarāmi jagatkuṭīm ..6.22.40..

etāṃś cānyāṃś ca vṛttāntān saṃsmarāmi bahūn api .
kiṃ tena bahunoktena sāraṃ saṅkṣepataś śṛṇu ..6.22.41..

asaṅkhyātān manūn brahman smarāmi śataśo gatān .
sargān ārambhabahulāṃś caturyugaśatāni ca ..6.22.42..

ekadevamayaṃ śuddhaṃ puruṣāsuravarjitam .
alokatritayaṃ caikasvargaṃ sargaṃ smarāmy aham ..6.22.43..

surāpabrāhmaṇaṃ mattaṃ niṣiddhasuraśūdrakam .
bahunāthasatīkaṃ ca kañcit sargaṃ smarāmy aham ..6.22.44..

vṛkṣanīrandhrabhūlokam akalpitamahārṇavam .
svargasañjātapuruṣaṃ kañcit sargaṃ smarāmy aham ..6.22.45..

aparvatam abhūmiṃ ca vyomasthāmaramānavam .
acandrārkaprakāśāḍhyaṃ kañcit sargaṃ smarāmy aham ..6.22.46..

anindram amahīpālam amadhyasthādhamottamam .
samasarvakakubbhūtaṃ kañcit sargaṃ smarāmy aham ..6.22.47..

sargaprārambhakalanāvibhāge bhuvanatraye .
devāsuravinirmāṇaṃ dvīpābdhivalayodayaḥ ..6.22.48..

kulaparvatasaṃsthānaṃ jambudvīpe pṛthaksthitim .
varṇadharmadhiyaṃ sṛṣṭivibhāgaṃ maṇḍalāvaleḥ ..6.22.49..

ṛkṣacakrakasaṃsthānaṃ dhruvanirmāṇam eva ca .
janmendubhāskarādīnām indropendravyavasthitiḥ ..6.22.50..

hiraṇyākṣāpaharaṇaṃ varāhoddharaṇaṃ kṣiteḥ .
kalpanaṃ pārthivānāṃ ca vedānayanam eva ca ..6.22.51..

mandaroddhūnanaṃ cābdher amṛtārthe ca manthanam .
ajātapakṣo garuḍas sāgarāṇāṃ ca sambhavaḥ ..6.22.52..

ityādikā yās smṛtayas svalpātītamanukramāḥ .
bālair api hi tās tāta smaryante tāsu kiṃ grahaḥ ..6.22.53..

garuḍavāhanam agaruḍavāhanaṃ
sitavivāhanam asitavivāhanam .
suvṛṣavāhanam asuvṛṣavāhanaṃ
kalitavān aham akalitajīvitaḥ ..6.22.54..

tato jagati jāteṣu bhagavan yuṣmadādiṣu .
bharadvājapulastyātrināradendramarīciṣu ..6.23.1..

pulahoddālakādyeṣu kratubhṛgvaṅgirassu ca .
sanatkumārabhṛṅgīśaskandebhavadanādiṣu ..6.23.2..

gaurīsarasvatīlakṣmīgāyatryādyāsu bhūriṣu .
merumandarakailāsahimavaddardurādiṣu ..6.23.3..

hayagrīvahiraṇyākṣakālanemibalādiṣu .
hiraṇyakaśipukrāthabaḍiprahlādakādiṣu ..6.23.4..

niminyaṅkupṛthuprothavainyanābhāgakeliṣu .
nalamāndhātṛsagaradilīpanahuṣādiṣu ..6.23.5..

ātreyavyāsavālmīkivatsavātsyāyanādiṣu .
upamanyumanīmaṅkibhagīrathaśukādiṣu ..6.23.6..

alpakātītakāleṣu kiñcid dūreṣu keṣucit .
tathādyatanasargeṣu smaraṇe gaṇanaiva kā ..6.23.7..

mune te brahmaputrasya janmāṣṭamam idaṃ kila .
saṃsmarāmy aṣṭame sarge tv asmiṃs tvaṃ mama saṅgataḥ ..6.23.8..

kadācij jāyase vyomnaẖ kadācij jāyase jalāt .
kadācij jāyase śailāt kadācij jāyase 'nalāt ..6.23.9..

yādṛśo yādṛśācāro yādṛksaṃsthānadiggaṇaḥ .
sargo 'yaṃ tādṛśān eva trīn sargān saṃsmarāmy aham ..6.23.10..

ekarūpākhilācārasanniveśanarāmarān .
samakālākhilasthairyān daśa sargān smarāmy aham ..6.23.11..

antardhānaṃ gatā devā vārapañcakam uddhṛtāḥ .
mune pañcasu sargeṣu kūrmā iva payonidheḥ ..6.23.12..

mandarākarṣaṇāvegaparyākulasurāsuram .
smarāmi dvādaśaṃ cedam amṛtāmbhodhimanthanam ..6.23.13..

sarvauṣadhirasopetāṃ baliṃ grāhas taṭād iva .
vāratrayaṃ hiraṇyākṣo nītavān vasudhām adhaḥ ..6.23.14..

reṇukātmajatāṃ gatvā ṣaṣṭhaṃ vāram imaṃ hariḥ .
bahusargāntareṇāpi cakāra kṣatriyakṣayam ..6.23.15..

śataṃ kaliyugānāṃ ca harer buddhadaśāśatam .
śākyarājatayaivāptaṃ smarāmi munināyaka ..6.23.16..

triṃśattripuravikṣobhān dvau dakṣādhvarasaṅkṣayau .
daśa śukravighātāṃś ca candramaules smarāmy aham ..6.23.17..

bāṇārtham aṣṭau saṅgrāmāj jvarapramathanāyakān .
vikṣobhitasurānīkān smarāmi hariśarvayoḥ ..6.23.18..

yugaṃ prati dhiyāṃ puṃsām ūnādhikatayā mune .
kriyāṅgapāṭhavaicitryayuktān vedān smarāmy aham ..6.23.19..

ekāgrāṇi samagrāṇi bahupāṭhāni me 'nagha .
purāṇāni pravartante vivṛtāni yugaṃ prati ..6.23.20..

punas tān eva tān evam anyān api yuge yuge .
devarṣivipraracitān itihāsān smarāmy aham ..6.23.21..

itihāsaṃ mahāścaryam anyaṃ rāmāyaṇābhidham .
granthalakṣapramāṇaṃ saj jñānaśāstraṃ smarāmy aham ..6.23.22..

rāmavad vyavahartavyaṃ na rāvaṇavilāsavat .
iti yatra dhiyā jñānaṃ haste phalam ivārpitam ..6.23.23..

kṛtaṃ vālmīkinā caitad adhunā ca kariṣyati .
adya tv aprakaṭaṃ loke sthitaṃ jñāsyati kālataḥ ..6.23.24..

vālmīkināmnā jīvena tenaivānyena cākṣatam .
etat tad dvādaśaṃ vāraṃ kriyate vismṛtiṃ gatam ..6.23.25..

dvitīyam etasya samaṃ bhārataṃ nāma nāmataḥ .
smarāmi prāktanavyāsakṛtaṃ jagati vismṛtam ..6.23.26..

vyāsābhidhena jīvena tathaivānyena cākṣatam .
etat tu saptamaṃ vāraṃ kriyate vismṛtiṃ gatam ..6.23.27..

ākhyānakāni śāstrāṇi vivṛtāni yugaṃ prati .
vicitrasanniveśāni saṃsmarāmi munīśvara ..6.23.28..

punas tāny eva tāny eva tathānyāni yuge yuge .
sādho padārthajālāni prapaśyāmi smarāmi ca ..6.23.29..

rākṣasakṣataye viṣṇor mahīm avatariṣyataḥ .
adhunaikādaśaṃ janma rāmanāmno bhaviṣyati ..6.23.30..

vasudevagṛhe viṣṇor bhuvo bhāranivṛttaye .
adhunā ṣoḍaśaṃ janma bhaviṣyati munīśvara ..6.23.31..

nārasiṃhena vapuṣā hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hariḥ .
jaghāna vāratritayaṃ mṛgendra iva vāraṇam ..6.23.32..

jagattrayībhrāntir iyaṃ na kadācin na vidyate .
vidyate na kadācic ca jalabudbudavat sthitā ..6.23.33..

dṛśyabhrāntir aniṣṭheyam antassthā saṃvidātmani .
jāyate līyate cāśu lolā vīcir ivāmbhasi ..6.23.34..

samaikasanniveśāni bahūni viṣamāṇi ca .
tathārdhasamarūpāṇi trijaganti smarāmy aham ..6.23.35..

tāny eva tādṛkkarmāṇi tathānyācaraṇāni ca .
tatkarmāṇi tathānyāni bhūtānīha smarāmy aham ..6.23.36..

pratimanvantaraṃ brahman viparyaste jagatkrame .
sanniveśe 'nyathā jāte prayāte saṃstute jane ..6.23.37..

mamānyāni ca mitrāṇi te 'nya eva ca bandhavaḥ .
anya eva navā bhṛtyā anya eva samāśrayāḥ ..6.23.38..

kadācid aham ekānte vindhyamūlalatāśrayaḥ .
kadācin meruśṛṅgāgrakalpavṛkṣalatāśrayaḥ ..6.23.39..

kadācit sahyanilayaẖ kadācid dardurālayaḥ .
kadācid dhimavadvāsī kadācin malayāśrayaḥ ..6.23.40..

kadācit prāktanenaiva sanniveśena bhūdharam .
vanaṃ vṛkṣaṃ ca śākhāṃ ca prāpya nīḍaṃ karomy aham ..6.23.41..

adyānanteṣu yāteṣu yugeṣu munināyaka .
prāktanenaiva jāto 'yaṃ sanniveśena pādapaḥ ..6.23.42..

tāte jīvati yaivābhūc chobhāsya sutaros tayā .
kṛtaprāksanniveśo 'yam ahaṃ sthitim upāgataḥ ..6.23.43..

nehābhūd uttarā pūrvaṃ kakum nāyaṃ ca bhūdharaḥ .
dig uttarābhūd anyaiva pūrvaṃ merumahīdharā ..6.23.44..

ekaikadehasaṃsthānanītabrahmaniśāgamaḥ .
dhyānānte khastha evaitat sargam ālokya vedmy aham ..6.23.45..

arkāder ṛkṣasañcārān mervādes sthānakād diśām .
saṃsthānam anyathā tasmin sthite yānti diśo 'nyathā ..6.23.46..

na san nāsaj jagan manye bhramo 'yaṃ kevalaṃ dhiyaḥ .
ātmaspandacamatkāravibhavo 'yaṃ vijṛmbhate ..6.23.47..

putraḫ pitṛtvam āyāto mitrāṇi tv aritāṃ tathā .
strītvaṃ ca śataśo yātān puṃsaś caiva smarāmy aham ..6.23.48..

kalau kṛtayugācārān kṛte kaliyugasthitīḥ .
tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva saṃsmarāmi munīśvara ..6.23.49..

adṛṣṭavedavedārthān svasaṅketavihāriṇaḥ .
sargān nirargalācārān kvacit kāṃścit smarāmy aham ..6.23.50..

dhyātari brahmaṇi brahman sasurāsuramānuṣam .
caturyugasahasre dve jagac chūnyaṃ smarāmy aham ..6.23.51..

vicitrasaṃsthānaviśeṣadeśān
vicitrakāryākulabhūtakośān .
vicitravinyāsavilāsaveṣān
smarāmy ahaṃ brahmadineṣv aśeṣān ..6.23.52..

athāsau vāyasaśreṣṭho jijñāsārtham idaṃ mayā .
bhūyaḫ pṛṣṭo mahābāho kalpavṛkṣalatāgrakhe ..6.24.1..

caratāṃ jagataẖ kośe vyavahāravatām api .
kathaṃ vihagarājendra dehaṃ mṛtyur na bādhate ..6.24.2..

jānann api hi sarvajña brahmañ jijñāsayaiva mām .
pṛcchasi prabhavo nityaṃ bhṛtyaṃ vācālayanti hi ..6.24.3..

tathāpi yat pṛcchasi māṃ tat te prakathayāmy aham .
anājñābhaṅgam evāhur mukhyam ārādhanaṃ satām ..6.24.4..

doṣamuktāphalaprotā vāsanātantusantatiḥ .
hṛdi na grathitā yasya mṛtyus taṃ na jighāṃsati ..6.24.5..

viśvāsavṛkṣakrakacās sarve dehalatāghuṇāḥ .
ādhayo yaṃ na bhindanti mṛtyus taṃ na jighāṃsati ..6.24.6..

ṣaṇḍāt ṣaṇḍaṃ nipatitaṃ śākhāmṛgam ivoddhataṃ .
na cañcalaṃ mano yasya taṃ mṛtyur na jighāṃsati ..6.24.7..

śarīratarusarpaughāś cittaurvaśikhinaś śikhāḥ .
āśā yaṃ na dahanty antas taṃ mṛtyur na jighāṃsati ..6.24.8..

rāgadveṣaviṣāpūras svamanobilamandiraḥ .
lobhavyālo na bhuṅkte yaṃ mṛtyus taṃ na jighāṃsati ..6.24.9..

pītāśeṣavivekāmbuś śarīrāmbhodhivāḍavaḥ .
na nirdahati yaṃ kopas taṃ mṛtyur na jighāṃsati ..6.24.10..

yantraṃ tilānāṃ kaṭhinaṃ rāśim ugram ivākulam .
yaṃ pīḍayati nānaṅgas taṃ mṛtyur na jighāṃsati ..6.24.11..

ekasmin nirmale yena pade paramapāvane .
saṃśritā dṛḍhaviśrāntis taṃ mṛtyur na jighāṃsati ..6.24.12..

ete brahman mahādoṣās saṃsāravyādhihetavaḥ .
manāg api na lumpanti cittam ekasamāhitam ..6.24.13..

ādhivyādhisamutthāni valitāni mahābhramaiḥ .
na vilumpanti duẖkhāni cittam ekasamāhitam ..6.24.14..

na dādati na cādatte na jahāti na yācate .
kurvad eva ca kāryāṇi cittam ekasamāhitam ..6.24.15..

nāstam eti na codeti nasaṃsmṛti navismṛti .
na suptaṃ na ca jāgratsthaṃ cittam ekasamāhitam ..6.24.16..

andhīkṛtahṛdākāśāẖ kāmakrodhavikārajāḥ .
cintā na parihiṃsanti cittam ekasamāhitam ..6.24.17..

ye durarthā durārambhā durguṇā durudāhṛtāḥ .
duṣkramās te na kṛntanti cittam ekasamāhitam ..6.24.18..

śubhāni vipulārthāni mahānti guṇavanti ca .
sarvāṇy evānudhāvanti cittam ekasamāhitam ..6.24.19..

yad udarkahitaṃ satyam anapāyi gatabhramam .
durīhitadaśāmuktaṃ tatparaṃ kārayen manaḥ ..6.24.20..

yad adṛṣṭam aśuddhena ciravaidhuryakāriṇā .
mune kāmapiśācena tatparaṃ kārayen manaḥ ..6.24.21..

ādau madhye tathānte ca cirāya pari coditam .
yac cāru madhuraṃ pathyaṃ tatparaṃ kārayen manaḥ ..6.24.22..

yad anarthadaśāhīnaṃ nirṇītaṃ sadbhir āditaḥ .
guṇānubandhi lokyaṃ ca tatparaṃ kārayen manaḥ ..6.24.23..

peśalaṃ madhuraṃ hṛdyaṃ svādu śītam apakṣayam .
sutīkṣṇam atinirṇītaṃ tatparaṃ kārayen manaḥ ..6.24.24..

yad buddheḫ param ālokyam ādyaṃ yad amṛtaṃ param .
yad anuttamasaubhāgyaṃ tatparaṃ kārayen manaḥ ..6.24.25..

sāmare sahagandharve savidyādharakinnare .
sasurastrīgaṇe svarge na kiñcit susthiraṃ śubham ..6.24.26..

sanare sanarādhīśe saparvatapuravraje .
sāmbudhau bhūtale tāta na kiñcic chobhanaṃ sthiram ..6.24.27..

sanāge sāsuravyūhe sāsurastrījane tathā .
samasta eva pātāle na kiñcic chobhanaṃ sthiram ..6.24.28..

sasvarge sadharābhoge sapātāle sadiktaṭe .
jagaty asmiṃs tu sarvasmin na kiñcic chobhanaṃ sthiram ..6.24.29..

samukhe sakare sāṃse sapāde sorumaṇḍale .
saraktamāṃse dehe 'smin na kiñcic chobhanaṃ sthiram ..6.24.30..

ādhivyādhivilolāsu duẖkhaughavalitāsu ca .
kriyāsu nityatucchāsu na kiñcic chobhanaṃ sthiram ..6.24.31..

taralīkṛtacittāsu hṛdayāmardanīṣu ca .
cintāsu jīvakārāsu na kiñcit susthiraṃ śubham ..6.24.32..

hṛtkṣīrodakasaspandamandareṣu caleṣv ati .
svasaṅkalpavikalpeṣu na kiñcit susthiraṃ śubham ..6.24.33..

anāratāgamāpāyaparāsv aśiśirāsv ati .
citrācārāsu ceṣṭāsu na kiñcit susthiraṃ śubham ..6.24.34..

na varam ekamahītalarājatā
na ca varaṃ vividhāmararūpatā .
na ca varaṃ dharaṇītalanāgatā
sthitim upaiti hi yatra satāṃ manaḥ ..6.24.35..

na varam ākulaśāstravicāraṇaṃ
na ca varaṃ varakāvyavivecanam .
na varam agryakathākramacarvaṇaṃ
sthitim upaiti hi yatra satāṃ manaḥ ..6.24.36..

na varam ādhimayaṃ cirajīvitaṃ
na ca varaṃ maraṇaṃ dṛḍhamūḍhatā .
na ca varaṃ narako na ca viṣṭapaṃ
sthitim upaiti hi yatra satāṃ manaḥ ..6.24.37..

iti vividhajagatkramās samastāś
calamatimūḍhatayā narasya rūḍhāḥ .
calatarakalanāhite padārthe
katham upayānti ciraṃ sthitiṃ mahāntaḥ ..6.24.38..

ekaiva kevalaṃ dṛṣṭir anapāyā gatabhramā .
vidyate sarvavicchreṣṭha sarvaśreṣṭhā samunnatā ..6.25.1..

ātmacintā samastānāṃ duẖkhānām antakāriṇī .
cirasambhṛtasantaptasaṃsāraśramahāriṇī .
niṣkalaṅkamanomārgavipulāṅganacāriṇī ..6.25.2..

tayā samastaduẖkhānāṃ sattānarthavilāsinām .
jyotsnayevāndhakārāṇām alam antaḫ prajāyate ..6.25.3..

sā svātmacintā bhagavan sarvasaṅkalpavarjitā .
yuṣmadādiṣu suprāpā duṣprāpaivāsmadādiṣu ..6.25.4..

samastakalanātītaṃ parāṃ koṭim upāśritam .
padam āsādayantv etat kathaṃ sāmānyabuddhayaḥ ..6.25.5..

ātmacintāvilāsinyas tv asyās sakhyo mahāmate .
kiñcit sāmyam upāyātā vidyante śaśiśītalāḥ ..6.25.6..

ātmacintāsamānānāṃ vividhānāṃ munīśvara .
ātmacintāvayasyānāṃ madhyād ekatamā mayā ..6.25.7..

sarvaduẖkhakṣayakarī sarvasaubhāgyavardhinī .
kāraṇaṃ jīvitasyeyaṃ prāṇacintā samāśritā ..6.25.8..

ity uktavantaṃ vihagaṃ bhusuṇḍaṃ punar apy aham .
jānann apīdam avyagraḫ pṛṣṭavān krīḍayā punaḥ ..6.25.9..

sarvasaṃśayavicchedinn atyantacirajīvita .
yathārthaṃ brūhi me sādho prāṇacintā kim ucyate ..6.25.10..

sarvavedāntavettāsi sarvasaṃśayanāśakaḥ .
mām etat parihāsārthaṃ mune pṛcchasi vāyasam ..6.25.11..

atha vā bhavatām eva bhavadbhyaḫ pariśikṣitam .
punaḫ pratyuccarāmīdaṃ kā me kṣatir upasthitā ..6.25.12..

bhusuṇḍajīvitakaraṃ bhusuṇḍasyātmalābhadam .
śṛṇu prāṇasamādhānaṃ kathyamānam idaṃ mayā ..6.25.13..

paśyedaṃ bhagavaṃs tāvad dehagehaṃ manoramam .
tripradhānamahāsthūṇaṃ navadvārasamāvṛtam ..6.25.14..

puryaṣṭakakalatreṇa tanmātrasvajanena ca .
ahaṅkāragṛhasthena sarvataḫ paripālitam ..6.25.15..

antassuṣirasatkarṇaśaṣkulīcandraśālikam .
śiroruhācchādanavad vipulākṣagavākṣakam ..6.25.16..

āsyapradhānasaddvāraṃ bhujapārśvopamandiraṃ .
dantāliketakasragbhir bhūṣitadvārakoṭaraṃ ..6.25.17..

anārataraṭadrūparasanādvārapālakam .
aṅgulīlokavalitapādālindakṛtasthiti ..6.25.18..

raktamāṃsarasādigdhasnāyusantativeṣṭitam .
sthūlāsthikāṣṭhasadbandhaṃ sukuḍyaṃ supramārjitam ..6.25.19..

īdṛśasyāsya dehasya gehasya munināyaka .
suṣire komale madhye pārśukābhittimālite ..6.25.20..

padmayugmamayaṃ yantram asthimāṃsamayaṃ mṛdu .
ūrdhvādhonālam anyo'nyamilatkośaṃ lasaddalam ..6.25.21..

satataspandarūpeṇa sakalākāśacāriṇā .
tasya yantrasya pattrāṇi mṛdūny āttāni vāyunā ..6.25.22..

lasatsu teṣu pattreṣu sa marut parivardhate .
vātāhatalatāpattrajāle bahir ivābhitaḥ ..6.25.23..

vṛddhiṃ gato 'sau pavanaẖ kṛtvātmānam anekadhā .
ūrdhvādho dikṣu cānyāsu dehe 'smin prasaraty atha ..6.25.24..

prāṇāpānasamānādyais tatas sa hṛdayānilaḥ .
saṅketaiḫ procyate tajjñair vicitrācāraceṣṭitaḥ ..6.25.25..

hṛtpadmayantrakuharāt samastāḫ prāṇaśaktayaḥ .
ūrdhvādhaḫ prasṛtā dehe candrabimbād ivāṃśavaḥ ..6.25.26..

yānty āyānti vivalganti haranti viharanti ca .
utpatanti patanty āśu tā etāḫ prāṇaśaktayaḥ ..6.25.27..

sa eṣa hṛtpadmagataḫ prāṇa ity ucyate budhaiḥ .
asya kācin mune śaktiḫ praspandayati locane ..6.25.28..

kācit sparśam upādatte kācid vahati nāsayā .
kācid annaṃ jarayati kācid vakti vacāṃsi ca ..6.25.29..

bahunātra kim uktena sarvam eva śarīrake .
karoti bhagavān vāyur yantrehām iva yāntrikaḥ ..6.25.30..

tatrordhvādho dvisaṅketau prasṛtāv anilau mune .
prāṇāpānāv iti khyātau prakaṭau tau varānilau ..6.25.31..

tayor anusaran nityaṃ mune gatim ahaṃ sthitaḥ .
śītoṣṇavapuṣor nityaṃ nityam ambarapānthayoḥ ..6.25.32..

kalevaramahāyantre vāhayoś śramahīnayoḥ .
hṛdākāśārkaśaśinor agnīṣomasvarūpayoḥ ..6.25.33..

śarīrapurapālasya manaso rathacakrayoḥ .
ahaṅkāreśvarasyāsya praśasteṣṭaturaṅgayoḥ ..6.25.34..

tayor mamānusarataḫ prāṇāpānābhidhānayoḥ .
gatiṃ śarīramarutor āśarīram aruddhayoḥ ..6.25.35..

jāgratsvapnasuṣupteṣu sadaiva samarūpayoḥ .
suṣuptasaṃsthitasyeva brahman gacchanti vāsarāḥ ..6.25.36..

sahasradhā nikṛttāṅgād bisatantulavād api .
durlakṣyā vidyamānā ca gatis sūkṣmatarā tayoḥ ..6.25.37..

aviratagatayor gatiṃ viditvā
hṛdi marutor anusṛtya coditāṃ tām .
na punar iha hi jāyate mahātman
muditamanāḫ puruṣaḫ praṇaṣṭapāśaḥ ..6.25.38..

jānann api mune sarvaṃ kiṃ māṃ pṛcchasi līlayā .
yathāpṛṣṭam ahaṃ vacmi tatrāpi śṛṇu me vacaḥ ..6.26.1..

prāṇo 'yam aniśaṃ brahman spandaśaktis sadāgatiḥ .
sabāhyābhyantare dehe prāṇo 'yam upari sthitaḥ ..6.26.2..

apāno 'py aniśaṃ brahman spandaśaktis sadāgatiḥ .
sabāhyābhyantare dehe tv apāno 'yam avāk sthitaḥ ..6.26.3..

jāgratas svapataś caiva prāṇāyāmo 'yam uttamaḥ .
pravartate yas tajjñasya taṃ tāvac chreyase śṛṇu ..6.26.4..

bāhyonmukhatvaṃ prāṇānāṃ yad dhṛdambhojakoṭarāt .
svairam evāttayatnānāṃ taṃ dhīrā recakaṃ viduḥ ..6.26.5..

dvādaśāṅgulaparyantaṃ bāhyam ākramatāṃ hṛdaḥ .
prāṇānām aṅgasaṃsparśo yas sa pūraka ucyate ..6.26.6..

bāhyāt parāpataty antar apāne yatnavarjitam .
yo 'ṅgaprapūraṇe sparśo vidus tam api pūrakam ..6.26.7..

apāne 'staṅgate prāṇo yāvan nābhyudito hṛdi .
tāvat sā kumbhakāvasthā yogibhir yānubhūyate ..6.26.8..

pūrakaẖ kumbhakaś caiva recakaś ca dvidhā sthitaḥ .
apānasyodayasthāne dvādaśāntābhidhe bahiḥ ..6.26.9..

svabhāvāt sarvakālasthās somyā yatnavivarjitāḥ .
ye proktās sphāramatibhis tāṃs tvaṃ śṛṇu mahāmate ..6.26.10..

dvādaśāṅgulaparyantād bāhyād abhyuditaḫ prabho .
apānas tasya tatraiva svabhāvāt pūrakādayaḥ ..6.26.11..

mṛdantarasthāniṣpannaghaṭavad yā sthitir bahiḥ .
vyomni nityam apānasya taṃ viduẖ kumbhakaṃ budhāḥ ..6.26.12..

bāhyonmukhatvaṃ vāyor yā nāsikāgrāvadhir gatiḥ .
taṃ bāhyapūrakaṃ tv ādyaṃ vidur yogavido janāḥ ..6.26.13..

nāsāgrād api nirgatya dvādaśāntāvadhir gatiḥ .
yā vāyos taṃ vidur dhīrā aparaṃ bāhyapūrakam ..6.26.14..

atraivāstaṅgate prāṇe yāvan nāpāna udgataḥ .
tāvat pūrṇāṃ samāvasthāṃ bahissthaṃ kumbhakaṃ viduḥ ..6.26.15..

yat tadantarmukhatvaṃ syād apānasyodayaṃ vinā .
taṃ bāhyarecakaṃ vidyāc cintyamānaṃ vimuktidam ..6.26.16..

dvādaśāntād yad utthāya rūpapīvaratā parā .
apānasya bahis tat tam aparaṃ recakaṃ viduḥ ..6.26.17..

bāhyān ābhyantarāṃś caitān kumbhakādīn anāratam .
prāṇāpānasvabhāvān svān buddhvā bhūyo na jāyate ..6.26.18..

aṣṭāv ete mahābuddhe rātrindivam anusmṛtāḥ .
svabhāvād eva vāyūnāṃ kathitā muktidā mayā ..6.26.19..

gacchatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgratas svapato 'pi vā .
ete na rodham āyānti prakṛtyā hi calo 'nilaḥ ..6.26.20..

yat karoti yad aśnāti buddhyaitān samanusmaran .
kumbhakādīn naras so 'ntas tatra kartā na kiñcana ..6.26.21..

suvyagram asmin vyāpāre bāhyaṃ parijahan manaḥ .
dinaiẖ katipayair eva padam āpnoti kevalam ..6.26.22..

etad abhyasyataḫ puṃso bāhye viṣayavṛttiṣu .
na badhnāti ratiṃ cetaś śvadṛtau brāhmaṇo yathā ..6.26.23..

etāṃ dṛṣṭim avaṣṭabhya ye sthitāẖ kṛtabuddhayaḥ .
prāptaṃ prāptavyam akhilaṃ tair akhinnās ta eva hi ..6.26.24..

tiṣṭhatā gacchatā nityaṃ jāgratā svapatā tathā .
eṣā cet prekṣyate dṛṣṭis tan na bandhanam āpyate ..6.26.25..

prāṇāpānānusaraṇāt prāpte bodhe nirāmaye .
saṃśāntamadamohena svasthenāntar ihoṣyate ..6.26.26..

sarvārambhāṃs tyajan svasthaẖ kurvaṃś cāpi budho janaḥ .
prāṇāpānagatīḫ prāpya susvasthas sukham edhate ..6.26.27..

prāṇasyābhyudayo brahman padmayantrād dhṛdi sthitāt .
dvādaśāṅgulaparyante prāṇo 'staṃ yāty ayaṃ bahiḥ ..6.26.28..

apānasyodayo bāhyād dvādaśāntān mahāmune .
astaṅgatir athāmbhojayantre hṛdayasaṃsthite ..6.26.29..

prāṇo yatrāstam āyāti dvādaśānte nabhaḫpade .
padāt tasmād apāno 'yam udeti samanantaram ..6.26.30..

bāhyākāśonmukhaḫ prāṇo vahaty agniśikhā yathā .
hṛdākāśonmukho 'pāno nimne vahati vārivat ..6.26.31..

apānaś candramā deham āpyāyayati bāhyataḥ .
prāṇas sūryo 'gnir atha vā pacaty antar idaṃ vapuḥ ..6.26.32..

prāṇo hi hṛdayākāśaṃ tāpayitvā pratikṣaṇam .
mukhāgragaganaṃ paścāt tāpayaty uttamo raviḥ ..6.26.33..

apānendur mukhāgre khaṃ pyāyayitvā hṛdambaram .
paścād āpyāyayaty eṣa nimeṣasamanantaram ..6.26.34..

apānaśaśino 'ntassthāẖ kalāḫ prāṇavivasvatā .
yatra grastās tad āsādya padaṃ bhūyo na śocyate ..6.26.35..

prāṇārkasya kalāntassthā yatrāpānahimāṃśunā .
grastā tat padam āsādya na bhūyo janmabhāṅ manaḥ ..6.26.36..

prāṇa evārkatāṃ yāti sabāhyābhyantare 'mbare .
āpyāyanakarīṃ paścāc chaśitām adhigacchati ..6.26.37..

prāṇa evendutāṃ tyaktvā śarīrāpyāyakāriṇīm .
kṣaṇād āyāti sūryatvaṃ saṃśoṣaṇakaraṃ param ..6.26.38..

arkatāṃ samparityajya na yāvac candratāṃ gataḥ .
prāṇas tāvad vicāryāntar deśakālau na śocyate ..6.26.39..

hṛdi candrārkayor jñātvā nityam astamayodayam .
ātmano nijam ādhāraṃ na bhūyo jāyate manaḥ ..6.26.40..

sodayāstamayaṃ senduṃ saraśmiṃ sasamāgamam .
hṛdaye bhāskaraṃ devaṃ yaḫ paśyati sa paśyati ..6.26.41..

nākṣīṇaṃ na parikṣīṇaṃ bahissthaṃ siddhaye tamaḥ .
hārdaṃ tu kṣapayed dhvāntaṃ yatkṣaye siddhir uttamā ..6.26.42..

bāhye tamasi saṅkṣīṇe lokālokaḫ prajāyate .
hārde tu tamasi kṣīṇe svāloko jāyate paraḥ ..6.26.43..

hārdāndhakārakṣayadaṃ parijñātaṃ vimuktidam .
sodayāstamayaṃ yatnāt prāṇārkam avalokayet ..6.26.44..

apānenduḫ prayāty astaṃ yatra hṛtpadmakoṭare .
padāt tasmād udety antaḫ prāṇārko bahirunmukhaḥ ..6.26.45..

apāne 'staṅgate prāṇas samudeti hṛdambujāt .
chāyāyāṃ galitāṅgāyāṃ tatraivāśu yathātapaḥ ..6.26.46..

prāṇe tv astaṅgate bāhyād apānaḫ prodayet kṣaṇāt .
ātape parito naṣṭe chāyevāśu pade navā ..6.26.47..

prāṇajanmāvanau naṣṭam apānaṃ viddhi sanmate .
apānajanmabhūmau ca prāṇaṃ naṣṭam avaihi hi ..6.26.48..

astaṅgatavati prāṇe tv apāne 'bhyudayonmukhe .
bahiẖkumbhakam ālambya ciraṃ bhūyo na śocyate ..6.26.49..

apāne 'staṅgate prāṇe kiñcid abhyudayonmukhe .
antaẖkumbhakam ālambya ciraṃ bhūyo na śocyate ..6.26.50..

prāṇarecakamūlastham apānāpūrakoṭigam .
svasthaṃ kumbhakam abhyasya na bhūyaḫ paritapyate ..6.26.51..

apānarecakādhāraṃ prāṇapūrāntasaṃsthitam .
svasaṃsthaṃ kumbhakaṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhūyaḫ paritapyate ..6.26.52..

prāṇāpānāv ubhāv antar yatraitau vilayaṃ gatau .
tad ālambya padaṃ śāntam ātmanā nānutapyate ..6.26.53..

prāṇabhakṣyonmukhāpānaṃ deśaṃ kālaṃ ca niṣkalam .
vicārya bahir antar vā na bhūyaḫ pariśocyate ..6.26.54..

apānabhakṣaṇaparaṃ prāṇaṃ hṛdi tathā bahiḥ .
deśaṃ kālaṃ ca samprekṣya na bhūyo jāyate manaḥ ..6.26.55..

yatra prāṇo hy apānena prāṇenāpāna eva ca .
nigīrṇo bahir antaś ca deśau kālau ca paśya tau ..6.26.56..

kṣaṇam astaṅgataprāṇam apānodayavarjitam .
ayatnasiddhaṃ bāhyasthaṃ kumbhakaṃ tat padaṃ viduḥ ..6.26.57..

kṣaṇam astaṅgatāpānaḫ prāṇodayavivarjitaḥ .
ayatnasiddho hy antassthaẖ kumbhakaḫ paramaṃ padam ..6.26.58..

etat tad ātmano rūpaṃ śuddhaiṣā sā paraiva cit .
etat sad asadābhāsam etat prāpya na śocyate ..6.26.59..

puṣpasyāntar ivāmodaṃ prāṇasyāntar avasthitam .
na ca prāṇaṃ na cāpānaṃ cidātmānam upāsmahe ..6.26.60..

prāṇakṣayapadāntastham apānakṣayakoṭigam .
apānaprāṇayor madhyaṃ cidātmānam upāsmahe ..6.26.61..

prāṇasya prāṇanaṃ proccaiḫ paraṃ jīvasya jīvitam .
dehasya dhāraṇaṃ dhuryaṃ cidātmānam upāsmahe ..6.26.62..

yasmin sarvaṃ yatas sarvaṃ yas sarvaṃ sarvataś ca yaḥ .
yaś ca sarvamayo nityaṃ cidātmānam upāsmahe ..6.26.63..

ālokālokanaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāvanapāvanam .
bhāvābhāvanam anyūnaṃ cidātmanam upāsmahe ..6.26.64..

parasparopasaṅghaṭṭe hṛdaye marutos sthitam .
bahir antas tathākāśe cidātmanam upāsmahe ..6.26.65..

apāno 'staṅgato yatra prāṇo nābhyuditaẖ kṣaṇam .
kalākalaṅkarahitaṃ tac cittattvam upāsmahe ..6.26.66..

nāpāno 'bhyudito yatra prāṇaś cāstam upāgataḥ .
nāsāgragaganāvartaṃ tac cittattvam upāsmahe ..6.26.67..

prāṇāpānodbhavasthāne bāhyābhyantarasaṃsthite .
ye dve yogipadādhāraṃ tac cittattvam upāsmahe ..6.26.68..

prāṇāpānarathārūḍham aprāṇāpānam ātatam .
yac chaktirūpaṃ śaktīnāṃ tac cittattvam upāsmahe ..6.26.69..

hṛtprāṇakumbhakaṃ devaṃ bahiś cāpānakumbhakam .
pūrakāṃśavimṛṣṭaṃ yat tac cittattvam upāsmahe ..6.26.70..

prāṇāpānaparāmarśasattārūpāvabodhakam .
yat prāpyaṃ prāṇamananāt tac cittattvam upāsmahe ..6.26.71..

yat prāṇapavanaspando yat spandānandakāraṇam .
kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ yat tac cittattvam upāsmahe ..6.26.72..

yad akhilakalanākalaṅkahīnaṃ
parivalitaṃ ca sadā kalāgaṇena .
anubhavavibhavaṃ padaṃ tad agryaṃ
sakalasurāvanataṃ paraṃ prapadye ..6.26.73..

eṣā hi citi viśrāntir mayā prāṇasamādhinā .
krameṇānena samprāptā svayam ātmani nirmale ..6.27.1..

etāṃ dṛṣṭim avaṣṭabhya saṃsthito 'smi mahāmune .
na calāmi nimeṣāṃśam api merur ivācalaḥ ..6.27.2..

gacchatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgratas svapato 'pi vā .
svapne 'pi na calaty eṣa susamādhir mamātmani ..6.27.3..

nityānityāsu lolāsu jagatsthitiṣu saṃsthitaḥ .
antarmukho 'smi tiṣṭhāmi svayam evātmanātmani ..6.27.4..

api saṃrudhyate vāyur api vā salilaṃ gateḥ .
naitasmāt susamādhānān niruddhaṃ saṃsmarāmy aham ..6.27.5..

prāṇāpānānusaraṇāt paramātmāvalokanāt .
aśokam anuyāto 'smi padam ādyaṃ mahātapaḥ ..6.27.6..

ā mahāpralayād brahmann unmajjananimajjane .
ayam adyāpi bhūtānāṃ paśyañ jīvāmi dhīradhīḥ ..6.27.7..

na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyac ca cintayāmi kadācana .
dṛṣṭim ālambya tiṣṭhāmi vartamānām ihātmanaḥ ..6.27.8..

yathāprāpteṣu kāryeṣu parityaktaphalaiṣaṇaḥ .
suṣuptasamayā buddhyā paritiṣṭhāmi kevalam ..6.27.9..

bhāvābhāvamayīṃ cintām īhitānīhitānvitām .
vimucyātmani tiṣṭhāmi ciraṃ jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.10..

prāṇāpānasamāyogasamayaṃ samanusmaran .
svayam ātmani tuṣyāmi tenāsmi cirajīvitaḥ ..6.27.11..

idam adya mayā labdham idaṃ lapsyāmi sundaram .
iti cintā na me tena ciraṃ jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.12..

na staumi na ca nindāmi kvacit kiñcit kadācana .
ātmano 'nyasya vā sādho tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.13..

na tuṣyati śubhaprāptau nāśubheṣv api khidyate .
mano mama samaṃ nityaṃ tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.14..

paramaṃ tyāgam ālambya sarvam eva sadaiva hi .
jīvitādi mayā tyaktaṃ tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.15..

praśāntacāpalaṃ vītaśokam astasamīhitam .
mano mama mune śāntaṃ tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.16..

kāṣṭhaṃ vilāsinīṃ śailaṃ tṛṇam agniṃ himaṃ nabhaḥ .
samaṃ sarvatra paśyāmi tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.17..

kim adya mama samprāptaṃ prātar vā bhavitā punaḥ .
iti cintājvaro nāsti tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.18..

jarāmaraṇaduẖkheṣu rājyalābhasukheṣu ca .
na bibhemi na hṛṣyāmi tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.19..

ayaṃ bandhuḫ paraś cāyaṃ mamāyam ayam anyataḥ .
iti brahman na jānāmi tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.20..

āharan viharaṃs tiṣṭhann uttiṣṭhann ucchvasan svapan .
deho 'ham iti no vedmi tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.21..

imaṃ saṃsāram ārambhaṃ suṣuptavad avasthitaḥ .
asantam iva paśyāmi tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.22..

yathākālam upāyātāv arthānarthau samau mama .
hastāv iva śarīrasthau tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.23..

apāriplavayā ṛjvyā sudṛśā snigdhamugdhayā .
ṛju paśyāmi sarvatra tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.24..

āpādamastakānte 'smin na dehe mamatā mama .
tyaktāhaṅkārapaṅkasya tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.25..

yat karomi yad aśnāmi tat tyaktvā tadvato 'pi me .
mano naiṣkarmyam ādatte tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.26..

yadā yadā mune kiñcid vijānāmi tadā tadā .
natim āyāmi nauddhatyaṃ tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.27..

karomīśo 'pi nākrāntiṃ paritapye na kheditaḥ .
daridro 'pi na vāñchāmi tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.28..

naśyadrūpe śarīre 'sminn anaṣṭātmā cidāspadaḥ .
bhūtavṛndaṃ hasāmy ārāt tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.29..

āśāpāśavinunnāyāś cittavṛttes samāhitaḥ .
saṃsparśaṃ na dadāmy antas tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.30..

asattāṃ jagatas sattām ātmanaẖ karabilvavat .
suptaḫ prabuddhaḫ paśyāmi tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.31..

kṣīṇaṃ bhinnaṃ ślathaṃ jīrṇaṃ kṣubdhaṃ
kṣuṇṇaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam .
paśyāmi navavat sarvaṃ tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.32..

sukhito 'smi sukhāsakte duẖkhito duẖkhite jane .
sarvasya priyamitraṃ ca tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.33..

āpady acaladhīro 'smi jaganmitraṃ ca sampadi .
bhāvābhāveṣu naivāsmi tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.34..

nāham asmi na cānyo me nāham anyasya kasyacit .
iti me bhāvitaṃ cetas tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.35..

ahaṃ jagad ahaṃ vyoma deśakālakramāv aham .
ahaṃ kriyeti me buddhis tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.36..

ghaṭaś cic cit paṭaś cit khaṃ cid vaṭaś śakaṭaś ca cit .
cit sarvam iti me bhāvas tena jīvāmy anāmayaḥ ..6.27.37..

ity ahaṃ muniśārdūla trilokīkamalālikaḥ .
bhusuṇḍanāmā kākolaẖ kathitaś cirajīvitaḥ ..6.27.38..

brahmārṇave vilulitaṃ trijagattaraṅgam
utpādanāśavibhavena vibhinnarūpam .
ālīnam unnamitam ākuladṛśyadṛśyam
ālokayan prakalayaṃś ca ciraṃ sthito 'smi ..6.27.39..

etat te kathitaṃ brahman yathāsmi yad ihāsmi vā .
tvadājñāmātrasiddhyarthaṃ dhārṣṭyena jñānapāraga ..6.28.1..

aho nu citraṃ bhagavan bhavatā bhūṣaṇaṃ śruteḥ .
ātmodantaḫ prakathitaḫ paraṃ vismayakāraṇam ..6.28.2..

dhanyās te ye mahātmānam atyantaṃ cirajīvitam .
bhavantaṃ paripṛcchanti dvitīyam iva padmajam ..6.28.3..

vayam adya bhṛśaṃ dhanyās svātmodantam akhaṇḍitam .
yathāvat pāvanaṃ buddhes sarvaṃ kathitavān asi ..6.28.4..

prabhrāntaṃ dikṣu sarvāsu dṛṣṭā vibudhabhūmayaḥ .
bhavān iva jagaty asmin na mahān avalokitaḥ ..6.28.5..

kathañcit prāpyate kaccid bhrāntveha hi mahājanaḥ .
na bhavān iva bhavyātmā sulabho jagati kvacit ..6.28.6..

vaṃśakhaṇḍe hi kasmiṃścij jāyate mauktikaṃ yathā .
jagatkhaṇḍe hi kasmiṃścij jāyate tvādṛśas tathā ..6.28.7..

mayā tu sumahat kāryam adya sampāditaṃ śubham .
puṇyadeho vimuktātmā yad bhavān avalokitaḥ ..6.28.8..

tad astu tava kalyāṇaṃ praviśātmaguhāṃ śubhām .
madhyāhnasamayo 'yaṃ me vrajāmi suramandiram ..6.28.9..

ity ākarṇya bhusuṇḍo 'sau jagrāhotthāya pādapāt .
saṅkalpitābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ supātraṃ hemapallavam ..6.28.10..

kalpavṛkṣalatāpuṣpakesareṇa himatviṣā .
tat pātraṃ mauktikārgheṇa pūrayām āsa pūrṇadhīḥ ..6.28.11..

tenārghyapādyapātreṇa trinetram iva mām asau .
āpādamastakaṃ bhaktyā pūjayām āsa pūrvajaḥ ..6.28.12..

anuvrajyākadarthena khagendrālam iti bruvan .
viṣṭarād aham utthāya tataẖ khagavad āplutaḥ ..6.28.13..

vyomni yojanamātreṇa madanuvrajyayā gataḥ .
karaṃ kareṇāvaṣṭabhya balāt saṃrodhitaẖ khagaḥ ..6.28.14..

mayi yāte tato dīrghe gaganādhvany adṛśyatām .
nivṛtto 'sau vihaṅgeśo dustyajā saṅgatis satām ..6.28.15..

anyo'nyaṃ mayi tasmiṃś ca taraṅgaka ivāmbudhau .
vyomany adṛśyatāṃ yāte gatas smṛtyā munīn aham ..6.28.16..

saptarṣimaṇḍalaṃ prāpya jāyayā paripūjitaḥ .
vismayotphullahṛdayas tato 'haṃ rāghavāvasam ..6.28.17..

bhusuṇḍo bhavyatuṇḍo 'sau tasmin kalpalatālaye .
samaś śāntamanā mānyas svasamādhānavān abhūt ..6.28.18..

jīvaty adyāpi matimāṃs tasminn eva latādale .
tatraiva saṃsthito meros tathaiva kanakadrume ..6.28.19..

yāte kṛtayugasyādau purā varṣaśatadvaye .
saṅgato 'haṃ bhusuṇḍena merau śṛṅgadrume 'bhavam ..6.28.20..

adya rāma kṛte kṣīṇe tretā samparivartate .
madhye tretāyugasyāsya jātas tvaṃ ripusūdana ..6.28.21..

punar adyāṣṭamaṃ varṣaṃ tatraivopari bhūbhṛtaḥ .
milito 'bhūd bhusuṇḍo 'sau tathaivājararūpavān ..6.28.22..

itīdaṃ kathitaṃ citraṃ bhusuṇḍodantam uttamam .
śrutvā vicārya caivāntar yad yuktaṃ tat samācara ..6.28.23..

iti sumunibhusuṇḍasaṅkathāṃ yo
vimalamatiḫ pravicārayiṣyatīha .
bhavabhayabahalāṃ kusaṃsṛtiṃ sa
prasabham asatsaritaṃ tariṣyatīti ..6.28.24..

evaṃ bhusuṇḍavṛttāntaẖ kathitas te mayānagha .
anayā prajñayā tīrṇo bhusuṇḍo mohasaṅkaṭāt ..6.29.1..

etāṃ dṛṣṭim avaṣṭabhya svaprāṇābhyāsapūrvikām .
bhusuṇḍavan mahābāho bhava tīrṇabhavārṇavaḥ ..6.29.2..

yathā jñānena yogena santatābhyāsajanmanā .
bhusuṇḍo 'vāptavān prāpyaṃ tathā sādhaya tat padam ..6.29.3..

asaktabuddhayas santo bhusuṇḍavad avasthitim .
prāpnuvanti pare tattve prāṇāpānāvalokinaḥ ..6.29.4..

etā vicitrā bhavatā śrutā vijñānadṛṣṭayaḥ .
idānīṃ dhiyam ālambya yathecchasi tathā kuru ..6.29.5..

bhagavan bhavatā bhūmibhāsvatā jñānaraśmibhiḥ .
hārdam uddāmadaurātmyaṃ pramṛṣṭam akhilaṃ tamaḥ ..6.29.6..

prabuddhās smaḫ prahṛṣṭās smaḫ praviṣṭās smas svam āspadam .
sthitās smo jñātavijñeyā bhavanto hy aparā iva ..6.29.7..

aho bhusuṇḍacaritaṃ paraṃ vismayakārakam .
bhagavan bhavatā proktam uttamārthāvabodhadam ..6.29.8..

bhusuṇḍacarite brahmann etasmin yat tvayā vibho .
tac charīragṛhaṃ proktaṃ māṃsacarmāsthinirmitam ..6.29.9..

tat kena nāma racitaṃ kuto vā tat samutthitam .
kathaṃ vā sthitim āyātaṃ ko vā tatrāvatiṣṭhate ..6.29.10..

paramārthāvabodhāya doṣāpākaraṇāya ca .
śṛṇu rāghava tattvena vakṣyamāṇam idaṃ mayā ..6.29.11..

asthisthūṇaṃ navadvāraṃ raktamāṃsāvalepanam .
śarīrasadanaṃ rāma na kenacid idaṃ kṛtam ..6.29.12..

ābhāsamātram evedam ittham evāvabhāsate .
dvicandravibhramākāraṃ sad asac ca vyavasthitam ..6.29.13..

dvicandravibhramavidhau dvicandratvaṃ sad eva hi .
vastutaś caika evendus sthitir dehe tathaiva hi ..6.29.14..

dehapratyayakāle hi deho 'yaṃ san vyavasthitaḥ .
asann eva vastutas sa proktas sadasadātmakaḥ ..6.29.15..

svapnas svapnavidhau satyas tv anyadā sa mudhaiva hi .
budbudo budbudavidhau satyo mithyaiva cānyadā ..6.29.16..

deho dehāvadhau satyo 'py asatya itarāvadhau .
pratibhāsāvadhau tāpe jalaṃ sad asad anyadā ..6.29.17..

pratibhāsāvadhau dehas sann asaṃs tv anyadā smṛtaḥ .
ābhāsamātram evedam itthaṃ samprati bhāsate ..6.29.18..

ayaṃ nāmāham ity antar gṛhītamananaṃ sthitam ..6.29.19..

māṃsāsthimayanirmāṇaṃ deho nānyad iti bhramam .
tyaja saṅkalpanirmāṇā dehās santi sahasraśaḥ ..6.29.20..

varatalpagato yena svapne dehena diktaṭam .
paribhramasi he rāma sa dehas te kva saṃsthitaḥ ..6.29.21..

jāgarāyāṃ manorājye yena svargapurāntaram .
paribhramasi meruṃ vā sa dehas te kva saṃsthitaḥ ..6.29.22..

svapneṣv api ca yas svapnas tatra yena mahītaṭān .
paribhramasi he rāma sa dehas te kva saṃsthitaḥ ..6.29.23..

gatair dehair manorājye mahāvibhavabhūmiṣu .
paribhramasi yeneha sa dehas te kva saṃsthitaḥ ..6.29.24..

manorājye manorājye vicitrā yā jagatkriyāḥ .
prakaroṣi mahābāho yair dehais te kva saṃsthitāḥ ..6.29.25..

vilāsinyānurāgiṇyā yena saṅkalpakāntayā .
nirvṛtiṃ yāsi dehena sa dehas te kva saṃsthitaḥ ..6.29.26..

ete rāma yathā dehā mānasaspandasanmayāḥ .
tathaiva tādṛgārambho deho 'yaṃ mānasas smṛtaḥ ..6.29.27..

idaṃ dhanam ayaṃ deho deśo 'yam iti yo bhramaḥ .
tat sarvaṃ cittavīryasya saṅkalpasya vijṛmbhitam ..6.29.28..

dīrghaṃ svapnam imaṃ viddhi dīrghaṃ vā cittavibhramam .
dīrghaṃ vāpi manorājyaṃ saṃsāraṃ raghunandana ..6.29.29..

prabodham eṣyasi yadā param ātmecchayā svayā .
drakṣyasi tvaṃ tadā samyag idam ūrdhvād adho yathā ..6.29.30..

svapnasaṅkalpakalane yathānyeva jagatsthitiḥ .
tathaiveyaṃ hi saṅkalpakalanā kācid eva ha ..6.29.31..

yathā pūrvaṃ mayotpattiḫ proktā kamalajanmanaḥ .
manasas svayam evāntas saṅkalpakalanodbhavā ..6.29.32..

vicitraracanopetam anantaśatavibhramam .
saṅkalpakalanāmātraṃ tathedam avabhāsate ..6.29.33..

yathā kalita ābhāso manaso 'bjajatāgatau .
dehavac cintito dehas sthito 'nyas tadvad eva hi ..6.29.34..

prākpravāhacirābhyasto vāsanāvilayena yaḥ .
tathaiva dṛśyate dehas tadākṛtyudayena saḥ ..6.29.35..

pauruṣeṇa prayatnena saṅkalpo hy ayam eva cet .
anyathā bhāvyate rāma bhūyate tad ihānyathā ..6.29.36..

ayaṃ so 'haṃ mamāyaṃ ca saṃsāra iti bhāvite .
satyo 'yaṃ bhāsate rāma bhāvanādārḍhyasambhavaḥ ..6.29.37..

bhāvitaṃ tīvravegena yad evāśu tad eva ca .
sarvatra dṛśyate rāma kāntevātyantavallabhā ..6.29.38..

aharvyāpṛtir abhyastā yathā svapne 'pi dṛśyate .
tathā sambhāvanābhyastas saṃsāro 'py avalokyate ..6.29.39..

yathā svapnāvadhau kṣipram aharvad avabhāsate .
tathedaṃ sarvakālastham api saṃlakṣyate ciram ..6.29.40..

vyomany eva yathā tāpasantapte dṛśyate sarit .
dharāpy avidyamānaiva saṅkalpād dṛśyate tathā ..6.29.41..

dṛśyate dṛṣṭivairūpyād yathā vyomani piñchikā .
tathaiveyaṃ jagallakṣmīr durjñānād eva bhāsate ..6.29.42..

bhīrur apy eti na yathā svasaṅkalpeṣu sambhramam .
svasaṅkalpe 'pi saṃsāre na tathaiti bhayaṃ sudhīḥ ..6.29.43..

sva eva hi svabhāvo 'yam itthaṃ samprati bhāsate .
saṃsārasaraṇisthityā kasmāt ko 'tra vibhāti kim ..6.29.44..

sa eva kiñcit saṃśodhyaś śuddhyā vimalatāṃ gate .
tasmin na dṛśyate rāma moho 'yaṃ jāgataś calaḥ ..6.29.45..

samyagālokamātreṇa svabhāvaś śuddhim ṛcchati .
na gṛhṇāti malaṃ bhūyas tāmratām iva kāñcanam ..6.29.46..

ābhāsamātram evaitan na san nāsaj jagattrayam .

maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ svargo jñānam ajñānam eva ca .
cidābhāsād ṛte nāstīty ekatā samyagīkṣaṇam ..6.29.48..

tvamahantādisaṃsāram idam etā diśo daśa .
sarvaṃ svābhāsam eveti samyagālokanaṃ viduḥ ..6.29.49..

sadasanmayasaṃsāre yathābhūtārthadarśanāt .
nāstam eti na codeti samyagālokanān manaḥ ..6.29.50..

nirṇīya sarvabhāvānām asattvaṃ sattvam eva vā .
niṣkāmaṃ śāntim abhyeti samyagālokanān manaḥ ..6.29.51..

na nindati na ca stauti na hṛṣyati na śocati .
śītalaṃ satyatām eti samyagālokanān manaḥ ..6.29.52..

avaśyam eva martavyaṃ sarvair eva hi bandhubhiḥ .
iti bandhuviyogeṣu kiṃ vṛthā paritapyase ..6.29.53..

avaśyam eva ca mayā martavyam iti niścaye .
ity ātmamaraṇaprāptau kiṃ mudhā paritapyase ..6.29.54..

avaśyam eva jātena kiñcit svavibhavādikam .
prāptavyaṃ puruṣeṇeti harṣasyāvasaro hi kaḥ ..6.29.55..

sarvasyaiva hi saṃsāre narasya vyavahāriṇaḥ .
anarthāya bhavaty āpac chokasyāvasaro hi kaḥ ..6.29.56..

bruḍaty udeti sphurati budbudaugha ivārṇave .
idaṃ hi janatājālaṃ kim atra paridevanā ..6.29.57..

sat sad eva sadaivaitad asad evāsad eva hi .
kriyāvaicitryamātre tu kim asmin paridevanā ..6.29.58..

nāham asmi na cābhūvaṃ na bhaviṣyāmi cādhunā .
deho 'haṃ cittadoṣo 'yaṃ kim anyat paridevyate ..6.29.59..

dehāc ced anya evāhaṃ cidābhāsas tad aṅga he .
kau tau me sadasadbhāvau yanniṣṭhaṃ paritapyate ..6.29.60..

iti niścayavat tv antas samyagjñānān mano muneḥ .
nāstam eti na codeti na cāntaḫ paritapyate ..6.29.61..

paratām eva tāṃ so 'ntar anuttarapadasthitām .
ādatte tittirir mṛdvīṃ tṛṇakoṭim ivāmalām ..6.29.62..

etadartham asatye 'smin nāsthā kāryā manāg api .
surajjveva balīvardo badhyate jantur āsthayā ..6.29.63..

asatsvapnaṃ dṛḍham idam iti nirṇīya buddhitaḥ .
āsthārahitayā dṛṣṭyā vihartavyam ihānagha ..6.29.64..

kartavyam eva kartavyaṃ yasya na pratibhāsate .
so 'ntaśśītalatām eti dinānte bhuvanaṃ yathā ..6.29.65..

pravibhāgaṃ parityajya padārthapaṭalavraje .
ābhāsamātrasāmānyam idam ālokayānagha ..6.29.66..

ābhāsamātrakaṃ rāma cintāmarśakalaṅkitam .
tatas tad api santyajya nirābhāso bhavottamaḥ ..6.29.67..

cidākāśamayo nityas sarvagas sarvavarjitaḥ .
ābhāsasya parityāge bhavasy ekāntanirmalaḥ ..6.29.68..

nāham asmi na me bhogās satyā ity abhibhāvite .
nedam āḍambaraṃ vyartham anarthāyāvabhāsate ..6.29.69..

aham eva hi vā sarvaṃ cid ity evābhibhāvite .
nedam āḍambaraṃ vyartham anarthāyāvabhāsate ..6.29.70..

darśanadvayam apy etat satyam atyantasiddhidam .
yad ekam etayor vetsi ramyaṃ tad rāma saṃśraya ..6.29.71..

dvābhyām evātha vai tābhyāṃ darśanābhyām ihānagha .
viharan kuru kalyāṇaṃ rāgadveṣaparikṣayāt ..6.29.72..

yat kiñcid ucitaṃ loke yan nabhasy atha yat pare .
tat sarvaṃ prāpyate rāma rāgadveṣaparikṣayāt ..6.29.73..

rāgāhihitayā buddhyā yādṛg rāma viceṣṭyate .
tat tad eva prayāty āśu mūḍhānāṃ viparītatām ..6.29.74..

dveṣadoṣoparuddhāsu na guṇāś cittavṛttiṣu .
padaṃ kurvanti dagdhāsu sthalīṣu hariṇā iva ..6.29.75..

rāgo dveṣaś ca sarpau dvau na nilīnau manobile .
yasya kalpataros tasmāt kiṃ nāmāṅga na labhyate ..6.29.76..

ye hi prājñās suniyatā vidagdhāś śāstraśālinaḥ .
rāgadveṣamayās te cej jambukās tad dhig astu tān ..6.29.77..

mad dhanaṃ bhuktam anyena dhanaṃ bhuktaṃ mayānyataḥ .
itthaṃ saṃvyavahārehā ko rāgadveṣayoẖ kramaḥ ..6.29.78..

dhanāni bandhavo mitraṃ punar āyānti yānti ca .
kim eteṣu naraḫ prājño rajyate vā virajyate ..6.29.79..

bhāvābhāvabhavābhogā māyeyaṃ pārameśvarī .
saṃsāraracanāsarpī prasaktaṃ pradahaty alam ..6.29.80..

na dhanaṃ na jano nāsmi satyaṃ rāghava vastutaḥ .
mithyaiva mithyāvalitam itīdaṃ parilakṣyate ..6.29.81..

ādyantayos sarvam asan madhye 'py asthiram ādhimat .
kva badhnātu dhṛtiṃ dhīro hy anyakalpitakhadrume ..6.29.82..

ekena kalpitā khe strī bhuṅkte tāṃ dūrago 'paraḥ .
itīyam aṅga saṃsāraracanā netaraẖ kramaḥ ..6.29.83..

ihājavañjavībhāvam imam ākulam ātatam .
gandharvapuranirmāṇavināśena samaṃ viduḥ ..6.29.84..

svapnasaṅkalpapuravad asad evedam utthitam .
kāladairghyadhiyā jātapratyayaṃ jātam adya vaḥ ..6.29.85..

nāsi nāyaṃ paṭo nārtho vidyate bhittibhāgavān .
saṅkalpakalanaiveyam abhyāsāt puṣṭatāṃ gatā ..6.29.86..

suṣuptasaṃsthito nityaṃ vitate śāśvate pade .
na kaścid eva parame bhavān ātmani saṃsthitaḥ ..6.29.87..

sarvaṃ tatrastha evedaṃ suṣuptapadavicyutaḥ .
paripaśyasi saṃsāradīrghasvapnam urubhramam ..6.29.88..

ajñānanidrāsughanasvasvabhāvān manāk cyutaḥ .
saṃsārasvapnasambhrānto bhavān ayam iha sthitaḥ ..6.29.89..

tad etāṃ vitatāṃ nidrāṃ ghanājñānamayātmikām .
tyajālakṣmīm iva prāptanidhānaḫ puruṣottama ..6.29.90..

prabodham ehi paśyāccham ātmānam uditaṃ sadā .
nirvikalpacidābhāsaṃ prātaḫ padmo raviṃ yathā ..6.29.91..

prabudhyasva prabudhyasva punaḫ punar ayaṃ mayā .
prabodhyase mahābāho paśyātmārkam anāmayam ..6.29.92..

mayaitenātiśītena vṛṣṭena jñānavāriṇā .
suśabdaśālinā rāma ghanenevāsi bodhitaḥ ..6.29.93..

bodham āsādaya paraṃ prabuddho 'sy eva rāghava .
satyam ālokayālīkaṃ tyaktvemaṃ jāgataṃ bhramam ..6.29.94..

na te janma na te duẖkhaṃ na doṣas te na te bhramaḥ .
sarvasaṅkalpamuktas tvaṃ svātmanātmani saṃsthitaḥ ..6.29.95..

parigalitavikalpadoṣajālas
samasitasārasuṣuptasomyavṛttiḥ .
ativitatam idaṃ ca somyarūpaṃ
samupaśamātmani tiṣṭha he mahātman ..6.29.96..

ity ākarṇayati svacchasamacetasi rāghave .
viśrānte svātmani svairaṃ paramānandam āgate ..6.30.1..

tatrastheṣu ca sarveṣu teṣūpaśamaśāliṣu .
aparikṣubdhacitteṣu sthiteṣv abhyuditātmasu ..6.30.2..

saṃśāntasakalaspandaśabdasaṃvyavahāriṇi .
sabhābhoge sthite somye rātrāv iva mahītale ..6.30.3..

pramūkamugdhaghaṇṭāsu niṣaṇṇāsu nabhastale .
śṛṇvantīṣv iva śuddhāsu patākāsu vaco muneḥ ..6.30.4..

śāntasañcārasaṅkrāntaniścalāsyeṣu pakṣiṣu .
svapatsv antaḫpurāṇāṃ ca pañjareṣv ālayeṣu ca ..6.30.5..

vicārayatsu tattvārthaṃ buddhyā prāptavikāsayā .
sutattvajñeṣu sabhyeṣu sahajānandaśāliṣu ..6.30.6..

paropaśamaśālinyā tayā sadvākyamālayā .
vinayāvanatistheṣu krīḍāmarkaṭakeṣv api ..6.30.7..

rāghavasyātmaviśrāntisthityarthaṃ vacanaughataḥ .
virarāma munir vāri sasetv ātmarayād iva ..6.30.8..

atha yāte muhūrtārdhe rāghave pratibodhite .
punar āha tam evārthaṃ vasiṣṭho vadatāṃ varaḥ ..6.30.9..

rāma samyakprabuddho 'si svātmānam asi labdhavān .
etam evāvalambyāntas tiṣṭha meha madaṃ kṛthāḥ ..6.30.10..

idaṃ saṃsāracakraṃ hi nābhau saṅkalpamātrake .
saṃrodhitāyāṃ vahanād raghunandana rudhyate ..6.30.11..

bodhitāyāṃ manonābhyām idaṃ saṃsāracakrakam .
prayatnād rodhitam api pravahaty eva vegataḥ ..6.30.12..

paraṃ pauruṣam āśritya balaṃ prajñāṃ ca yuktitaḥ .
nābhiṃ saṃsāracakrasya cittam eva nirodhayet ..6.30.13..

prajñāsaujanyayuktena śāstrasaṃvalitena ca .
pauruṣeṇa na yat prāptaṃ na tat kvacana labhyate ..6.30.14..

daivaikaparatāṃ tyaktvā bālabodhopakalpitām .
nijaṃ prayatnam āśritya cittam ādau nirodhayet ..6.30.15..

ā viriñcāt pravṛttena bhrameṇājñānarūpiṇā .
asad eva sadābhāsam idam ālakṣyate 'nagha ..6.30.16..

ajñānabhramavistāramithyaikākṛtayo 'nagha .
ime dehā bhramantīha sarva evāsadutthitāḥ ..6.30.17..

saṅkalpapuruṣasyeva dehasyārthe kadācana .
sukhaduẖkhavikāritvaṃ na kāryaṃ rāma dhīmatā ..6.30.18..

duẖkhamlānamukhakledī prasannāt kledavarjitāt .
api citranarād dehanaras tucchataras smṛtaḥ ..6.30.19..

ādhivyādhiparimlāne svayaṃ kledini nāśini .
na tathā sthiratā dehe citrapuṃsi yathā kila ..6.30.20..

vināśito hi citrastho deho naśyati nānyathā .
avaśyanāśo nāśātmā svayaṃ deho vinaśyati ..6.30.21..

pālitas susthirāṃ śobhām ādatte citramānavaḥ .
dehas tu pālito 'py uccair naśyaty eva na vardhate ..6.30.22..

tena śreṣṭhaś citradeho nāyaṃ saṅkalpadehakaḥ .
ye guṇāś citradehe hi na te saṅkalpadehake ..6.30.23..

citradehād api jaḍād yo 'yaṃ tucchataraẖ kila .
tasmin māṃsamaye dehe kevāsthā bhavato 'nagha ..6.30.24..

dīrghasaṅkalpadeho 'yam asmin kvāsthā mahāmate .
svalpasaṅkalpajād dehād api tucchataro hy ayam ..6.30.25..

svalpasaṅkalpajo dīrghais sukhaduẖkhair na gṛhyate .
dīrghasaṅkalpajaś cāyaṃ dīrghaduẖkhena duẖkhitaḥ ..6.30.26..

deho hi saṅkalpamayo nāyam asti na nāsti ca .
kiṃ vyartham etadarthaṃ hi mūḍho 'yaṃ kleśabhāg janaḥ ..6.30.27..

yathā citramaye puṃsi kṣate kṣīṇe na vaẖ kṣatiḥ .
yathā saṅkalpapuruṣe kṣate kṣīṇe na vaẖ kṣatiḥ ..6.30.28..

yathā manorājyamaye kṣate kṣīṇe na vaẖ kṣatiḥ .
yathā dvitīye śaśini kṣate kṣīṇe na vaẖ kṣatiḥ ..6.30.29..

yathā svapnasamārambhe kṣate kṣīṇe na vaẖ kṣatiḥ .
yathā ghanātapajale kṣate kṣīṇe na vaẖ kṣatiḥ ..6.30.30..

saṅkalpamātrakalite prakṛtyaiva vināśini .
tathā śarīrayantre 'smin kṣate kṣīṇe na vaẖ kṣatiḥ ..6.30.31..

dīrghasvapnamaye hy asmiṃś cirasaṅkalpakalpite .
bhūṣite dūṣite dehe na hi kiñcic citaẖ kṣatam ..6.30.32..

na cid astam upāyāti nātmā calati rāghava .
na brahma vikṛtiṃ yāti kiṃ vo dehakṣaye kṣatam ..6.30.33..

bhramaccakroparistho hi tyaktacakro 'pi cakravat .
yathā paśyati dikcakraṃ bhramad atyantamohitaḥ ..6.30.34..

akasmād eva rūḍhena mithyājñānena valgatā .
abhyastena tathaivedaṃ dṛśyate dehacakrakam ..6.30.35..

bhramitaṃ ca bhramadrūpaṃ patadrūpaṃ ca pātitam .
hataṃ ca hanyamānaṃ ca vapur durvāsanāvaśāt ..6.30.36..

ajñānajaṃ bhramaṃ tyaktvā satyāṃ dṛṣṭim avekṣya ca .
dhīratām alam ālambya ghanaṃ bhramam idaṃ tyajet ..6.30.37..

saṅkalpena kṛto deho mithyājñānena san na san .
asatyena kṛtaṃ yat syān na tat satyaṃ kadācana ..6.30.38..

asadabhyutthito deho rajjvām iva bhujaṅgamaḥ .
asatyām eva cemāṃ ca karoti ca jagatkriyām ..6.30.39..

jaḍena rāma kriyate yat tan na kṛtam ucyate .
kurvann api tato deho na kartā kvacid eva hi ..6.30.40..

nirīho hi jaḍo deho nātmano 'sty abhivāñchitam .
kartā na kaścid evāto draṣṭā kevalam asy ajaḥ ..6.30.41..

yathā dīpo nivātasthas svātmany eva hi tiṣṭhati .
sākṣivat sarvabhāveṣu tathā tiṣṭha jagatsthitau ..6.30.42..

yathā divasakāryāṇi bhāskaras svastha eva san .
karoty evam imāṃ rāma kuru pārthivasaṃsthitim ..6.30.43..

asmin hy asanmaye dehagehe śūnye samutthite .
sattām upagate mithyā bālakalpitayakṣavat ..6.30.44..

kuto 'py āgatya nissāras sarvasajjanavarjitaḥ .
ahaṅkārakuvetālaḫ praviṣṭaś cittanāmabhṛt ..6.30.45..

bhṛtyatāṃ māsya gaccha tvam ahaṅkārasya durmateḥ .
asya bhṛtyatayā rāma nirayaḫ prāpyate phalam ..6.30.46..

svasaṅkalpavilāsena dehagehe nirākṛtiḥ .
unmattacittavetālaḫ parivalgati līlayā ..6.30.47..

śūnyadehagṛhaṃ prāpya cittayakṣeṇa tat kṛtam .
bhītā yena mahānto 'pi samādhiniratās sthitāḥ ..6.30.48..

cittavetālam udvāsya svaśarīraikamandirāt .
saṃsāraśūnyanagare na bibheṣi kadācana ..6.30.49..

cittabhūtābhibhūte 'smin ye śarīragṛhe ratāḥ .
citram adyāpi te kasmād ghaṭṭitā nāśmavat sthitāḥ ..6.30.50..

graste cittapiśācena dehaveśmani yā dhṛtiḥ .
piśācasyaiva sā buddhir nāpiśācasya rāghava ..6.30.51..

ahaṅkārabṛhadyakṣe gṛhe dagdhaśarīrake .
viharānāsthayā sādho na tavaitat kila sthiram ..6.30.52..

ahaṅkārānucaratāṃ tyaktvā vitatayā dhiyā .
ahaṅkāramṛtiṃ prāpya svātmaivāśv avalambyatām ..6.30.53..

ahaṅkārapiśācena grastā ye nirayaiṣiṇaḥ .
teṣāṃ mohāmayāndhānāṃ na mitrāṇi na bandhavaḥ ..6.30.54..

ahaṅkāropahatayā buddhyā yā kriyate kriyā .
viṣavallyā iva phalaṃ tasyās syān maraṇātmakam ..6.30.55..

vivekadhairyahīnena svāhaṅkāramahāśavam .
mūrkheṇālambitaṃ yena naṣṭam evāśu viddhi tam ..6.30.56..

ahaṅkārapiśācena varākā ye vaśīkṛtāḥ .
ta ete narakāgnīnāṃ rāghavendhanatāṃ gatāḥ ..6.30.57..

ahaṅkārorago yasya parisphurati koṭare .
sa dehapādapo dhīrair acireṇa nipātyate ..6.30.58..

ahaṅkārapiśāco 'smin dehe tiṣṭhatu yātu vā .
tvam enam ālokaya mā manasā mahatāṃ vara ..6.30.59..

avadhūto hy avajñātaś cetasaiva tiraskṛtaḥ .
ahaṅkārapiśācas te neha kiñcit kariṣyati ..6.30.60..

dehālaye sphuraty asmin rāma cittapiśācake .
asyānantavilāsasya kim ivāgatam ātmanaḥ ..6.30.61..

cittayakṣābhibhūtānāṃ yāḫ puṃsāṃ vitatāpadaḥ .
śakyante parisaṅkhyātuṃ na tā varṣaśatair api ..6.30.62..

hato mṛto 'smi dagdho 'smīty etā durbhagavṛttayaḥ .
ahaṅkārapiśācasya śaktayo 'nyasya nānagha ..6.30.63..

sarvago 'pi yathākāśas sambaddho neha kenacit .
sarvago 'pi tathaivātmā nāhaṅkāreṇa saṅgataḥ ..6.30.64..

yat karoti yad ādatte dehayantram idaṃ calam .
vātarajjuyutaṃ rāma tad ahaṅkāraceṣṭitam ..6.30.65..

vṛkṣonnatau yathā hetur akartr api kilāmbaram .
ātmasaṃsthas tathehātmā cittaceṣṭāsu kāraṇam ..6.30.66..

ātmasannidhimātreṇa kuḍyarūpam ivāmalam .
dīpasannidhimātreṇa sphuraty āttavapur manaḥ ..6.30.67..

ativiśliṣṭayo rāma nityam evātmacittayoḥ .
dyāvāpṛthivyor iva kas sambandhaḫ prakaṭāndhayoḥ ..6.30.68..

calanaspandanehābhir ātmaśaktibhir āvṛtam .
cittam ātmeti maurkhyeṇa dṛśyate raghunandana ..6.30.69..

ātmā prakāśarūpo hi nityas sarvagato vibhuḥ .
cittaṃ śaṭham ahaṅkāraṃ viddhi hārdaṃ bṛhattamaḥ ..6.30.70..

ātmāsi raghusarvasva jaḍā nāsi manodṛṣat .
dūrīkuru manomohaṃ kim etenāsi saṅgataḥ ..6.30.71..

piśāco hi manonāmā śūnye dehagṛhe sthitaḥ .
bhāyayaty eṣa duṣṭātmā mainam uttama saṃspṛśa ..6.30.72..

bhayapradam akalyāṇaṃ dhairyasarvasvahāriṇam .
manaḫpiśācam utsārya yo 'si sa tvaṃ sthiro bhava ..6.30.73..

cittayakṣadṛḍhākrāntaṃ na śāstrāṇi na bandhavaḥ .
śaknuvanti paritrātuṃ guravo na ca mānavam ..6.30.74..

saṃśāntacittavetālaṃ guruśāstrārthabandhavaḥ .
śaknuvanti samuddhartuṃ svalpapaṅkān mṛgaṃ yathā ..6.30.75..

asmiñ jagacchūnyapure sarvam eva pradūṣitam .
dehagehaṃ pramattena cittayakṣeṇa valgatā ..6.30.76..

cittavetālavalitasamastagṛhaṣaṇḍakā .
iyaṃ jagadaraṇyānī śūnyā kasya na bhītaye ..6.30.77..

jagannagaryām asyāṃ tu śāntacittapiśācakam .
dehagehaṃ katipayais sevyate sadbhir eva ca ..6.30.78..

iha saṃśrīyate yā yā dik saiva raghunandana .
pramattamohavetālaiḫ pūrṇā dehaśmaśānakaiḥ ..6.30.79..

asyāṃ jagadaraṇyānyāṃ muhūrtaṃ mugdhabālavat .
svayam ālambya dhairyāṃśam ātmanātmānam uddhara ..6.30.80..

jagajjaradaraṇye 'smiṃś caradbhūtamṛgavraje .
dhṛtiṃ tṛṇarasai rāma mā gaccha mṛgapotavat ..6.30.81..

asmin mahītalāraṇye carannṛmṛgapotake .
tvam ajñānagajaṃ bhaṅktvā saiṃhīṃ vṛttim upāśraya ..6.30.82..

anye naramṛgā mugdhā jambudvīpe svajaṅgale .
viharanti yathā rāma tathā mā viharānagha ..6.30.83..

atyalpakālaṃ śiśire kardamālepadāyini .
na maṅktavyaṃ vadhūrūpe mahiṣeṇeva palvale ..6.30.84..

bhogābhogā bahiṣkāryā āryasyānusaret padam .
pravicārya mahāryais svam ekam ātmānam āśrayet ..6.30.85..

apavitrasya tucchasya durbhagasya durākṛteḥ .
dehasyārthe na maṅktavyaṃ cintācuṇṭīṣu cāruṇā ..6.30.86..

anyena racito deho yakṣeṇānyena saṃśritaḥ .
duẖkham anyasya bhoktānyaś citreyaṃ maurkhyacakrikā ..6.30.87..

yathaikarūpā ghanatā dṛṣado 'py ātmanas tathā .
sattāmātraikasāmānyād itarasyātyasambhavāt ..6.30.88..

yathopalasya ghanatā manastā hi tathātmanaḥ .
sattāmātrād abhinnā svād abhāvād anyasaṃvidaḥ ..6.30.89..

yathopalasya ghanatā tathāsya paramātmanaḥ .
rūpaikarūpā saṃvittis sattāsāmānyarūpataḥ ..6.30.90..

pṛthak sambhavatīhāṅga na jāḍyaṃ na ca cetanam .
mithyāsaṅkalparacite ete hi śiśuyakṣavat ..6.30.91..

yathekṣurasamātrasya tv ekasyaiva pṛthaṅmayī .
ayaṃ guḍa idaṃ khaṇḍam iti māyā mudhoditā ..6.30.92..

paramātmana ekasya sattāsāmānyarūpataḥ .
mudhaivābhyuditaiveyaṃ jāḍyājāḍyamatis tathā ..6.30.93..

kṣīyate prekṣitaivaiṣā prekṣāmātraikanāśinī .
śuktirupyamatiprakhyā na satī nāsatī tataḥ ..6.30.94..

nāsato vidyate bhāvo yo nāsty eveha san na saḥ ..6.30.95..

svarūpamātraniṣṭhatvād dvaitaikyābhāvayogataḥ .
abhāvād anyasaṃvittes samatvam upalātmanoḥ ..6.30.96..

ananyo 'nanta ekātmā svasattānubhavī yathā .
tathopalas svatāniṣṭho na jaḍo na ca cetanaḥ ..6.30.97..

anyāsambhavato nityadvaitaikyābhāvayogataḥ .
cetyasyāsambhavād ātmā na jaḍo na ca cetanaḥ ..6.30.98..

jaḍājaḍadṛśau vandhyāputravad vyomavṛkṣavat .
samāyāte na cāyāte prekṣite na ca vīkṣite ..6.30.99..

jaḍacetanaśabdārthāv asantau rajjusarpavat .
bhavatas tau kathaṃ satyam aprekṣāmātrakād ṛte ..6.30.100..

yac ca cetanam ātmeti jaḍaś copala ity api .
uktaṃ tad īdṛgvāgyogyabodhyabodhanahetukam ..6.30.101..

bodhyaḫ paratare bodhe yayā yuktyā prabodhyate .
sopadeśyā na gṛhṇāti mūḍhas tat sahasā padam ..6.30.102..

cittaṃ pṛthak pṛthag imāni hatendriyāṇi
kartā na dṛśyata idaṃ ca gṛhaṃ mudhaiva .
ko 'py anya eva parivalgati nissvabhāva
eṣo 'ham ity alam aho mahad indrajālam ..6.30.103..

lolāsu saṃsṛtiṣu bhūtaparamparāṇāṃ
krīḍāsu cānyapuruṣasya cidekavṛtteḥ .
tattvaṃ vicārya ramate hi mahānubhāvo
mantrī yatholbaṇaviṣāsu bhujaṅgamīṣu ..6.30.104..

na tvaṃ śiro na nayane na ca raktamāṃse
nāsthīni naiva ca mano na ca bhūtajālam .
mā moham ehi na śarīram asi prasannā
cit tvaṃ prapannasakalāmalasarvageti ..6.30.105..

etāṃ dṛṣṭim avaṣṭabhya naṣṭakaṣṭeṣṭaceṣṭitaḥ .
tiṣṭhāṣṭaguṇam aiśvaryam apy ariṣṭam ivotsṛjan ..6.31.1..

athemām aparāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ mahāmohavināśinīm .
duṣprāpām api suprāpām anapāyām anāmayām ..6.31.2..

śṛṇu yā kathitā pūrvaṃ mama kailāsakandare .
saṃsāraduẖkhaśāntyarthaṃ devenārdhendumaulinā ..6.31.3..

astīndukarasambhārabhāsuraḫ pārago divaḥ .
kailāso nāma śailendro gaurīramaṇamandiram ..6.31.4..

gaṅgānirjharanirdhauto gaṇodgīrṇaguhāgṛhaḥ .
mandānilavalaccūtakadambavanabandhuraḥ ..6.31.5..

līlālolāmaragaṇaẖ kṛtakokakalāravaḥ .
kaumārabarhivalitakharjūravanapiñjaraḥ ..6.31.6..

tamālāntarhitāmbhodaẖ kadalītulitāmbudaḥ .
cañcarījālajaṭilaẖ kūjatkalakapiñjalaḥ ..6.31.7..

vidyādharodgītaguhaẖ kacatkanakakandaraḥ .
kāraṇḍavoḍḍāmaravāg asaṅkhyakusumāmbudaḥ ..6.31.8..

vimuktajaladodgāras siddhacāraṇasevitaḥ .
candrāvacūladayitas trilokīlokavanditaḥ ..6.31.9..

satkalpapādapabhujas suśikhāśṛṅgakandharaḥ .

kācakandarakeśaśrīs svavanāvalanāṃśukaḥ .

bhavānīhṛtadehārdhas sarvalokaikakāraṇam .
kandarpadarpadalanaẖ kalākarakalādharaḥ ..6.31.13..

taṃ pūjayan mahādevaṃ tasminn eva girau purā .
kadācid avasaṃ gaṅgātaṭe 'haṃ racitāśramaḥ ..6.31.15..

tapo'rthaṃ tāpasācāre cirāya racitasthitiḥ .

nivāsārthaṃ kṛtasnānaẖ kṛtanīladaloṭajaḥ .

sañcitāgryavanaprāṇir upārjitakamaṇḍaluḥ .
puṣpārthaṃ syūtapuṭakas sūmbhitasvākṣamālikaḥ ..6.31.18..

śiṣyasaṅghātavalitaẖ kṛtaśāstrārthasaṅgrahaḥ .
ānītapustakavyūhaḫ paripālitasanmṛgaḥ ..6.31.19..

evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭasya kailāsavanakuñjake .

athaikadā kadācit tu bahulasyāṣṭame dine .
gate śrāvaṇapakṣasya rātryardhe kṣayam āgate ..6.31.21..

dikṣu saṃśāntarūpāsu kāṣṭhamaunasthitāsv iva .
khaḍgacchedyāndhakāreṣu kuñjeṣu gahaneṣu ca ..6.31.22..

avaśyāyalasanmuktāhāse sarati mārute .
ālavālopadhāneṣu mṛgeṣv āśramaśāyiṣu ..6.31.23..

amṛtāṃśukarasyandam ātmanaḫ parivṛddhaye .
lihatsu śaśiraśmibhyaḫ pallaveṣv amṛtadravam ..6.31.24..

kumudvatīṣv oṣadhīṣu cakorīṣu latāsu ca .
pibantīṣv amṛtasyandaṃ karair ākīrṇam aindavam ..6.31.25..

śailaviśrāntanīlābhrapallavasya visāriṇaḥ .
kṛttikāgucchake vyomatāpiñchasya tribhāgage ..6.31.26..

tāraughapratibimbena girau sphaṭikabhūmiṣu .

mayi pallavapalyaṅkagate muktehayā dhiyā .

dvitīyamaddehavati vyomni saptarṣimaṇḍale .
madartham iva tām eva diśam āpatatīva ca ..6.31.29..

tārakātritaye vyomno gṛhamūrdhani madhyage .
mṛgatraye kirātātte sadā bhramam ivāgate ..6.31.30..

utphullakumudāmodadviguṇoddāmamanmathe .
cakravākagaṇe śailasarasīṣv anyatāṃ gate ..6.31.31..

śilāśikhopaviṣṭāsu śailotkīrṇāsv ivābhitaḥ .
pibantīṣu cakorīṣu śītaṃ śaśikarāmṛtam ..6.31.32..

vahati madhuramārute vane 'ntaś
śaśikaraśīkaravarṣaṇaikaśīte .
dalacayacalanotthaśabdagīte
kumudavadhūprathamābhisāriṇīva ..6.31.33..

etasmin samaye tatra yāmārdhe prathame gate .
samādhiṃ tanutāṃ nītvā sthito 'haṃ bāhyalagnadṛk ..6.32.1..

apaśyaṃ kānane tejo jhagity eva samutthitam .
mandarāhananoddhūtakṣubdhakṣīrodabhāsuram ..6.32.2..

śubhrābhraśatasaṅkāśaṃ nṛtyadindugaṇopamam .
caṇḍānilabaloddhūtaṃ himarāśim ivācalam ..6.32.3..

yugāntatāpagalitaṃ susphāṭikam ivācalam .

śaṅkhaśauklyam ivoḍḍīnaṃ śubhrābhram iva sambhṛtam .

gaṅgātaraṅgabharavat praviṣṭaṃ kandarāntaram .
piṇḍahāryaṃ sudadhivac chārvaṃ hāsam ivātatam ..6.32.6..

prakaṭīkṛtadik tejas tad ālokya mayā smayāt .

yāvat paśyāmi taṃ sānuṃ līlayaiva yadṛcchayā .
viharan svagirau hṛdye tāvac candrakalādharaḥ ..6.32.8..

pāścātyagulmāntaritagaṇajālopamālitaḥ .
gaurīkarārpitakaro nandiprotsāritāgragaḥ ..6.32.9..

paścātparikrāntavṛṣas sarvarātricarāvṛtaḥ .
kalhāradāmavalito mandārakṛtaśekharaḥ ..6.32.10..

jaṭāmaulīndukaliko bhogīndrakṛtakuṇḍalaḥ .
calattuṣāraśailābhas sarvasaṅkalpitārthadaḥ ..6.32.11..

manodṛṣṭas sa bhagavān manasaiva tato mayā .
dattamandārapuṣpeṇa praṇatenābhivanditaḥ ..6.32.12..

iti kṛtvā mayā dehaḫ paryaṅkaśayanād ayam .
kṣaṇād utthāpitas tasmād bhūteneva mahāśavaḥ ..6.32.13..

śiṣyān udbodhya tatrasthān gṛhītvārghaṃ susaṃyataḥ .
agamaṃ lokanāthasya dṛṣṭipūtam ahaṃ puraḥ ..6.32.14..

tatra puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā dūrād eva trilocanaḥ .
dattārgheṇa mayā devas sa praṇamyābhivanditaḥ ..6.32.15..

tataś candraprabhāmṛdvyā ṛjvyā śītalayā tayā .
dṛśā sarvārtihāriṇyā saraṇyā śāśvate pade ..6.32.16..

aham ālokya devena candrārdhakṛtamaulinā .
puṣpasānūpaviṣṭena proktas smitasitākṣaram ..6.32.17..

ānayārghyaṃ tathā pādyaṃ brahman svāgatam astu te .
āśramātithayaḫ prāptā vayam adya tavānagha ..6.32.18..

ghanābhirāmaśālinyā satataṃ śamaśāntayā .
muditodārayā brahmaṃs tapolakṣmyā virājase ..6.32.19..

āgacchopaviśāsmiṃs tvam akṛtrimadalāsane .
mṛdau sānusamudbhūte puṇyasañcayapāvane ..6.32.20..

iti proktavate tasmai niśeśārdhārdhadhāriṇe .
arghaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā pādyaṃ samupetyārpitaṃ mayā ..6.32.21..

pādayor hastayoś caiva tanvāṃ cāsya svayambhuvaḥ .
mandārapuṣpāvalayo vikīrṇā bahavaḫ puraḥ ..6.32.22..

tato bhagavatī gaurī tādṛśyaiva saparyayā .
sampūjitā sakhīyuktā gaṇamaṇḍalikā tathā ..6.32.23..

gṛhītavantau tau tāṃ me saparyām ādarāt prabhū .
bhaktipraṇayino rāma pārvatīparameśvarau ..6.32.24..

pūjānte pūrṇaśītāṃśuraśmiśītalayā girā .
tatropaviṣṭaṃ provāca mām athendukalādharaḥ ..6.32.25..

brahman praśamaśālinyaḫ prāptaviśrāntayaḫ pare .
kaccit kalyāṇakāriṇyas saṃvidas te sthitāḫ pade ..6.32.26..

kaccit kamalakalhārakumudānayanakṣamāḥ .
tavāntevāsino brahman nīrujas tvadanuvratāḥ ..6.32.27..

balibhāgabhujāṃ kaccid bhagavan bhavadāśrame .
kuśalaṃ mugdhamugdhānāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ matpriyādṛśām ..6.32.28..

kaccin mandārakusumāny ete mandārapādapāḥ .
tavāsmadādipūjārthaṃ samprayacchanti sūnnatāḥ ..6.32.29..

kaccin mandākinī puṇyaṃ tava snānopayogikam .
ekayā vāhalatayā dadāty utpalapaṅkajam ..6.32.30..

asamañjasaceṣṭāsu nityaṃ ceṣṭāsu me 'nagha .
api madgaṇalīlāsu muninātha na khidyase ..6.32.31..

tiṣṭhantam iha śailendre vipināraṇyavāsinaḥ .
api nodvejayanti tvāṃ dhaneśānucarā mune ..6.32.32..

durvṛttaghanayakṣaughe vipra lolaniśācare .
vasato 'smin gireẖ kukṣāv apy anudvegitāsti te ..6.32.33..

evaṃvādini deveśe sarvalokaikakāraṇe .
girānunayaśālinyā mayoktaṃ raghunandana ..6.32.34..

tryakṣānusmṛtikalyāṇavatām iha maheśvara .
na kiñcid api duṣprāpaṃ na ca kāścana bhītayaḥ ..6.32.35..

tvadanusmaraṇānandaparipūrṇitacetasaḥ .
na te santi jagatkośe praṇatiṃ ye na bibhrati ..6.32.36..

te deśās te janapadās tā diśas te ca parvatāḥ .
tvadanusmaraṇaikāntadhiyo yatra narās sthitāḥ ..6.32.37..

phalaṃ bhūtasya puṇyasya vartamānasya secanam .
taror ivaiṣyato bījaṃ tvadanusmaraṇaṃ prabho ..6.32.38..

bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyac ca saphalaṃ yena nāma tat .
kālatritayakalyāṇaṃ tvadanusmaraṇaṃ prabho ..6.32.39..

paramaṃ manaso mitraṃ sarvāpatprasarāpaham .
sarvasampallatāsekas tvadanusmaraṇaṃ prabho ..6.32.40..

mahāmahimnāṃ mahatāṃ mahitānāṃ ca karmaṇām .
kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ vai tvadanusmaraṇaṃ prabho ..6.32.41..

vivekapayasām abdhiḫ puṇyaratnākaraḫ paraḥ .
ajñānatimirārkaughas tvadanusmaraṇaṃ prabho ..6.32.42..

jñānāmṛtaughakalaśo dhṛtijyotsnāniśākaraḥ .
apavargapuradvāraṃ tvadanusmaraṇaṃ prabho ..6.32.43..

tṛṣṇālatāyāḫ paraśur dhairyāmbhodharaparvataḥ .
dainyadurvanadāvāgnis tvadanusmaraṇaṃ prabho ..6.32.44..

jayaty ābhāsitāśeṣacittasaṃsāramaṇḍapaḥ .
apūrvaḫ paramo dīpas tvadanusmaraṇaṃ prabho ..6.32.45..

tvadanusmaraṇodāracintāmaṇimatā mayā .
sarvāsām āpadāṃ mūrdhni dattaṃ bhūtapate padam ..6.32.46..

sakaladuẖkhabhayāpahara prabho
kṣaṇam apīha mayāsi na cetasā .
varada vīra maheśvara vismṛtas
sukham ato nivasāmi bhavān iva ..6.32.47..

ity uktavaty atha munau divaso jagāma
sāyantanāya vidhaye 'stam ino jagāma .
snātuṃ sabhā kṛtanamaskaraṇā jagāma
śyāmākṣaye ravikaraiś ca sahājagāma ..6.32.48..

ity uktavantam atrāsau gaurī bhagavatī giram .
mām uvāca jaganmātā māteva tanayaṃ priyam ..6.33.1..

bhagavan bhavatā brūhi bhūrisaubhāgyabhāginī .
pativratānāṃ prathamā kva kṛtārundhatī priyā ..6.33.2..

uttiṣṭhānaya tām asmād āśramān macchramāpahāt .
tayā saha kathāś citrāẖ karomy ekavayasyayā ..6.33.3..

ity ukte tatra pārvatyā mayā sā gṛhiṇī svayam .
gatvoddeśaṃ tam evāśu samānītā samāśayā ..6.33.4..

arundhatyā samaṃ kṛtvā lalanācāram akṣatam .
svakāryaikaparā gaurī babhūva parinirvṛtā ..6.33.5..

aham asmin kṣaṇe buddhyā rāma cintitavān idam .
avyagro matprasannaś ca labdho 'yaṃ bhagavān mayā ..6.33.6..

kam enaṃ parameśānaṃ sarvajñānamahārṇavam .
paripṛcchāmi sandeham indubhūṣitaśekharam ..6.33.7..

iti sañcintya sa gurur idaṃ pṛṣṭo mayānagha .
śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te sarvaṃ yad uktaṃ candramaulinā ..6.33.8..

bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa sarvakāraṇakāraṇa .
bhavatprasādenedaṃ me dhārṣṭyam abhyāgataṃ sphuṭam ..6.33.9..

pṛcchāmi tvā mahādeva yad ahaṃ tat tvam āśu me .
brūhi prasannayā buddhyā tyaktodvegam anāmaya ..6.33.10..

sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvakalyāṇavardhanam .
devārcanavidhānaṃ me satyaṃ brūhi maheśvara ..6.33.11..

śṛṇu brahman varam idaṃ devārcanam anuttamam .
vadāmi mucyase yena kṛtena sakṛd eva hi ..6.33.12..

kaccit vetsi mahādevo devaẖ kas syād iti dvija .
na devaḫ puṇḍarīkākṣo na ca devas trilocanaḥ ..6.33.13..

na devaẖ kamalodbhūto na devas tridaśeśvaraḥ .
na devaḫ pavano nārko nānalo na niśākaraḥ ..6.33.14..

na brāhmaṇo nāvanipo nāhaṃ na tvaṃ dvijottama .
na devo deharūpo 'sti na devaś citrarūpadhṛt ..6.33.15..

na devaẖ kalanārūpī nāpi devo bhaven matiḥ .
akṛtrimam anādyantaṃ vedanaṃ deva ucyate ..6.33.16..

ākārādiparicchinnam iti vastuni tat kutaḥ .
akṛtrimam anādyantaṃ vedanaṃ cicchivaṃ viduḥ ..6.33.17..

tad eva devaśabdena kathyate tat prapūjayet .
tad evāsti yatas sarvaṃ sattāsattātmarūpadhṛt ..6.33.18..

ajñātaśivatattvānām ākārādyarcanaṃ kṛtam .
yojanādhvany aśaktasya krośādhvā parikalpyate ..6.33.19..

iyattādiparicchinnaṃ rudrādeḫ prāpyate phalam .
akṛtrimam anādyantaṃ phalam ānanda ātmanaḥ ..6.33.20..

akṛtrimaphalaṃ tyaktvā yaẖ kṛtrimaphalaṃ vrajet .
sa tyaktamandāravanaẖ kārañjaṃ yāti kānanam ..6.33.21..

bodhas sāmyaṃ śama iti puṣpāṇy agryāṇi tatra vai .
śivaṃ cinmātram akalam ātmānam amalaṃ viduḥ ..6.33.22..

śamabodhādibhiḫ puṣpair deva ātmā yad arcyate .
tat taddevārcanaṃ viddhi nākārārcanam arcanam ..6.33.23..

ātmasaṃvittirūpaṃ tu tyaktvā devārcanaṃ janāḥ .
kṛtrimārcāsu ye saktāś ciraṃ kleśaṃ bhajanti te ..6.33.24..

jñātajñeyā hi ye santo bālakrīḍopamaṃ na te .
ātmadhyānād ṛte brahman kurvate devapūjanam ..6.33.25..

ātmaiva devo bhagavāñ śivaḫ paramakāraṇam .
jñānārcanenāvirataṃ pūjanīyas sa sarvadā ..6.33.26..

tvam etac cetanākāśam ātmānaṃ jīvam avyayam .
svabhāvaṃ viddhi na tv anyat pūjyapūjātmapūjanam ..6.33.27..

cetanākāśamātrātma yathā jagad idaṃ prabho .
yathā ca cetanasyaiva jīvāditvaṃ tad ucyatām ..6.33.28..

cidvyomaiva kilāstīha pārāvāravivarjitam .
sarvatrāsambhavaccetyaṃ yat kalpānteṣu śiṣyate ..6.33.29..

tad yat svayaṃ prakacati tasya svakacanasya tu .
svayaṃ saṃviditaṃ nāma tenedaṃ jagad ity alam ..6.33.30..

ity evaṃ svapnapuravaj jagad bhāti cidātmakam .
evaṃ cidvyomamātrātma jagad acchaṃ na bhittimat ..6.33.31..

atyantāsambhavaccetyadṛṣṭi cidvyomamātrakam .
cittvāt kacati sargādau yat taj jagad iti smṛtam ..6.33.32..

tasmāt svapnapurākāraṃ yad idaṃ bhāsate jagat .
tatra cidvyomamātrātmany anyatā nāma kā kutaḥ ..6.33.33..

cinmātram eva girayaś cinmātraṃ jagadambaram .
