bhaviṣyatha madaṃśā me gaṇā matpurabhūṣaṇāḥ .
tato mahāpralayato yāsyāmas tat padaṃ saha ..6.68.5..

ity uktvā bhagavān rudras teṣāṃ so 'ntaradhīyata .
anyasaṃsārasaṃsthānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ madhyam āyayau ..6.68.6..

prayayus svāspadaṃ te 'pi jīvaṭabrāhmaṇādayaḥ .
svakalatrais samaṃ dehaṃ kṣapayitvātha kālataḥ ..6.68.7..

rudralokaṃ samāsādya bhaviṣyanti gaṇottamāḥ .
kadācid vyomni dṛśyante tārakākāradhāriṇaḥ ..6.68.8..

bhikṣusaṅkalparūpās te jīvaṭabrāhmaṇādayaḥ .
kathaṃ satyatvam āyātās saṅkalpārtheṣv asatyatā ..6.68.9..

saṅkalpasatyatāstīśe saṅkalpāsatyatāsty aje .
yatra yan nāsti tan nāsti yatas sarvātma tat padam ..6.68.10..

yat svapne dṛśyate yac ca saṅkalpair avalokyate .
tat tathā vidyate tatra sarvakālaṃ tadātmakam ..6.68.11..

taddeśakālātmikayā tayaivāvasthayāpyate .
taddeśakālātmikayā gatyā deśāntaraṃ yathā ..6.68.12..

deśād deśāntaraṃ yadvad yatnagatyādikaṃ vinā .
na labhyate tathā svapno vinā tattāṃ na labhyate ..6.68.13..

sarvam asti citaẖ kośe yad yathālokayaty asau .
cit tat tathā tadāpnoti sarvātmatvād avikṣatam ..6.68.14..

saṅkalpasvapnavastv aṅga yayā ca daśayāpyate .
paramābhyāsayogābhyāṃ vinā seha na labhyate ..6.68.15..

yeṣāṃ tu yogavijñānadṛṣṭayaḫ phalitās sthitāḥ .
sarvaṃ sarvatra paśyanti ta ete śaṅkarādayaḥ ..6.68.16..

idam agragataṃ vastu tathāsaṅkalpitaṃ ca yaḥ .
prārthayaty ubhayabhraṃśaṃ sa prāpnoty ubhayāśrayāt ..6.68.17..

sarvaṃ hy abhimataṃ kāryam ekaniṣṭhasya sidhyati .
dakṣiṇāṃ kakubhaṃ gacchan kaḫ prāpnoty uttarāṃ diśam ..6.68.18..

saṅkalpārthaparair eva saṅkalpārtho 'vagamyate .
agrasthārthaparair agrasaṃsthito 'rtho 'vagamyate ..6.68.19..

agrasthabuddhisaṃsthe 'smin kalpitaṃ prāptum icchati .
yas sa nā naikaniṣṭhatvāt tadā tan nāśayed dvayam ..6.68.20..

tasmād ekārthaniṣṭhatvād bhikṣujīvena rudratām .
prāpya sarvātmano labdhaṃ padāt sarvaṃ tathāsthiteḥ ..6.68.21..

bhikṣusaṅkalpajīvānāṃ pratyekaṃ taj jagat pṛthak .
paśyanti te ca nānyo'nyaṃ rudrajñānād ṛte tataḥ ..6.68.22..

aprabuddhāḫ prajāyante jīvā jīvāt prabodhinaḥ .
tadicchayāśu viduṣa iva mūrkhās sutā iva ..6.68.23..

iha vidyādharo 'haṃ syām iha syām aham eḍikā .
ity ekadhyānasāphalyadṛṣṭānto 'syāṃ kriyāsthitau ..6.68.24..

ekatvaṃ ca śatatvaṃ ca maurkhyaṃ pāṇḍityam eva ca .
devatvaṃ mānuṣatvaṃ ca deśakālakriyākramaiḥ ..6.68.25..

tulyakālam alaṅkartuṃ dhāraṇādhyānayatnataḥ .
sarvaśaktyajarūpatvāj jīvasyāsty eva śaktatā ..6.68.26..

anantaś cāntayuktaś ca svabhāvo 'sya svabhāvataḥ .
savikāsas sasaṅkoco haṃsasyeva cidātmanaḥ ..6.68.27..

yad icchati tad asty aṅga nanu sampadyate svayam .
svayaṃsaṅkalpitair ebhir deśakālakriyākramaiḥ ..6.68.28..

yoginyo yoginaś ceha tiṣṭhanty anyatra yānti ca .
iha cāmutra cehante dṛṣṭam etad anekaśaḥ ..6.68.29..

kārtavīryo gṛhe tiṣṭhan vavarṣāmbudharo bhavan .
viṣṇuẖ kṣīrodadhau tiṣṭhañ jāyate puruṣo bhuvi ..6.68.30..

paśvarthaṃ yānti tiṣṭhantyo yoginyo yoginīgaṇe .
śakras svargāsane tiṣṭhan yāti yajñārtham urvarām ..6.68.31..

sahasram ekaṃ bhavati tathāsmiñ jagadātmani .
nṛṇāṃ śatāni bhaktānāṃ yānti sāyujyatāṃ tanau ..6.68.32..

ekas sahasraṃ bhavati tathā caiṣa janārdanaḥ .
ekaẖ kāntāsahasrāṇi tulyakālaṃ niṣevate ..6.68.33..

evaṃ te bhikṣusaṅkalpajīvaṭabrāhmaṇādayaḥ .
rudravijñānavaśatas svasaṅkalpapurīr gatāḥ ..6.68.34..

tatra bhuktvā ciraṃ bhogān prāpya rudrapuraṃ tataḥ .
gaṇatām āpnuvantas te sthāsyanti saparicchadāḥ ..6.68.35..

nityapraphultanavakalpalatālayeṣu
rudreṇa sārdham ururatnagulucchakeṣu .
nānājagatsu ca tadā purapattaneṣu
vidyādharīṣv amalamaulidharā ramante ..6.68.36..

eṣa dṛṣṭo yathānena bhikṣuṇā cetanābhramaḥ .
bhūtaṃ pratyekam evaivaṃ pṛthaṅ mṛtvā tu paśyati ..6.69.1..

sarvasya nāma jīvasya mṛtijanmamayī sthitiḥ .
bhavaty eva cidākāśarūpiṇo 'py ākṛtiṃ gatā ..6.69.2..

pṛthak pratyekam abhyeti khātmā saṃsāraṣaṇḍakaḥ .
pṛthag āmodasārthasya yathā kusumaṣaṇḍakaḥ ..6.69.3..

sarva eva mṛto jantuḫ pṛthak svapratibhātmakam .
paśyaty evaṃ kharūpo 'pi dehī cāmokṣam ākulaḥ ..6.69.4..

jīva eṣa mayā tubhyaṃ kathitaẖ kathayānayā .
parāt praspanditātmeti na bhikṣū rāma kevalaḥ ..6.69.5..

mohān mohāntaraṃ yāti jīvo jaraḍhajīvitaḥ .
parvatāgraparibhraṣṭo hy adho 'dha upalo yathā ..6.69.6..

paramātmapadabhraṣṭo jīvas svapnam imaṃ dṛḍham .
paśyaty asmād api svapnād yāti svapnāntaraṃ punaḥ ..6.69.7..

svapnāt svapne 'pi nipatan mṛṣaivedaṃ śilādṛḍham .
paripaśyati deho 'ntar māyayā jarjarīkṛtaḥ ..6.69.8..

kvacit kenacid evaiṣa kadācid vā na vā svayam .
dehena mohanidrāto mucyate samprabudhyate ..6.69.9..

aho nu viṣamo moho jīvasyāsyopajāyate .
padāc cyutasya stokena nānākāravikāradaḥ ..6.69.10..

mithyājñānograyāminyā māyayā nipuṇād idam .
aho nu khalu vaiṣamyaṃ bhīmaṃ nijapadacyuteḥ ..6.69.11..

bhagavan sarvadā sarvaṃ sarvathaiva jagatsthitau .
tvayā sambhavatīty uktaṃ mayā tac cānubhūyate ..6.69.12..

evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭātmā sumahātman sa bhikṣukaḥ .
kvacid asti na vety antar ālokya kathayāśu me ..6.69.13..

atra rātrau samādhisthas trilokīmaṭhikām imām .
bhikṣur eṣo 'sti nāstīti prekṣya prātar vadāmy aham ..6.69.14..

munāv evaṃ kathayati bahir madhyāhnadiṇḍimaḥ .
udabhūt pralayakṣubdhaghanagarjitamāṃsalaḥ ..6.69.15..

tatyajuḫ pādayos tasya puṣpāñjaliparamparāḥ .
nṛpāḫ paurā viṭapinaḫ puṣpaṃ vātayutā iva ..6.69.16..

pūjayitvā muniśreṣṭhān udatiṣṭhat sa viṣṭarāt .
muninā saha bhūpāla udayādrer ivāṃśumān ..6.69.17..

sabhā tadanu sottasthau sapraṇāmaparasparam .
krameṇa hyastanenaiva jagmuẖ khecarabhūcarāḥ ..6.69.18..

svāspadeṣu yathāśāstram aharvyāpāram ādṛtāḥ .
sarve sampādayām āsur nijadharmakramocitam ..6.69.19..

cintayanto muniproktaṃ mahīcaranabhaścarāḥ .
jñānaṃ kṣapāṃ kṣaṇam iva ninyuẖ kalpam ivāpi ca ..6.69.20..

prātaḫ punaḫ prasṛtakāryaparampare 'smiñ
jāte jane khacarabhūcarasiddhasaṅghaḥ .
āsthānalokaracanena tathaiva tasthāv
anyo'nyasaṃvadanapūjitapūjyalokaḥ ..6.69.21..

vasiṣṭhamunisaṃyuktā viśvāmitrādisaṃyutā .
sthitakhecarasiddhaughā viśrāntanṛpanāyakā ..6.70.1..

sarāmalakṣmaṇā saiva tathaivātha sabhā babhau .
somyā samasamābhogā śāntavātyeva padminī ..6.70.2..

anapekṣyaiva ca praśnam uvācātha munīśvaraḥ .
bodhayanti balād eva sānukampā hi sādhavaḥ ..6.70.3..

rājan raghukulākāśaśaśāṅka raghunandana .
hyo mayā dhyānanetreṇa sa bhikṣuḫ prekṣitaś ciram ..6.70.4..

dhyānenāhaṃ ciraṃ bhrāntas tādṛgbhikṣudidṛkṣayā .
dvīpāni sapta vipulāṃs tathaiva kulaparvatān ..6.70.5..

yāvat kutaścid apy eva bhikṣur labdho na tādṛśaḥ .
kathaṃ kila manorājyaṃ bahir apy upalabhyate ..6.70.6..

tatas tribhāgaśeṣāyāṃ rātrau punar ahaṃ dhiyā .
uttarāśāntaraṃ yāto velāvāta ivārṇavam ..6.70.7..

cīnanāmātha tatrāsti śrīmāñ janapado mahān .
valmīkopari tatrāsti vihāro jinasaṃśrayaḥ ..6.70.8..

tasmin vihāre svakuṭīkośe kapilamūrdhajaḥ .
bhikṣur dīrghaśayā nāma sthita evaṃparodayaḥ ..6.70.9..

ekaviṃśatirātraṃ ca tasyaivaṃsthitiśālinaḥ .
dṛḍhārgaḍaṃ gṛhaṃ dhyānabhaṅgabhītā viśanti no ..6.70.10..

bhṛtyāḫ prāyaẖ kila tathā sa tiṣṭhati subhikṣukaḥ .
adyaivaṃ tasya sampannaṃ niyater īdṛśī sthitiḥ ..6.70.11..

rātrayo dhyānaniṣṭhasya gatās tasyaikaviṃśatiḥ .
sa tu varṣasahasrāṇi tathā citte 'nubhūtavān ..6.70.12..

kasmiṃścit prāktane kalpe bhikṣur evaṃ purābhavat .
adya tv iha dvitīyo 'sti tṛtīyo nopalabhyate ..6.70.13..

mayā tu punar anviṣṭaś cetasā caturātmanā .
tādṛg bhikṣus tṛtīyo 'nyo jagatpadmodarālinā ..6.70.14..

asmāt sargāt tu no labdhas tṛtīyas tādṛgāśayaḥ .
athānye līlayā sargā mayā samprekṣitās tataḥ ..6.70.15..

yāvat kasmiṃścid ākāśakośaśāyini sargake .
tṛtīyo vidyate bhikṣur brāhmaṇaś cedṛśakramaḥ ..6.70.16..

evaṃ tenaiva tenaiva sanniveśena bhūriśaḥ .
bhaviṣyanty abhavan santi padārthās sargasantatau ..6.70.17..

asyāṃ sabhāyām api ye munayo brāhmaṇā nṛpāḥ .
bhāvyam evaṃsamācārais tair anyair apy anekaśaḥ ..6.70.18..

nāradenāmunā bhāvyaṃ punar anyena cānagha .
evam evātriṇā bhāvyaṃ punar anyena cādhunā ..6.70.19..

evaṃ kalatrakarmabhyāṃ yuktenānena bhūriśaḥ .
evaṃjanmādinā bhāvyaṃ vyāsena ca śukena ca ..6.70.20..

janakena punar bhāvyaṃ kratunā pulahena ca .
agastyena pulastyena bhṛguṇāṅgirasāpi ca ..6.70.21..

eta eva tathānye ca evaṃrūpakriyāspadam .
cirāc cirād bhaviṣyanti māyeyaṃ vitatā yataḥ ..6.70.22..

sadṛśācārajanmānas ta evānye ca bhūriśaḥ .
bhūyo bhūyo vivartante sargeṣv apsv iva vīcayaḥ ..6.70.23..

atyantasadṛśāẖ kecit kecid ardhasamakramāḥ .
kecid īṣatsamāẖ kecin na kadācit punas tathā ..6.70.24..

evam eṣātivitatā māyā manasi mohinī .
kṣaṇo nehāsti no kalpaḫ pratipattir hi jṛmbhate ..6.70.25..

kvaikaviṃśatyahorātrā anantāẖ kva kuyonayaḥ .
kva tāsām upalambho 'lam aho bhīmā manogatiḥ ..6.70.26..

pratibhāmātram evedam itthaṃ vikasitaṃ sitam .
nānākalahakallolacalaṃ prātar ivāmbujam ..6.70.27..

jātaṃ saṃvedanād eva śuddhād idam aśuddhavat .
saṃsārajālam akhilaṃ vahnir vahnikaṇād iva ..6.70.28..

pratyekam evam uditaḫ pratibhāsaṣaṇḍaṣ
ṣaṇḍāntareṣv api ca tatra vicitraṣaṇḍāḥ .
sarve svayaṃ nanu ca te ca mitho na mithyā
sarvātmani sphurati kāraṇakāraṇe 'smin ..6.70.29..

munināyaka taṃ bhikṣuṃ gatvā sambodhayantv amī .
narā matprahitāś śīghraṃ cīnabuddhakuṭīgatam ..6.71.1..

rājaṃs tasya mahābhikṣos sa dehaḫ prāṇavarjitaḥ .
kledaṃ vaivarṇyam āyāto nāsau jīvitabhājanam ..6.71.2..

tasya bhikṣoś ca jīvo 'sau bhūtvā padmajasārasaḥ .
jīvanmuktas sthito bhūyo nāsau saṃsṛtibhājanam ..6.71.3..

tadgṛhe māsaparyante balān niṣkāsitārgaḍāḥ .
antar ālokayiṣyanti bhikṣum akṣuṇṇamānasam ..6.71.4..

anyenaiva sa dehena bhikṣur mukto vyavasthitaḥ .
kathaṃ prabodhyate naṣṭaṃ tadvihāre śarīrakam ..6.71.5..

eṣā guṇamayī māyā durbodhena duratyayā .
nityaṃ satyāvabodhena sukhenaivātivāhyate ..6.71.6..

asatyaiva kṛtārambhā hemnaẖ kaṭakatā yathā .
pratibhāsaviparyāsamātrakāraṇakodayā ..6.71.7..

paramātmana eveyam itthaṃ māyeti mīyate .
taraṅgateva payasi prekṣāmātravināśinī ..6.71.8..

jño 'pi dṛśyamayād dīrghasvapnāt svapnāntaraṃ vrajan .
evaṃ nānyatvam āyāti vivekāt sarvagātmadṛk ..6.71.9..

yo yo 'sya pratibhāsas syād ātmaiva sa sa bodhataḥ .

pratyekaṃ bhūtam uditaṃ pṛthak saṃsāramaṇḍalam .

prasṛtaḫ padmajād eva jagatsvapno 'yam āditaḥ .

āpitāmaham ābhāti sargas svapnavilāsavat .

spande 'spandīkṛte bodhāc citas sañjñā vilīyate .

citspanda eva citspande sarvātmātmani jṛmbhate .

nānātehāsty abodhena so 'bodho 'sty anavekṣaṇāt .

ciccandrabimbe saṅkalpakalaṅkas sphuratīva yaḥ .

spandāspandau kalpanākalpanāṃśau

suṣuptamaunavān bhūtvā dhūtvā dvitvaikarūpiṇīm .

vāṅmaunam akṣamaunaṃ ca kāṣṭhamaunaṃ ca vedmy aham .

catuṣprakāram āhus tan maunaṃ maunavido janāḥ .

vāṅmaunaṃ vacasāṃ rodho balād indriyanigrahaḥ .

manomaunaṃ pañcamaṃ yat tan mṛte kāṣṭhatāpase .
bhavet suṣuptamaunākhyaṃ jīvanmukte hi jīvati ..6.72.9..

triṣu maunaviśeṣeṣu viṣayaẖ kāṣṭhatāpasaḥ .
suṣuptamaunāvasthāyāś caturthyāś caiva muktadhīḥ ..6.72.10..

vāṅmaunaṃ maunam ity eva siddhaṃ tac ca manaẖkalā- .
malinaṃ jīvabandhāya tatrasthāẖ kāṣṭhatāpasāḥ ..6.72.11..

haṭhād vā yogayuktyaiva yas svākṣāṇāṃ vinigrahaḥ .
tad akṣamaunam ity āhus tatrasthāẖ kāṣṭhatāpasāḥ ..6.72.12..

asmaran saṃsmaran vāpi dṛśyaṃ vāgdvayam aspṛśan .
apaśyann eva paśyantīṃ kāṣṭhamaunī hi tiṣṭhati ..6.72.13..

prasphuraccittakalanam etan maunatrayaṃ smṛtam .
sambhavaty ajñamuniṣu na tu tajjñeṣu līlayā ..6.72.14..

nātropādeyatā jñānām etan maunatrayaṃ kila .
līlayā helayā vāpi tajjñāẖ kurvanti vā na vā ..6.72.15..

idaṃ suṣuptamaunaṃ tu jīvanmuktamatisthitam .
apunarjanmane jantoś śṛṇu śravaṇabhūṣaṇam ..6.72.16..

nātra saṃyamyate vāṇī trividhā nāpi cojjhyate .
nollāsyante na jīyante samastendriyasaṃvidaḥ ..6.72.17..

nānātākalaneyaṃ hi na valgati na śāmyati .
ceto na ceto nāceto na san nāsan na khaṃ na gauḥ ..6.72.18..

avibhāgam anāyāsaṃ yad anādyantam āsitam .
dhyāyato dhāvataś caiva sauṣuptaṃ maunam aṅga tat ..6.72.19..

yathābhūtam imaṃ buddhvā jagannānātvavibhramam .
yad āsitam asaṅgehaṃ sauṣuptaṃ maunam aṅga tat ..6.72.20..

anekasaṃvidrūpātma caikam evedam ātatam .
ity āsitam anantaṃ yat sauṣuptaṃ maunam aṅga tat ..6.72.21..

ākāśaṃ naiva cākāśaṃ sarvam asmi na cāsmi ca .
iti sthitaṃ samaṃ śāntaṃ yat tan maunaṃ suṣuptavat ..6.72.22..

sarvaṃ śūnyaṃ nirālambaṃ śāntaṃ vijñaptimātrakam .
na san nāsad iti svastham āsitaṃ maunam uttamam ..6.72.23..

bhāvābhāvadaśonmeṣaviśeṣair vitathotthitaiḥ .
saṃvido yad anāmarśas tan maunaṃ paramaṃ viduḥ ..6.72.24..

asataiva satevāntaś cetasā vṛttirūpiṇā .
yad anāvartanaṃ saṃvidvṛttes tan maunam akṣayam ..6.72.25..

nāham asmi na cānyo 'sti na mano na ca mānasam .
iti saṃvidasaṃvittir avicchinnātimaunatā ..6.72.26..

aham asmi jagac cāsti tv astiśabdārthamātrakam .
sattāsāmānyam eveti sauṣuptaṃ maunam ucyate ..6.72.27..

sattvāt saṃvida evānyās svapnādikalanāẖ kutaḥ .
anantam eva sauṣuptaṃ sarvaṃ maunam atas tatam ..6.72.28..

suṣuptamaunam evedam anantatvāt prabodhavat .
turyam evāmalaṃ viddhi turyātītam athāpi vā ..6.72.29..

suṣuptaikasamādhānas tathā turyasamādhikaḥ .
turyātītasamādhir vā jāgraty api bhaveta vai ..6.72.30..

turyastha eva sakalāmalaśāntavṛttir
jāgraty api vyavaharan nipuṇaṃ svapitvā .
nityaṃ sadeha uta vāpi videha eva
brāhmaṃ nabho bhava tad eva kilāsi sādho ..6.72.31..

om ity apāstabhavavāsanam ekam āssva
na tvaṃ na cāham iti kiñcid ihāsti satyam .
sarvaṃ ca vidyata itīha śilāntarābhaṃ
jñas tiṣṭha cidgaganakośakalaikaniṣṭhaḥ ..6.72.32..

kutaś śatatvam āyātaṃ rudrāṇāṃ munināyaka .
ye gaṇās te ca kiṃ rudrā uta neti vadasva me ..6.73.1..

svapnānāṃ bhikṣuṇā dṛṣṭaṃ śataṃ śataśarīrakam .
sarvam uddeśato jñātam ata uktaṃ na tan mayā ..6.73.2..

yad ākārāś śataṃ svapne tat tad gaṇaśataṃ smṛtam .
tad eva tad rudraśataṃ rudrā api gaṇābhidhāḥ ..6.73.3..

ekasmād bhagavaṃś cittāt kathaṃ cittaśataṃ kṛtam .
tatsvapnaśatarudreṇa dīpād dīpaśataṃ yathā ..6.73.4..

nirāvaraṇasadbhāvā yad yathā kalpayanti ye .
tat tathāśu bhavaty eva na sāvaraṇasaṃvidaḥ ..6.73.5..

sarvātmanas sarvagatvād yad yathā yatra bhāvyate .
tathānubhūyate tatra tat tat tajjñena nādhiyā ..6.73.6..

kapālamālābharaṇo bhasmasnāyī digambaraḥ .
śmaśānanilayo brahman kāmukaś ca maheśvaraḥ ..6.73.7..

maheśvarāṇāṃ siddhānāṃ jīvanmuktaśarīriṇām .
na kriyāniyamo 'stīha sa hy ajñeṣv eva kalpitaḥ ..6.73.8..

ajñās tv ajitacittatvāt kriyāniyamanaṃ vinā .
gardhān mātsyena nyāyena paraṃ duẖkhaṃ prayānti hi ..6.73.9..

tajjñās tv iṣṭeṣv aniṣṭeṣu na nimajjanti vastuṣu .
jitendriyatvād buddhatvān nirvāsanatayānayā ..6.73.10..

kākatālīyavad rūḍhāṃ kriyāṃ kurvanti te sadā .
na kurvanty api vā kecin naiṣāṃ kvacid api grahaḥ ..6.73.11..

kākatālīyavad viṣṇur evaṃkarmoditaḫ parāt .
evaṃkarmā trinayana evaṃkarmāmbujodbhavaḥ ..6.73.12..

na nindyam asti nānindyaṃ nopādeyaṃ na heyakam .
na cātmīyaṃ na ca paraṃ karma jñaviṣayaṃ kvacit ..6.73.13..

agnyādīnāṃ yathauṣṇyādi sargādau rūḍhim āgatam .
harādīnāṃ tathā karma dvijātīnāṃ ca jātayaḥ ..6.73.14..

sarge prarūḍhim āyāte saṅketavaśataḫ pṛthak .
anubhūtaphalais svārthāẖ kalpanāẖ kalpitās tataḥ ..6.73.15..

videhamuktaviṣayaṃ turyaṃ maunam ito mayā .
noktaṃ te pañcamaṃ maunaṃ videhasya raghūdvaha ..6.73.16..

khād apy atitarām accham ātmākāśaṃ cidātmakam .
tatra prāptiḫ paraṃ śreyas sā kathaṃ prāpyate śṛṇu ..6.73.17..

samyagjñānāvabodhena nityam ekasamādhinā .
saṅkhyayaivāvabuddhā ye te sāṅkhyā yoginas smṛtāḥ ..6.73.18..

prāṇādyanilasaṃśāntau yuktā ye padam āgatāḥ .
anāmayam anādyantaṃ te smṛtā yogayoginaḥ ..6.73.19..

upādeyaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ śāntaṃ padam akṛtrimam .
tat kaiścit saṅkhyayā prāptaṃ kaiścid yogena dehataḥ ..6.73.20..

ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḫ paśyati sa paśyati .
yat sāṅkhyaiḫ prāpyate sthānaṃ paraṃ yogais tad eva hi ..6.73.21..

yatra prāptā manovṛttir atyantaṃ nopalabhyate .
vāsanāvāgurākrāntā tad viddhi paramaṃ padam ..6.73.22..

vāsanāṃ cittam evāhuẖ kāraṇaṃ tad dhi saṃsṛteḥ .
tad akāraṇatām eti vilīya bhavakarmasu ..6.73.23..

manaḫ paśyati vai dehaṃ bālo vetālakaṃ yathā .
ātmānaṃ vilayaṃ nītvā na bhūyas taṃ prapaśyati ..6.73.24..

mano mudhaivābhyuditam asad evānavekṣaṇāt .
svapne svamaraṇākāraṃ prekṣyamāṇaṃ na vidyate ..6.73.25..

mano'bhāvān na saṃsāraẖ kvāmodaẖ kusumaṃ vinā .
upadeśyopadeśādi bandhamokṣau ca tat kutaḥ ..6.73.26..

ekatattvaghanābhyāsaḫ prāṇānāṃ vilayas tataḥ .
manovinigrahaś ceti mokṣaśabdārthakāraṇam ..6.73.27..

yadi hi prāṇavilayo mune mokṣasya kāraṇam .
mṛtā eva hi mucyante tan manye sarvajantavaḥ ..6.73.28..

triṣv eteṣu prayogeṣu manaḫpraśamanaṃ varam .
sādhyaṃ viddhi tad evāśu yathā bhavati tac chivam ..6.73.29..

yadā nirvāsanaṃ prāṇās tyajantīdaṃ śarīrakam .
tadā na bhūyas tanmātrair yānti vyomani saṅgamam ..6.73.30..

vāsanāṃśātmakāny eva viddhi tanmātrakāṇi vai .
tadātmakair manovadbhiḫ prāṇāś śliṣyanti netaraiḥ ..6.73.31..

savāsanās tu yady ete prāṇā muñcanti dehakam .
tad vyomavāyusaṃśleṣaṃ yānti duẖkhāya gandhavat ..6.73.32..

manas sāmbur ivāmbhodo na śāmyati savāsanam .
nāmanaskās sambhavanti prāṇās sūryā ivātviṣaḥ ..6.73.33..

na jahāti manaḫ prāṇān vinā jñānena karhicit .
tṛṇāntareṇaiva vinā tṛṇāgram iva tittiriḥ ..6.73.34..

jñānād avāsanībhāvaṃ svanāśaṃ prāpya vai manaḥ .
prāṇaspandaṃ ca nādatte tataś śāntir hi śiṣyate ..6.73.35..

jñānāt sarvapadārthānām asattvaṃ samudety alam .
tato 'ṅga vāsanānāśād viyogaḫ prāṇacetasoḥ ..6.73.36..

tato na paśyati manaḫ praśāntaṃ dehatāṃ punaḥ .
svanāśena padaṃ prāptaṃ vāsanaiva mano viduḥ ..6.73.37..

ceto hi vāsanāmātraṃ tadabhāvaḫ paraṃ padam .
tac ca sampadyate jñānāj jñānam āhur vicāraṇam ..6.73.38..

ity asyās saṃsṛte rāma paryantas sampravartate .
svayaṃ vivekamātreṇa rajjusarpabhramākṛteḥ ..6.73.39..

ekārthābhyasanaprāṇarodhacetaḫparikṣayāḥ .
ekasminn eva saṃsiddhe saṃsidhyanti parasparam ..6.73.40..

tālavṛntaparispande śānte śānto yathānilaḥ .
prāṇānilaparispande śānte śāntaṃ tathā manaḥ ..6.73.41..

prāṇāś śarīravilaye prayānti vyomavāyutām .
yathāvāsitam evedaṃ manaḫ paśyanti tatra ca ..6.73.42..

yathā videhāḫ paśyanti prāṇā vyomani dehakam .
samanaskās tathācāraṃ sarvaṃ cānubhavanti te ..6.73.43..

śānte vātaparispande yathā gandhaḫ praśāmyati .
tathā śānte manasspande śāmyanti prāṇavāyavaḥ ..6.73.44..

avinābhāvinī nityaṃ jantūnāṃ prāṇacetasī .
kusumāmodavan miśre tilataile iva sthite ..6.73.45..

manasas spandanaṃ prāṇaḫ prāṇasya spandanaṃ manaḥ .
ete viharato nityam anyo'nyaṃ rathasārathī ..6.73.46..

ādhārādheyavat tv ete ekābhāve vinaśyataḥ .
kurutaś ca svanāśena kāryaṃ mokṣākhyam uttamam ..6.73.47..

ekatattvaghanābhyāsāc chāntaṃ śāmyaty alaṃ manaḥ .
tallayatvāt svabhāvasya tena prāṇo 'pi śāmyati ..6.73.48..

vicārya yad anantātmatattvaṃ tanmayatāṃ nayet .
manas tatas tallayatas tad eva bhavati sthiram ..6.73.49..

yad evātitarāṃ śreyo 'nupalambhopalambhayoḥ .
dvayor apy asatos tatra śeṣe vāpi sthiro bhava ..6.73.50..

ekasmin sudṛḍhe tattve tāvad bhāvaṃ vibhāvayet .
bhāvo 'bhāvatvam āyāti svābhyāsād yāvad ātatam ..6.73.51..

pratyāhāravaśāc cetas svayaṃ bhogyakṣayād iva .
vilīyate saha prāṇaiḫ param evāvaśiṣyate ..6.73.52..

yadekatānaṃ bhavati cetas tad bhavati kṣaṇāt .
śāntāśeṣaviśeṣaughaṃ cirābhyāsasvabhāvataḥ ..6.73.53..

avidyeyaṃ tu nāstīti buddhvā yuktiyutaṃ dhiyā .
jñānād eva parāvāptis tadabhyāsas tato varam ..6.73.54..

citte śānte śāmyatīyaṃ saṃsāramṛgatṛṣṇikā .
jarām upagate meghe mihikā mahatī yathā ..6.73.55..

cittamātram avidyeti kuru tenaiva tatkṣayam .
tadrūpanāma cittātmānubhāvo hi paraṃ padam ..6.73.56..

muhūrtam eva nirvāṇaṃ yadi cetaḫ pare pade .
tat tatpariṇataṃ viddhi tatraivāsvādam āgatam ..6.73.57..

yadi sāṅkhyena viśrāntaṃ ceto yogena vā pade .

ceto vigalitāvidyaṃ sattvaśabdena kathyate .
dagdhaṃ saṃsārabījaṃ tan na dadyād aṅkuraṃ punaḥ ..6.73.59..

jñaś cidvigalitāvidyas sattvasthaś śāntavāsanaḥ .
samaṃ śūnyopamaṃ śāntaṃ jyotiḫ paśyati śāmyati ..6.73.60..

vigalitājñapadaṃ vimalaṃ manas
subhaga sattvam itīha hi kathyate .
na punar eti kalāmalinaṃ padaṃ
kanakatām iva tāmram upāgatam ..6.73.61..

jīvo 'jīvībhavaty āśu yāti cittam acittatām .
vicārād ity avidyānto mokṣa ity abhidhīyate ..6.74.1..

mṛgatṛṣṇājalam iva sargo 'hantādi dṛśyate .
asad eva manāg eva tad vicārāt pralīyate ..6.74.2..

saṃsṛtisvapnaviśrāntau vetālodāhṛtān imān .
praśnān ākarṇaya śubhān prasaṅgāt smṛtim āgatān ..6.74.3..

asti vindhyamahāṭavyāṃ vetālo vipulākṛtiḥ .
sa kiñcin maṇḍalaṃ gardhād ājagāma jighatsayā ..6.74.4..

sa vetālo 'vasat pūrvaṃ kasmiṃścit sajjanāspade .
bahubalyupahāreṇa nityatṛptatayā sukhī ..6.74.5..

nirnimittaṃ nirāgaskaṃ na tenāsau purogatam .
kṣudhito 'pi naraṃ hanti saṅgo hi nyāyadaiśikaḥ ..6.74.6..

sa kālenāṭavīgeho jagāma nagarāntaram .

tatra prāpa sa bhūpālaṃ rātricaryāvinirgatam .
tam āha ghanaghoreṇa śabdenograniśācaraḥ ..6.74.8..

rājaṃl labdho 'si bhīmena vetālena mayādhunā .

bho rātricara nirnyāyaṃ māṃ ced atsi balād iha .

na tvām admy aham anyāyaṃ nyāyo 'yaṃ tu mayocyate .

mamemām arthitāṃ rājan sambhavārthaṃ prapūraya .

kasya sūryasya raśmīnāṃ brahmāṇḍāny aṇavaẖ kṛśāḥ .

svapnāt svapnāntaraṃ gacchañ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ .

rambhāstambho yathā pattramātram eva punaḫ punaḥ .

brahmāṇḍākāśabhūtaughasūryamaṇḍalameravaḥ .

kasyānavayavasyaiva paramāṇumahāgireḥ .
śilāntar nibiḍaikāntarūpo majjā jagattrayī ..6.74.17..

iti kathayasi cen na me durātmaṃs

phalam iva tava maṇḍalaṃ graseyaṃ
prasabham upetya jagad yathā kṛtāntaḥ ..6.74.18..

ity uktavati vetāle vaktuṃ praśnān vihasya saḥ .
uvāca vacanaṃ rājā dantāṃśudhavalānanaḥ ..6.75.1..

asti cittiktatātmedaṃ brahmāṇḍamaricaṃ phalam .

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi phalānāṃ yatra santi hi .
asty uccais tādṛśī śākhā vipulā calapallavā ..6.75.3..

tādṛśīnāṃ sahasrāṇi śākhānāṃ yatra santy atha .
tādṛśo 'sti mahāvṛkṣo durlakṣyo vipulākṛtiḥ ..6.75.4..

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi vanānāṃ yatra santy atha .

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi śṛṅgāṇāṃ yatra santy atha .

tādṛśīnāṃ sahasrāṇi pṛthvīnāṃ yatra santy atha .

tādṛksāgaralakṣyāṇi taraṅgo yatra pelavaḥ .

tādṛṃśy abdhisahasrāṇi yasyodarajalāny atha .

tādṛśo 'sti mahādityas sa tapaty āsu dṛṣṭiṣu .

asyādityasya raśmīnāṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ trasareṇuvat .

vijñānātmaiṣa paramo bhāskaro bhāvibhāsanaḥ .
ime ye bhuvanābhogās tasyaiva trasareṇavaḥ ..6.75.20..

vijñānaparamārkasya bhāsā bhānti bhavanti ca .
imā jagadaharlakṣmyas tv aharlakṣmyo raver iva ..6.75.21..

vijñānamātrakacitātmani jantujāte
trailokyamaṇḍapagaṇe ca vikāsabhāji .
nirmajjanodbhavanasambhramabhāvalekhās
santīva neha hi manāg api śāntam āssva ..6.75.22..

kālasattā nabhassattā spandasattā ca cinmayī .
śuddhacetanasattātha sarvam ityādi pāvanam ..6.76.1..

paramātmamahāvāyau rajas sphurati cañcalam .

jagadākhye mahāsvapne svapnāt svapnāntaraṃ vrajet .

saṅkalpaparibṛṃheyam anantasphuraṇā svataḥ .

rambhāstambho yathā pattramātram evāntarāntarā .
antar antas tathedaṃ hi viśvaṃ brahma vivarty atha ..6.76.6..

sabrahmātmādibhiś śabdair yad etair abhidhīyate .
śūnyam avyapadeśyaṃ tan na nakiñcin na kiñcana ..6.76.7..

yā yā vibhāvyate sattā sā sānubhavanirmitā .

sūkṣmatvād apy alabhyatvāt paramātmā paro 'ṇukaḥ .
anantatvād asāv eva prokto mervādidhūlimān ..6.76.9..

aṇor apy atyanantasya puro 'sya jagadādy api .
paramāṇuvad ābhāti pramitatvād arūpavat ..6.76.10..

paro 'ṇur eṣo 'labhyatvāt pūrakatvān mahāgiriḥ .
sarvāvayavarūpo 'pi nirastāvayavaḫ pumān ..6.76.11..

asya vijñaptimātrasya majjāmātraṃ jagattrayī .

vijñānamātram akalākalitaṃ jaganti

vetālabālaka padaṃ tad alaṅghanīyam
evaṃsmayas samanubhāvaya śāntam āssva ..6.76.13..

iti rājamukhāc chrutvā vetālaś śāntim āyayau .
bhāvitātmatayā tatra vicāroditayā dhiyā ..6.77.1..

upaśāntavapur bhūtvā gatvaikāntam aninditaḥ .
babhūvāvicaladhyānī vismṛtya viṣamāṃ kṣudham ..6.77.2..

etad rāma mayoktaṃ te vetālapraśnajālakam .
evaṃkrameṇa cidaṇāv evedaṃ saṃsthitaṃ jagat ..6.77.3..

cidaṇoẖ kośagaṃ viśvaṃ vicāreṇa vilīyate .
kopo vetālakasyeva śiṣyate yat paraṃ tu tat ..6.77.4..

saṃhṛtya sarvataś cittaṃ stimitenāntarātmanā .

ākāśaviśadaṃ kṛtvā manasaiva mano muniḥ .
tiṣṭhaikaśamaśāntātmā vyomavadviśadāśayaḥ ..6.77.6..

sthirabuddher amūḍhasya yathāprāptānuvartinaḥ .
rājño bhagīrathasyeva dussādham api sidhyati ..6.77.7..

sampūrṇaśāntamanasaḫ paritṛptavṛtter

sidhyanti durlabhatarā api vāñchitārthā
gaṅgāvatāra iva sāgarakhātṛnaptuḥ ..6.77.8..

yathā cittacamatkṛtyā rājño gaṅgāvatāraṇam .
bhagīrathasya sampannaṃ tan me kathaya bhoḫ prabho ..6.78.1..

āsīd bhagīratho nāma rājā paramadhārmikaḥ .
bhuvas samudradvīpāyā maṇḍanātilakopamaḥ ..6.78.2..

saṅkalpānantaraṃ prāpur yathābhimatam arthinaḥ .
candraprasannavadanād yasmāc cintāmaṇer iva ..6.78.3..

sādhūnāṃ yo vyavasthārthaṃ dhanāny avirataṃ dadau .
tṛṇamātram upādatte karaṃ tṛṇamaṇir yathā ..6.78.4..

vajrasāram api protam ajvalann eva yo 'bhinat .
ayomaṇir ayoyantram iva durjanaceṣṭitam ..6.78.5..

adhūmo hy adahañ śīto vitaikṣṇyo hārdam apy alam .
tamo 'haran nṛṇāṃ naiśaṃ yo maṇir veśmanām iva ..6.78.6..

kirann agnikaṇāsāram abhitas svapratāpajam .
madhyāhnasūryakāntāgnir iva jvalati yo 'riṣu ..6.78.7..

mṛduśītasukhasparśo yas samāhlādayan mahīm .

jagadyajñopavītasya svargapātālavāhinaḥ .

agastyaśoṣito 'mbhodhir gaṅgāpūreṇa pūritaḥ .
yena duṣpūrarūpo 'pi mahāsārtho 'rthinām iva ..6.78.10..

gaṅgāsopānapaddhatyā yena pātālavāsinaḥ .
yojitā brahmaṇo loke bāndhavā lokabandhunā ..6.78.11..

brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ jahnuṃ tapasārādhayaṃś ca yaḥ .
bhūyo bhūyo yayau khedaṃ na mūrtavyavasāyavat ..6.78.12..

yauvane vartamānasya tasya bhūmipater atha .
pravicārayato lokayātrāṃ paryākulām imām ..6.78.13..

svavirāgacamatkāravicārakaṇikodabhūt .
cetasy api sutāruṇye daivād vallī marāv iva ..6.78.14..

ekānte cintayām āsa mahīpatir asāv atha .

punar dinaṃ punaś śyāmā dānādānāśanaṃ punaḥ .

yena prāptena loke 'smin nāprāptam avaśiṣyate .

punaḫ punaḫ paryuṣitaṃ karma kurvan na lajjate .
mūḍhabuddhir amūḍhas tu kaẖ kuryāt kila bālavat ..6.78.18..

athaikadodvignamanāẖ kadācit tryuttulaṃ gurum .

antaśśūnyāsu suciraṃ bhraman saṃsāravṛttiṣu .

jarāmaraṇamohādirūpāṇāṃ bhavakāriṇām .

cirasāmyātmanācchena nirvibhāgavilāsinā .
rājañ jñeyāvabodhena pūrṇena bharitātmanā ..6.78.22..

kṣīyante sarvaduẖkhāni truṭyanti granthayo 'bhitaḥ .
saṃśayāś śamam āyānti sarvakarmāṇi cānagha ..6.78.23..

jñeyaṃ tu vidur ātmānaṃ saṃśuddhajñaptirūpiṇam .
sa ca sarvagato nityaṃ nāstam eti na codayam ..6.78.24..

cinmātraṃ sarvagaṃ śāntam asti nirmalam acyutam .
dehādi netarat kiñcid iti vedmi munīśvara ..6.78.25..

kiṃ tv atra pratipattir me sphuṭatām eti notarām .
etāvanmātrasaṃvittis syām ahaṃ bhagavan katham ..6.78.26..

jñānena jñeyaniṣṭhatvam eti ceto hṛdantare .

asaktir anabhiṣvaṅgaḫ putradāragṛhādiṣu .
nityaṃ ca samacittatvam iṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu ..6.78.28..

ātmano 'nanyayogena sadbhāvanam anāratam .
viviktadeśasevitvam aratir janasaṃsadi ..6.78.29..

adhyātmajñānaniṣṭhatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanam .

rāgadveṣakṣayākārāt saṃsāravyādhibheṣajāt .
ahambhāvopaśāntau tu rājañ jñānam avāpyate ..6.78.31..

śarīre 'smiṃś ciraṃ rūḍho girau tarur ivoccakaiḥ .
ahambhāvo mahābhogo vada me tyajyate katham ..6.78.32..

pauruṣeṇa prayatnena tyaktvā bhogaughabhāvanam .
gatvānviṣya citā tattvam ahaṅkāro vilīyate ..6.78.33..

yantrāṇāṃ pañjaraṃ yāvad bhagnaṃ lajjādi nākhilam .

sarvam eva dhiyas tyaktvā yadi tiṣṭhasi niścalaḥ .

śāntāśeṣaviśeṣaṇo vigatabhīs santyaktasarvaiṣaṇo

mām apy ujjhitavān alaṃ yadi bhavasy uccais tad uccair asi ..6.78.36..

atha tasya guror vaktrād ity ākarṇya bhagīrathaḥ .
manasy āhitakartavyas svavyāpāraparo 'bhavat ..6.79.1..

tataẖ katipayeṣv eva vāsareṣu gateṣv asau .
agniṣṭomamakhaṃ cakre sarvatyāgaikasiddhaye ..6.79.2..

gobhūmyaśvahiraṇyādi dadau dhanam aśeṣataḥ .
dvijadevārtabandhubhyo guṇyaguṇyavicāravān ..6.79.3..

divasatrayamātreṇa sarvam evaṃ parityajan .
svavastramātraśeṣo 'sāv āsīd rājā bhagīrathaḥ ..6.79.4..

atha sarvārthariktaṃ taṃ khinnaprakṛtipaurakam .
sīmāntine tṛṇam iva rājyaṃ svam araye dadau ..6.79.5..

ākrānte dviṣatā rājye pure sadmani maṇḍale .

yatra na jñāyate nāmnā yatra na jñāyate mukhāt .

ity alpenaiva kālena praśāntasakalaiṣaṇaḥ .
parameṇa śamenāsau prāpa viśrāntim ātmani ..6.79.8..

bhraman dvīpāni bhūpīṭhe kadācit kālayogataḥ .

tān evārīṃś ca tatrāsau pravāhāpatitakramam .

prabho rājyaṃ gṛhāṇeti prārthito 'py ariṇā muniḥ .

athānyatropaśāntātmā pariviśrāntadhīs sukhī .

kim ayaṃ dhāryate dehaẖ kim anenojjhitena naḥ .

iti niścitya tiṣṭhantau tau vanād vanagāminau .

dhanāni nārīr vibhavān aiśvaryaṃ cāṣṭadhoditam .

svakarmaṇaiva deho 'yaṃ yāvadantam anicchayā .

abhinanandatur āgatam uttamau

sukham asaukhyam apīpsitavarjitau
samasamau khasamau śaminau svataḥ ..6.79.21..

athaikadā puraśreṣṭhe kasmiṃścin maṇḍalāntare .

tatra prakṛtayaẖ khinnā naṣṭadeśakramā nṛpam .
anviṣyanti sma saṃyuktaṃ guṇalakṣmyā viśālayā ..6.80.2..

bhagīrathaẖ kṣaṇenaiva prāvṛṣīvāmbunā saraḥ .
dhūlitas senayā gurvyā jhagity āropito gaje ..6.80.4..

bhagīratho jagannātho jayatīti ghanāravaiḥ .

tatra tat pālayantaṃ taṃ rājyaṃ rājānam ādṛtāḥ .

rājann asmākam adhipo yas tvayā sa purā kṛtaḥ .

sarvasāgaracihnāyās sa babhūva patir bhuvaḥ ..6.80.9..

samaś śāntamanā maunī vītarāgo vimatsaraḥ .

pātālatalanaṣṭānāṃ sāgarākārakāriṇām .

tadā kila svarganadī vahati sma na bhūtale .

bhagīrathenātha mahīm avatārayituṃ divaḥ .

tatra varṣasahasrais sa samārādhya punaḫ punaḥ .

etām avaṣṭabhya dṛśaṃ bhagīrathadhiyā vṛtām .

idaṃ pūrvaṃ parityajya kroḍīkṛtya tatas svayam .

dhairyaudāryadayāyuktaẖ kṣamāśamadamānvitaḥ .

peśalas snigdhamadhuro vidagdhaḫ prītanāgaraḥ .

veditā viditārthānāṃ dātā sakalasampadām .

kṛtvā ṣoḍaśavarṣātmā kṛtvā digvijayaṃ vaśī .

atiṣṭhad vigatāśaṅkaṃ pālayan dharmataḫ prajāḥ .
dhīmān sa mantribhis sārdhaṃ yaśasā śuklayan diśaḥ ..6.81.19..

atha gacchatsu varṣeṣu vasante prollasaty alam .
puṣpeṣu jṛmbhamāṇeṣu sphuratsu śaśiraśmiṣu ..6.81.20..

mañjarījāladolāsu viṭapāntaḫpurāntare .
rajaẖkarpūradhavale caladdalakavāṭake ..6.81.21..

āmodini lasatpuṣpagulucchakavitānake .
gāyatsu gahaneṣūccair mithuneṣv alināṃ mithaḥ ..6.81.22..

āyāti madhure vāyau śaśiśīkaraśītale .
kadalīkandalīkacchatalapallavalāsini ..6.81.23..

kāntāṃ prati babhūvāsya navaṃ cetas samutsukam .
kṣīvaṃ kusumasambhārasaugandhimadhurāsavaiḥ ..6.81.24..

manorājyam idaṃ cakre sa vasantamadaidhitaḥ .

kadā praṇayinīṃ mugdhāṃ bālābjamukulastanīm .

kadā kamalavallīnāṃ dolāsv alir ivālinīm .

mṛṇālahārakundenduvṛndatalpābhilāṣiṇī .

velopavanadolāsu līlākamalinīṣu ca .
vallīvalayageheṣu vividhodyānabhūmiṣu ..6.81.30..

vanopavanavinyāsavarṇanāvalitāsu ca .
śṛṅgārarasagarbhāsu kathāsv aramatonmanāḥ ..6.81.31..

hārihāsalasacchvāsavilolālakavallarīḥ .
kumārīḫ pūjayām āsa suvarṇakalaśastanīḥ ..6.81.32..

evam asya vidur bhavyā mantriṇo navaniścayam .

nīlanīrajanetrāṃ tāṃ cūḍālāṃ sa śikhidhvajaḥ .
snehād vikāsayām āsa śobhayārka ivābjinīṃ ..6.81.37..

antaḫpureṣu dolāsu candanāguruvīthiṣu .
mandāradāmadolāsu kadalīkandalīṣu ca ..6.81.40..

purānteṣu vanānteṣu diganteṣu sarassu ca .

svarūpam ekam evaitau dadhatur miśratāṃ gatau .
anyo'nyaṃ hṛdayasthatvād iva saṅkrāntam akṣatam ..6.81.44..

sarvaśāstrādivaidagdhyaṃ citrādy api mukhāt prabhoḥ .

vaidagdhyasundaramatī sarvaśāstrārthakovidau .

reje lasannṛpatibhogavilāsakāntam

brahmābjaṣaṇḍakuhareṣv iva rājahaṃsa-

evaṃ bahūni varṣāṇi mithunaṃ nirbharaspṛham .
reme yauvanalīlābhir anantābhir dine dine ..6.82.1..

atha yāteṣu varṣeṣu bahuṣv āvṛttiśāliṣu .
śanair galati tāruṇye bhinnakumbhād ivāmbhasi ..6.82.2..

śāradasyeva parṇasya mithunasyāsya kālataḥ .

virāgavāsanākrāntam ekāntastham acintayat .

kiṃ nāmeha manohāri saṃsārakuharabhrame .

pātaḫ pakvaphalasyeva maraṇaṃ durnivāraṇam .
himāśanir ivāmbhoje jarā nipatanonmukhī ..6.82.6..

āyur galaty avirataṃ jalaṃ karatalād iva .

śailanadyā raya iva samprayāty eva yauvanam .

tad iha syāt kusaṃsāre kiṃ nāma bata śobhanam .

ātmajñānaikamantreṇa saṃsṛtyākhyā viṣūcikā .
saṃśāmyatīti niścitya tāv āstāṃ tatparāyaṇau ..6.82.14..

taccittau tadgataprāṇau tatkathau tadvidāśrayau .

tatraivātighanābhyāsau bodhayantau parasparam .

atha sāvirataṃ bālā ramaṇīyapadakramān .

prekṣe tāvat svam ātmānaṃ kim idaṃ syām iti svayam .

dehas tāvaj jaḍo mūko nāham ity eva niścayaḥ .
ābālam etat saṃsiddhaṃ mṛtau caivānubhūyate ..6.82.20..

karmendriyagaṇaś cāsya na bhinno 'vayavātmakaḥ .
avayavāvayavinor abhedāj jaḍa eva ca ..6.82.21..

buddhīndriyagaṇo 'py evaṃ jaḍa eveti dṛśyate .
preryate manasā yasmād yaṣṭyeva bhuvi loṣṭakaḥ ..6.82.22..

manaś caiva jaḍaṃ manye saṅkalpātmakaśaktimat .

buddhir niścayarūpaivaṃ jaḍāsatyeti niścayaḥ .

jīvaś ca kalanākāro vātātmā hṛdaye sthitaḥ .
śukrasāro 'ntar anyena kenāpi parijīvati ..6.82.26..

ām aho jñātam etena cetyollekhakalaṅkinā .
jīvo jīvati jīvena cidrūpeṇātmarūpiṇā ..6.82.27..

cetyabhramavatā jīvaś cidrūpeṇaiva jīvati .
āmodaḫ pavaneneva khāteneva saridrayaḥ ..6.82.28..

asatyajaḍacetyāṃśaśrayaṇāc cidvapur jaḍam .
mahājaḍagato hy agnir api rūpaṃ svam ujjhati ..6.82.29..

sad vāsad vā yad ābhāsi cit samācāmati svataḥ .
svaṃ rūpam alam utsṛjya tad eva bhavati kṣaṇāt ..6.82.30..

evaṃ cidrūpam apy etac cetyonmukhatayā svayam .
jaḍaṃ śūnyam asaṅkalpaṃ cetaty anyaprabodhitam ..6.82.31..

iti sañcintya cūḍālā kenaiṣā cit pracetate .
iti sañcintayām āsa cirāc cetthaṃ vyabudhyata ..6.82.32..

aho nu cirakālena jñātaṃ jñeyam anāmayam .
yad vai ciccamitaṃ kṛtvā na kiñcid dūyate punaḥ ..6.82.33..

ete hi cidvilāsāntā manobuddhīndriyādayaḥ .
asantas santa evāho dvitīyenduvad āsthitāḥ ..6.82.34..

mahācid ekaivāstīha mahāsatteti yocyate .
niṣkalaṅkā samā śuddhā nirahaṅkārarūpiṇī ..6.82.35..

śuddhasaṃvedanākārā śivaṃ cinmātram acyutā .
sakṛdvibhātā vimalā nityodayavatī sthitā ..6.82.36..

sadbrahmaparamātmādināmabhir yābhidhīyate .
cetyacetanacittādi nāsyā bhinnaṃ na sā tataḥ ..6.82.37..

tayaiṣā cetyate cicchrīs saiṣādyā cid iti smṛtā .
acetyaṃ yad idaṃ cittvaṃ tat tasyā rūpam akṣatam ..6.82.38..

manobuddhīndriyādyartharūpais saivaṃ vijṛmbhate .
taraṅgakaṇakallolavalanair ambv ivātmani ..6.82.39..

jagadbhūtapadārthānāṃ sattā sphurati sāntare .
yad idaṃ tat paraṃ rūpaṃ tasyāẖ khalu mahāciteḥ ..6.82.40..

śuddhasaṃvinmahāsiṃhī seyaṃ samasamoditā .
ananyayaivānyayeva jagajjṛmbhikayā sthitā ..6.82.41..

sattā tadvyatirekeṇa nānyā sambhavatīha hi .
vicitrahemabhāṇḍānāṃ nanu hemetarā yathā ..6.82.42..

sā yathodeti tadrūpam ātmānaṃ cetati svayam .
svacittvena dravatvena taraṅgāditvam ambv iva ..6.82.43..

mahācito jagac cittvād udetīvānudayy api .
tadātmaiva yathāvarto rūpavāñ jaladhau dravāt ..6.82.44..

evaṃ cinmātram evāham anahambhāvam ātatam .
na tasya janmamaraṇe na ca stas sadasadgatī ..6.82.45..

na nāśas sambhavaty asya cinmātranabhasaẖ kvacit .

aho nu cirakālena śāntāsmi parinirvṛtā .
nirvāsitamatir muktam āse nirmandarābdhivat ..6.82.47..

asadābhāsam atyaccham anantam ajam acyutam .
ātmākāśam anāyāsam avalambya rame ciram ..6.82.48..

anantam idam ākāśaṃ bhūtaughaś cācalādikaḥ .
surāsurayutaṃ viśvam etanmayam akṛtrimam ..6.82.49..

pustakarmamayī senā sarvā mṛṇmātrakaṃ yathā .
draṣṭṛdṛśyadṛśāṃ sattā cinmātraikamayī tathā ..6.82.50..

idam aikyam idaṃ dvitvam ahaṃ nāham itīti ca .

tad anantam anāyāsam upaśāntāsmi khaṃ sthitā .
nirvāmi parinirvāṇā satyam āse gatajvaram ..6.82.52..

acetanaṃ cetanaṃ vā yo yo nāmābhicetati .
sattāmātrātma tadrūpaṃ svaṃ mahāciti saṃsthitam ..6.82.53..

teneha nāham nānyaś ca na bhāvābhāvasambhavaḥ .

dinānudinam eṣātha svātmārāmatayā tayā .
nityam antarmukhatayā babhūva prakṛtisthitiḥ ..6.83.1..

nīrāgā nīrujāsaṅgā nirdvandvā nissamīhitā .

paritīrṇā bhavāmbhodhiṃ śāntasandehajālikā .

viśrāntā suciraśrāntā ghanalabdhapadātmani .

yathāyam āgataẖ kaścij jāgatas spandavibhramaḥ .

adṛṣṭasakalabhrāntau pade viśrāntim etya sā .

anākulasamāloke āśaśvāsātmanātmani .

svavivekaghanābhyāsavaśād ātmodayena sā .

atha tām anavadyāṅgīṃ kadācit sa śikhidhvajaḥ .
apūrvaśobhām ālokya smayamāna uvāca ha ..6.83.10..

bhūyo yauvanayukteva maṇḍiteva punaḫ punaḥ .
adhikaṃ rājase tanvi jagadrājyavatī yathā ..6.83.11..

prapītāmṛtasāreva labdhālabhyapadeva ca .

upaśāntaṃ ca kāntaṃ ca dadhānā sundaraṃ vapuḥ .
abhibhūyendum āyāsi śriyaṃ kām api kāmini ..6.83.13..

tṛṇīkṛtatribhuvanaṃ pītākhilajagattrayam .

bhogair abhuktais tuṣyāmi bhuktair iva sudūragaiḥ .

evam ātmani viśrāntāṃ vadantīṃ tāṃ varānanām .

yad idaṃ dṛśyate kiñcij jagat sasthāsnujaṅgamam .

ātmajño vāpy anātmajñas siddhyarthaṃ līlayā tathā .

trividhaṃ sambhavaty aṅga sādhyaṃ vastv iha sarvataḥ .

yad yad āhlādanakaram ādeyaṃ tad asanmateḥ .

sanmater viduṣo jñasya sarvam ātmamayaṃ yadā .
traya eva tadā pakṣās sambhavanti na kecana ..6.84.25..

kevalaṃ sarvam evedaṃ kadācil līlayā na vā .
upekṣyam akṣinikṣiptam ālokayati vā na vā ..6.84.26..

jñasyopekṣyātmakaṃ rāma mūḍhasyādeyatāṃ gatam .
heyaṃ sphāravirāgasya śṛṇu siddhikramaṃ katham ..6.84.27..

deśakālakriyādravyasādhanās sarvasiddhayaḥ .
jīvam āhlādayantīha vasanta iva bhūtalam ..6.84.28..

madhye caturṇām eteṣāṃ kriyā prathamakalpikī .
siddhyādisādhane sādhos tanmayās te yataẖ kramāḥ ..6.84.29..

gulikāñjanakhaḍgādikriyākramanirūpaṇam .
tatrāstāṃ tāvad eṣo 'tra vistāraḫ prakṛtārthahā ..6.84.30..

ratnauṣadhitapomantrakriyākramanirūpaṇam .
tatrāstāṃ tāvad eṣo 'tra vistāraḫ prakṛtārthahā ..6.84.31..

śrīśaile siddhadeśe ca mervādau vā nivāsataḥ .
siddhir ity api vistāraẖ kriyotthā prakṛtārthahā ..6.84.32..

tasmāc chikhidhvajakathāprasaṅgapatitām imām .
prāṇādipavanābhyāsakriyāṃ siddhiphalāṃ śṛṇu ..6.84.33..

samūlam akhilās tyaktvā sādhyārthetaravāsanāḥ .
gudādidvārasaṅkocāt sthānakādikriyākramaiḥ ..6.84.34..

bhojanāsanaśuddhyā ca sādhuśāstrārthabhāvanāt .
svācārāt sujanāsaṅgāt sarvatyāgāt sukhāsanāt ..6.84.35..

prāṇāyāmaghanābhyāsād rāma kālena kenacit .
kopalobhādisantyāgād bhogatyāgāc ca suvrata ..6.84.36..

tyāgādānanirodheṣu bhṛśaṃ yānti vidheyatām .
prāṇāḫ prabhutvatajjñasya puṃso bhṛtyā ivākhilāḥ ..6.84.37..

rājyādyā mokṣaparyantās samastā eva sampadaḥ .
dehānilavidheyatvasādhyās sarvasya rāghava ..6.84.38..

parimaṇḍalitākārā kandasthānasamāśritā .
antraveṣṭanikā nāma nāḍī nāḍīśatāśritā ..6.84.39..

vīṇāgrāvartasadṛśī salilāvartasannibhā .
lipyādyoṅkārasaṃsthānā kuntalāvartavat sthitā ..6.84.40..

devāsuramanuṣyeṣu mṛganakrakhagādiṣu .
kīṭādiṣv abjajānteṣu sarveṣu prāṇiṣūditā ..6.84.41..

śītārtasuptabhogīndrabhogavad baddhamaṇḍalā .
sitā kalpāgnivigaladinduvad baddhakuṇḍalā ..6.84.42..

manobhrūmadhyarandhrādhoviśadabvṛtticañcalā .
anārataṃ rasasyandaiḫ plavamānaiva tiṣṭhati ..6.84.43..

asyā abhyantare tasmin kadalīkośakomale .
yā vātaśaktis sphurati veṇāv iva lasadgatiḥ ..6.84.44..

soktā kuṇḍalinī nāmnā kuṇḍalākāravāhinī .
prāṇinaḫ paramā śaktis sarvaśaktijavapradā ..6.84.45..

aniśaṃ niśśvasadrūpā kupiteva bhujaṅgamī .
saṃsthitordhvīkṛtamukhī spandānāṃ hetutāṃ gatā ..6.84.46..

yadā prāṇānilo yāti hṛdi kuṇḍalinīpadam .
tadā saṃvid udety antar bhūtatanmātrabījabhūḥ ..6.84.47..

yadā kuṇḍalinī dehe sphuraty abja ivālinī .
tadā saṃvid udety antar mṛdusparśavaśodayā ..6.84.48..

sparśena mṛdunā nāḍyā liṅgakāmātapatrayoḥ .
yathā saṃvid udety uccais tathā kuṇḍalinī javāt ..6.84.49..

tasyāṃ samastās sambaddhā nāḍyo hṛdayakośagāḥ .
utpadyante vilīyante mahārṇava ivāpagāḥ ..6.84.50..

nityaṃ vātātmakatayā spandonmukhatayā tayā .
sā sarvasaṃvidāṃ bījam ekam ādyam udāhṛtam ..6.84.51..

dikkālādyanavacchinnā citsaṃvit sarvagāsti hi .
tasyāẖ kuṇḍalinīkośāt kenārthenodayas sphuṭaḥ ..6.84.52..

sarvadā sarvatas satyaṃ citsaṃvid vidyate 'nagha .
kiṃ tv asyā bhūtatanmātravaśād abhyudayaẖ kvacit ..6.84.53..

sarvatra vidyamānā cid deheṣu taralāyate .
sarvago 'py ātapas sāraratneṣv ativijṛmbhate ..6.84.54..

kvacin naṣṭaṃ kvacit suptaṃ kvacid ucchūnatāṃ gatam .
vastu vastuni yad dṛṣṭaṃ tat svabhāvavijṛmbhitam ..6.84.55..

etad bhūyaẖ krameṇāhaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te 'nagha .
deheṣv eva yathodeti bhṛśaṃ saṃvinmayaẖ kramaḥ ..6.84.56..

cetanācetanaṃ bhūtajātaṃ vyoma tathākhilam .
sarvaṃ cinmātrasanmātraṃ śūnyamātraṃ yathā nabhaḥ ..6.84.57..

tad dhi cinmātrasanmātram avikārādy anāmayam .
kvacit sthitaṃ saṃvidaiva kṛtatanmātrapañcakam ..6.84.58..

tat pañcakaṃ gataṃ dvitvaṃ likṣādyantaṃ svasaṃvidā .
antarbhūtavikārādi dīpād dīpaśataṃ yathā ..6.84.59..

svasattāmātrakeṇaiva saṅkalpalavarūpiṇā .
pañcakāni vrajantīha devatvaṃ tāni kānicit ..6.84.60..

kānicit tiryagāditvaṃ hemāditvaṃ ca kānicit .
kānicid dṛṣadāditvaṃ dravyāditvaṃ ca kānicit ..6.84.61..

evaṃ hi pañcakaṃ spandamātraṃ jagad iti sthitam .
citsaṃvid atra sarvatra vidyate raghunandana ..6.84.62..

kevalaṃ pañcakavaśād dehādau cetanābhidhā .
jaḍaspandābhidhā vāri sthāvarādau jaḍābhidhā ..6.84.63..

yathābdhiṣv ambv ito vīcir itas talam iti sthitam .
pañcakeṣu tathetaś cil lolarūpā jaḍā tv itaḥ ..6.84.64..

itas somya ito lolaẖ kim abdhir iti no yathā .
vikalpārhas tathaivaitat pañcakaṃ hi jaḍājaḍam ..6.84.65..

dehādipañcakaṃ jīvatspandi śailādikaṃ jaḍam .
sthāvarādy anilaspandi svabhāvavaśato 'nagha ..6.84.66..

na ca paryanuyoktavyās svabhāvā raghunandana .
śītoṣṇaṃ kiṃ himāgnyādi vakteti parihasyate ..6.84.67..

gṛhītavāsanāṃśānāṃ puṣṭabhāvavikāriṇām .
sthitayaḫ pañcakānāṃ hi yogyāḫ paryanuyojane ..6.84.68..

vāsanāṃśaviparyastā ito netum itaś ca tāḥ .
puṃsā prājñena śakyante sukhaṃ paryanuyojinā ..6.84.69..

aśubhe vā śubhe vāpi tena paryanuyojyate .
prabuddhavāsanaṃ nānyat pañcakaṃ suptavāsanam ..6.84.70..

yatra paryanuyogasya phalaṃ samanubhūyate .
tatra taṃ samprayuñjīta nākāśaṃ muṣṭibhiẖ kṣipet ..6.84.71..

tṛṇāgraniṣṭhā mervādyāḫ pañcakānāṃ hi rāśayaḥ .
viriñcaniṣṭhāẖ kīṭādyā ete sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ..6.84.72..

prasuptavāsanāẖ kecid yathā sthāvarajātayaḥ .
prabuddhavāsanāẖ kecid yathā narasurādayaḥ ..6.84.73..

svavāsanābilāẖ kecid yathā vai tiryagādayaḥ .
prakṣīṇavāsanāẖ kecid yathaite mokṣabhāginaḥ ..6.84.74..

yathāsvāsv eva saṃvitsu manobuddhyādibhiẖ kṛtāḥ .
hastapādādisaṃyuktaiẖ sañjñāḫ pañcakarāśibhiḥ ..6.84.75..

tiryagādibhir apy anyair anyās sañjñāḫ prakalpitāḥ .
sthāvarādibhir apy anyair anyathā saṃvidaẖ kṛtāḥ ..6.84.76..

iti sādho sphurantīme citrāḫ pañcakarāśayaḥ .
rūpair ādyantamadhyeṣu calācalajaḍājaḍaiḥ ..6.84.77..

eṣām eko hi saṅkalpaparamāṇur mahāmate .
bījam ākāśavṛkṣāṇāṃ sargāṇāṃ teṣv imāni tu ..6.84.78..

indriyāṇy aṅga puṣpāṇi viṣayāmodavanti hi .
icchābhramaryo rājantyo mañjaryaś cañcalāẖ kriyāḥ ..6.84.79..

lokāntarāṇi gucchāni gulmā malayameravaḥ .
pallavānīha jaladā latālīlā diśo daśa ..6.84.80..

vartamānāni bhūtāni bhaviṣyanti ca yāni tu .
jaganti tāny asaṅkhyāni phalāni raghunandana ..6.84.81..

evaṃbījās ta ete hi rāma pañcakapādapāḥ .
svayaṃ svabhāvāj jāyante svayaṃ naśyanti kālataḥ ..6.84.82..

svayaṃ nānātvam āyānti ciraṃ jāḍyāt sphuranti ca .
suviviktāś śamaṃ yānti taraṅgā iva toyadheḥ ..6.84.83..

yato yānti samutsedhaṃ yato yānti śamaṃ svayam .
ete jāḍyavivekābhyāṃ taraṅgā iva toyadheḥ ..6.84.84..

ye vivekavaśato layaṃ gatā
rāma pañcakavilāsarāśayaḥ .
te na bhūya iha yānti saṃsthitiṃ
prabhramanti jagatītare muhuḥ ..6.84.85..

etat pañcakabījaṃ yat kuṇḍalinyāṃ tad antare .
prāṇamārutarūpeṇa tasyāṃ sphurati sarvadā ..6.85.1..

sāntaẖ kuṇḍalinī spandasparśasaṃvitkalāmalā .
kaloktā kalanenāśu kathitā cetanena cit ..6.85.2..

jīvanāj jīvatāṃ yātā mananāc ca manas sthitā .
saṅkalpāt saiva saṅkalpo bodhād buddhir iti smṛtā ..6.85.3..

ahaṅkārakalāṃ yātā saiṣā puryaṣṭakābhidhā .
sthitā kuṇḍalinī dehe jīvaśaktir anuttamā ..6.85.4..

apānatām upāgatya satataṃ pravahaty adhaḥ .
samānanāmnī madhyasthā udānākhyoparisthitā ..6.85.5..

adhas tv apānarūpaiva madhye somyaiva sarvadā .
pṛṣṭhād udānarūpaiva puṃsas svasthasya tiṣṭhati ..6.85.6..

sarvayatnam adho yātā yadi yatnān na dhāryate .
tat pumān mṛtim āyāti tayā nirgatayā balāt ..6.85.7..

samastaivordhvam āyātā yadi yuktyā na dhāryate .
tat pumān mṛtyum āyāti tayā nirgatayā balāt ..6.85.8..

sarvathātmani cet tiṣṭhet tyaktvordhvādhogamāgamam .
taj jantor jāyate vyādhir malamārutarodhataḥ ..6.85.9..

sāmānyanāḍīvaidhuryāt sāmānyavyādhisambhavaḥ .
pradhānanāḍīvaidhuryāt pradhānavyādhisambhavaḥ ..6.85.10..

kiṃvināśāẖ kimutpādāś śarīre 'smin munīśvara .
ādhayo vyādhayaś caiva yathāvat kathayāśu me ..6.85.11..

ādhayo vyādhayaś caiva dvayaṃ duẖkhasya kāraṇam .
tannivṛttiṃ sukhaṃ vidyāt tatkṣayo mokṣa ucyate ..6.85.12..

mithaẖ kadācij jāyete kadācit samam eva tu .
paryāyeṇa kadācit tāv ādhivyādhī śarīrake ..6.85.13..

dehaduẖkhaṃ vidur vyādhim ādhyākhyaṃ vāsanāmayam .
maurkhyamūle hi te vidyāt tattvajñānaparikṣaye ..6.85.14..

atattvajñānavaśatas svendriyākramaṇaṃ vinā .
hṛdi tānavam ujjhatsu rāgadveṣeṣv anāratam ..6.85.15..

idaṃ prāptam idaṃ neti jāḍyāndhyaghanamohadāḥ .
ādhayas sampravartante varṣāsu mihikā iva ..6.85.16..

bhṛśaṃ sphurantīṣv icchāsu maurkhyāc cetasy anirjite .
durannābhyavahāreṇa durdeśākramaṇena ca ..6.85.17..

duṣkālavyavahāreṇa duṣkriyāsphuraṇena ca .
durjanāsaṅgadoṣeṇa durbhāvodbhavanena ca ..6.85.18..

kṣīṇatvād vā prapūrṇatvān nāḍiṣv asukhasaṃsṛtau .
prāṇe vidhuratāṃ yāte kupatheva navādhvage ..6.85.19..

daussthityakāraṇaṃ doṣād vyādhir dehe pravartate .
nadyāṃ prāvṛṇnidāghābhyām ivākāraviparyayaḥ ..6.85.20..

prāktanī vaihikī vāpi śubhā vāpy aśubhā matiḥ .
yaivādhikā saiva tathā tasmin yojayati krame ..6.85.21..

ādhayo vyādhayaś caivaṃ jāyante bhūtapañcake .
kathaṃ śṛṇu vinaśyanti rāghavāṇāṃ kulodvaha ..6.85.22..

dvividho hy ādhir astīha sāmānyas sāra eva ca .
vyavahāras tu sāmānyas sāro janmamayas smṛtaḥ ..6.85.23..

prāptenābhimatenaiva naśyanti vyāvahārikāḥ .
ādhikṣayeṇādhibhavāẖ kṣīyante vyādhayo 'py alam ..6.85.24..

ātmajñānaṃ vinā sāro nādhir naśyati rāghava .
bhūyo rajjvavabodhena rajjusarpo hi naśyati ..6.85.25..

ādhivyādhivilāsānāṃ rāma sārādhisaṅkṣayaḥ .
sarveṣāṃ mūlahā prāvṛṇnadīva taṭavīrudhām ..6.85.26..

anādhijā vyādhayas tu dravyamantraśubhakramaiḥ .
cikitsakādiśāstroktair naśyanty abhrair ivātapāḥ ..6.85.27..

snānamantrauṣadhopāyavaktṝṇy adhigatāni ca .
tvayā cikitsāśāstrāṇi kim anyad upadiśyate ..6.85.28..

ādheẖ kathaṃ bhaved vyādhiẖ kathaṃ ca sa vinaśyati .
dravyād itarayā yuktyā mantrapuṇyādipūrvayā ..6.85.29..

citte vidhurite dehas samyaṅ nānubhavaty ayam .
yathā hi ruṣito jantur agram eva na paśyati ..6.85.30..

anapekṣya yathāprāptam amārgam anudhāvati .
prakṛtaṃ mārgam utsṛjya śarārto hariṇo yathā ..6.85.31..

saṅkṣobhāt sāmyam utsṛjya vahanti prāṇavāyavaḥ .
dehe gajaghaṭārtāni payāṃsīva sarittaṭe ..6.85.32..

asamaṃ vahati prāṇe nāḍyo yānti visaṃsthitim .
asamyak saṃsthite bhūpe yathā varṇāśramakramāḥ ..6.85.33..

kāścin nāḍyaḫ prapūrṇatvaṃ yānti kāścic ca riktatām .
prāṇe vidhurite deśe sarvartau sarito yathā ..6.85.34..

kujīrṇatvam ajīrṇatvam atijīrṇatvam eva vā .
doṣāyaiva prayāty annaṃ prāṇasañcāraduṣkramaiḥ ..6.85.35..

yathā kāṣṭhāni nayati prāptaṃ deśaṃ saridrayaḥ .
tathānnāni nayaty antaḫ prāṇavātas svam āśrayam ..6.85.36..

yāny annāni virodhena tiṣṭhanty antaś śarīrake .
tāny eva vyādhitāṃ yānti pariṇāmasvabhāvataḥ ..6.85.37..

evam ādher bhaved vyādhir ādhyabhāvāc ca naśyati .
yathā mantraiś ca naśyanti vyādhayas tatkramaṃ śṛṇu ..6.85.38..

yathā virekaṃ kurvanti harītakyas svabhāvataḥ .
bhāvanāvaśataẖ kāryaṃ tathā yaralavādayaḥ ..6.85.39..

śuddhayā puṇyayā sādho kriyayā sādhusevayā .
manaḫ prayāti vaimalyaṃ nikaṣeṇeva kāñcanam ..6.85.40..

ānando vardhate dehe śuddhe cetasi rāghava .
pūrṇendāv udite vyabhre nairmalyaṃ bhuvane yathā ..6.85.41..

sattvaśuddhau vahanty ete krameṇa prāṇavāyavaḥ .
jarayanti tathānnāni vyādhis tena vinaśyati ..6.85.42..

ādhivyādhyor iti proktau nāśotpattikramau tvayi .
kuṇḍalinyāẖ kathāyogād adhunā prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu ..6.85.43..

puryaṣṭakāparākhyasya jīvasya prathamāśrayam .
viddhi kuṇḍalinīm antar āmodasyeva mañjarīm ..6.85.44..

tāṃ yadā pūrakābhyāsād āpūrya sthīyate ciram .
tadaiti mairavaṃ sthairyaṃ kāyasyāpīnatā tathā ..6.85.45..

yadā pūrakapūrṇāntar amuktaprāṇamārutam .
nīyate saṃvidaivordhvaṃ soḍhagharmaklamaśramaṃ ..6.85.46..

sarpī prakupitevoccair yāti daṇḍopamāṃ gatā .
nāḍīs sarvās samādāya dehe baddhā latopamā ..6.85.47..

tadā samastam evemaṃ khaṃ plāvayati dehakam .
nīrandhrā pavanāpūrṇā bhastrevāmbugataṃ naram ..6.85.48..

ityabhyāsavilāsena yogena vyomagāmitām .
yoginaḫ prāpnuvanty uccair dīnās te sudaśām iva ..6.85.49..

brahmanāḍipravāheṇa śaktiẖ kuṇḍalinī yadā .
bahir ūrdhvapravāheṇa dvādaśāṅgulamūrdhani ..6.85.50..

recakena prayogeṇa nāḍyantaranirodhinā .
muhūrtaṃ sthitim āpnoti tadā vyomagadarśanam ..6.85.51..

darśanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ brahman nayanāṃśugaṇaṃ vinā .
anyeṣām indriyāṇāṃ ca tattvam evaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ..6.85.52..

na kecana mahābāho bhūcareṇa nabhaścarāḥ .
adivyair āśritājñānair dṛśyante puruṣendriyaiḥ ..6.85.53..

vijñānādūrasaṃsthena buddhinetreṇa rāghava .
dṛśyante vyomagās siddhās svapnavat svārthadā api ..6.85.54..

svapnāvalokanaṃ yadvat tadvat siddhāvalokanam .
kevalo 'yaṃ viśeṣo yat siddhaprāptau sthirārthatā ..6.85.55..

mukhād bahir dvādaśānte recakābhyāsayuktitaḥ .
prāṇe ciraṃ sthitiṃ nīte praviśanty aparāṃ purīm ..6.85.56..

vada svabhāvasya kathaṃ brahman na calati sthitiḥ .
vaktāras sānukampā hi duṣpraśne 'pi na khedinaḥ ..6.85.57..

śaktir vastusvabhāvākhyā yathā sphurati yātmanaḥ .
sargādinā tathaivāsau sthitiṃ yātīti niścayaḥ ..6.85.58..

avastutvād avidyāyā vastuśaktir api kvacit .
bhidyate dṛśyate hy aṅga vasante śāradaṃ phalam ..6.85.59..

sarvam evaṃvidhaṃ brahma nānānānātayānayā .
dṛśyate vyavahārārthaṃ kevalaṃ kalpyate sthitiḥ ..6.85.60..

sūkṣmacchidrādigatyarthaṃ pūraṇārthaṃ ca khasya vā .
aṇutāṃ sthūlatāṃ vāpi kāyo 'yaṃ nīyate katham ..6.85.61..

kāṣṭhakrakacayoś śleṣād yathā cchedaḫ pravartate .
tayos saṅgharṣaṇād agnis svabhāvāj jāyate tathā ..6.85.62..

māṃsābjayantraṃ jaṭhare sthitaṃ śliṣṭamukhaṃ mithaḥ .
ūrdhvādhassammilanmūlaṃ dyubhūmyor iva vai talam ..6.85.63..

tasya kuṇḍalinī lakṣmīr nilīnāntar nijāspade .
padmarāgasamudgasya kośe muktāvalī yathā ..6.85.64..

āvartaphenamāleva nityaṃ śalaśalāyate .
daṇḍāhateva bhujagī susannatavivartanā ..6.85.65..

dyāvāpṛthivyor madhyasthā kriyeva spandarūpiṇī .
saṃvinmadhuvibodhotthā hṛtpadmapuṭaṣaṭpadī ..6.85.66..

tat sarvaṃ śaktipadmādi bāhyair ābhyantarais sadā .
hṛdi vyādhūyate vātair abhravṛndam ivābhitaḥ ..6.85.67..

yad yad vyoma sphuraty aṅga svabhāvāt tatra vāyavaḥ .
pelavaṃ mṛdu yat kiñcit tat tat pracalayanty alam ..6.85.68..

vātair āhanyamānaṃ tat padmādi taralāyate .
hṛdy anyo'nyanikāṣeṇa pallavādi yathā tarau ..6.85.69..

dehoṣmakāraṇaṃ sarvarasādipacanodyatam .
janayaty agnim anyo'nyasaṅgharṣād ghanaveṇuvat ..6.85.70..

svabhāvaśītaśītātmā dehas tenauṣṇyam ety alam .
uditena sa sarvāṅgaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhānunā yathā ..6.85.71..

sarvato visaradraśmi tat tejas tārakākṛti .
hṛtpadmahemabhramaro yogināṃ cintyatāṃ gatam ..6.85.72..

tat prakāśamayaṃ jñānaṃ cintitaṃ sat prayacchati .
yena yojanalakṣasthaṃ vastu niśy api dṛśyate ..6.85.73..

tasyāgner vāḍavasyeva jalaṃ saṃśuṣkam indhanam .
māṃsapaṅkajaṣaṇḍāḍhyahṛtsaraẖ kośavāsinaḥ ..6.85.74..

yad abjaśītalatvaṃ tad apānātmendur ucyate .
itīndor utthitas so 'gnir agnīṣomau hi dehakaḥ ..6.85.75..

sarvam ūṣmātmakaṃ kiñcit tejo'rkāgnyabhidhaṃ viduḥ .
śītātmakaṃ ca somākhyam ābhyām eva kṛtaṃ jagat ..6.85.76..

vidyāvidyāsvarūpeṇa sarvaṃ sadasadātmanā .
jagad dvayena nirvṛttaṃ tad evaivaṃ vibhajyate ..6.85.77..

sac cit prakāśaṃ vidyādi sūryam agniṃ vidur budhāḥ .
asaj jāḍyaṃ tamo 'vidyādy āhus somaṃ maṇīṣiṇaḥ ..6.85.78..

vahnir vāryātmanas somād udetīti mune śrutam .
somasyotpattim adhunā vada me vadatāṃ vara ..6.85.79..

agnīṣomau mithaẖ kārye kāraṇe ca svasaṃsthiteḥ .
paryāyeṇa samau caitau prajāyete parasparam ..6.85.80..

janmāṅga bījāṅkuravat tathā divasarātrivat .
sthitiś chāyātapasamā kevalā caitayor bhavet ..6.85.81..

tulyakālopalambhā hi mithaś chāyātapasthitiḥ .
kevalaikopalambhā syāt sthitir divasarātrivat ..6.85.82..

kāryakāraṇabhāvaś ca dvividhaẖ kathito 'nayoḥ .
sadrūpapariṇāmottho vināśapariṇāmajaḥ ..6.85.83..

ekasmād yad dvitīyasya sambhavo 'ṅkurabījavat .
kāryakāraṇabhāvo 'sau sadrūpapariṇāmajaḥ ..6.85.84..

ekanāśe dvitīyasya yad bhāvo dinarātrivat .
kāryakāraṇabhāvo 'sau vināśapariṇāmajaḥ ..6.85.85..

sadrūpapariṇāmasya mṛdghaṭakramasaṃsthiteḥ .
akṣopalambhād itarat pramāṇaṃ nopayujyate ..6.85.86..

vināśapariṇāmasya dinarātrikramasthiteḥ .
abhāvo 'py ekavastūttho gato mukhyapramāṇatām ..6.85.87..

svanāśe nāsti kartṛtvam ityādyā yuktivādinaḥ .
avajñāya bahiẖ kāryās svānubhūtyapalāpinaḥ ..6.85.88..

pratyakṣavad abhāvo 'pi pramaiva raghunandana .
agnyabhāvo hi śītasya pramāṇaṃ sarvajantuṣu ..6.85.89..

agner dhūmatayā bhāgo yaḫ prayāti payodatām .
sadrūpapariṇāmena tad agnis somakāraṇam ..6.85.90..

agnir nāśātmakatayā śaityād aptāṃ prayāti yat .
vināśapariṇāmena tad agnis somakāraṇam ..6.85.91..

saptāmbudhipayaḫ pītvā dhūmodgāreṇa vāḍavaḥ .
payodatāṃ prayātena tad eva janayaty alam ..6.85.92..

arkaḫ pītvā niśānātham amāvasyāṃ punaḫ punaḥ .
udgiraty amale pakṣe mṛṇālam iva sārasaḥ ..6.85.93..

pītvāmṛtopamaṃ śītaṃ prāṇas somaṃ mukhāgragaṃ .
abbhāgam āpūrayati śarīre 'pānatāṃ gataḥ ..6.85.94..

jalād aṇutayā bhāgo yaḫ prayāty arkaraśmitām .
sadrūpapariṇāmena taj jalaṃ vahnikāraṇam ..6.85.95..

nāśātmakatayā toyam auṣṇyād yāti yad agnitām .
vināśapariṇāmena tat toyaṃ vahnikāraṇam ..6.85.96..

agner vināśe sadrūpaḫ pariṇāmo niśākaraḥ .
indor nāśe nigharṣotthapariṇāmo hutāśanaḥ ..6.85.97..

hutāśo nāśam āgatya somo bhavati vai tathā .
divaso nāśam āgatya rātrir bhavati vai yathā ..6.85.98..

tamaḫprakāśayoś chāyātapayor dinarātrayoḥ .
madhye vilakṣaṇaṃ rūpaṃ prājñair api na labhyate ..6.85.99..

sandhir apy ābilo yas syād etayor eva tad vapuḥ .
bhāvābhāvau yathaikasya śliṣṭāv etau tathaiva hi ..6.85.100..

dvābhyāṃ caitanyajāḍyābhyāṃ bhūtāni prasphuranti hi .
yathā tamaḫprakāśābhyām ahorātrā mahītale ..6.85.101..

cidrūpajaḍarūpābhyām ārabdheyaṃ jagatsthitiḥ .
jalāmṛtābhyāṃ miśrābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ tanur ivaindavī ..6.85.102..

prakāśam analaṃ sūryaṃ cidrūpaṃ viddhi rāghava .
jaḍātmakaṃ tamorūpaṃ viddhi somaśarīrakam ..6.85.103..

citsūrye nirmale dṛṣṭe tamo naśyed bhavāmayaḥ .
vyomasūrye bahir dṛṣṭe yathā kṛṣṇaniśātamaḥ ..6.85.104..

somadehe jaḍe dṛṣṭe cittejo 'satyavad bhavet .
niśīthe vilasaccandre yathā sauraḫ prabhābharaḥ ..6.85.105..

somaṃ prakaṭayaty agniś cid dehaṃ suciraprabhā .
agniṃ bhāsayatīnduś ca dehaṃ svaṃ rūpam arpayan ..6.85.106..

cin niṣkriyā tv anābhāsā kevalā nopalabhyate .
āloka iva dīpena dehenaivāvagamyate ..6.85.107..

citaś cetyonmukhatvena lābhas saiva ca saṃsṛtiḥ .
niścetyāyās tu no lābho nirvāṇaṃ ca tad eva hi ..6.85.108..

anyo'nyalabdhasattākāv evaṃ kuḍyaprakāśavat .
agnīṣomāv imau viddhi sampṛktau dehadehinau ..6.85.109..

atiśāyini nirvāṇe jāḍye caivātiśāyini .
agnes somasya caivāṅga sthitir bhavati kevalā ..6.85.110..

prāṇo 'gnir uṣṇaprakṛtir apānaś śītalaś śaśī .
chāyātapavad ity etau saṃsthitau mukhamārgagau ..6.85.111..

apāne śītale sattām ety uṣṇaḫ prāṇapāvakaḥ .
pratibimbam ivādarśe sa ca tasmiṃs tathaiva hi ..6.85.112..

cidagniḫ padmayantrasthaṃ somaṃ vāryātmakaṃ tviṣā .
janayaty anubhūtyeha kuḍyālokaṃ yathā bahiḥ ..6.85.113..

saṃsṛtyādau hi yā kācit saṃvic chītoṣṇarūpiṇī .
agnīṣomābhidhāṃ prāptā saiva sargo nṛṇām iha ..6.85.114..

yatra somakalā grastā kṣaṇaṃ sūryeṇa ṣoḍaśī .
mukhād vitastimātrāgre tatra baddhapado bhava ..6.85.115..

nūnaṃ sūryapadaṃ prāptas somo yatra hṛdambare .
nūnaṃ kevalayā sthityā tatra baddhapado bhava ..6.85.116..

auṣṇyam agniś cid ādityaś śaityaṃ soma udāhṛtaḥ .
yatraitau pratibimbasthau tatra baddhapado bhava ..6.85.117..

śārīrasomasūryāgnisaṅkrāntijño bhavānagha .
atra yojanalakṣasthaṃ vastu paśyasi niśy api .
atra saṅkrāntikālā hi bāhyās tṛṇasamās smṛtāḥ ..6.85.118..

saṅkrāntim uttaram athāyanam aṅga samyak-
kālaṃ tathā viṣuvatī yadi dehavātaiḥ .
antar bahisstham iva vetsi yathānubhūtaṃ
tac chocasīha na punaḫ param abhyupetaḥ ..6.85.119..

aṇutāṃ sthūlatāṃ cāyaṃ yathā gacchati yoginām .
deho rāma tathā samyag vakṣyamāṇam idaṃ śṛṇu ..6.86.1..

hṛdy abjapattrakośotthaḫ prasphuraty ānalaẖ kaṇaḥ .
hemabhramaravat sāndhye vidyutkaṇa ivāmbude ..6.86.2..

sa pravardhanasaṃvittyā vātyayevāśu vardhate .
saṃvidrūpatayā nūnam arkavad yāti codayam ..6.86.3..

sandhyābhraprathamārkābho vṛddhim abhyāgataẖ kṣaṇāt .
gālayaty akhilaṃ sāṅgaṃ dehaṃ hema yathānalaḥ ..6.86.4..

jalasparśāsaho yuktyā gālayaty upalādy api .
bāhya evānalaspanda āntaras tu viśeṣataḥ ..6.86.5..

sa śarīradravaḫ paścād vidhūya kvāpi nīyate .
citkṣobhitena prāṇena nīhāro vātyayā yathā ..6.86.6..

ādhāranāḍinirhīnā vyomasthaivāvaśiṣyate .
śaktiẖ kuṇḍalinī vahner dhūmalekheva nirgatā ..6.86.7..

kroḍīkṛtamanobuddhimayajīvādyahaṅkṛtiḥ .
antassphuraccamatkārā dhūmalekheva tāgarī ..6.86.8..

bisavālavraṇe bhittāv upale divi bhūtale .
sā yathā yojyate yatra tena niryāty alaṃ tathā ..6.86.9..

saṃvittis saiva yady aṅga rasādānād yathākramam .
rasenāpūrṇatām eti tan nīhāra ivāmbunā ..6.86.10..

rasapūrṇā yam ākāraṃ bhāvayaty āśu tat tathā .
dhatte citrakṛto buddhau rekhā rāma yathākṛtim ..6.86.11..

dṛḍhabhāvavaśād antar asthīny āpnoti sā tataḥ .
mātṛgarbhaniṣaṇṇeva suṣiktevāṅkurasthitiḥ ..6.86.12..

yathābhimatam ākāraṃ pramāṇaṃ ceti rāghava .
jīvaśaktir avāpnoti sumervādi tṛṇādi vā ..6.86.13..

śrutaṃ tvayā yogasādhyam aṇimādyarthasādhanam .
jñānasādhyam idānīṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu śravaṇabhūṣaṇam ..6.86.14..

ekaṃ cinmātram astīha śuddhaṃ somyam alakṣitam .
sūkṣmāt sūkṣmataraṃ śāntaṃ nājagan na jagatkriyāḥ ..6.86.15..

tac cinoty ātmanātmānaṃ saṅkalponmukhatāṃ gatam .
yadā tadā jīva iti proktam ābilatāṃ gatam ..6.86.16..

asatyam eva saṅkalpabhrameṇedaṃ śarīrakam .
jīvaḫ paśyati mūḍhātmā bālo yakṣam ivoddhatam ..6.86.17..

yadā tu jñānadīpena samyagāloka āgate .
saṅkalpamoho jīvasya kṣīyate śaradabhravat ..6.86.18..

śāntim āyāti deho 'yaṃ sarvasaṅkalpasaṅkṣaye .
tadā rāghava niśśeṣaṃ dīpas tailakṣaye yathā ..6.86.19..

nidrāvyapagame jantur yathā svapnaṃ na paśyati .
jīvo hi bhāvite satye tathā dehaṃ na paśyati ..6.86.20..

atattve tattvabhāvena jīvo dehāvṛtas sthitaḥ .
nirdeho bhavati śrīmān sukhī tattvaikabhāvanāt ..6.86.21..

anātmani śarīrādāv ātmabhāvanam aṅga yat .
sūryādyālokadurbhedaṃ hārdaṃ tad dāruṇaṃ tamaḥ ..6.86.22..

ātmany evātmabhāvena sarvavyāpi nirañjanam .
cinmātram amalo 'smīti jñānādityena paśyati ..6.86.23..

pratimanvantaraṃ rāma buddhatām anutiṣṭhati .
kalau harir ameyātmā kiñcid āśritya kāraṇam ..6.86.24..

tasya buddhābhidhānasya munināthasya rāghava .
ye bhaktimanto dhīmanto mokṣamārgābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ ..6.86.25..

śūnyaṃ vijñānamātraṃ vā madhyaṃ vā kiñcid etayoḥ .
astīti hetūpanyāsair brahma vyapadiśanti te ..6.86.26..

teṣāṃ madhye hi vijñānavido dvitve kṣayīkṛte .
jagad bhrāntiparāmarśamātraṃ paśyanti netarat ..6.86.27..

madhyaṃ mādhyamikāḫ prāhuẖ kṣaṇabhaṅgavidaḫ pare .
na śūnyaṃ na ca vijñānam idaṃ kiñcid iti sthitāḥ ..6.86.28..

te śūnyavādinas tv anye śūnyatvadṛḍhabhāvanāḥ .
vyomnaś śūnyataraṃ sarvaṃ jagad ity āsthayojjhitāḥ ..6.86.29..

ekam ākāśam evoccair ākāśaviśadāśayāḥ .
paśyanti rāma nātmānaṃ jagadādi ca vā pṛthak ..6.86.30..

śilākuḍyena niryānti nabhasevānirodhitam .
śastrānilair na bhidyante nabhobhāgā ivācalāḥ ..6.86.31..

sumeruvipulākārā apy ādityāṃśureṇuṣu .
bisatantuṣu megheṣu tiṣṭhanti paramāṇuvat ..6.86.32..

śūnyatvam iva saṃyātāś śūnyatābaddhabhāvanāḥ .
śūnyā iva nabhobhāgāś śūnye tiṣṭhanti vijvaram ..6.86.33..

śūnye ca viditātmāno bhāvayanti yathaiva yat .
tat tathaivāśu paśyanti dṛḍhabhāvanayā svayā ..6.86.34..

dṛḍhabhāvānusandhānād vimūḍhā api rāghava .
viṣaṃ nayanty amṛtatām amṛtaṃ viṣatām api ..6.86.35..

evaṃ yathā yathaiveha bhāvyate dṛḍhabhāvanam .
bhūyate hi tathaivāśu tad ety ālokitaṃ punaḥ ..6.86.36..

satyabhāvena dṛṣṭo 'yaṃ deho deho bhavaty alam .
dṛṣṭas tv asatyabhāvena vyomatāṃ yāti dehakaḥ ..6.86.37..

aṇimādipadaprāptau jñānayuktir iti śrutā .
bhavataiṣādhunā rāma yuktim anyām imāṃ śṛṇu ..6.86.38..

recakābhyāsayogena jīvaẖ kuṇḍalinīgṛhāt .
uddhṛtya yojyate vāyāv āmodaẖ kusumād iva ..6.86.39..

tyajyate vigataspando deho 'yaṃ kāṣṭhaloṣṭavat .
dehe vijīve vimaṇau vaṃśe ca ka ivādaraḥ ..6.86.40..

sthāvare jaṅgame vāpi yathābhimatayecchayā .
bhoktuṃ tatsampadaṃ samyag jīvo 'ntar viniveśyate ..6.86.41..

iti siddhiśriyaṃ bhuktvā sthitaṃ cet tad vapuḫ punaḥ .
praviśyate svam anyad vā yad yathātrābhirocate ..6.86.42..

dehād ayātayā viṣvag vyāptavatyā ca khānilam .
saṃvidā jagad āpūrya sampūrṇaṃ sthīyate 'tha vā ..6.86.43..

jñātvā sadābhyuditam ujjhitadoṣam īśaṃ
yad yad yathā samabhivāñchati citprakāśaḥ .
prāpnoti tat tad acireṇa tathaiva rāma
sampatpadaṃ vidur anāvaraṇatvam eva ..6.86.44..

aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryayuktā sā nṛpamāninī .
evaṃ babhūva cūḍālā ghanābhyāsavatī satī ..6.87.1..

jagāmākāśamārgeṇa viveśāmbudhikoṭaram .
cacāra vasudhāpīṭhe gaṅgevāmalaśītalā ..6.87.2..

kṣaṇam apy agatā bhartur vakṣasaś cetasas tathā .
sarveṣūvāsa rājyeṣu lakṣmīr iva jagatsu ca ..6.87.3..

ākāśagāminī śyāmā vidyudālolabhūṣaṇā .
babhrāma meghalekheva girimālā mahītale ..6.87.4..

kāṣṭhaṃ tṛṇopalaṃ bhūmiṃ khaṃ vātam analaṃ jalam .
nirvighnam aviśat sarvaṃ tantur muktāphalaṃ yathā ..6.87.5..

meror upari śṛṅgāṇi lokapālapurāṇi ca .
digvyomodararandhrāṇi vijahāra yathāsukham ..6.87.6..

tiryagbhūtapiśācādyais saha nāgāmarāsuraiḥ .
vidyādharāpsarassiddhair vyavahāraṃ cakāra sā ..6.87.7..

yatnena taṃ ca bhartāram ātmajñānāmṛtaṃ prati .
bahuśo bodhayām āsa mātā bālam ivātmajam ..6.87.8..

na cāsāv āpa tadbhartā rājā viśrāntim ātmani .
muktāphalam asaṃśliṣṭaṃ muktāphala ivātale ..6.87.9..

etāvatāpi kālena tām evaṃguṇaśālinīm .
bālo vidyām iva nṛpaś cūḍālāṃ na viveda saḥ ..6.87.10..

kalāvidagdhā mugdhā ca bāleyaṃ gṛhiṇī mama .
ity eva kevalaṃ rājā sa cūḍālāṃ viveda tām ..6.87.11..

sāpy alabdhātmaviśrāntes tāṃ siddhiśriyam ātmanaḥ .
darśayām āsa no rājñaś śūdrasyeva makhakriyām ..6.87.12..

mahatyās siddhayoginyās tasyā api śikhidhvajaḥ .
yatnena prāpa no bodhaṃ budhyate 'nyaẖ kathaṃ prabho ..6.87.13..

upadeśakramo nāma vyavasthāmātrapālanam .
jñaptes tu kāraṇaṃ śuddhā śiṣyaprajñaiva rāghava ..6.87.14..

na śrutena na puṇyena jñāyate jñeyam ātmanaḥ .
jānāty ātmānam ātmaiva sarpas sarpapadāni va ..6.87.15..

evaṃ sthite varamune katham etaj janaśrutau .
śrutaṃ gurūpadeśaś ca svātmajñānasya kāraṇam ..6.87.16..

atyantaṃ kṛpaṇaẖ kaścit kirāṭo dhanadhānyavān .
āste vindhyāṭavīkacche kuṭumbī vraṇakīṭavat ..6.87.17..

tasyaikadā nipatitā gacchato vindhyajaṅgale .
ekā varāṭikā rāma tṛṇajālabusāvṛte ..6.87.18..

kārpaṇyāt sa prayatnena sarvaṃ tṛṇabusādikam .
kapardikārtham abhito dudhāva divasatrayam ..6.87.19..

kapardakād dvau bhavataś catvāro 'ṣṭau ca kālataḥ .
tataś śataṃ sahasraṃ ca sahasraṃ ceti cetasā ..6.87.20..

kalayañ jaṅgale dīno rātrindinam atandritaḥ .
janahāsaṃ sahaṃs trīṇi dināni dhutavān busam ..6.87.21..

tato dinatrayasyānte tena tasmāt kujaṅgalāt .
pūrṇendubimbapratimo labdhaś cintāmaṇir mahān ..6.87.22..

taṃ prāpya tuṣṭahṛdayas samāgatya gṛhaṃ sukhī .
prāptākhilajagadbhūtiś śāntasarvabhayas sthitaḥ ..6.87.23..

evaṃ yathā kirāṭena kapardānveṣaṇena tat .
ratnaṃ labdhaṃ jaganmūlyam ahorātram akhidyatā ..6.87.24..

tathā śrutopadeśena svātmajñānam avāpyate .
anyad anviṣyate cānyal labhyate hi gurukramāt ..6.87.25..

brahma sarvendriyātītaṃ śrutādīndriyasaṃvidā .
tenopadeśād anagha nātmatattvam avāpyate ..6.87.26..

gurūpadeśaṃ ca vinā nātmatattvāgamo bhavet .
kena cintāmaṇir labdhaẖ kapardānveṣaṇaṃ vinā ..6.87.27..

tattvasyāsya mahārghasya gurūpakathanaṃ gatam .
akāraṇaṃ kāraṇatāṃ maṇer iva kapardakaḥ ..6.87.28..

paśya rāghava māyeyaṃ mohanī mahatām api .
anyad anviṣyate yatnād anyad āsādyate phalam ..6.87.29..

anyat karoti puruṣaḫ phalam anyad eva
prāpnoti vastuniyatiś ca vilokyate ca .
tasmād anantavibhavasya jagatkramasya
śreyo 'tivāhanam asaṅgam avajñayaiva ..6.87.30..

tādṛśo 'pi bahujño 'pi jīvanmukto 'py asau muniḥ .

sabāhyābhyantaraṃ nityam ākāśaviśado 'pi ca .

sarvasyā eva rājendra bhūtajāter jagattraye .

ajñam astv atha vā tajjñaṃ yāvan mattaṃ śarīrakam .

ātmasvabhāvavaśato jātaṃ jagad idaṃ mahat .
sthitiṃ vāsanayābhyetya dharmādharmavaśe sthitam ..6.90.1..

vāsanāṃśaṃ samānīya dharmādharmair na gṛhyate .

atyudāraṃ mahārthaṃ ca vakṣi tvaṃ vadatāṃ vara .

tvadvākyavibhavenādya śrutenānena sundara .
pītenevendunā rāhur antar yāto 'smi śītatām ..6.90.4..

tat samāsena tāṃ tāvad ātmotpattiṃ vadāśu me .

sarge sphuradbhir matpuṇyair manye sampreṣito bhavān .

duẖkhād gacchāmi duẖkhaugham amṛtaṃ me viṣaṃ sthitam ..6.91.14..

pitāmaham ahaṃ pūrvaṃ kadācit pṛṣṭavān idam .
yat kriyājñānayor ekaṃ śreyas tad brūhi me vibho ..6.91.15..

jñānaṃ hi paramaṃ śreyaẖ ka ivaitan na vetty alam .
kālātivāhanāyaiva vinodāyocitā kriyā ..6.91.16..

alabdhajñānadṛṣṭīnāṃ kriyāmutra parāyaṇam .
yasya nāsty ambaraṃ paṭṭaṃ kambalaṃ kiṃ tyajaty asau ..6.91.17..

vāsanāmātrasāratvād ajñasya saphalāẖ kriyāḥ .
sarvā evāphalā jñasya vāsanāmātrasaṅkṣayāt ..6.91.18..

sarvā hi vāsanābhāve prayānty aphalatāṃ kriyāḥ .
suśubhāḫ phalavatyo 'pi sekābhāve latā iva ..6.91.19..

ṛtvantare yathā yāti vilayaṃ pūrvam ārtavam .
tathaiva vāsanānāśe nāśam eti kriyāphalam ..6.91.20..

na svabhāvena phalati yathā śaralatā phalam .
kriyā nirvāsanāmutra phalaṃ phalati no tathā ..6.91.21..

sayakṣavāsano bālo yakṣaṃ paśyati nānyathā .
saduẖkhavāsano mūḍho duẖkhaṃ paśyati nānyathā ..6.91.22..

ākārabhāsurāpy uccair na dadāti phalaṃ kriyā .
śubhāśubhā ca tajjñasya phullā śaralatā yathā ..6.91.23..

vāsanā ceha nāsty eva svāhaṅkārādirupiṇī .

yasya maurkhyaṃ kṣayaṃ yātaṃ sarvaṃ brahmeti bhāvanāt .
nodeti vāsanā tasya prājñasyevāmbudhīr marau ..6.91.25..

vāsanāmātrasantyāgāj jarāmaraṇavarjitam .

savāsanaṃ mano jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ nirvāsanaṃ manaḥ .
jñānena jñeyatām etya punar jīvo na jāyate ..6.91.27..

jñānam eva paraṃ śreya iti brahmādayo 'pi te .

itaẖ kamaṇḍalur ito daṇḍakāṣṭham ito bṛsī .

ko 'haṃ katham idaṃ jātaṃ kathaṃ śāmyati ceti bhoḥ .

kathaṃ bandhaẖ kathaṃ mokṣa iti praśnān udāharan .

dusspandasaṃvidā śailakoṭare kriyayānayā .

sādhūnāṃ samadṛṣṭīnāṃ paripraśnena sevayā .
saṅgamena ca sā yuktir labhyate mucyate yayā ..6.91.33..

mā narādhamavad grāsaṃ bhuñjāno vanakoṭare .
tiṣṭhāvaṣṭabdhaduśceṣṭo dharāvivarakīṭavat ..6.91.34..

kāntayā devarūpiṇyā tayaivaṃ pratibodhitaḥ .
asrupūrṇamukho vākyaṃ śikhidhvaja uvāca ha ..6.91.35..

aho 'vabodhito 'smy adya cirāt surasuta tvayā .
maurkhyād āryasamāsaṅgamukto 'ham avasaṃ vane ..6.91.36..

aho nu me kṣayaṃ yātaṃ mohadhvāntam aśeṣataḥ .
yat tvam evaṃ samāgatya samprabodhayasīha mām ..6.91.37..

gurus tvaṃ me pitā tvaṃ me mitraṃ tvaṃ me varānana .
śiṣyo namaskaromy agre pādau tava kṛpāṃ kuru ..6.91.38..

yad udāratamaṃ vetsi yasmiñ jñāte na śocyate .
bhavāmi nirvṛto yena tad brahmopadiśāśu me ..6.91.39..

ghaṭajñānādayo jñānavibhavās santy anekaśaḥ .

yady upādeyavākyo 'haṃ rājarṣe tad vadāmi te .

anupādeyavākyasya vaktuḫ pṛṣṭasya līlayā .

yad vakṣi tad anuṣṭheyaṃ mayā vidhir iva śruteḥ .
avikāritam evāśu satyam etad vrataṃ mama ..6.91.43..

yathā bālaḫ pitur vākyaṃ muktahetūpapādanam .
ādatte hi tathaivedaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ vaco mama ..6.91.44..

śravaṇānantaraṃ buddhyā śubham ity eva bhāvayan .
śṛṇu gītam iva tyaktvā hetvarthitvaṃ vaco mama ..6.91.45..

svacaritasadṛśaṃ tavodayantyāś

asti kaścit pumāñ śrīmān sthānaṃ nityaviruddhayoḥ .

kalāvāñ śāstrakuśalo vyavahāre vicakṣaṇaḥ .

anantayatnasaṃsādhye sa cintāmaṇisādhane .

tasya yatnena mahatā kālenādhyavasāyinaḥ .
siddhaś cintāmaṇiẖ kiṃ vā na sidhyaty unnatātmanām ..6.92.4..

pravṛttim udyamaṃ prajñāṃ prayuṅkte ced akhedavān .
akiñcano 'pi śakratvaṃ tad avāpnoty avighnataḥ ..6.92.5..

maṇim agre sthitaṃ prāptaṃ hastaprāpyaṃ dadarśa saḥ .
meror udayaśṛṅgastho munir indum ivoditam ..6.92.6..

babhūva maṇirājendre na tu niścayavān asau .
rājye jhagiti samprāpte sudīna iva pāmaraḥ ..6.92.7..

idaṃ sañcintayām āsa manasā smayaśālinā .
samprāptopekṣayā dīrghaduẖkhasambhramabhāvinā ..6.92.8..

ayaṃ maṇir maṇir nāyaṃ maṇiś cet tad bhaven na saḥ .
spṛśāmi na spṛśāmy enaṃ kadācit sparśato vrajet ..6.92.9..

naitāvataiva kālena maṇīndraẖ kila sidhyati .
yatnenājīvitāntena sidhyatīty āgamakramaḥ ..6.92.10..

kriyānikūṇitenākṣṇā lolālātatalopamam .
ratnālokaṃ prapaśyāmi dvicandratvam iva bhramāt ..6.92.11..

kuta etāvatī sphītā bhāgyasampan mamātatā .
adhunaiva yad āpnomi maṇīndraṃ sarvasiddhidam ..6.92.12..

kecid eva mahāntas te mahābhāgyā bhavanti hi .
yeṣām alpena kālena prayānty abhimukhaṃ śriyaḥ ..6.92.13..

aham alpatapās sādhur varāko mānuṣaẖ kila .
siddhayaẖ katham āyānti mām abhāgyaikabhājanam ..6.92.14..

evaṃ vikalpasaṅkalpaiś ciram ajñaḫ parāmṛśan .
na maṇigrahaṇe yatnam akaron maurkhyamohitaḥ ..6.92.15..

na yadā yena labdhavyaṃ na tat prāpnoty asau tadā .
cintāmaṇir avāpto 'pi durdhiyā helayojjhitaḥ ..6.92.16..

iti tasmin sthite yāto maṇir uḍḍīya siddhayaḥ .
tyajanti hy avamantāraṃ śarā guṇam ivojjhitāḥ ..6.92.17..

hṛtvā prāksampadaḫ puṃsas sa yātas siddhayaẖ kila .
āgatās samprayacchanti sarvaṃ yātā haranty alam ..6.92.18..

pumān bhūyaẖ kriyāyatnaṃ cakre ratnendrasādhane .

dadarśātha kacadrūpaṃ kācakhaṇḍam apaṇḍitaḥ .

ayaṃ cintāmaṇir iti mūḍhas tasmin sa vastutām .

aṣṭau ṣaṣṭiṃ dviṣan mitraṃ rajjuṃ sarpaṃ sthalaṃ jalam .

taṃ dagdhamaṇim ādāya prāktanīṃ sa śriyaṃ jahau .
sarvaṃ cintāmaṇer asmāt prāpyate kiṃ dhanair iti ..6.92.23..

deśo 'yam asukho rūkṣo janaiḫ pāpibhir āvṛtaḥ .

dūraṃ gatvā yathākāmaṃ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhāmi sampadā .

tatra kācadalenāsau tena tām āpadaṃ yayau .
kajjalādrer iva niśā maurkhyasyaivāṅga yā samā ..6.92.26..

duẖkhāni maurkhyavibhavena bhavanti yāni

sarvāpadāṃ śirasi tiṣṭhati maurkhyam ekaṃ
kṛṣṇaṃ janasya vapuṣām iva keśajālam ..6.92.27..

athemam aparaṃ ramyaṃ vṛttāntaṃ śṛṇu bhūpate .

asti vindhyavane hastī mahāyūthapayūthapaḥ .
agastyaruddhayā vṛddhyā vindhyenevaidhitas svataḥ ..6.93.2..

vajrāśriviṣamau dīrghau stas tasya daśanau śitau .
kalpānalaśikhātulyau sumerūnmūlanakṣamau ..6.93.3..

sa baddho lohajālena hastipena cchalāditaḥ .

nibaddho yantraṇāpāśaśastrakumbhārpito gajaḥ .
tāṃ jagāma vyathāṃ vīro na vāggocaram eti yā ..6.93.5..

ripau hastipake dūrād guptaṃ paśyati vāraṇaḥ .
ayassamudgake tasmin nināya divasatrayam ..6.93.6..

khedān nigaḍanirbhedayatnavān sa jhaṇajjhaṇam .

dantābhyāṃ yatnatas tābhyāṃ muhūrtadvitayena saḥ .

baḍes svargāvadalanaṃ harir merutaṭād iva ..6.93.9..

tasyāvacchinnapāśasya mūrdhni tālataro ripuḥ .
papātākramatas svargaṃ harir meror baḍer iva ..6.93.10..

sa patan pādapān mohād aprāpya kariṇaś śiraḥ .

taṃ puraḫ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahebhaẖ karuṇāṃ yayau .
sphuratsphāraguṇās santas santi tiryaggatāv api ..6.93.12..

patitaṃ dalayāmīti kiṃ nāma mama pauruṣam .
vāraṇo 'pīti kalayan na jaghāna ca taṃ ripum ..6.93.13..

kevalaṃ nigaḍavyūhaṃ vidāryāśu jagāma ha .

tam anādṛtya mātaṅgo bhaṅktvā jālaṃ javād yayau .
vidārya meghasaṅghātaṃ nabhasīva divākaraḥ ..6.93.15..

gate gaje samuttasthau hastipas svasthadehadhīḥ .
gajenaiva samaṃ tasya vyathā dūrataraṃ gatā ..6.93.16..

prottālatālaviṭapāt sa tathā patito 'pi san .
na bhedam āpa durbhedā manye dehā durātmanām ..6.93.17..

vardhate prāvṛṣīvābdaẖ kukāryeṣv asatāṃ balam .
atīvāsīt samutsāhī sa gajākramaṇe tadā ..6.93.18..

vāraṇārir asiṃho 'sau gatebho duẖkham āyayau .
āgatyopagate 'ntardhiṃ nidhāna iva nirdhanaḥ ..6.93.19..

so 'nviyeṣa gajaṃ yatnād gulmakāntaritaṃ vane .
payodapihitaṃ bhoktuṃ rāhur indum ivāmbare ..6.93.20..

cireṇālabhatebhendraṃ kasmiṃścit kānane sthitam .
viśrāmyantaṃ tarutale samarād iva nirgatam ..6.93.21..

atha yatra sthito nāgas tatra tadbandhanakṣamam .
parayā rājasāmagryā gajalampaṭarūpayā ..6.93.22..

sa khātavalayaṃ cakre hastipaẖ kānane navam .
sarvadikkaṃ vidhir bhūmau samudravalayaṃ yathā ..6.93.23..

upary asthagayaj jīrṇalataughena sa taṃ śaṭhaḥ .
śūnyaṃ tanvabhrajālena śaratkāla ivāmbaram ..6.93.24..

dinaiẖ katipayair eva vāraṇo viharan vane .
tasmin nipatitaẖ khāte śuṣkābdhāv iva parvataḥ ..6.93.25..

vrajan sarpākṛtau kūpe pātālatalabhīṣaṇe .
khāte śuṣkābdhikhātābhe gajaratnasamudgake ..6.93.26..

iti bhūyo dṛḍhaṃ baddhas tena hastipakena saḥ .
tiṣṭhaty adyāpi duẖkhena bhūsadmani yathā baḍiḥ ..6.93.27..

ahaniṣyat puraivāsau yady agropagataṃ ripum .
tan nālapsyata tad duẖkhaṃ gajaẖ khātanibandhanam ..6.93.28..

maurkhyād āgāminaṃ kālaṃ vartamānakriyākramaiḥ .
aśodhayan naro duẖkhaṃ yāti vindhyagajo yathā ..6.93.29..

mukto 'smi śastranigaḍād iti tuṣṭo 'pi vāraṇaḥ .
dūrastho 'pi punar baddho maurkhyaṃ kveva na bādhate ..6.93.30..

maurkhyaṃ nibandhanam avaihi paraṃ mahātman
bandho na bandha iha cetasi tadviyukte .
ātmodaye trijagad ātmamayaṃ samastam
aśve sthitasya sahayā nanu sarvabhūmiḥ ..6.93.31..

maṇisādhanavanyebhabandhanādy amarātmaja .
sūcitaṃ satkathājālaṃ punar me prakaṭīkuru ..6.94.1..

vākyārthadṛṣṭer niṣpattyā hṛdgṛhe cittabhittiṣu .
śṛṇuṣva satkathācitraṃ citram unmīlayāmi te ..6.94.2..

yo 'sau śāstrārthakuśalas tattvajñāne tv apaṇḍitaḥ .
ratnasaṃsādhane proktas sa tvam eva mahīpate ..6.94.3..

tajjño bhavasi śāstreṣu ravir merutaṭeṣv iva .

viddhi cintāmaṇiṃ sādho sarvatyāgam akṛtrimam .
tam antaṃ sarvaduẖkhānāṃ saṃsādhayasi śuddhadhīḥ ..6.94.5..

sarvatyāgena śuddhena sarvam āsādyate 'nagha .
sarvatyāgo hi sāmrājyaṃ kiṃ cintāmaṇinā bhavet ..6.94.6..

siddhas sa sarvasantyāgas sādho saṃsādhitas tava .
kharvīkurvañ jagadbhūtiṃ vindhyasyātmodayo yathā ..6.94.7..

santyaktaṃ bhavatā rājyaṃ sadāradhanabāndhavam .
brahmaṇeva jagatsargavyāpāras svaniśāgame ..6.94.8..

svadeśasyātidūrastham āgato 'sīmam āśramam .
bhuvo 'ntam iva viśrāntyai vainateyas sakacchapaḥ ..6.94.9..

kevalaṃ sarvasantyāge śeṣitāhammatis tvayā .
mṛṣṭākhilakalaṅkena svasattevānilena khe ..6.94.10..

manomātre hṛdas tyakte yāvat te yāti pūrṇatām .
tyāgas tāvad vikalpas tvāṃ kham ambuda ivāvṛṇot ..6.94.11..

nāyaṃ sa paramānandas sarvatyāgo mahodayaḥ .

cintayeti gate vṛddhiṃ saṅkalpagrahaṇe śanaiḥ .

tyāgitā syāt kutas tasya cintām apy āvṛṇoti yaḥ .
pavanaspandayuktasya nisspandatvaṃ kutas taroḥ ..6.94.14..

cintaiva cittam ity āhus saṅkalpetaranāmakam .

saṅkalpagrahaṇenāntas tyāgaḫ proḍḍīya te gataḥ .
śabdasaṃśravaṇenāṅga yathā grāmavihaṅgamaḥ ..6.94.17..

niścintatvadhanaṃ sarvaṃ tyāga ādāya te gataḥ .
āmantryāpūjito yāti yas sa duẖkhaṃ karoti hi ..6.94.18..

sarvatyāgamaṇāv evaṃ gate kamalalocana .
tapaẖkācamaṇir dṛṣṭas tvayā saṅkalpacakṣuṣā ..6.94.19..

tvayā tasmiṃs tapasy eva duẖkhe dṛṣṭibhramodite .
grāhyaikabhāvanā baddhā jalendau śiśunā yathā ..6.94.20..

avāsanam anārabhya kṛtānandā savāsanā .
ādyantamadhyaviṣamā duẖkhāyaiva tapaẖkriyā ..6.94.21..

amitānandam utsṛjya susādhaṃ yaḫ pravartate .

sarvatyāgas samārabhya na viniṣpāditas tvayā .
tapoduẖkhaikatajjñena baddhena vanasadmani ..6.94.23..

rājyabandhād viniṣkramya gajavad duẖkhapūrite .
vanavāsābhidhe sādho baddho 'si dṛḍhabandhane ..6.94.24..

dviguṇā eva te cintāś śītavātātapādayaḥ .
bandhanād adhikaṃ manye vanavāsam ajānataḥ ..6.94.25..

cintāmaṇir mayā prāpta ity alaṃ buddhavān asi .

ity etad aṅga maṇiyatnakathāsamānaṃ
samyaṅ mayā prakaṭitaṃ tava padmanetra .
udbodhya bodham amalaṃ svayam eva buddhyā
yad vacmi tat pariṇatiṃ kuru cittakośe ..6.94.27..

idānīṃ rājaśārdūla vastusampratipattaye .
śṛṇu vindhyebhavṛttāntavivṛtiṃ smayakāriṇīm ..6.95.1..

yo 'sau vindhyavane hastī so 'smin bhūmitale bhavān .
yau vairāgyavivekau te tau tasya daśanau śitau ..6.95.2..

yaś cāsau vāraṇākrāntitatparo hastipas sthitaḥ .
tad ajñānaṃ tvadākrāntitatparaṃ tava duẖkhadam ..6.95.3..

atiśakto 'py aśaktena duẖkhād duẖkhaṃ bhayād bhayam .
hastī hastipakeneva rājan maurkhyeṇa nīyase ..6.95.4..

yal loharajjusāreṇa vāraṇaḫ pariyantritaḥ .
tad āśāpāśajālena bhavān āpadam āgataḥ ..6.95.5..

āśā hi loharajjubhyo viṣamā vipulā dṛḍhā .
kālena kṣīyate lohaṃ tṛṣṇā tu parivardhate ..6.95.6..

yad baddhaṃ prekṣate vairī gajam ārād alakṣitaḥ .

yad babhañja gajaś śastraśṛṅkhalājālabandhanam .
tat tatyāja bhavān bhogabhūmiṃ rājyam akaṇṭakam ..6.95.8..

kadācit sukaraṃ śastraśṛṅkhalājālabhedanam .

yad ibhe pāṭayaty uccair bandhaṃ hastipako 'patat .

athotthāya dadāhāsau śuṣkaṃ tat parṇamandiram .

sarvanāśo 'sya yas sādho cetasas saṃsṛtikṣayaḥ .

niścayātmā nirākāro buddhir ity eva socyate ..6.98.17..

asya buddhyabhidhānasya yāṅkurasya prapīnatā .

indriyāṇy atha bhogāś ca bhāvābhāvamayormayaḥ .

īdṛśasyāsya cittasya durvṛkṣasya pratikṣaṇam .

cittadrumasya śākhādeẖ kurvāṇo 'haṃ vikartanam .

vāsanā vividhāś śākhāḫ phalaskandhādinānvitāḥ .
abhāvitā bhavanty antar lūnās saṃvidbalena te ..6.98.24..

gauṇaṃ śākhāvilavanaṃ mukhyaṃ mūlavikartanam .

nādres taṭaṃ na vipinaṃ na parṇasadanādi vā .

karmendriyāṇy api na ca na ca buddhīndriyāṇi ca .

kaṭakatvaṃ yathā hemni tathāhantvaṃ cidātmani .

sanniveśaviśeṣātmaśabdārthādi pare pade .

jānann apīti bhagavann ahantvamalamārjanam .

etāvanmātrakaṃ vṛndaṃ yadi na tvaṃ mahīpate .

cinmātram aham acchātmavedanaṃ viduṣāṃ vara .
yatra bhāvās svadanty ete nirmīyante ca yena vā ..6.98.38..

evaṃrūpasya me lagnaṃ nūnaṃ malam akāraṇam .
sakāraṇaṃ cāham iti yat tat tyaktuṃ na vedmy aham ..6.98.39..

asad etad anātmīyaṃ pramārṣṭuṃ malam ātmanaḥ .
mune yadā na śakto 'smi tena tapye sudāruṇam ..6.98.40..

brūhi kiṃ tan mahābāho lagnaṃ tava malaṃ mahat .
sthito 'si yena saṃsārī satā vāpy asatātha vā ..6.98.41..

cittadrumasya yad bījam ahambhāvas sa me malam .
tac ca tyaktuṃ na jānāmi tyaktaṃ tyaktam upaiti mām ..6.98.42..

kāraṇāj jāyate kāryaṃ yat tat sarvatra sad bhavet .
anyat tv asad dvicandrābhaṃ dṛṣṭam eva na vidyate ..6.98.43..

kāraṇāj jāyate kāryam ahambhāvātmakaṃ tataḥ .
itikāraṇam anviṣya kathayāśu mamātmanā ..6.98.44..

mune 'ham iti doṣasya vedanaṃ vedmi kāraṇam .
tad yathopaśamaṃ yāti tan me vada munīśvara ..6.98.45..

citaś cetyonmukhatvena duẖkhāyāham iti sthitaḥ .
cetyopaśamanaṃ brūhi mune tadupaśāntaye ..6.98.46..

kāraṇaṃ kāraṇajño 'si vedanasya vadāśu me .
