vedyavedanarūpasya cetyasañcetanasya ca .
akāraṇaṃ kāraṇatāṃ yad gataṃ tava tad vada ..6.98.48..

cetyacetanarūpasya vedyasaṃvedanākṛteḥ .
iyaṃ padārthasatteha dehādyā kāraṇaṃ mune ..6.98.49..

śarīrāditayodeti vedanaṃ vastusattayā .
asatyābhāsayā spando yathā pavanalekhayā ..6.98.50..

asattāṃ vastusattāyā nāvagacchāmy ahaṃ yayā .
ahantvavedanaṃ cittabījaṃ samupaśāmyati ..6.98.51..

vidyate yadi dehādivastusattā tad asti te .
abhāvād dehasattādeẖ kiṃniṣṭhaṃ tava vedanam ..6.98.52..

yasyopalabhyate kiñcit svarūpaṃ kalanātmakam .
asadrūpaṃ kathaṃ tat syāt prakāśas syāt kathaṃ tamaḥ ..6.98.53..

hastapādādisaṃyuktaẖ kriyāphalavilāsavān .
sadānubhūyamāno 'pi deho nāsti kathaṃ mune ..6.98.54..

kāraṇaṃ yasya kāryasya bhūmipāla na vidyate .
vidyate neha tat kāryaṃ tatsaṃvittis tu vibhramaḥ ..6.98.55..

kāraṇena vinā kāryaṃ vidyate na kadācana .
vidyate yasya no bījaṃ tad dravyaṃ kveva jāyate ..6.98.56..

akāranaṃ tu yat kāryaṃ sad ivāgre 'nubhūyate .
tad draṣṭur vibhramaṃ viddhi mṛgatṛṣṇājalopamam ..6.98.57..

avidyamānam eva tvaṃ viddhi mithyābhramoditam .
nātiyatnavatāpy etan mṛgatṛṣṇāmbu labhyate ..6.98.58..

asato dvīndubimbāder na yuktaṃ kāraṇekṣaṇam .
vandhyātanayasarvāṅgamaṇḍanaṃ kasya rājate ..6.98.59..

kāraṇena vinā kāryaṃ śarīrādy asthipañjaram .
avidyamānam evedaṃ viddhy asambhavato nṛpa ..6.98.60..

hastapādādiyuktasya śarīrasya munīśvara .
nityam ālakṣyamāṇasya pitā kasmān na kāraṇam ..6.98.61..

kāraṇābhāvato rājan pitā nāma na vidyate .
asato yat tu sañjātam asad eva tad ucyate ..6.98.62..

padārthānāṃ ca kāryāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bījam ucyate .
sambhavaty aṅga jagati na bījena vināṅkuraḥ ..6.98.63..

tasmān na kāraṇaṃ yasya kāryasyehopapadyate .
bījābhāve hi tan nāsti tatsaṃvittis tu vibhramaḥ ..6.98.64..

avaśyam eva yan nāsti nirbījaṃ tan matibhramaḥ .
dvīndutvamarubhūmyambuvandhyāputradṛśā samaḥ ..6.98.65..

pitāmahānāṃ putrāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca jagattraye .
ādyaḫ pitāmahaẖ kasmāt pūrvotpanno na kāraṇam ..6.98.66..

ādyaḫ pitāmaho yas syāt so 'pi nāsty eva bhūpate .
kāraṇābhāvato nityaṃ yadā kāryaṃ na kasyacit ..6.98.67..

kāraṇasya svabījasya nityābhāvāt pitāmahaḥ .
ādyas san dṛśyamāno 'pi bhramād anyo na vidyate ..6.98.68..

mṛgatṛṣṇāmbuvad bhrāntirūpa evāvabhāsate .
pitāmaho 'rthakāritvam api tv asya bhramātmakam ..6.98.69..

pitāmahāder etasya mithyāpratyayatas tv iti .
ghanatā tu nivṛttaiva mārjayiṣyāmy athetarat ..6.98.70..

tasmāc cidātmakatayātmani cinnabho yan
nityaṃ svayaṃ kacati cāru tad eṣa devaḥ .
tenaiva padmaja iti svayam ātmanātmā
proktaẖ kharūpa iti śāntam idaṃ samastam ..6.98.71..

ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ yady ayaṃ bhāsate bhramaḥ .
arthakriyāsamarthaś ca tat sthitaṃ duẖkhakāraṇam ..6.99.1..

evaṃ jagadbhramasyāsya tānavaṃ tāvad āgatam .
śilībhūtasya śītena salilasyeva sūṣmaṇā ..6.99.2..

ajñānaṃ śithilībhūtam eva naṣṭaṃ vidur budhāḥ .
na nāśena vinodeti pūrvasaṃsthānavicyutiḥ ..6.99.3..

tanutvaṃ sargabodhasya yat tad eva hi kāraṇam .
sargopaśamasampatteḫ pratipatteḫ pare pade ..6.99.4..

tānavaṃ dṛśyate yasya tasyānukramatas svayam .
pūrvasaṃsthānavigamāt praśamo 'py upapadyate ..6.99.5..

anenaiva krameṇainaṃ tvam ādipuruṣaṃ nṛpa .
bhramākārodayaṃ viddhi mṛgatṛṣṇāmbv ivoditam ..6.99.6..

eṣā pitāmahābhāve 'py asatī bhūtasantatiḥ .
na kadācana tat siddhaṃ yad asiddhena sādhyate ..6.99.7..

ayaṃ bhūtopalambho hi mṛgatṛṣṇāmbv ivoditaḥ .
vicārād vilayaṃ yāti śuktau rajatadhīr iva ..6.99.8..

kāraṇābhāvataẖ kāryam abhūtvā bhavatīti yat .
mithyājñānād ṛte tasya na rūpam upapadyate ..6.99.9..

mithyādṛṣṭiḫ prekṣitā ca na kadācana vidyate .
mṛgatṛṣṇāmbhasā kena ghaṭakāḫ paripūritāḥ ..6.99.10..

sraṣṭur ādyasya paramaṃ brahma kasmān na kāraṇam .
anantam ajam avyaktam īśvaraṃ śāntam acyutam ..6.99.11..

hetutvābhāvato brahma kāryatvābhāvatas tataḥ .
advaitaikyāvikārātma na kāryaṃ na ca kāraṇam ..6.99.12..

akartṛkarmakaraṇam akāraṇam abījakam .
apratarkyam avijñeyaṃ brahma kartṛ kathaṃ bhavet ..6.99.13..

akāraṇatvāt kāryatvarahitaṃ tad yadā bhavet .

apratarkyam avijñeyaṃ yac chivaṃ śāntam avyayam .

ato nedaṃ kṛtaṃ kiñcij jagadādi na vidyate .
na kartāsti na bhoktāsti sarvaṃ śāntam ajaṃ śivam ..6.99.16..

kāraṇābhāvataẖ kāryaṃ na kasyacid idaṃ jagat .
akāryatvāc ca nāsty etat sarga itthaṃ na vidyate ..6.99.17..

yadā na kasyacit kāryaṃ kāraṇasya jagat tadā .
padārthābhāvasaṃsiddhis tatsiddhau kasya vedanam ..6.99.18..

evaṃ tu vedanābhāve nāsty ahantvasya kāraṇam .
ataś śuddho 'si mukto 'si kevoktir bandhamokṣayoḥ ..6.99.19..

āṃ prabuddho 'smi bhagavan yuktam uktaṃ tvayottamam .
kāraṇābhāvataẖ kartṛ neha brahmeti vedmy aham ..6.99.20..

kartrabhāvāj jagan nāsti tena nāsti padārthadṛk .
nātaś cittādi tadbījaṃ nāto 'hantādi kiñcana ..6.99.21..

evaṃ sthite viśuddho 'smi vibuddho 'smi na cāsmi ca .
namo mahyaṃ paraṃ naumi nakiñcid api bodhataḥ ..6.99.22..

padārthavedanaṃ mithyaivāsad evāvabhāsate .
ahamādy alam etena śāntam āse khakośavat ..6.99.23..

jagatpadārthapravibhāgadṛṣṭis
sadeśadikkālakalākriyaughā .
aho nu kālena cireṇa śāntā
brahmaiva vā nūnam avasthiteti ..6.99.24..

śāmyāmi nirvāmi paraṃ sthito 'smi
na yāmi nodemi na cāstam emi .
tiṣṭhāmy aniṣṭhaṃ ca yathāsthitātmā
śivaṃ śubhaṃ pāvanamaunam asmi ..6.99.25..

iti brahmaṇi viśrāntim avāpya sa śikhidhvajaḥ .
muhūrtam āsīt saṃśāntamanā nirvāṇadīpavat ..6.100.1..

nirvikalpasamādhānapariṇatyāstam īyivān .
svalīlayeti kumbhena sa jhagity eva bodhitaḥ ..6.100.2..

rājann ajñānanidrātaḫ prabuddho 'si śivas sthitaḥ .
kāryaṃ nāstamayeneto na cānastamayena te ..6.100.3..

sakṛd eva vibhātātmā tiṣṭhāniṣṭhapadātmakaḥ .
kalākalananirmukto jīvanmukto 'ṅga sāmpratam ..6.100.4..

kumbhena bodhitas tv evaṃ sa babhūva prabodhavān .
vinirgato rarājoccair mahāmohasamudgakāt ..6.100.5..

viśrāntadhīẖ kṣaṇenaiva paśyan dṛśyasya vastunaḥ .
asattām eva muktātmā līlayā samuvāca ha ..6.100.6..

jñātaprāyam apīdaṃ tu yat pṛcchāmi tad ucyatām .

śive śānte nirābhāse pare 'nullaṅghitātmani .

sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahārāja rājase bodhabhāsvatā .

evaṃrūpaṃ jagad idaṃ samyagjñānāc chivaṃ bhavet .

asamyagjñānam akhilaṃ jagad duẖkhapradaṃ param .

kevalaṃ param evetthaṃ paramaṃ bhāsate śivam .
kuto jagadahantādi praśna eveha nocitaḥ ..6.100.44..

yad vastu vidyamānaṃ sat praśnas tatra virājate .

akāraṇatvān nāstīdaṃ brahmaivetthaṃ vijṛmbhate .

cinmātram eva kacati yac cinmātratayātmani .
akacat tv eva tan nāma kacitaṃ sargavedanam ..6.100.51..

ahaṃ citā cid evāsau bhavatīva svayaṃ svataḥ .

cito rūpam anādyantaṃ manorūpam anantakam .

śāntaṃ jagatprasararūpatayā svabhāva-

vastusthitaṃ nijacamatkaraṇāvaloka-

na vijñānamayo 'rtho 'sti na bāhyo nāpi śūnyatā .
vedanāmātrasāratvād yathāvit so 'rtha ucyate ..6.101.1..

dravatvaṃ salilasyeva vido vittvam akāraṇam .
khātma nityam anantaṃ tad yathāsthitam avasthitam ..6.101.2..

pratiyogivyavacchedābhāvatas svatvabhāvayoḥ .
asattā tena na pare sattvabhāvavyavasthitau ..6.101.3..

yadi kāraṇatāpattiyogyaṃ śāntaṃ paraṃ bhavet .
aniṅganam anābhāsam apratarkyaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ..6.101.4..

ato na kāraṇaṃ naiva bījaṃ brahma kadācana .
kāryasya kasyacin nāma tena sargo na vidyate ..6.101.5..

na cānyathopapattir hi sargasyāsyopapadyate .
cinmātrakād ṛte tasmāj jaḍas sargo na vidyate ..6.101.6..

yad idaṃ dṛśyate kiñcit tac cidghanam avedhitam .

cittaṃ nāstīti me bodho yathā yuktyā sphuṭo bhavet .

evam ajñāvabuddhātma jagad yasmān na vidyate .

anenaiva prayogeṇa rājaṃś ceto na vidyate .

jagad dṛśyam idaṃ vāsyaṃ tad evotpannam eva no .

yat kiñcit paramākāśam īṣat kacakacāyate .

ahaṃ tvaṃ jagad ity eṣā pratipattir na vāstavī .
mithyā svapna ivābhātā nūnam apy arthakāriṇī ..6.102.16..

vāsyasya jagato 'bhāvād yato nāsty eva vāsanā .

aprabuddhair avagataṃ caittaṃ dṛśyam idaṃ jagat .
asad eva nirākāraṃ pūrvam utpannam eva no ..6.102.18..

notpannaṃ kāraṇābhāvāt sargādāv eva sarvadā .
lokaśāstrānubhavato na ca dṛśyasya vastunaḥ ..6.102.19..

anāditvam ajatvaṃ vā sthairyaṃ vāpy upapadyate .
sākārasyāsya jagatas sthūlasapratighākṛteḥ ..6.102.20..

samastakāraṇābhāvāl lokaśāstrānubhūtibhiḥ .
yujyante ca nirākartuṃ na mahāpralayodayāḥ ..6.102.21..

śāstrānubhavavedārthasiddhān etāṃś ca yo 'pi vā .

lokāś śāstrāṇi vedāś ca pramāṇaṃ yasya nāmateḥ .
asatyoktes sumūḍhasya sa paśus taṃ na saṃśrayet ..6.102.23..

na ca sapratighasyāsya dṛśyasyāpratighaṃ kvacit .
kāraṇaṃ bhavituṃ śaktaṃ sākārasya nirākṛtiḥ ..6.102.24..

ittham ālakṣyamāṇaṃ san na cedaṃ nāvabhāsate .

tasmād idaṃ niraṃśasya cidvyomno 'pratighākṛteḥ .

brahmaṇas sarvarūpasya śāntaṃ śāntasya yat samam .
svata evātmakacanaṃ sargapralayarūpadhṛt ..6.102.27..

svakaṃ vapus tat tenaiva jñātaṃ jagad idaṃ kṣaṇam .

brahmaivedam atas sarvaṃ kva caittajagadādidhīḥ .

sarvaṃ nirālambam ajaṃ praśāntam

idaṃ ca nānaiva na cāpi nānā
yathāsthitaṃ tiṣṭha sukāṣṭhamaunaḥ ..6.102.30..

naṣṭo mohas smṛtir labdhā tvatprasādān mayā mune .
sthito 'smi gatasandeho viśrāntamatir ātmavān ..6.103.1..

jñātajñeyo mahāmaunī tīrṇamāyāmahārṇavaḥ .

aho nu suciraṃ kālaṃ prabhrānto 'ham avāntare .
sthānam avyayam akṣubdham adhunā prāptavān aham ..6.103.3..

evaṃ sthite mune nāsti sāhantādijagattrayam .

yathāsti vāto nisspando yathāsti kham anīlima .

evaṃ caitan mahābuddhe yādṛśaṃ kāraṇaṃ param .

babhūvāmīlitamanolocanaś śāntavāg abhīḥ .
śilātalād ivotkīrṇo nisspandāvayavākṛtiḥ ..6.105.2..

tato muhūrtamātreṇa prabuddhaṃ sphāritekṣaṇam .
tam uvāca mahābāho cūḍālā kumbharūpiṇī ..6.105.3..

kaccid asmin pade sphāre śuddhe mṛduni nirmale .
sutalpe nirvikalpānāṃ sukhaṃ viśrāntavān asi ..6.105.4..

kaccid antaḫ prabuddho 'si kaccid bhrāntis tvayojjhitā .
kaccij jñeyaṃ parijñātaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyam eva vā ..6.105.5..

bhagavaṃs tvatprasādena mahāvibhavabhūṣitā .
mahatī padavī dṛṣṭā sarvasyordhve sthitā mayā ..6.105.6..

satāṃ viditavedyānām aho bata mahātmanām .
apūrvaikāmṛtamayas saṅgas sāraphalapradaḥ ..6.105.7..

janmanāpi mayā labdhaṃ yan nāma na mahāmṛtam .
tad adya tvatsamāsaṅgāt kṣaṇenāsāditaṃ svayam ..6.105.8..

anantam ādyam amṛtam etat kamalalocana .
kathaṃ nāsāditam abhūd etad ātmapadaṃ mayā ..6.105.9..

manasy upaśamaṃ yāte tyaktabhogaiṣaṇe sthite .
kaṣāyapāke nirvṛtte sarvendriyagaṇasya ca ..6.105.10..

yānti cetasi viśrāntiṃ vimalā daiśikoktayaḥ .
yathā sitāṃśuke śuddhe bindavaẖ kuṅkumāmbhasaḥ ..6.105.11..

kaṣāyāṇām anantānāṃ sambhṛtānāṃ śarīrake .
svavāsanāsvarūpāṇām adya pākas tavoditaḥ ..6.105.12..

dehān malāni sarvāṇi kālena kamalekṣaṇa .
sādho vṛkṣāt phalānīva pākena vigalanty adhaḥ ..6.105.13..

vāsanātmasu yāteṣu maleṣu vilayaṃ sakhe .
yad vakti gurur antas tad viśatīṣur yathā bile ..6.105.14..

kaṣāyapāke sampanne tvaṃ mayādya vibodhitaḥ .
tenādyaiva tavājñānakṣayo jāto mahāmate ..6.105.15..

adya pakvakaṣāyas tvam adyaivājñānasaṅkṣayī .
adyaiva sopadeśyas tvam adyaivāsi prabuddhavān ..6.105.16..

śubhāśubhānāṃ sarveṣāṃ karmaṇām adya saṅkṣayaḥ .
satsaṅgavyapadeśena tava niṣpattim āgataḥ ..6.105.17..

yāvad asya dinasyaiṣa pūrvo bhāgo mahīpate .
tāvac ceto hy aham iti tavājñānaṃ babhūva ha ..6.105.18..

idānīṃ madvacobodhāc cetasi kṣayam āgate .
hṛdayāt samparityakte samprabuddho 'si bhūpate ..6.105.19..

hṛdi yāvan manassattā tāvad ajñānasaṃsthitiḥ .
citte cittatayā tyakte jñānasyābhyudayo bhavet ..6.105.20..

dvitvaikatvadṛśau cittaṃ tad evājñānam ucyate .
etayor yo layo dṛṣṭyos taj jñānaṃ sā parā gatiḥ ..6.105.21..

prabuddho 'si vimukto 'si tyaktaṃ cittaṃ tvayā nṛpa .
sad eva sattayāttaṃ hi tvayā tyaktam asat padam ..6.105.22..

vītaśoko nirāyāso nissaṅgo nityam ātmavān .
mahodayo munir maunī kharūpas tiṣṭha nirmalaḥ ..6.105.23..

evaṃ hi bhagavañ jantor mūrkhasyaivāsti cittabhūḥ .
na prabuddhasya tajjñasya cittam asti kila prabho ..6.105.24..

jīvanmuktās ta ete hi viharanti kathaṃ vada .
avidyamānamanaso yuṣmadādyās tathā narāḥ ..6.105.25..

iti me kathayāśeṣam anyaiś ca vacanāṃśubhiḥ .
hārdaṃ tamo me nipuṇam evamprāyaiḫ pramārjaya ..6.105.26..

yathā vadasi dharmajña tat tathaiva hi nānyathā .
cittaṃ hi jīvanmuktānāṃ nāsty aṅkura ivāśmanām ..6.105.27..

punarjananayogyā yā vāsanā ghanavāsanā .
sā proktā cittaśabdena na sā tajjñasya vidyate ..6.105.28..

yayā vāsanayā tajjñā viharantīha karmasu .
tāṃ tvaṃ sattvābhidhāṃ viddhi punarjananavarjitām ..6.105.29..

jīvanmuktā mahātmānas sattvasthās saṃyatendriyāḥ .
viharanti gatāsaṅgaṃ na cittasthāẖ kadācana ..6.105.30..

mūḍhaṃ cittaṃ cittam āhuḫ prabuddhaṃ sattvam ucyate .
aprabuddhā hi cittasthās sattvasthā hi mahādhiyaḥ ..6.105.31..

bhūyaḫ prajāyate cittaṃ sattvaṃ bhūyo na jāyate .
aprabuddhasya bandho 'sti na prabuddhasya bhūpate ..6.105.32..

sattvavān asi sañjāto mahātyāgī sthito bhavān .
aśeṣeṇa tvayā tyaktaṃ cittam adyeti vedmy aham ..6.105.33..

samastavāsanāmukto rājan rājeva rājase .
ākāśasāmyam āyātaṃ manye tava mune manaḥ ..6.105.34..

śamaṃ prāpto 'si paramaṃ śuddhas samasamasthitiḥ .
mandarāhananonmukto yathā kṣīramahārṇavaḥ ..6.105.35..

parityaktā tvayā rājyād vāsanā tapasas tathā .
kānanāc ca śarīrāc ca śubhāśubhaphalād api ..6.105.36..

nirīho vigatāsaṅgas tyaktacitto vivāsanaḥ .
sampannas tvaṃ mahābāho mahātyāgipadaṃ gataḥ ..6.105.37..

ayaṃ sa hi mahātyāgas sarvaṃ yatra samujjhitam .
svargāpavargacittādi tapodānaphalādy api ..6.105.38..

prabuddhayeddhayā sādho dhiyā paramabodhayā .
tapo nāma kiyanmātraduẖkhakṣayakaraṃ bhavet ..6.105.39..

kṣayātiśayanirmuktaṃ yat sukhaṃ samatāmayam .
tat sat tad vastu tat kiñcin na tu svargādi bhaṅguram ..6.105.40..

bhāvābhāvatulārūḍhas sthitādhivyādhivedhitaḥ .
svargo nāma kimānandas so 'pi sandeham āsthitaḥ ..6.105.41..

aprāptasvārthasaṃsiddheẖ kriyākāṇḍaś śubho bhavet .
yena nāsāditaṃ hema rītiṃ kiṃ sa parityajet ..6.105.42..

cūḍālādisamāsaṅgād bhavej jñatvaṃ sukhena te .
tat kimartham anarthe 'smin nimagnas tvaṃ tapomaye ..6.105.43..

āśramādivikalpāṃśasādhyasyāsya kukarmaṇaḥ .
ādyantau paśya sumate madhya eva ramasva mā ..6.105.44..

yata ete samāyātā yasmin pariṇamanti ca .
taporūpā vikalpāṃśās tatra baddhapado bhava ..6.105.45..

cidvyomno nabhaso 'py acchāt sarve bhāvās samutthitāḥ .
tatraiva ca layaṃ yānti tatraivāssva ramasva ca ..6.105.46..

idaṃ kāryam idaṃ neti saṅkalpā brahmabindavaḥ .
bindūñ śikhidhvaja tyaktvā pūrṇameghaṃ samāśraya ..6.105.47..

iṣṭaṃ me prārthayasveti yathaiva prārthyate sakhī .
striyā tathaiva na kathaṃ dayitaḫ prārthyate svayam ..6.105.48..

saṅkalparacitān etān bhāvān āpātabhāsurān .
na gṛhṇanti mahātmānaḫ prājñā jalaravīn iva ..6.105.49..

svargamokṣādiphaladaṃ yat kiñcit samam eva tat .
tyaktvā samasamābhāso yo 'sy asāv eva vai bhava ..6.105.50..

santaṃ sattvena nāśena naśyantaṃ vigataspṛhaḥ .
padārthaugham imaṃ gṛhṇaṃs tiṣṭhāspanditacittabhūḥ ..6.105.51..

aparispandacittasya saṃsṛtir neha bādhate .
pauruṣaprabhavā sādho vipan nītimato yathā ..6.105.52..

yāni yānīha duẖkhāni prasphuranti jagattraye .
cetaścāpalajāny eva tāni tāni mahīpate ..6.105.53..

sthiraṃ śāntaṃ gataspandaṃ yasya cittam acāpalam .
sa vibhus sa mahānandī sāmrājyasya sa bhājanam ..6.105.54..

atha cetasi tattvajña spandāspandau tad ekatām .
nītvā tiṣṭha yathākāmam aikyam āgatya śāśvatam ..6.105.55..

katham aikyavidhiṃ yātas spandāspandāv imau vibho .
sarvasaṃśayavicchedakārinn etad vadāśu me ..6.105.56..

ekaṃ vastu jagat sarvaṃ cinmātraṃ vār ivāmbudhiḥ .
tad eva spandate no vā śuddhaṃ vārīva vīcibhiḥ ..6.105.57..

brahma cinmātram amalaṃ satyam ityādināmabhiḥ .
yad gītaṃ tad idaṃ mūḍhaḫ paśyaty aṅga jagattayā ..6.105.58..

nisspanda eva sarvasmin sarge tasmād dhi saṃsṛtiḥ .
parispando hi vīcyādis tad aspandaṃ samaṃ param ..6.105.59..

citas sa eva cet spandas tathāspandaś ca bhāvitaḥ .
ekarūpatayā nāma tat tad apy acalaṃ śivam ..6.105.60..

sargaś citspandamātrātmā samyagdṛṣṭo vilīyate .
udety asamyagdṛṣṭātmā rajjvāṃ sarpabhramo yathā ..6.105.61..

saspandā cic cidabhidhā nisspandā tv iyam ātatā .
turyātītapadārūḍhā vācā vaktuṃ na pāryate ..6.105.62..

śāstrasajjanasamparkasantatābhyāsayogataḥ .
kālenāmalatāṃ yāte cetasīndāv ivodite ..6.105.63..

etat kevalam ābhātaṃ svānubhūtigirātatam .
kathyate svānubhūtes tu svayaṃ svaṃ rūpam ātmanā ..6.105.64..

prāpto 'si bhāvaṃ svam anādimadhyam
atraiva tiṣṭheṣṭapade niviṣṭaḥ .
nīrūpanirbhedamahācidātmā
jāto 'si sādho khalu vītaśokaḥ ..6.105.65..

iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śikhidhvaja mahīpate .
yathedam utthitaṃ sarvaṃ yathā ca pravilīyate ..6.106.1..

etac chrutvā ca buddhvā ca matvā ca munināyaka .
yathecchasi tathā tiṣṭha dṛṣṭaspaṣṭapadaḫ pade ..6.106.2..

svargaṃ gacchāmy ahaṃ tatra kāle 'smin nārado muniḥ .
brahmalokāt samāyāto bhavaty amarasaṃsadam ..6.106.3..

na māṃ paśyati cet tatra tat kopam upagacchati .
nodvejanīyā bhavyena guravo hi kadācana ..6.106.4..

tyaktasaṅkalpalekhena na kiñcid abhivāñchatā .
tvayātmany eva vastavyaṃ dṛṣṭir eṣaiva pāvanī ..6.106.5..

iti yāvat prativacaḫ puṣpahastaś śikhidhvajaḥ .
praṇāmāya dadāty eṣa tāvad antardhim āyayau ..6.106.6..

pratibhāsagataṃ vastu yathaivāgre na dṛśyate .
na dṛṣṭavāṃs tathā kumbham agre rājā śikhidhvajaḥ ..6.106.7..

gate kumbhe mahīpālaḫ paraṃ vismayam āyayau .
tad eva cintayaṃś citraṃ citrārpita ivābhavat ..6.106.8..

iti sañcintayām āsa citraṃ vilasitaṃ vidheḥ .
yat kumbhavyapadeśena bodhito 'smi cirād ayam ..6.106.9..

kva nāradasutaẖ kumbhaẖ kvāhaṃ nāma śikhidhvajaḥ .
kevalaṃ kālayuktyaivam ahaṃ sampratibodhitaḥ ..6.106.10..

aho nu samyak kathitaṃ devaputreṇa yuktimat .
aho nu samprabuddho 'smi mohanidrākulaś cirāt ..6.106.11..

kvāham āsaṃ vinirmagnaẖ kriyājālakukardame .
idaṃ kāryam idaṃ neti mithyāvibhramam ācaran ..6.106.12..

aho nu śītalā śuddhā śānteyaṃ padavī nijā .
rasāyanadravākārā sattvaṃ śītayatīva me ..6.106.13..

śāmyāmi parinirvāmi sukham āse ca kevalam .
cinmātram api necchāmi saṃsthito 'smi yathāsthitam ..6.106.14..

evaṃ sañcintayan rājā evaṃnirvāsanāśayaḥ .
śailād iva samutkīrṇo maunam evātha tasthivān ..6.106.15..

tasminn eva tato maunī nissaṅkalpe nirāmaye .
pratiṣṭhāṃ niścalāṃ prāpya sa tasthau giriśṛṅgavat ..6.106.16..

sa tatra saṃśāntabhayo mahātmā
cireṇa viśrāntim itas samātmā .
cireṇa samprāptanijāmalātmā
yogena suṣvāpa tadā cidātmā ..6.106.17..

nirvikalpasamādhānāt kāṣṭhakuḍyopamas sthitaḥ .
evaṃ śikhidhvajo rāma cūḍālām adhunā śṛṇu ..6.107.1..

śikhidhvajaṃ taṃ bhartāraṃ kumbhaveṣena tena sā .
prabodhyāntardhim āgatya tatāra tarasā nabhaḥ ..6.107.2..

devaputrākṛtiṃ vyomni jahau māyāvinirmitām .
vidagdhamugdham ākāraṃ straiṇaṃ jagrāha sundaram ..6.107.3..

nabhasā svapuraṃ prāpya viveśāntaḫpuraṃ kṣaṇāt .
dṛśyā babhūva lokasya nṛpakarma cakāra sā ..6.107.4..

vāsaratritayenāpi punar ambaram etya sā .
babhūva kumbho yogena śikhidhvajavanaṃ yayau ..6.107.5..

tathā tatraiva taṃ bhūpam apaśyad vanabhūmigā .
nirvikalpasamādhisthaṃ samutkīrṇam iva drumāt ..6.107.6..

aho nu khalu bho diṣṭyā viśrānto 'yam ihātmani .
sthitas svasthas samaś śānta ity uvāca puraḫ prabhoḥ ..6.107.7..

tad enaṃ tāvad etasmād bodhayāmi parāt padāt .
idānīm eva kiṃ dehatyāgam eṣa karoti vai ..6.107.8..

kañcit kālaṃ sphuritveha rājyena vipinena vā .
samam eva gamiṣyāvas tyaktadehāv imau śamam ..6.107.9..

tad yāvad eṣo vicalaṃ pariṇāmaṃ na gacchati .
anenābhyāsayogena tāvad ābodhayāmy aham ..6.107.10..

iti sañcintya cūḍālā siṃhanādaṃ cakāra sā .
bhūyo bhūyaḫ prabhor agre vanecarabhayapradam ..6.107.11..

na cacāla śilevādrau yadā nādena tena saḥ .
bhūyo bhūyaẖ kṛtenāpi tadā sā taṃ vyacālayat ..6.107.12..

cālitaḫ pātito 'py eṣa yadā na bubudhe nṛpaḥ .
tadā sañcintayām āsa cūḍālā kumbharūpiṇī ..6.107.13..

aho pariṇatas sādhus svapade bhagavān ayam .
tad enaṃ hi kayā yuktyā sāmprataṃ bodhayāmy aham ..6.107.14..

atha vainaṃ mahātmānaṃ kimarthaṃ bodhayāmy aham .
videhaṃ bodham āsādya tiṣṭhatv eṣa yathāsukham ..6.107.15..

aham apy aṅganādeham imaṃ tyaktvā paraṃ padam .
apunarjananāyaiva gacchāmīha hi kiṃ mama ..6.107.16..

iti sañcintya dehaṃ svaṃ tyaktum abhyudyatā satī .
punas sañcintayām āsa cūḍālā sā mahāsatī ..6.107.17..

ālokayāmi vai tāvad enaṃ dehaṃ mahīpateḥ .
yady asya sattvaśeṣo 'sti bodhabījaṃ hṛdantare ..6.107.18..

tat kālenaiṣa bhagavān samprabodham upaiṣyati .
mūlakośarasālīnaṃ puṣpajālaṃ madhāv iva ..6.107.19..

tadeha viharañ jīvanmukta eko bhavaty ayam .
maiko bhavatv eṣa iti manye gacchāmi no śamam ..6.107.20..

iti sañcintya cūḍālā sparśena nayanena ca .
patim ālokya sāśaṅkam uvāca varavarṇinī ..6.107.21..

asty eva sattvaśeṣo 'sya hṛdi sambodhakāraṇam .
kāyo 'yam agaladrūpo nemaṃ dehaṃ tyajāmy aham ..6.107.22..

bhṛśaṃ saṃśāntacittasya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamasthiteḥ .
sattvaśeṣaẖ kathaṃ brahmañ jñāyate dhyānaśālinaḥ ..6.107.23..

prabodhakāraṇaṃ yasya durlakṣyāṇuvapur hṛdi .
vidyate sattvaśeṣo 'ntar bīje puṣpaphalaṃ yathā ..6.107.24..

cittaspandavimuktasya tasyāspanditasaccitaḥ .
dvitvaikatvavihīnasya samasyācalasaṃsthiteḥ ..6.107.25..

kāyas samasamābhogo na glāyati na hṛṣyati .
nāstam eti na codeti samam evāvatiṣṭhate ..6.107.26..

dvitvaikatvādiyuktasya yasya praspandate manaḥ .
tasya deho 'nyatām eti nāspandasya kadācana ..6.107.27..

cittaspando hi sarveṣāṃ kāraṇaṃ jagatas sthiteḥ .
rāma bhāvavikārāṇāṃ kusumānāṃ yathā madhuḥ ..6.107.28..

yasmin praspandate dehe cittaṃ sa hi muhur muhuḥ .
harṣaglapanasammohavaśam eti raghūdvaha ..6.107.29..

citte praśamam āyāte kāyo yas sattvavān sthitaḥ .
bādhate nāmbarasyeva tasya bhāvavikārabhūḥ ..6.107.30..

vīcyādi na yathodeti samāyā jalasantateḥ .
tathā na dṛśyate doṣas samāyās sattvasaṃsthiteḥ ..6.107.31..

sattvasyānupalambho 'sti nānyas svopaśamād ṛte .
yāvad bhāvi samaṃ sattvaṃ kālāc chāmyati kevalam ..6.107.32..

dehe yasmiṃs tu no cittaṃ nāpi sattvaṃ ca vidyate .
sa tāpahimavad rāma pañcatvena vilīyate ..6.107.33..

śikhidhvajasya deho 'sau niścitaṃ cetasojjhitaḥ .
sattvāṃśena ca saṃyuktas tena na mlānibhājanam ..6.107.34..

taṃ tathābhūtam ālokya bhartur dehaṃ varāṅganā .
anujjhitavatī dehaṃ cintayām āsa satvaram ..6.107.35..

cittattvaṃ sarvagaṃ śuddhaṃ praviśyābodhayāmy aham .
bhaviṣyadbodhanaṃ kāntam eṣa tatra hi saṃsthitaḥ ..6.107.36..

na bodhayāmi yady enaṃ cirāt tad budhyate svayam .
kim ihaikāvatiṣṭhe 'ham ity enaṃ bodhayāmy aham ..6.107.37..

iti sañcintya cūḍālā dehaṃ kāraṇapañjaram .
santyajya prāpa cittattve sthitim ādyantavarjite ..6.107.38..

tatra sā cetanaspandaṃ kṛtvā sattvavataḫ prabhoḥ .
svaṃ viveśa punar dehaṃ khān nīḍam iva pakṣiṇī ..6.107.39..

kumbhākṛtir athotthāya niviṣṭā kusumasthale .
sāma gātuṃ pravṛttā sā bhramarīvṛndasasvanā ..6.107.40..

taṃ sāmasvanam ākarṇya cit sattvaguṇaśālinaḥ .
bubudhe bhūpater dehe vasanta iva padminī ..6.107.41..

dṛśaṃ vikāsayām āsa tāṃ tadārka ivābjinīm .
gṛhītasattvasampattiś śikhidhvajamahīpatiḥ ..6.107.42..

apaśyat kumbham agrasthaṃ sāmagāyanatatparam .
pareṇa vapuṣā yuktaṃ sāmavedam ivāparam ..6.107.43..

aho bata vayaṃ dhanyāḫ punaḫ prāpto munes sutaḥ .
ity evodāharan rājā kumbhāya kusumaṃ dadau ..6.107.44..

diṣṭyā sthitās smo bhagavaṃs tava cetasi pāvane .
ke nāma na mahāsattvāḫ prasādeṣv aṅga hi sthirāḥ ..6.107.45..

asmatpavitrīkaraṇam ekam āgamakāraṇam .
tava pāpāpahaṃ brūhi dvitīyaṃ katarad bhavet ..6.107.46..

yataḫ prabhṛti yāto 'smi tvatsakāśād arindama .
tataḫ prabhṛti ceto me tvayaiveha samaṃ sthitam ..6.107.47..

na rame svargaraṅgeṣu devodyāneṣu cānagha .
merumandarakūṭeṣu kailāsakuhareṣu ca ..6.107.48..

tvatsaṅgam eva vāñchāmi subhagācārapeśalam .
amṛtasyandasaṅkāśaṃ madhumāsam iva drumaḥ ..6.107.49..

tasmād eveha tiṣṭhāmi samīpe tava sāmpratam .
abhīṣṭaṃ yad yad evāṅga ramyāṇāṃ dhuri tat sthitam ..6.107.50..

tvādṛśo bandhur āptaś ca suhṛn mitraṃ sakhā tathā .
viśvāsyaś caiva śiṣyaś ca manye jagati nāsti me ..6.107.51..

ratnadīpaprakāśāḍhyamaṇimandiramaṇḍite ..6.110.12..

puṣpabhārānatottuṅgavṛkṣajanyavirājite .
vanapuṣpalatālāsyanārīnṛttamanohare ..6.110.13..

niśi vyomagatās tārā bhartrā pūrṇendunā saha .
āvayoḫ paripaśyantu karṇāntāgatalocanāḥ ..6.110.14..

uttiṣṭhātmavivāhārthaṃ kurvaẖ kānanakoṭarāt .
rājaṃś candanapuṣpādisambhāraṃ ratnasaṃyutam ..6.110.15..

ity uktvā kumbha utthāya saha tena mahībhṛtā .
kusumāvacayaṃ cakre tathā ratnādisañcayam ..6.110.16..

tato muhūrtamātreṇa ratnasānau same śubhe .
samālambhanapuṣpāḍhyās tābhyāṃ vai rāśayaẖ kṛtāḥ ..6.110.17..

hārāmbaramaṇīndrādirāśayas te virejire .
saubhāgyasyeva kāmena kośāẖ kālena sambhṛtāḥ ..6.110.18..

tathā janyatrasambhāraṃ kṛtvā kāñcanakandare .
yayatus tau mahāmitre snātuṃ mandākinīṃ nadīm ..6.110.19..

tatrainaṃ snapayām āsa mahārājam athādarāt .
gajakumbhopamaskandhaṃ kumbho maṅgalapūrvakam ..6.110.20..

bhaviṣyadvanitārūpāṃ bhaviṣyatpatitāṃ gataḥ .
cūḍālāṃ snapayām āsa kumbharūpadharāṃ priyām ..6.110.21..

pūjayām āsatus snātau tatra devān pitṝn munīn .
yathā kriyāphale 'nicchau kriyātyāge tathaiva tau ..6.110.22..

nityaṃ jñānarasātṛptau vyavasthārthaṃ jagatsthiteḥ .
cakrāte bhojanaṃ bhavyau tāv anyo'nyasamīritau ..6.110.23..

kalpavṛkṣadugūlāni paridhāya sitāni tau .
phalāni bhuktvā janyatrasthānam āyayatuẖ kramāt ..6.110.24..

etāvatātra kālena tayor janyatrasotkayoḥ .
priyaṃ kartum ivāstādrau jhagity evāviśad raviḥ ..6.110.25..

atha sandhyākrame vṛtte kṛte japyāghamarṣaṇe .
vivāhadarśanāyeva tārājāle kham āgate ..6.110.26..

mithunaikasakhī yāmā kumudotkarahāsinī .
prāleyajālaprakaraṃ vikirantī samāyayau ..6.110.27..

ratnadīpān bahūn samyak kumbhas sānāv ayojayat .
jyotīṃṣīndvarkayuktāni padmodbhava ivāmbarāt ..6.110.28..

bhūṣayām āsa rājānaṃ strītvaṃ gacchan niśāmukhe .
candanāgurukarpūrapūrair mṛgajakuṅkumaiḥ ..6.110.29..

hārakeyūrakaṭakais tathā kalpalatāṃśukaiḥ .
sragdāmair avataṃsaiś ca mālyaiś ca vividhombhitaiḥ ..6.110.30..

tathā kalpalatāgucchair mandāraiḫ pārijātakaiḥ .
santānair bahuratnaiś ca maulinā cendurūpiṇā ..6.110.31..

etāvatātha kālena vadhūtvaṃ kumbha āyayau .
ghanastanataṭākrānto babhūvāśu vilāsavān ..6.110.32..

idaṃ sañcintayām āsa sampanno 'yam ahaṃ vadhūḥ .
kāmāyātmā mayādeyaẖ kāryaṃ kālocitaṃ kila ..6.110.33..

iyam asmi vadhūẖ kāntā bhartāyaṃ me puras sthitaḥ .
gṛhāṇa kāma mām ehi kālo 'yaṃ tava hṛcchaya ..6.110.34..

iti sañcintya bhartāram agrastham abhimaṇḍitam .
udayantam ivādityaṃ ratiẖ kāmam ivāha sā ..6.110.35..

ahaṃ madanikā nāma bhāryāsmi tava mānada .
pataye te praṇāmo 'yaṃ sasnehaṃ kriyate mayā ..6.110.36..

ity uktvā sānavadyāṅgī lajjāvanamitānanā .
lolālakena śirasā praṇanāma nayāt patim ..6.110.37..

uvācedaṃ ca he nātha tvaṃ māṃ bhūṣaya bhūṣaṇaiḥ .
krameṇāgniṃ ca sañjvālya matpāṇigrahaṇaṃ kuru ..6.110.38..

rājase 'titarāṃ nātha māṃ karoṣi smarāturām .
rater vivāhe madanam abhibhūyādhitiṣṭhasi ..6.110.39..

indor ivāṃśujālāni rājan mālyāni bhānti te .
merugaṅgāpravāhābhāṃ dhatte hāras tavorasi ..6.110.40..

mandārakusumaprotaiẖ kuntalair nṛpa rājase .
kanakābjam ivālolair bhṛṅgaiẖ kesaradhūsaraiḥ ..6.110.41..

ratnāṃśujālaiẖ kusumaiś śriyā sthairyeṇa tejasā .
unnatyā ca vibho merum abhibhūyāvatiṣṭhase ..6.110.42..

evamādi vadantau tau bhaviṣyannavadampatī .
pracchannapūrvadāmpatyau mithas tuṣṭau babhūvatuḥ ..6.110.43..

mahārājñīṃ madanikāṃ mahārājaś śikhidhvajaḥ .
kāñcanāmalaparyaṅke niyojyābhūṣayat svayam ..6.110.44..

avataṃsais tathā mālyair maṇimuktāvibhūṣaṇaiḥ .
vastrair vilepanaiḫ puṣpair ucitasthānayojitaiḥ ..6.110.45..

sā babhau bhūṣitā tanvī madanī madadāyinī .
girijeva vivāhotkā kāmakānteva kāminī ..6.110.46..

mahārājo mahārājñīṃ bhūṣayitvedam āha tām .
rājase mṛgaśāvākṣi lakṣmīr iva navotthitā ..6.110.47..

śakreṇa saha yac chacyā yal lakṣmyā hariṇā saha .
yad gauryāś śambhunā sārdhaṃ tat te bhavatu maṅgalam ..6.110.48..

padmakandāṅkuraradā lolanīlotpalekṣaṇā .
āmodasubhagākārā tvaṃ sthitā padminīsamā ..6.110.49..

suraktapallavakarā stabakastanadhāriṇī .
tvam eva phaladā manye kāmakalpataror latā ..6.110.50..

himaśītāvadātāṅgī jyotsnāprasarahāsinī .
pūrṇenduśrīr ivodyuktā dṛṣṭaivāhlādayasy alam ..6.110.51..

tad uttiṣṭha varārohe vedīṃ vaivāhikīṃ svayam .
ratnapuṣpalatājālai racayāvo yathākramam ..6.110.52..

ity uktvā dampatī kāntau racayām āsatus tadā .
vedīm ātmavivāhāya mahendramaṇikandare ..6.110.53..

muktājālais sajhāṅkāraiḫ puṣpottaṃsais saṣaṭpadaiḥ .
ratnamālyais saṭāṅkārair vaijayantīpaṭaiś calaiḥ ..6.110.54..

kalpavṛkṣalatāsūtraiẖ kalpastabakamaṇḍalaiḥ .
kalpapādapapaṭṭaiś ca kalpadrumaphalotkaraiḥ ..6.110.55..

devadārulatājālaiẖ kāṇḍapratisarāṅkitaiḥ .
muktākusumalājānāṃ prakarais tārakopamaiḥ ..6.110.56..

caturdikkaṃ caturbhiś ca nārikelamahāphalaiḥ .
pūrṇakumbhatayā gāṅgavāripūraiḫ prakalpitaiḥ ..6.110.57..

jvalayām āsatus tasyāṃ madhye candanadārubhiḥ .
jvalanaṃ jvalitajvālaṃ dakṣiṇasthapradakṣiṇam ..6.110.58..

pūrvābhimukham agnes tāv agre pallavaviṣṭare .
niyojya dampatī kāntau tayor viviśatus svayam ..6.110.59..

sa hutvā tilalājādi pāvakāya śikhidhvajaḥ .
utthāyotthāpya kāntāṃ ca pāṇibhyāṃ svayam ādade ..6.110.60..

anyo'nyaṃ śobhamānau tāv anyāv iva navau śivau .
cakratur dampatī tasya pāvakasya pradakṣiṇam ..6.110.61..

svadāyaṃ jñānasarvasvaṃ hṛdayaṃ prema cācalam .
dadatus tau mitho mānyau smitakāntamukhaśriyau ..6.110.62..

pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā lājān santyajya vahnaye .
madbhāryām ambarād dṛṣṭvā karau tatyajatuẖ kramāt ..6.110.63..

smayamānamukhau kāntau candrāv iva navoditau .
pūrvoparacite puṣpatalpe viviśatur nave ..6.110.64..

etasminn antare candraś caturbhāgaṃ nabhastalāt .
śanair ākramayām āsa śobhāṃ draṣṭum ivaitayoḥ ..6.110.65..

tasmin sānau latācchidrair draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭīr ivābhitaḥ .
lolais sañcārayām āsa karān indur varāṅgane ..6.110.66..

tais tais tatra kathālāpair indāv abhyudite tathā .
tāv āsāṃ cakratuẖ kāntau dampatī tu muhūrtakam ..6.110.67..

athotthāya jvaladratnadīpāṃ kāñcanakandarām .
svayaṃ pūrvoparacitāṃ guptāṃ viviśatuḫ priyau ..6.110.68..

navaṃ dadṛśatus tatra talpaṃ kusumakalpitam .
parito vyāptam utphullair hemapaṅkajarāśibhiḥ ..6.110.69..

mandārādibhir anyaiś ca puṣpair mlānivivarjitaiḥ .
uccakaiḫ puṃpramāṇena nirmitaṃ kusumais samaiḥ ..6.110.70..

dīrghendubimbapratimaṃ tuṣārasthalaśītalam .
kṣīrodajaladhārābhaṃ jyotsnāsampiṇḍapāṇḍuram ..6.110.71..

pratibimbam anantasya ratnabhittāv iva sthitam .
sugandham unnataṃ kāntaṃ viśarārutayojjhitam ..6.110.72..

mithunaṃ puṣparāśau tat papāta dhavalāmale .
tasmin samasamābhoge kṣīrode mandaro yathā ..6.110.73..

tais tais tataḫ praṇatipeśalavāgvilāsais
tatkālakāryasubhagaiḫ praṇayopacāraiḥ .
satkāntayor navanavena tayos sukhena
dīrghā muhūrta iva sā rajanī jagāma ..6.110.74..

atha sūryāṃśuraṅgeṇa rañjite bhuvanodare .
śikhidhvajāṅganā bhūyo madanī kumbhatāṃ yayau ..6.111.1..

evaṃ mahendradaryāṃ tāv ubhau kumbhaśikhidhvajau .
svayaṃ vivāhitāv iṣṭau sampannau navadampatī ..6.111.2..

vilesatur vicitrāsu pratyahaṃ vanarājiṣu .
prapakvaphalabhārāsu puṣpapallavinīṣu ca ..6.111.3..

divā priyatare mitre yāminyām iṣṭadampatī .
prabhādīpāv iva śliṣṭau na viyuktau babhūvatuḥ ..6.111.4..

remāte vanakuñjeṣu guhāsu ca mahībhṛtām .
tamālasālaṣaṇḍeṣu mandāragahaneṣu ca ..6.111.5..

sahyadardurakailāsamahendramalayeṣu ca .
gandhamādanavindhyādrilokālokataṭeṣu ca ..6.111.6..

dinais tribhis tribhir gatvā nidrāṃ gatavati priye .
cūḍālā rājakāryāṇi kṛtvā svāny āyayau punaḥ ..6.111.7..

tau divā suhṛdau rātrau dampatī kumbhabhūmipau .
nānākusumasaṃvītau tasthatur muditau mithaḥ ..6.111.8..

māsam ekaṃ mahendrādrisānau saralasaṅkule .
ratnakuḍye guhāgehe pūjitau surakinnaraiḥ ..6.111.9..

hastalabhyoditendau ca mandāravanamālite .
evaṃ śuktimataḫ pṛṣṭhe pakṣaṃ pakṣaṃ latāgṛhe ..6.111.10..

māsadvayam ṛkṣavato girer dakṣiṇatas taṭe .
pārijātavane devapuṣpastabakamaṇḍape ..6.111.11..

jambūṣaṇḍatale meroḫ pāde jambūnadītaṭe .
jāmbūnadamaye māsaṃ jambūphalarasāvanau ..6.111.12..

daśottarakurūṇāṃ ca maṇḍale divasāni tau .
kailāsasyottarastheṣu saptaviṃśativāsarān ..6.111.13..

evam anyeṣu deśeṣu vicitreṣu mahībhṛtām .
sthitavantau mahābhāgau suhṛdau snigdhadampatī ..6.111.14..

tato yāteṣu māseṣu śanaiẖ katipayeṣu sā .
cūḍālā cintayām āsa devaputrakarūpiṇī ..6.111.15..

suropabhogabhāreṇa parīkṣe 'haṃ śikhidhvajam .
mā kadācana ceto 'sya bhogeṣu ratim eṣyati ..6.111.16..

iti sañcintya cūḍālā māyayā svāmino vane .
āgataṃ darśayām āsa sasurāpsarasaṃ harim ..6.111.17..

indram abhyāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā parivārasamanvitam .
yathāvat pūjayām āsa vanasaṃsthaś śikhidhvajaḥ ..6.111.18..

ātmanaẖ kiṃ kṛtā dūrād abhyāgamakadarthanā .
devarāja prasādān me yathāvad vaktum arhasi ..6.111.19..

ime vayam ihānītās tvadguṇātiśayena khāt .
hṛdi lagnena sūtreṇa khagā dūragatā iva ..6.111.20..

uttiṣṭha svargam āgaccha tatra sarve tvadunmukhāḥ .
tvadguṇaśravaṇāścaryās sthitā devagaṇāṅganāḥ ..6.111.21..

ime rathā idaṃ yānam ayam uccaiśśravā hayaḥ .
ayam airāvaṇo nāgo yathābhimatam āśraya ..6.111.22..

pādukāgulikākhaḍgarasādīdam athāpi ca .
gṛhītvā siddhamārgeṇa svīkuru svargamaṇḍalam ..6.111.23..

ākalpaṃ vaibudhā bhogās tvayā vibudhasadmani .
jīvanmuktena bhoktavyās tena tvām aham āgataḥ ..6.111.24..

vimānayanti samprāptāṃ na tiraskaraṇaiś śriyam .
nābhivāñchanti cāprāptāṃ tvādṛśās sādhusādhavaḥ ..6.111.25..

avighnam āgatenādya sukhaṃ viharatā tvayā .
svargaḫ pavitratāṃ yātu hariṇeva jagattrayam ..6.111.26..

svargaṃ svargasamācāraṃ vedmi devādināyaka .
kiṃ tu sarvatra me svargo niyato na tu kutracit ..6.111.27..

sarvatraiva hi tuṣyāmi sarvatraiva rame prabho .
avāñchanatvān manasas sarvatrānandavān aham ..6.111.28..

niyataṃ kiñcid ekatra sthitaṃ svargakam īdṛśam .
śakra gantuṃ na jānāmi nājñātaṃ ca karomy aham ..6.111.29..

sādho viditavedyānāṃ paripūrṇadhiyāṃ satām .
sajjanācaritaṃ yuktaṃ manye bhogopasevanam ..6.111.30..

deveśe proktavaty evaṃ tūṣṇīm eva sthite nṛpe .
kim evaṃ nopayāmy eva tvām iti proktavān hariḥ ..6.111.31..

bāḍham ity eva kālena vadatīṣac chikhidhvaje .
kalyāṇaṃ te 'stu kumbheti vadann antardhim āyayau ..6.111.32..

tad devavṛndam akhilaṃ tridaśeśayuktaṃ
tatra kṣaṇād alam adṛśyam abhūd vilīnam .
kallolajālam iva vārinidhau praśānta-
vāte sphuranmakaraphenaphaṇīndraśabdam ..6.111.33..

tāṃ māyāṃ śamam ānīya cūḍālā samacintayat .
diṣṭyā bhogecchayā nāyaṃ hriyate vasudhādhipaḥ ..6.112.1..

śāntas samasamābhoga eva śakrasamāgame .
asambhramam ahelaṃ ca kṛtavān vyavahāritām ..6.112.2..

bhūya eva prapañcena vimṛśāmy enam ādarāt .
rāgadveṣapradhānena kenacid buddhihāriṇā ..6.112.3..

iti sañcintya sā rātrāv indāv abhyudite vane .
gṛhītamaṇḍanā nūnaṃ kāntā madanikā satī ..6.112.4..

vāte vahati puṣpāḍhye madirāmodamāṃsale .
sandhyājapyapare nadyās tīrasaṃsthe śikhidhvaje ..6.112.5..

santānakalatāgehaṃ nīrandhraṃ puṣpagucchakaiḥ .
śuddhāntaṃ vanadevīnāṃ praviveśa madānvitā ..6.112.6..

tatra saṅkalpite puṣpaśayane mālyamālitā .
kaṇṭhe saṅkalpitaṃ kāntaṃ śiḍgam ādāya saṃsthitā ..6.112.7..

āgatyānviṣya kuñjān sa pradadarśa śikhidhvajaḥ .
latāgehe madanikākaṇṭhe śiḍgaṃ manoharam ..6.112.8..

kuntalāvalitaskandhaṃ samālabdhaṃ ca candanaiḥ .
śayanāvṛttivikṣepaparyākulitaśekharam ..6.112.9..

hemābhe dviguṇākāre bālābāhūpadhānake .
magnaikaśravaṇāpāṅgakapolatalakuntalam ..6.112.10..

mithunaṃ tad dadarśātha mithaḫ prahasitānanam .
anyo'nyavadanāsaktaṃ channaṃ kalpalatāṃśukaiḥ ..6.112.11..

ālolamālyaśayanaṃ madanāturam ākulam .
aṅgarāgacchalenātmarāgam anyo'nyam arpayat ..6.112.12..

ratyunmukhaṃ ghanānandam uddāmamadamanmatham .
parasparāhataṃ puṣpair vakṣobhyāṃ pīḍitastanam ..6.112.13..

tad ālokyāvikāreṇa cetasā sa tutoṣa ca .
aho sukhaṃ sthitau śiḍgāv ity āha sa śikhidhvajaḥ ..6.112.14..

tiṣṭhatho 'ṅga yathākāmaṃ sukhaṃ śiḍgau yathāsthitam .
vighnaṃ mā kuruthaḫ prītāv ity uktvā nirjagāma saḥ ..6.112.15..

tato muhūrtamātreṇa prapañcaṃ svam upekṣya sā .
niryayau darśayantī svaṃ ratiyuddhākulaṃ vapuḥ ..6.112.16..

upaviṣṭaṃ dadarśainaṃ nṛpaṃ hemaśilātale .
samādhisaṃstham ekānte manāgvikasitekṣaṇam ..6.112.17..

taṃ pradeśam upāgatya lajjāvanamitānanā .
tūṣṇīm āsit kṣaṇaṃ khinnā mlānā madanikāṅganā ..6.112.18..

kṣaṇāc chikhidhvajo dhyānād viratas tām uvāca ha .
prasannamadhuraṃ vākyam idam akṣubdhayā dhiyā ..6.112.19..

tanvi kiṃ śīghram eva tvaṃ vighnitānandam āgatā .
ānandāyaiva bhūtāni yatante yāni kānicit ..6.112.20..

bhūyas toṣaya taṃ gaccha kāntaṃ praṇayavṛttibhiḥ .
parasparepsitasneho durlabho hi jagattraye ..6.112.21..

aham etena cārthena nodvegaṃ yāmi mānini .
yad yad iṣṭatamaṃ loke tad tad deyaṃ vijānatā ..6.112.22..

ahaṃ kumbhaś ca tanvaṅgi vītarāgāv iha sthitau .
durvāsaśśāpajā bālā tvaṃ yad icchasi tat kuru ..6.112.23..

evam eṣa mahābhāga strīpumbhāvo hi cañcalaḥ .
kāmo hy aṣṭaguṇas strīṇāṃ na kopaṃ kartum arhasi ..6.112.24..

abalāham anenāsmi krāntā gahanakānane .
tvayi sandhyājapapare kiṃ karomi varākikā ..6.112.25..

abalā vākyamātreṇa tāvan naranirodhanam .
karoti yāvac chiḍgena nāṅge sve viniveśitā ..6.112.26..

striyās sundara yātāyāḫ parapuṃsāṅgasaṅgamam .
manyur niṣedha ākrandas satītvaṃ kiṃ kariṣyati ..6.112.27..

abalā strī tathā bālā mūḍhāham aparādhinī .
kṣantum arhasi māṃ nātha kṣamāvanto hi sādhavaḥ ..6.112.28..

manyur mama na bāle 'ntar vidyate kha iva drumaḥ .
kevalaṃ sādhunindyatvān necchāmi tvām aham vadhūm ..6.112.29..

suhṛttvena vanānteṣu pūrvavat samam aṅgane .
vītarāgatayā nityaṃ tapasaiva ramāvahe ..6.112.30..

evaṃ samatayā tatra sthite tasmiñ śikhidhvaje .
cūḍālā cintayām āsa tatsatyenoditāśayā ..6.112.31..

aho bata paraṃ sāmyaṃ bhagavān ayam āgataḥ .
vītarāgabhayakrodho jīvanmukto 'vatiṣṭhati ..6.112.32..

nainaṃ haranti bhogāśā na mahatyo 'pi siddhayaḥ .
na sukhāni na duẖkhāni nāpado na ca sampadaḥ ..6.112.33..

cintitās sakalā eva prayānty enam aninditāḥ .
manye maharddhayaẖ kāntā nārāyaṇam ivāparam ..6.112.34..

ātmavṛttāntam akhilaṃ tad enaṃ smārayāmy aham .
kumbharūpam idaṃ tyaktvā cūḍālaiva bhavāmy aham ..6.112.35..

iti sañcintya cūḍālā cūḍālāvapur akṣatam .

atha tāṃ dayitāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayotphullalocanaḥ .

aṅgena vyavahāreṇa smitenānunayena ca .

kumbhādidehanirmāṇas tvāṃ bodhayitum eṣa me .

sargasyādyantayor ukto yaẖ kramo vedanātmakaḥ .

śabdārthabhāvanehānāṃ vittvāt satyāvabodhataḥ .

adṛṣad dṛṣadābhāsaṃ jñam apy ajñam iva sthitam .

śāstrasajjanasamparkaiḫ prajñām ādau vivardhayet .

turyāvasthopaśāntātha muktir eva hi kevalam .

ānandaikaghanībhāvāt suṣuptākhyā tu pañcamī .

turyātītapadāvasthā saptamī bhūmikottamā .

padārthas sanniveśais svair yathānanyais samanvitaḥ .

yathormikādiẖ kanake tathā sargaḫ pare pade .

hāṭake kaṭakādiś ca sargaś ca parame pade .
vidyamāno 'pi nāsty eva prekṣāyāṃ kalpanārthavat ..6.125.40..

aspandayāvedanayā spandavedanasattayā .

sā tvaṃ sā cin manas sā ca na tvaṃ no cin manaś ca no .

ākāśād iva śūnyatvaṃ taraṅgatvam ivāmbhasaḥ .

draṣṭṛdarśanadṛśyānāṃ tasyāṃ dṛśi vayaṃ sthitāḥ .

na sarvāpahnavaṃ vedmi na sarvaṃ nāpy apahnavam .
tvattvamattvādyasambhāvāt paraṃ śāntaṃ jagannabhaḥ ..6.125.45..

śāntāśeṣaviśeṣavastuviṣayā satyātmatāsatyatā-
yuktāhamprakṛtiẖ kriyeti gaditā nāstīti niścitya tat .

tasmād astajaḍājaḍāṅkurasamutsedhāsanenāsyatām ..6.125.46..

ity uktavaty atha munau divaso jagāma

snātuṃ sabhā kṛtanamaskaraṇā jagāma
śyāmākṣaye ravikaraiś ca sahājagāma ..6.125.47..

saṃśāntabhavasambandham arāgadveśavāsanam .

dravaṃ svam iva śuddhāmbu svāntarlekhā ivopalaḥ .

yathauṣṇyam agnis tuhinaṃ ca śaityaṃ

vid vetty adas tat tu na vetty atajjñaḥ ..6.126.20..

ātmanaivātmano lepaẖ ka iva syāt kathaṃ kila .

vāsanādivikalpo 'sti vyatiriktaś ca nātmanaḥ .

kaṭakādi yathā hemno vivartādi tathātmanaḥ .

na vikāro yathormitvaṃ vāra evaṃ jagac citaḥ .

upaśāntamahātāpāṃ parāṃ niṣṭhām ahaṃ gataḥ .

ajenātmā kila jñāto yad ahaṃ buddha īśvaraḥ .
ātmanātmani viśrāntaṃ jaleneva jalārṇave ..6.127.24..

dehendriyādinā karma karaṇaughena kalpyate .

sarvaṃ mamāhaṃ sarvasya caiveti dṛḍhaniścayāt .

ūrdhvād adhas tv adhastāc ca punar ūrdhvaṃ vrajaṃś ciram .
mā saṃsārāraghaṭṭasya cintārajjvāṃ ghaṭo bhava ..6.128.19..

idaṃ mamāham asyeti vyavahāraghanabhramam .

asyāham eṣa me so 'yam aham evammayātmani .

mā sāgare śileva tvam adho'dho gaccha mohitaḥ .

jalaphenavad utpannadhvaṃsitām anubhāvayan .

cittejo yaś cidādityaḫ prasārayati sarvataḥ .

yathā tiṣṭhan svabhāvena sphaṭikaẖ kirati prabhāḥ .

yad ātmanaiva vimalaṃ cittvena sphuraṇaṃ citaḥ .

yadā brahma paraṃ brahma tatraiva brahma bṛṃhitam .

sarvaśaktitayā brahma cetastvād atiyātayā .

kiñcit kṣubdhaṃ payaẖ kiñcit somyarūpaṃ yathāmbudheḥ .

yadaivaivaṃ cito rūpaṃ tataṃ buddham akhaṇḍitam .

yaṃ yaṃ deśaṃ videśaṃ vā kālaṃ vā kalanāṃ ca vā .

cinmātratvaṃ prayātasya tīrṇamṛtyos svacetasaḥ .

sīmāntas sarvaduẖkhānāṃ mṛtyur eva jagattraye .

sarvāsām eva dṛṣṭīnāṃ sarvāsām eva sampadām .

tāvat prakṛtir ālolā yatate duẖkhasaṅkṣaye .

yathā puṣpaṃ samāsādya naśyanti śaraveṇavaḥ .

sarvam ādau jagac chūnyaṃ śūnyam ante ca bhūpate .

nāntaś śūnaṃ ca śūnyaṃ ca nācidrūpaṃ na cinmayam .

ajñānagranthinirbhedo mokṣa ity ucyate 'nagha .

eṣa eva śanair dehaṃ gālayitvopaśāmyati .

yathābhūtam idaṃ jñātvā jāgataṃ vastuvibhramam .
bhāvayitvā yathājñānaṃ jñas tiṣṭhati yathāsukham ..6.128.55..

praśāntaśāstrārthavicāracāpalo

nirastaniśśeṣavikalpaviplavas
samas sukhaṃ tiṣṭhasi śāśvatātmakaḥ ..6.128.56..

ātmārāmo vītaśoko nityam antarmukhas sukhī .
kurvann api ca karmāṇi tiṣṭhaty apagatabhramam ..6.129.1..

antaśśītalayā nityam anākulatayā tathā .
somyarūpatayā pūrṇaś śaśāṅka iva śobhate ..6.129.2..

samaś śāntamanā maunī kṣīṇavādavicāraṇaḥ .
kacaty ātmani cittattve dagdhendhana ivānalaḥ ..6.129.3..

yena kenacid ācchanno yena kenacid āśitaḥ .
yatra kvacana śāyī ca samrāḍ iva virājate ..6.129.4..

varṇadharmāśramācāraśāstramantrāmayojjhitaḥ .
nirgacchati jagajjālāt pañjarād iva kesarī ..6.129.5..

vācām atītaviṣayāṃ viṣayāśādaśojjhitām .
kām apy upagataś śobhāṃ śaradīva nabhastalam ..6.129.6..

gambhīraś ca prasannaś ca girāv iva mahāhradaḥ .
parānandarasakṣīvo ramate svātmanātmani ..6.129.7..

yathābhimatavistāro yathābhimatakarmakṛt .
paramāṃ nirvṛtiṃ yāti muktaśāstrārthayantraṇaḥ ..6.129.8..

sarvakarmaphalatyāgī nityatṛpto nirāśrayaḥ .

sphaṭikaḫ pratibimbena yathā nāyāti rañjanām .

hasan rudann api bhṛśaṃ dehapūjāvikartanaiḥ .
dāhāhlādau na jānāti pratibimbagatāv iva ..6.129.11..

nisstotro nirvaṣaṭkāraḫ pūjyapūjāvivarjitaḥ .
saṃyuktaś ca viyuktaś ca sarvācāranayakramaiḥ ..6.129.12..

tasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate ca saḥ .
harṣāmarṣabhayakrodhair mukto yuktaś ca dṛśyate ..6.129.13..

rāgadveṣodayārambhais tyajyate 'pi ca yujyate .

vidhūyānantanānātvaṃ yaẖ kilaikatayoditaḥ .

tanuṃ tyajati tīrthe vā śvapacasya gṛhe 'pi vā .

jñānasamprāptisamaye mukto 'sau vigatāmayaḥ .
vītaśokajarāyāso yat karoti karotu tat ..6.129.18..

ahambhrāntir hi bandhāya mokṣo jāte hi tatkṣaye .
yathā bhavati deho 'yaṃ tathā bhavatu kā kṣatiḥ ..6.129.19..

yat karoti yad ādatte yatropaviśati kṣaṇam .
yat paśyati spṛśati yat tasmai spṛhayati prajā ..6.129.20..

sa pūjanīyas sa stutyo namaskāryas sa yatnataḥ .
sa mahātmābhivādyaś ca vibhūtyai vibhavaiṣiṇā ..6.129.21..

na yajñatīrthair na tapaḫpradānair
āsādyate tat paramaṃ pavitram .
āsādyate kṣīṇabhavāmayānāṃ
bhaktyā satām ātmavidāṃ yad aṅga ..6.129.22..

evam uktvā sa bhagavān manus tūṣṇīm avasthitaḥ .
ikṣvākunā nṛpendreṇa muditenābhipūjitaḥ ..6.130.1..

jagāmākāśam āviśya śrīmān paitāmahaṃ gṛham .
etāṃ dṛṣṭim avaṣṭabhya rāmātmārāmatāṃ vraja ..6.130.2..

evaṃ sthite he bhagavañ jīvanmuktasya sanmateḥ .
apūrvo 'tiśayaẖ ko 'sau bhavaty ātmavidāṃ vara ..6.130.3..

jñasya kasmiṃścid evāṅga bhavaty atiśaye na dhīḥ .
nityatṛptaḫ praśāntātmā sa ātmany eva tiṣṭhati ..6.130.4..

apūrvo 'tiśayaẖ ko vā sādhor jagati vidyate .
sarve hy atiśayā loke śataśaḫ pūrvatāṃ gatāḥ ..6.130.5..

dhūrtais siddhaiś ca tajjñaiś ca tathānyair mṛgapakṣibhiḥ .
kṛtam ākāśayānādi kā tasya syād apūrvatā ..6.130.6..

kevalaṃ śāntasaṃrambhaṃ prakṛtavyavahāravān .

nottamaṃ na ca sāmānyaṃ nāśrutaṃ na bahuśrutam .
na suvṛttaṃ na durvṛttaṃ jñaṃ vidanti janā ime ..6.130.8..

lokācāragatasyāpi lokavat saṃsthitasya ca .
brahman viditavedyasya brūhi cihnaṃ manāg api ..6.130.9..

na kiñcid apy apūrvatvaṃ janāt tasyāṅga lakṣyate .

tattvajñasyeha he rāma na lokālokanakṣamam .
vidyate lakṣaṇaṃ sākṣād aṇimādy apadādi vā ..6.130.11..

vyavahārī yathaivājñas tajjño loke tathaiva hi .
vyavahāravaśaprāpte sukhe duẖkhe ca tiṣṭhati ..6.130.12..

eka eva viśeṣo 'tra sa cādṛśyo janasthitau .
sati vāsati vā dehe yad antaẖkṣīṇaduẖkhatā ..6.130.13..

svānubhūtyātmakād asmān nirduẖkhatvād ṛte paraḥ .
śiraśśṛṅgādi tajjñasya cihnam anyan na vidyate ..6.130.14..

nityam evottamānandād anyat svānubhavasthitāt .

mahākartṛtvam atha vā cihnaṃ tajjñasya dṛśyate .

etāvad eva khalu liṅgam aliṅgamūrtes

tajjñasya yan madanakopaviṣādamoha-
lobhāpadām anudinaṃ nipuṇaṃ tanutvam ..6.130.19..

bhūyaś śṛṇu mahābāho saṅgraheṇa vaco mama .
yad vacmi tava bodhāya mayūrasyeva vāridaḥ ..6.131.1..

tvadbodhanam upādeyam ātmīyāt tapaso mama .
abuddhapṛcchakā rāma ke raghūṇāṃ hi daiśikāḥ ..6.131.2..

janmāntaraśatābhyastaghanabhramaṇavihvalaḥ .
śṛṇu jīvan kathaṃ māyāpañjarāt pravimucyate ..6.131.3..

kṛtāhambhāvanā saṃvij jīvādyabhidhayānvitā .

yan mithyā tad bhramāyālpaṃ kālaṃ sphurati no ciram .

nāsato vidyate bhāvas snigdhatvaṃ sikatāsv iva .

yathā bhekarajo 'lakṣyaṃ yāti prāvṛṣi bhekatām .

kevalaṃ bhāvanāmātraṃ buddhyaivāsya pramārjaya .

māṃsāsthyoghaś śavo dehaẖ khaṃ kham adrigaṇo jagat .

cinmātrasyātiśuddhasya nissaṅkalpoditātmanaḥ .

khād eva jāyate kaścit kaścid vyomny eva līyate .

ātmānaṃ samyag ālokya yaẖ kha eva vilīyate .
na sa sandṛśyate bhūyo himaṃ tāpadrutaṃ yathā ..6.131.47..

yas tv apaśyan svam ātmānaṃ saspandaẖ kalanātmabhiḥ .
karmabhis sa sphuraty uccair vilīno jāyate punaḥ ..6.131.48..

yas saṅkalpaparispandais sthaulyam eti jaḍātmakaḥ .
prāvṛṣīva payovāhaẖ kṣīṇakṣīṇo 'py udety asau ..6.131.49..

ātmatvāṃśānvitam api citsaṅkalpaṃ raghūdvaha .
dūrīkuru mahāsiddhyai viṣasiktam ivāśanam ..6.131.50..

nirvikalpam anādyantam udāsīnam avasthitam .
sarvātmaikaṃ samuditaṃ cidvyoma bhava bhūtaye ..6.131.51..

akāraṇam upāyānti sarve jīvāḫ parāt padāt .
paścāt kāraṇatāṃ yānti bandhamokṣadaśāsv iha ..6.131.52..

saṅkalpitvaṃ hi bandhasya kāranaṃ tat parityaja .
mokṣas tu nissaṅkalpatvaṃ tadabhyāsaṃ dhiyā kuru ..6.131.53..

akāraṇaṃ tv akaraṇāt sarvakāraṇakāraṇāt .
yāvan nimeṣam avyaktāj jīvas sampadyate śivāt ..6.131.54..

tāvan nimeṣa evāsau yāti kāraṇatāṃ svayam .
saṃsṛtau svāsv avasthāsu vīciṣv iva calajjalam ..6.131.55..

sāvadhāno bhavātas tvaṃ grāhyagrāhakasaṅgame .
ajasram eva saṅkalpadaśāḫ pariharañ śanaiḥ ..6.131.56..

mā bhava grāhyabhāvātmā grāhakātmā ca mā bhava .
bhāvanām akhilāṃ tyaktvā yac chiṣṭaṃ tanmayo bhava ..6.131.57..

grāhyagrāhakasambandhasāvadhāno hy anāratam .
akurvan vāpi kurvan vā muktim evānudhāvati ..6.131.58..

grāhyagrāhakarūpātmā hy ajño rāma kṣaṇaṃ prati .
navaṃ navam upāyāti bandhanaṃ bhāvanāvaśāt ..6.131.59..

grāhyagrāhakasambandhe rasabhāvanayā svayā .
nimeṣaṃ prati jīvasya bandho gacchati pīnatām ..6.131.60..

grāhyagrāhakasambandhe vinaiva rasabhāvanām .
nimeṣaṃ prati jīvo 'yam ātmatām eti mokṣabhāk ..6.131.61..

ajasraṃ yaṃ yam evārthaṃ pataty akṣagaṇo 'nagha .
badhyate tatra rāgeṇa tatrārāgeṇa mucyate ..6.131.62..

kiñcic ced rocate tubhyaṃ tad baddho 'si bhavasthitau .
na kiñcid rocate te cet tan mukto 'si bhavasthiteḥ ..6.131.63..

asmāt padārthanicayāt sahasthāvarajaṅgamāt .
tṛṇāder devaparyantān mā kiñcit tava rocatām ..6.131.64..

ratir nityam anarthārtham aratiś śreyase nṛṇām .
antavattvād ratir duẖkhair anantair yojayen naram ..6.131.65..

aratis san yad aśnāsi yat karoṣi jahāsi yat .
na kartāsi na bhoktāsi tatra muktamatiś śamī ..6.131.66..

neha prajāyate kiñcin neha kiñcid vinaśyati .
sarvaṃ śāntaṃ nirālambaṃ cidvyomāmalam ātatam ..6.131.67..

santo 'tītaṃ na śocanti bhaviṣyac cintayanti no .
vartamānaṃ ca gṛhṇanti kramaprāptaṃ sadānagha ..6.131.68..

sphuranti jīvapuṣpāṇi jātāni brahmapādape .
tajjānyatanmayānīva phenā iva mahārṇave ..6.131.69..

anyo'nyapratibimbena cidarṇavataraṅgakāḥ .
ekātmakā api dvitvaṃ yānti jīvā jagatsthitau ..6.131.70..

dṛḍhabhāvanayā jīvo manastām upagacchati .
śītātiśayatas svacchaṃ payaḫ pāṣāṇatām iva ..6.131.71..

manasi grathitāḫ pāśās tṛṣṇāmohamadādayaḥ .
vāgurāyām iva khagāḫ methyām iva ca tarṇakāḥ ..6.131.72..

manasaiva mano rāma cchedanīyaṃ vijānatā .
vivekatīkṣṇenātaptam ayaseva balād ayaḥ ..6.131.73..

ananyadavikārādijanitaṃ svasvabhāvajam .
vaicitryaṃ śikhipiñchasya yathā bhāti tathātmanaḥ ..6.131.74..

nakiñcit kiñcid apy ātmā satyākāro 'py asadvapuḥ .
ākāśād apy alakṣyo 'sau jagadrūpo 'py arūpavān ..6.131.75..

sālambe 'pi nirālambo nirvikāro vikāriṇi .
sābhāse 'pi nirābhāso naśyaty arthe na naśyati ..6.131.76..

grāhyaṃ ca grāhakaṃ caiva grahaṇaṃ ca raghūdvaha .
yatra sattām upagataṃ tattvaṃ tatra sthiro bhava ..6.131.77..

manasaiva manaś chinddhi saṃsārabhramaśāntaye .
kṣālayanti malenaiva malaṃ kṣālanakovidāḥ ..6.131.78..

amanastvaṃ prayātasya na bhūyas te bhavo bhavet .
mananaṃ hi bhavaṃ viddhi svapnād yat tan na tatkṣayāt ..6.131.79..

sarvaṃ cinmātram ātmaiva nāsty anyā kalaneti vā .
buddhvā na jāyase bhūyas sati cāsati cetasi ..6.131.80..

sarvaṃ cinmātram ātmaiva nāsty anyad iti yā matiḥ .
tattvaṃ tad viddhi paramam unmanastvam ajanmane ..6.131.81..

sati citte 'py acittatvaṃ yad ātmatvaikabhāvanāt .
tad acittatvam ākāre sati vāsati mokṣadam ..6.131.82..

sarvaṃ cid iti bhāvena rāgadveṣadṛśoẖ kṣaye .
citte saty apy acittatve jāte bhūyobhavaẖ kutaḥ ..6.131.83..

sukhāśayaiti saṅkalpaṃ jīvo duẖkhaṃ tato vrajet .
jīvo hi yatate bhūtyai samprāpnoty āpadaṃ parām ..6.131.84..

mano vicāram āruhya mananānartham ujjhati .
yat karoti vimūḍhātmā tenaitan naśyati svayam ..6.131.85..

vivekaṃ prāpya cetas svān saṅkalpān nāśayaty alam .

prasāraṇāt pradṛśyante sṛṣṭayo 'ntargatāś citaḥ .
kadarkakasya vividhā yathā varṇakapaṅktayaḥ ..6.131.88..

samastaśaktikacitam ekātma brahma saṃvṛtam .

cinmātrālokitaṃ cittaṃ karotīmāṃ jagatsthitim .
nṛpekṣitaḫ pratīhāras sāmantaracanām iva ..6.131.90..

cidrūṣitasya manasaẖ karma saṃsṛtināmakam .
rasāsiktasya bījasya pattrapuṣpaphalaṃ yathā ..6.131.91..

atyullasadvividhabhaṅguravastujātaiś

tasyaiva samprati nivāraya cañcalatvaṃ
buddhveha satyam atha vā ghanatāṃ nayasva ..6.131.92..

jīvasya trīṇi rūpāṇi sthūlasūkṣmaparāṇi tu .
tatrāsya yat paraṃ rūpaṃ tad bhaja dve 'pare tyaja ..6.132.1..

asyāsatī tu dve rūpe dvicandratvam ivotthite .

jīvasya yad anāśaṃ tu rūpaṃ rāghava tad bhavān .
tatraivācalavad baddhapadam āssva ramasva ca ..6.132.3..

jīvasya yāni bhagavaṃs trīṇi rūpāṇi tāni me .
yathāvat kathayānāśaṃ rūpaṃ vedmi yathāsya tat ..6.132.4..

pāṇipādamayo yo 'yaṃ deho bhogāya valgati .
bhogārtham etaj jīvasya rūpaṃ sthūlam iha sthitam ..6.132.5..

svasaṅkalpacidākāraṃ yāvat saṃsārabhāvi yat .
cittaṃ tad viddhi jīvasya rūpaṃ rāmātivāhikam ..6.132.6..

sati cāsati dehe 'smin prāṇavātarathasthitam .
etad asya manorūpaṃ jagad bhrāmyaty avāritam ..6.132.7..

āmodaḫ pavanārūḍhaḫ puṣpaṃ tyaktvā yathāmbare .
bhavaty evaṃ śarīreṣu naṣṭeṣu prāṇagaṃ manaḥ ..6.132.8..

yathā rakṣārthasūtrasya granthayo vividhās sthitāḥ .
yathā veṇulatāyāś ca parvāṇy aṅge sthitāni vā ..6.132.9..

cittatantau sudīrghe 'smiñ śarīrāṇi tathānagha .
utpatyotpatya nāśīni saridrayataraṅgavat ..6.132.10..

ādyantarahitaṃ satyaṃ cinmātraṃ nirvikalpakam .

jagat prajāyate tasmāt tasminn eva pralīyate .
manāk sphuritvā tadrūpam ūrmijālam ivārṇave ..6.132.12..

jāgratsvapnasuṣuptānāṃ bhavanāśodbhavasthiteḥ .
etat turyapadaṃ śuddham atra baddhapado bhava ..6.132.13..

brahman yeyaṃ vinā nidrāṃ grāhyagrāhakasaṅgadṛk .

jāgradvat svapnakāle yā nidrāyāṃ sphurati bhrame .
grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittis sā svapnākhyeti vedmy aham ..6.132.15..

bhāvijāgratsvapnadaśā yā dṛṣadvad vimūḍhatā .
sā suṣuptadaśety eva jānāmy eva munīśvara ..6.132.16..

jāgratsvapnasuṣupteṣu sthitaṃ triṣv apy alakṣitam .
turyaṃ tūryād atītaṃ ca tad viprendra kim ucyate ..6.132.17..

ahambhāvānahambhāvau tyaktvā sadasatī tathā .
yad asaktaṃ samaṃ svacchaṃ sthitaṃ tat turyam ucyate ..6.132.18..

yā svasthā samatā śāntā jīvanmuktavyavasthitiḥ .
sākṣyavasthā vyavahṛtau sā turyakalanocyate ..6.132.19..

rāgadveṣaviyuktais tu viṣayān indriyaiś caran .
ātmavaśyair vidheyātmā turyatām upagacchati ..6.132.20..

samatā svacchatā cāntar ekatā nirvikalpatā .
śunyatā bhāvitā yena turyāvasthām asau gataḥ ..6.132.21..

sarva eva mahānto 'pi brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ .
narāś ca kecij jīvanto muktās turye vyavasthitāḥ ..6.132.22..

naitaj jāgran na ca svapnas saṅkalpānām asambhavāt .
suṣuptabhāvo nāpy etad abhāvāj jaḍatāntayoḥ ..6.132.23..

rajjusarpabhramanibhaṃ nātra cittaṃ vivalgati .
sattāsāmānyam ekātma sattvam atra samaṃ sthitam ..6.132.24..

ātmārāmāmalānandā saṃśāntasakalaiṣaṇā .
jīvanmuktadaśā rāma turyaśabdena kathyate ..6.132.25..

yathā svapne jagadbhānam idaṃ citkacanaṃ tv iti .
bodhād dveṣabhayonmuktaṃ śāntam apratighaṃ bhavet ..6.132.26..

atyantāsambhavād dṛśyadṛśāṃ brahmātmatodayāt .
tathā rāgādinirmuktam āsitaṃ turyam ucyate ..6.132.27..

śāntaṃ samyakprabuddhānāṃ yathāsthitam idaṃ jagat .
vilīnaṃ turyam ity āhur abuddhānāṃ sthiraṃ sthitam ..6.132.28..

jīvanmuktapadād ūrdhvaṃ vacasāṃ yan na gocare .

jīvanmuktapade turye kañcit kālaṃ yadṛcchayā .

turye baddhapado bhūtvā paramāṃ samatāṃ gataḥ .
mākartā mā ca kartā tvaṃ bhava prakṛtakarmaṇi ..6.132.31..

ahaṅkārakalātyāge śāntataivānubhūyatām .

yā karmasv iha saṃsṛtau vyavahṛtis sa svapnajāgradbhramo

jīvanmuktapadaṃ vivāsanatayā yat turyam āryeha tat
turyātītam adehamokṣa iha no vaktuṃ girā pāryate ..6.132.33..

akartṛkarmakaraṇam asi cittattvam akṣayam .
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyo bhramas saṅkalpitas tv asan ..6.133.1..

atremaṃ śṛṇu vṛttāntaṃ kathyamānaṃ mayādhunā .
prabuddho 'pi yathā bodham upaiṣi vibudhopamaḥ ..6.133.2..

kasmiṃścit kānane kāṣṭhamaunasthitam arindama .
dṛṣṭadrutamṛgaṃ kañcin muniṃ papraccha lubdhakaḥ ..6.133.3..

paścād upagato bāṇabhinnaṃ mṛgam abhidrutaḥ .
kva prayāto mṛga iti pratyuvāca sa taṃ muniḥ ..6.133.4..

śamaśīlā vayaṃ sādho munayo vanavāsinaḥ .
nāsmākam asty ahaṅkāro vyavahāreṣu yaẖ kṣamaḥ ..6.133.5..

sarvāṇīndriyakarmāṇi karoti hi sakhe manaḥ .
ahaṅkāramayaṃ tan me nūnaṃ pragalitaṃ ciram ..6.133.6..

maṇicandrārkadahanaprakāśāẖ kārukaṃ yathā .

ahaṅkāro manonāmā sa cendriyagaṇaṃ nṛṇām .
niyojayati kāryeṣu sveṣu sākṣivad āsthitaḥ ..6.133.8..

sa evābhyupaśānto naś śaradīva payodharaḥ .
kas tiṣṭhatv indriyārtheṣu mṛtaẖ ka iva valgati ..6.133.9..

cittaṃ śāntim upāyātam asmākaṃ vananāyaka .
mṛtacittā vayam iha sthitā dārumayā iva ..6.133.10..

asmākaṃ nāsty ahaṅkāro raso vā śuṣkabhūruhām .
ahaṅkāro hi sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ mūlakāraṇam ..6.133.11..

tantau muktāphalānīva prayānti samavāyitām .
ahaṅkṛtāv indriyāṇi sāmantā iva rājani ..6.133.12..

ahaṅkāramahātantau chinne tv indriyabālakāḥ .
itaś cetaś ca gacchanti sāmantā vinṛpā iva ..6.133.13..

nirahaṅkṛticittāni viśarārūṇi lubdhaka .
mamendriyāṇi kāryeṣu na laganty apsv ivāmbujam ..6.133.14..

mithas saṃśleṣam āyānti na mamendriyabālakāḥ .
vināhaṅkārajatunā śītalāyaẖkaṇā iva ..6.133.15..

na me buddhīndriyaṃ kañcid vetti karmendriyakramam .

sādho yad indriyaṃ vakti tena dṛṣṭo na te mṛgaḥ .
yasya vā darśane śaktir vaktuṃ jānāti tan na naḥ ..6.133.17..

na kānicin mamaitāni galitāhaṅkṛteẖ kila .

sarveṣām indriyāṇāṃ hi paśūnām iva pālakam .
cittaṃ tac ca vilīnaṃ nas sarvārtharahite pade ..6.133.19..

itaś cetaś ca vikṣiptarūpāṇy etāni tat katham .

nirmātṛpitṛko yadvad viśarāruś śiśuvrajaḥ .

jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyā daśā vedmi na kāścana .
turya evāvatiṣṭhe 'haṃ tatra dṛśyaṃ na vidyate ..6.133.22..

satyaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmabhāvaṃ gate jīve nirarthakam .

yatreṣṭāniṣṭasambandhe nodayas sukhaduẖkhayoḥ .

svapnakāle svapna eva jāgrad vyagrāparigrahāt .

asatyaṃ jāgrati svapnas svapne jāgrad asanmayam .

jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyaṃ trayam aṅga bhramodbhavam .

proktaṃ videhamuktatvaṃ turyānta iti paṇḍitaiḥ .

jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyaṃ trayaṃ rūpaṃ hi cetasaḥ .

yatra cittaṃ mṛtaṃ tatra sattvam ekaṃ sthitaṃ samam .

tatraite munayas siddhā brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ .

cittācāraṃ na jānāti mṛtacittas sa kañcana .

samastasaṅkalpavilāsamukte
turye pade tiṣṭha nirāmayātmā .
yatra sthitās sādhu sadehamuktāḫ
praśāntabhedā munayo mahāntaḥ ..6.133.39..

eṣa evāṅga siddhānto yat kālagaganādy api .
cinmātrāṃśād ṛte nānyaj jagadādy asti kiñcana ..6.134.1..

janayaty accham ābhāsaṃ bhaṅguraṃ sphuraṇāt svataḥ .
jagadrūpaṃ niśāvidyud iva cit kālakhādi ca ..6.134.2..

yatra sphurati cidvidyut taj jagat kālakhādi ca .
sthitaiva yan na sphurati tac chāntaṃ sarvam akramam ..6.134.3..

yāvad ālokyate 'mbhodas tāvat satyaiva khe taḍit .
kāraṇaṃ nātra pṛcchāmi citspande kāraṇaṃ vada ..6.134.4..

vaitaṇḍikājñadurbuddhivilāsaṃ dūratas tyajan .
śṛṇv etad īdṛśasyaiva vaktavyaṃ nāpalāpinaḥ ..6.134.5..

tiṣṭhaty eva ghane vidyut sā ca sphurati bhaṅgurā .
ābālam etat saṃsiddhaṃ kena nāmāpalapyate ..6.134.6..

nityaṃ sattvam asattvaṃ vā vibho hetvanapekṣaṇāt .
citspandasya kathaṃ na syāt spando hīha sahetukaḥ ..6.134.7..

avātāmbudhidīpāde ratnānāṃ kacanasya vā .
vāyor vā śūnyasaṃsthasya spande kasyeha hetutā ..6.134.8..

rāmāsarvātmano 'py evaṃ tattātattopapadyate .
svatas sarvātmano nityam ataẖ kiṃ nopapadyate ..6.134.9..

cid aspandā spandinīti śabde bhedo na vastuni .
brahmaikaghanam advaitaṃ viddhi vāri yathā dravam ..6.134.10..

yathā muktāvalīhaṃsadarśanaṃ khe svabhāvajam .
dṛṣṭer evaṃ cidacchāyās saṃvitspandāj jagadbhramaḥ ..6.134.11..

yathā nimīlite netre svaprabhāveṇa dṛk calam .
tārākāraṃ paśyatīyaṃ cic cetyaṃ dṛśyavat tathā ..6.134.12..

saṅkalpakalanās tyaktvā sarvā evātmatāṃ gataḥ .
paśya cidghana evācchaẖ kalpāntaikābdhivat sthitaḥ ..6.134.13..

asmadādir janas sādho pāradṛśvā jagatsthiteḥ .
tenaivāsmadvaco grāhyam om ity evāstasaṃśayam ..6.134.14..

codyacañcutayā kiñcid vadāmīti tyajan dhiyam .
yadi tiṣṭhasi madvāci tadā yāsy eva tat padam ..6.134.15..

no cet tad vividhānekavikalpakalanāmalaiḥ .
śuddhatārkikatām etya prayāsi tṛṇagulmatām ..6.134.16..

evaṃ cet tad iyaṃ brahmaṃs tvattāmattāmayātmikā .
tattvatas trijagannāmnī manye na kalanāsty alam ..6.134.17..

lavaṇaindavaśukrādivṛttāntavad upasthitam .
bhrāntimātraṃ jagan manye satyaṃ nāstīha kiñcana ..6.134.18..

evaṃ sthite muniśreṣṭha sarvāpahnava eva vai .
kṛto bhavati tad brūhi yujyate katham īdṛśam ..6.134.19..

rāma samyakprabuddho 'si jānāsy eva yathāsthitam .
śuddhacidghana evāsti taṃ ca tvam avabuddhavān ..6.134.20..

siddhānto 'dhyātmaśāstrāṇāṃ sarvāpahnava eva ca .
nāvidyāstīha no māyā śāntaṃ brahmedam akramam ..6.134.21..

śānta eva cidābhāse svacche samasamātmani .
samagraśaktikacite brahmeti kalitābhidhe ..6.134.22..

nirṇīya kecic chūnyatvaṃ kecid vijñānamātratām .
kecid īśvararūpatvaṃ vivadante parasparam ..6.134.23..

saṅkalpya jagad ucchūnaṃ nītvā ca śataśākhatām .
cālayanti vicāreṇa kecit sāṅkhyamatādikam ..6.134.24..

kecit sarvam idaṃ śāntaṃ brahmeti ghananiścayāḥ .
śuddhacidvyomatām etya santo 'santa iva sthitāḥ ..6.134.25..

na brahma na jagan nānyad iti niścitya kecana .
ākāśaviśadās svacchās saṃsthitās saugatādayaḥ ..6.134.26..

kecid apy anyathā kṛtvā nānāsaṅkalpakalpanam .
sthitāś śāmyanti jāyante saṃsaranti ca vā na vā ..6.134.27..

samastakalanāhīnam iti nirṇīya cidghanam .
samagraśaktikacitaṃ vivadante hi vādinaḥ ..6.134.28..

ekatra vastuni samastakalāvimukte
saṅkalpya saṅkalanayā vividhābhidhās svāḥ .
svaṃ vāsanāvilasitaṃ samudāharanto
vidyāvivādavibhavair vivadanti vaidyāḥ ..6.134.29..

śarīrendriyabuddhyādicetasāṃ spandanasya ca .
kiṃ kasmāt sāram uditaṃ vyāpakaṃ śreyase bhavet ..6.135.1..

yad idaṃ dṛśyate kiñcij jagat tvamahamādimat .
cittamātraṃ hi tat sarvaṃ jalamātraṃ yathārṇavaḥ ..6.135.2..

dehendriyādibhāvena cittaṃ jagad iti sthitam .
ṣaḍbhir vā pañcabhir dvāraiś cetyaṃ patati dehinām ..6.135.3..

yataẖ kutaścit sampannaṃ cittaṃ dvīnduvilāsavat .
yathā nāneva sampannaṃ tad uktaṃ bahuśas tava ..6.135.4..

jīvādisañjñāvalitaṃ dhṛtasaṃsṛtivibhramam .
yathā tat kṣīyate cittaṃ śreyase tad idaṃ śṛṇu ..6.135.5..

ceto bhāvavikārāḍhyaṃ paśyatīdaṃ śarīrakam .
avidyamānaṃ procchūnaṃ mṛgatṛṣṇāmbv ivaiṇakaḥ ..6.135.6..

tathā paśyati vai cetaś śarīraṃ spandacañcalam .
abhinnam eva svātmatvād dadhirūpaṃ yathā payaḥ ..6.135.7..

utpattisthitināśāntaṃ yathānubhavati svayam .
payo dadhitvam evaṃ hi cetaḫ paśyati dehakam ..6.135.8..

tathā hi bhārgavodanto lavaṇaindavavibhramaḥ .
śrutas tvayā mahābāho cittarūpanirūpaṇe ..6.135.9..

pratibhāṃ jaḍam apy eti cittaṃ sarvagaciccyutam .
anicchāyomaṇiprāptam ayaḫ praspandanaṃ yathā ..6.135.10..

nityoditāmalānantacidādityāṃśurañjanāt .
cittapadmo vikasati puryaṣṭakadalāvaliḥ ..6.135.11..

yathā muktāvalī dṛṣṭā śūnye khe sadasanmayī .
sphuraty evaṃ hi cittattve cetas sphurati cañcalam ..6.135.12..

yathā citrodayaś śūnye bhrāntimātram upaplavaḥ .
tathā cetasi deho 'yaṃ gandharvapuravat sthitaḥ ..6.135.13..

yathā cetasi deho 'yaṃ mithyā dvīnduvilāsavat .
indriyāṇi tathā dehe maivammātraparo bhava ..6.135.14..

yathendriyāṇi dehasya bālakalpitayakṣavat .
spandas tathaivendriyāṇāṃ jaḍo maitatparo bhava ..6.135.15..

yathendriyāṇāṃ vātānām iva spando jaḍātmakaḥ .
spandaboddhṛ tathaivāsat sphuraty etac calaṃ manaḥ ..6.135.16..

yathā spandasya tu mano bhramākṛti calaṃ jaḍam .
manaso 'sya tathā buddhir mṛgatṛṣṇā vijṛmbhate ..6.135.17..

yathaiva buddhis svāntasya tathā buddher ahaṅkṛtiḥ .
asadrūpā mudhodbhūtā maivammātraparo bhava ..6.135.18..

yathā buddher ahaṅkāro vallyāḫ puṣpam iva sthitaḥ .
tathaivāhaṅkṛter jīvo maivammātraparo bhava ..6.135.19..

yathaivāhaṅkṛter jīvaś śūnyehāvāsanātmakaḥ .
tathā jīvasya kalayā yuktā cit sacamatkṛtiḥ ..6.135.20..

tad apy anagha saṅkalpavaśān no vastunāpi sat .
maitad bhāvaya kiñcit tvaṃ naitat tenāsya vā bhavān ..6.135.21..

ete parasparaṃ sarve bhramāt kāraṇatāṃ gatāḥ .
taraṅgavad vivartante manobuddhīndriyādayaḥ ..6.135.22..

yathā śūnye mahāraṇye svasaṅkalpabhramākulāḥ .
bhramanty unmattakā evaṃ manobuddhīndriyādayaḥ ..6.135.23..

śarīraṃ saṃsṛtau sāras sāro 'kṣaughaś śarīrake .
sāras tv akṣagaṇe spandas spande sāras smṛtaṃ manaḥ ..6.135.24..

sāro manasi vai buddhis sāro buddhāv ahaṅkṛtiḥ .
sāras tv ahaṅkṛtau jīvo jīve sāraś cid ābilā ..6.135.25..

citi sāras tv acetyatvaṃ cetyasyāsambhavāc chive .
tasmāt sāratarāt sāraẖ kiñcid anyan na vidyate ..6.135.26..

nirvikalpacidābhāsa eva sarvatra kāraṇam .
kāraṇaṃ tasya nāsty anyat tat svato nityabhāsuram ..6.135.27..

tāvanmātraparo nityaṃ bhava pūrvaṃ parityajan .
sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ vāpi jagac cinmātram eva hi ..6.135.28..

valitaṃ sarvasaṅkalpair yadi vā yadi vojjhitam .
jagat tad akhilaṃ rāma viddhy etac chuddhacinmayam ..6.135.29..

ity asmāt paramāt sārād ajasraṃ saṃvid aṅga te .
rātrindivaṃ na calati yadi tat tvam ajaś śivaḥ ..6.135.30..

atra sthitasya tava kecana durvilāsā
rātrāv aher iva na rāma padaṃ labhante .
maināṃ parityaja mahāmṛtakandarāṃ tvam
atraiva tiṣṭha dṛḍhalekhyam ivāśmanīti ..6.135.31..

niricchenācchaśāntena cidādityena cetyate .
sargādiṣu svataś cetyaṃ dṛṣṭyā muktāvalīva khe ..6.136.1..

anantaraṃ tad evedaṃ śataśākhaṃ vijṛmbhate .
bhrame kāraṇatām etya jagajjālatayeddhayā ..6.136.2..

yathā svabhāvād itarat kāraṇaṃ nopapadyate .
śūnyadṛṅmauktikāloke tathā cic cetyavedane ..6.136.3..

ciccetyayor na bhedo 'sti yac cic cetyaṃ tad eva hi .
yaiva dṛk saiva muktālī bījam evāṅkuras smṛtaḥ ..6.136.4..

bījam eva phalaṃ viddhi tyaktāśeṣaviśeṣaṇam .
viśeṣakalpanād asya na saṅkalpasya satyatā ..6.136.5..

satyatā yadi saṅkalpe tasmāt tajjā tad eva vā .
sa ca saṅkalpa etasmād ādyād evoditaś śivāt ..6.136.6..

tasmād yad eva paramaṃ padaṃ cinmātram avyayam .
tad eva savikalpā cic cetyam ādyaṃ tad eva ca ..6.136.7..

tad eva jīvakalanaṃ tad evāhaṅkṛtis sphurat .
tad eva buddhis tac cittaṃ tat spandaś cendriyāṇi tat ..6.136.8..

tad dehas taj jagat kṛtsnaṃ tad diśas tac ca rodasī .
tad adryurvīnadīśādi tṛṇāntaṃ vābjajādi ca ..6.136.9..

jaḍo deho jaḍo 'kṣaugho jaḍaṃ cittaṃ jaḍā matiḥ .
jaḍaivāhaṅkalā ceti tathā praspandanaṃ jaḍam ..6.136.10..

eteṣāṃ yo 'nubhavitā so 'si sarvagato 'si ca .
tac ca niṣkalacinmātraṃ māsmāt svasmāt padāc cala ..6.136.11..

evam ādyantarahitam ekam evedam ātatam .
ittham ābhāsate bhāsā svayā nānyāsti kalpanā ..6.136.12..

sarvaṃ śāntaṃ svabhāsedaṃ bhāsate jñaptimātrakam .
tvattāmattājagajjanmamaraṇādi na vidyate ..6.136.13..

bhrāntiṃ parityaja samo bhava nirvikāro
nityodito niravalambanam astabhāvaḥ .
śāntaṃ samastam avikāram anādimadhyam
ity eva satyam apareṇa tavālam astu ..6.136.14..

evaṃ vāsiṣṭham ākarṇya vaco vikasitāśayaḥ .
ucchvasann iva cittena rāmo vacanam abravīt ..6.137.1..

aho nu bhāro bharavāṃś cetasā projjhitaś cirāt .
ayaṃ so 'ham idaṃ me 'dya cetyādis tvag ivāhinā ..6.137.2..

svacchatām upayāte 'yam antaẖkaraṇasaṃsthitiḥ .
śobhate śaradīva dyauś śāntavāridaviplavā ..6.137.3..

ayaṃ so 'ham idaṃ me 'dya iti bhāraṃ mahābharam .
api meror gurutaraṃ dhārayan ko na sīdati ..6.137.4..

śāmyāmi parinirvāmi jāgarmy āśvāsavān aham .
adhvagasyeva me skandhād gṛhītā mahatī śilā ..6.137.5..

etāvantam ahaṃ kālam aho nu khalu vañcitaḥ .
yad imāṃ padavīṃ śāntāṃ śītalācchāṃ na labdhavān ..6.137.6..

tad imaṃ saṃśayaṃ śeṣam ekaṃ me chettum arhasi .
bhagavan sarvadharmajña prodvijante hi nottamāḥ ..6.137.7..

paramātmamayaṃ sarvaṃ yadi nāma sadaiva hi .
idaṃ kāryam idaṃ neti tat kimarthaṃ kṛtaẖ kramaḥ ..6.137.8..

yathotpannā na votpannā jīvāḫ paramakāraṇāt .
dvaitavanto 'tha vādvaitās tat tāvaj jñātavān bhavān ..6.137.9..

tatra tāvat svasaṅkalpād yeṣāṃ dvaitam alaṃ sthitam .
tais tāvat saṃsṛtau kiñcit saṃsartavyam asaṃśayam ..6.137.10..

tatra kecid bālya eva svacamatkārayogataḥ .
vidanti paramātmānaṃ tiṣṭhanti vigatajvaram ..6.137.11..

anīśvarās seśvarāś ca ye jīvā dehatāṃ gatāḥ .
gṛhītadvaitavistārāẖ kālenāyānti te padam ..6.137.12..

bhavaty evātiviśrāntir nāsti kasyāsti kasya ca .
sucirāt kevalaṃ kaścid acirād vetti kaścana ..6.137.13..

kecid viditavedyatvaṃ yānti rāghava yauvane .
jarāvantaḫ paraṃ vastu vidantīhāpare janāḥ ..6.137.14..

evaṃ tajjñās tathājñāś ca tiṣṭhanty eva yathāsthitam .
asyāṃ vyavahṛtau jīvanmuktā baddhāś ca mānavāḥ ..6.137.15..

idaṃ kāryam idaṃ neti teṣāṃ yadi jagatsthitiḥ .
nonnīyate tat kṣayakṛn mātsyo nyāyaḫ pravartate ..6.137.16..

yāvat kiñcit prasphurati sargas tāvat kadarthanām .
mā yātu mātsyanyāyena kileti vihitā sthitiḥ ..6.137.17..

niṣpuṇyapāpaṃ niścittaṃ nirmamo 'mananakriyam .
kālātivāhanāyaiva jīvanmukto 'vatiṣṭhate ..6.137.18..

māyāgrastamatis tv ātmavāsanāvaśataḫ phalam .
prāpnotīhāmutra caiva tadarthaṃ yatate ca saḥ ..6.137.19..

etāvat tāvad ābālapaṇḍitāmaramānavam .
avisaṃvādi yad yādṛk cittaṃ tanmayatātmanaḥ ..6.137.20..

svasaṅkalpaikabījāya narakasvargaśākhine .
phalāyājñasya kartṛtvam akartṛtvaṃ ca rāghava ..6.137.21..

yat tu tajjñasya kartṛtvam akartṛtvaṃ ca vā kvacit .
tat prameyadaśām eti na kadācana kasyacit ..6.137.22..

kartā bhavatv akartā vā mukta evāṅga tattvavit .
bhūyo majjati nājñāne payaḫphena ivāmbhasi ..6.137.23..

kartā bhavatv akartā vā baddha evāyathārthavit .
araṇyakūpāc chvevāsmān mohān nottarati kvacit ..6.137.24..

nirdeho nirmanā maunī śāntas svastho nireṣaṇaḥ .
kurvann eva ca karmāṇi tiṣṭhottiṣṭhasva tatpade ..6.137.25..

jīvo brahmārṇave vīcir jīvāmbhodhāv ahaṅkṛtiḥ .
ahaṅkārāmbudhau buddhir buddhyabdhau cittam ābilam ..6.137.26..

cittābdhau vāsanā vīcir vāsanābdhau tu saṃsṛtiḥ .
saṃsārābdhau śarīraṃ ca śarīrābdhau ca jīvitam ..6.137.27..

jīvitābdhau ca yuvatā cañcale yauvanārṇave .
vīcir indriyasaṅghātas spandas tv indriyavāridhau ..6.137.28..

spandāmbhodhāv anubhavas svānubhūtyāmbudhau tataḥ .
taraṅgaś citsamullāsa itīdaṃ sargavedanam ..6.137.29..

śabdasaṃsparśarūpādi yenedam avabudhyate .
tac cinmātraṃ jagat sarvaṃ tatsāratvād raghūdvaha ..6.137.30..

akṣubdho 'vyapadeśyo 'sāv asargakaraṇonmukhaḥ .
unnīyate cidambhodhis sadbhir brahmeti kevalam ..6.137.31..

akṣubdham api tat kṣubdham iva cet kṛtavedanam .
tac cidaṃśam upāruhya brahma sarga iti sthitam ..6.137.32..

akṣubdho 'sāv avācyo hi samaś citimahārṇavaḥ .
vaktuṃ na kenacin nāmnā kalayā vāpi śakyate ..6.137.33..

na ca tasya mahābāho kṣobhas sambhavati kvacit .
pṛthak tanmātrarūpatvāt sarvasya jagato gateḥ ..6.137.34..

svarūpe tasya devasya kevalaṃ yā vilāsitā .
saiṣoktā kṣobhaśabdena cicchabdena ca vānagha ..6.137.35..

paramārthamahāmbhodhau cic cetyalavarūpiṇī .
ūrmivat sphurati spandāt tenedaṃ jāyate jagat ..6.137.36..

akṣubdho 'sāv anirdeśyas samaś cinmātrasāgaraḥ .
kṣubdhaś cetyataraṅgas tu cid ity ākalito budhaiḥ ..6.137.37..

cidabdhau laharī cetyaṃ sā ca tasmān na bhidyate .
tāvanmātraikasāratvād vāri vīcir ivāmbhasaḥ ..6.137.38..

tasmād bhūtāni jātāni tāvanmātrāṇi tāni ca .
tad evātad ivābhāti sakalaṃ cākalaṃ ca tat ..6.137.39..

ekam eva nakiñcid yat kiñcid vā tad idaṃ jagat .
nānānānātayā ceto mā mithyākulatāṃ naya ..6.137.40..

ekasya vāmbhaso vīcirūpeṇa sphurato yathā .

bījam eva yathā stambhaḫ pattraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ rasaḥ .

phalāntā bījasattaiva sphuraty anyatayeva sā .

bījaṃ sattaikasāmānyenāphalāntaṃ yathā sthitam .
brahma sattaikasāmānyenāsargāntaṃ tathā sthitam ..6.137.44..

brahmaikasattāsāmānyamātram evedam ātatam .
satyam ekaṃ jagad iti vyāhṛtaṃ taruvṛkṣavat ..6.137.45..

ya evācchaś citas spandas sa evetthaṃ jagadbhramaḥ .

aho mahattā svacchāyāś cito yasyā jaganty api .

yasyonmeṣanimeṣābhyāṃ bhāvānāṃ pralayodayau .

cid vātavad abhinnātmā spandād ātmagatād yathā .
tathaiva jagad etasmāt tasmāt tatsthaṃ tad eva ca ..6.137.49..

ataś śuddham anābhāsaṃ sarvaṃ cidghanam akṣaye .
dṛśyamāne 'pi naiva stas tvattāmatte bhavābhayaḥ ..6.137.50..

naikyaṃ na ca dvaitam ihāsti kiñcin
na tvattvamattvādi sad apy asad vā .
sarvaṃ ca sarvatra sadaiva cāsti
yad buddhavān evam apīha tat tat ..6.137.51..

maduktam etad ākarṇya nirṇīya śubham ity alam .
hṛdaye cākhilaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhetthaṃ śṛṇu rāghava ..6.138.1..

sarvam eva parityajya kāṣṭhamaunī bhavānagha .
nirvāsano nirmananaẖ kṣīṇacittaḫ praśāntadhīḥ ..6.138.2..

apaśyann apy agragatān aśṛṇvan paṭahān api .

prabhuñjāno 'py abhuñjāno vyomavad vimalāntaraḥ .

ātmany evāssva śāntātmā mūkāndhabadhiropamaḥ .

iti buddhīndriyair eva sthitvā merur iva sthiraḥ .
apunarbhavanāyaiṣi samādhānamahāśayaḥ ..6.138.6..

kuru karmendriyaiẖ kāryaṃ yantravat spandacañcalaiḥ .
ardhasuptaprabuddhābhais svakarmābhyāsacañcalaiḥ ..6.138.7..

aphalecchānusandhānair bālair unmattakair iva .

nityam antarmukho bhūtvā svātmārāmaḫ prapūrṇadhīḥ .
jāgraty eva suṣuptasthaẖ kuru karmāṇy anidravat ..6.138.9..

yathā maunī yantrapumān karoty evaṃ kuru kriyām .

antas sarvaparityāgī bahiẖ kurvann api sthiram .
na kartāsi na bhoktāsi na cāyam asi netaraḥ ..6.138.11..

yasya nāhaṅkṛto bhāvaś ceto yasya na lipyate .

yasya sarve samārambhāẖ kāmasaṅkalpavarjitāḥ .
jñānāgnidagdhakarmāṇaṃ muktam āhus tam uttamāḥ ..6.138.13..

evaṃ samādhānamayo mahātman
bhūyo na cintām upayāti kaścit .
mahāsamādhānam anantam etad
āśritya tiṣṭhāmṛtatām upaiṣi ..6.138.14..

yatraikadvitvakalanās sambhavanti hi kāścana .
tatraikāntasamādhāne bhaṅgo bhavati rāghava ..6.139.1..

ekam eva tu yatrāsti sattāsāmānyamātrakam .
tatra kiṃ kasya kenaiva samādhānaṃ vinaśyati ..6.139.2..

cinomi na cinomīti tyaktvā śabdārthavibhramam .
cidrūpa evācidrūpo maunavāṃs tiṣṭha kāṣṭhavat ..6.139.3..

sthitir vāyor avahataḫ payaso 'dreś ca khasya vā .
avāsanāntas sā te 'stu kurvato 'kurvataś citaḥ ..6.139.4..

ahambhāvo vilīno yas tāpasthahimaleśavat .
cetyasyācayanād antas sampannaḫ paramaṃ padam ..6.139.5..

aṇīyasām aṇīyāṃsaṃ sthaviṣṭhaṃ ca sthavīyasām .
śāntaṃ cittvam asaṃvedyam ananyad idam ātatam ..6.139.6..

ayaṃ pratyekam uditaḫ pṛthak saṃsṛtiṣaṇḍakaḥ .
sasurāsurapātālalokāntaradharāmbaraḥ ..6.139.7..

jñas sarvetarasaṅkalpasargān paśyaty akhaṇḍitān .
āsvāditekṣus sarvekṣurasān sānubhavān iva ..6.139.8..

saṅkalpasargapuruṣās satyās sarve parasparam .
cidvyomno 'cchinnarūpatvāt tattānubhavatas svataḥ ..6.139.9..

spandavicchittayas sarvā dravabhāvād yathāmbhasaḥ .
saṃvidvicchittayas sarvāś citirūpāt tathātmanaḥ ..6.139.10..

aikyam aikyātmatāpūrvaṃ ratnayugmatviṣo yathā .
yānti vittvena saṅkalpasargā bhinnās tathaikatām ..6.139.11..

yad yad ālokyate toye tat tat sarvaṃ yathā dravaḥ .
yad yad āmṛśyate śānte tat tat sarvaṃ citis tathā ..6.139.12..

cidīhanaṃ vidus cittaṃ nirvāṇaṃ cidanīhanam .
na cidālihanīyo 'taḫ padārtho 'viditātmanaḥ ..6.139.13..

cittasattā paraṃ duẖkhaṃ cittāsattā paraṃ sukham .
ataś cittaṃ vidīhātma neyaṃ śamam avedanāt ..6.139.14..

dṛṣṭvā ramyam aramyaṃ vā stheyaṃ pāṣāṇavat samam .
etāvatātmayatnena jitā bhavati saṃsṛtiḥ ..6.139.15..

svenaiva puruṣārthena padārthāmajjanātmanā .
tīryate goṣpadam iva na tu daivād bhavārṇavaḥ ..6.139.16..

vastuprāptau cidīhāyām udite cittarākṣase .
saṅkhyātuṃ kena śakyante śūnyās saṃsṛtivibhramāḥ ..6.139.17..

ataś citam adhāvantīṃ dhārayann avidann iva .
kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamas tiṣṭha kāryaṃ kurvan yathāgatam ..6.139.18..

saṃvedanīyaṃ na sukhaṃ nāsukhaṃ naiva madhyamam .
etāvatā tu yatnena duẖkhānto 'nanta āpyate ..6.139.19..

vastvasanmṛgatṛṣṇāmbu jīvo vastutayā lihan .
cittayakṣodaye bhīmām imāṃ prāpnoti saṃsṛtim ..6.139.20..

sabāhyābhyantaraṃ paśyaṃś citā caittaṃ dṛṣaddṛḍhaḥ .
bhūmikākramayogena mukto bhava bhavārṇavāt ..6.139.21..

āpīnamaṇḍalaśaśāṅkavad antar eva
śrīmadrasāyanamayas sukham eti tajjñaḥ .
vijñātasarvabhuvanatrayavastusāraẖ
kurvan na nāma kurute param abhyupetaḥ ..6.139.22..

saptānāṃ yogabhūmīnām abhyāsaẖ kriyate katham .
kīdṛśāni ca cihnāni bhūmikāṃ prati yoginaḥ ..6.140.1..

yataẖ kutaścit sampannam avidyāvyādhivedanam .
satyaṃ bhavatv asatyaṃ vā cikitsāṃ tv asya me śṛṇu ..6.140.2..

parād anantād yady eṣā tat tad eveyam akṣatam .
na jāteyaṃ na cāvidyā bodhamātrād bhaved ataḥ ..6.140.3..

pakṣam etam anādṛtya svasaṅkalpavilāsinaḥ .
satyām apīhāvidyāyāṃ śṛṇu nirnāśane kramam ..6.140.4..

jantuḫ prathamajātas tu suṣuptāvasthacetanaḥ .
bhāvibhāvanaduẖkhātmā krimisaṃvid bhavaty adhīḥ ..6.140.5..

bhavec cen navajātasya na bhāvī bhāvanodayaḥ .
sukhādisaṃvidā sadyas tat sa eva paraṃ padam ..6.140.6..

etāvataiva sauṣuptī sthitir bhinnā parāt padāt .
yad bhāvivāsanaughāsau jaḍā copaladharmiṇī ..6.140.7..

turyāvasthāsamā svasthā sadrūpā śāntavāsanā .
jīvanmuktes sthitir ato na suṣuptopamā bhavet ..6.140.8..

agrasthavastusambodhasantatābhyāsayogataḥ .
bālas suṣuptāvasthāyāẖ kramān niryāti rāghava ..6.140.9..

kiñcijjātadhiyo jantor deśabhāṣārthavedinaḥ .
gṛhṇāmīdaṃ tyajāmīdam iti sañjāyate sthitiḥ ..6.140.10..

etāvanmātrabuddhir yas svavṛddhajanagocaraḥ .
bhavet svakarmaśāstrāṇāṃ viṣayo 'sāv alaṃ vidheḥ ..6.140.11..

kulavṛddhaprayuktena svaniścayavataiva vā .
bhāvyaṃ padapadārthānāṃ tena tajjñena vai tataḥ ..6.140.12..

jantuḫ padapadārthajño heyaṃ tyajati tajjñadhīḥ .
upādeyam upādatte nālokayati madhyamam ..6.140.13..

vivekād vṛddhabhītyā vā śāstrārthavyavahāriṇaḥ .
vicārapūrvaṃ yasyehā sa pumān iti kathyate ..6.140.14..

pravṛttaś ca nivṛttaś ca bhavati dvividhaḫ pumān .
svargāpavargonmukhayoś śṛṇu lakṣaṇam etayoḥ ..6.140.15..

kim etan nāma nirvāṇaṃ varaṃ saṃsṛtir eva naḥ .
iti kartavyakartā yas sa pravṛtta iti smṛtaḥ ..6.140.16..

calārṇavayugacchidrakūrmagrīvārpaṇopamā .
anekajanmāntarato bhāvinī tasya mokṣadhīḥ ..6.140.17..

asārā bata saṃsāravyavasthālaṃ mamaitayā .
kiṃ karmabhiḫ paryuṣitair dinaṃ tair eva nīyate ..6.140.18..

kṣayātiśayanirmuktaṃ kiṃ syād viśramaṇaṃ param .
iti niścayavān yo 'ntas sa nivṛtta iti smṛtaḥ ..6.140.19..

sa vartamāna eveha janmani tv avivekini .
sa yogabhūmiṣv etāsu viṣayo viśadāśayaḥ ..6.140.20..

kathaṃ virāgavān bhūtvā saṃsārābdhiṃ tarāmy aham .
evaṃvicāraṇaparo yadā bhavati sanmatiḥ ..6.140.21..

sādhusaṅgamam ādatte sacchāstram api vīkṣate .
virāgam upayāty antar bhāvanāsv anuvāsaram ..6.140.22..

kriyāsūdārarūpāsu ramate mānam īhate .
grāmyāsu jaḍaceṣṭāsu calāsu vicikitsate ..6.140.23..

nodāharati marmāṇi puṇyaśarmāṇi ceṣṭate .
ananyodvegakārīṇi mṛdukarmāṇi sevate ..6.140.24..

snehapraṇayagarbhāṇi peśalāny ucitāni ca .
deśakālopapannāni vacanāny abhibhāṣate ..6.140.25..

tadāsau prathamām ekāṃ prāpto bhavati bhūmikām .
vakṣyamāṇasvabhāvo 'tha tatra rūḍhim upeṣyati ..6.140.26..

devāyatanadeśeṣu brāhmaṇāvasatheṣu ca .
vaneṣu ramate nityaṃ prathamāṃ bhūmikām itaḥ ..6.140.27..

śāstrasajjanasamparkaiḫ prajñāṃ vardhayati svayam .
śuklapakṣaẖ kalām indor iva saundaryaśālinīm ..6.140.28..

sarvāstivādanirataḫ peśalaḫ praṇayānvitaḥ .
manasā karmaṇā vācā sajjanān upasevate ..6.140.29..

kadarthalabdhāṃl labhyāṃś ca tajjñān anusaraṃś ciram .
yataẖ kutaścid ānīya nityaṃ śāstrāṇy avekṣate ..6.140.30..

vyālāpadhvaṃsanaśikhī dharmābdeśoccakandharaḥ .
snānadānatapodhyānavibhavān abhivāñchati ..6.140.31..

prathamām ity upāruhya dvitīyām āśrayed balāt .
puruṣārthād ṛte nānyā saṅkaṭottaraṇe gatiḥ ..6.140.32..

evaṃ vicāravān yas syāt saṃsārottaraṇaṃ prati .
sa bhūmikāvān ity uktaś śeṣas tv ārya iti smṛtaḥ ..6.140.33..

āryatātulyatāṃ yātā prathamaikaiva bhūmikā .
bhūmikānāṃ tu śeṣāṇām āryatā dāsyam arhati ..6.140.34..

vicāranāmnīm itarām āgato yogabhūmikām .
udāramatir ādatte svabhāvaṃ mahatām iti ..6.140.35..

śrutismṛtisamācāradhāraṇādhyānakarmaṇām .
mukhyayā vyākhyayā khyātaṃ śrayati śreṣṭhapaṇḍitam ..6.140.36..

icchākutukabandheṣu jayatīndriyaśatruṣu .
ā dehaṃ praharatsv antar vīreṣv iva sudāruṇaḥ ..6.140.37..

kim apūrvāṃ jhagity enāṃ saṃśrayāmy anurāgiṇīm .
iti hrīmān iva hriyaṃ dayāṃ caiṣa na muñcati ..6.140.38..

padārthapravibhāgajñaẖ kāryākāryaviniścayam .
jānāty adhigataśravyo gṛhaṃ gṛhapatir yathā ..6.140.39..

madābhimānamātsaryalobhamohātiśāyitām .
bahir apy āsthitām īṣat tyajaty ahir iva tvacam ..6.140.40..

candanāgurugandhīni vanitāliṅganāny api .
aprārthitopayātāni sevate svāny anādaram ..6.140.41..

mātṛvat paradārāṇi paradravyāṇi loṣṭavat .
svātmavat sarvabhūtāni kāruṇyenābhipaśyati ..6.140.42..

yat karoti yad aśnāti spandate yad yad īhate .
tad ādau buddhibhedena ciraṃ cāru parīkṣate ..6.140.43..

avicārātmakaṃ naiti na gacchati na vakti ca .
na dadāti na cādatte na cinoti na copati ..6.140.44..

vyavahārānuvṛttyartham aviruddhaṃ kṣaṇakṣayi .
harṣāmarṣāṃśam ādatte gantevālātakaṃ niśi ..6.140.45..

durdeśaṃ duradhiṣṭhānaṃ dussaṅgaṃ durupāśrayam .
ālokyam api dehādi liptaṃ tṛṇam ivojjhati ..6.140.46..

yad udarkahitaṃ lokyaṃ yad anādhi gatabhramam .
tad eva hariṇo vātam iva maunī vidhāvati ..6.140.47..

hārihāsavilāsāsu hāvabhāvavatīṣu ca .
vīkṣate bhāvināśāsu strīṣu śuṣkalatāsv iva ..6.140.48..

itthambhūtamatiś śāstraṃ gurusajjanasevanāt .
sarahasyam aśeṣeṇa yathāvad adhigacchati ..6.140.49..

asaṃsaṅgātmikām anyāṃ tṛtīyāṃ yogabhūmikām .
tataḫ pataty asau kāntaḫ puṣpaśayyām ivāmalām ..6.140.50..

durvyākhyām adhikavyākhyām ūnavyākhyāṃ vihāya dhīḥ .
yathāvac chāstravākyārtham ādatte 'syātra pāvanī ..6.140.51..

phalaty atrāsya śāstrārthaẖ kurvann antar asaṅgatām .
śikṣitas sūpakārasya samyak sūpo raseṣv iva ..6.140.52..

tāpasāśramaviśrāmaiḫ pāvanādhyātmasaṅkathaiḥ .
śilāśayyāsanāsīno jarayaty āyur ātatam ..6.140.53..

vanāvanivihāreṇa cittopaśamaśobhinā .
asaṅgasukhasomyena kālaṃ nayati nītimān ..6.140.54..

devadvijaguruprājñapaṇḍitārcanabhojanaiḥ .
aparāhṇaṃ kṣapayati pūrvāhṇaṃ śrutasajjanaiḥ ..6.140.56..

antarāntarasampannadharmyārthopārjanakramaḥ .
santoṣāmṛtatṛptātmā sādhvācāreṇa rājate ..6.140.57..

sarasīṣv acchatoyāsu phullāsu nalinīṣu ca .
saritsu bahupuṇyāsu vāpīṣu ca nimajjati ..6.140.58..

āsannacandrakarakīrṇasudhārasāsu

vanyāḫ phalair upacaranti mahānubhāvam ..6.140.59..

abhyāsāj jñānaśāstrāṇāṃ karaṇāt puṇyakarmaṇām .
jantor yathāvad eveyaṃ vastudṛṣṭiḫ prasīdati ..6.141.1..

tṛtīyāṃ bhūmikāṃ prāpya buddho 'nubhavati svayam .
dviprakāram asaṃsaṅgaṃ tasya bhedam imaṃ śṛṇu ..6.141.2..

asaṃsaṅgasya bhagavan prathamaṃ brūhi lakṣaṇam .
kathayiṣyasi me paścād asyaiva dviprakāratām ..6.141.3..

dviprakāratvakathanaprasaṅgenaiva lakṣaṇam .
asaṃsakteś śṛṇutarāṃ duritaṃ yena naśyati ..6.141.4..

dvividho 'yam asaṃsaṅgas sāmānyaś śreṣṭha eva ca .
śṛṇu sāmānyam evādau sa eva śraiṣṭhyam eṣyati ..6.141.5..

nāhaṃ karteśvaraẖ kartā na kaścid vātha ko 'pi vā .
ity amajjanam artheṣu sāmānyāsaṅganāmakam ..6.141.6..

sampadyata idaṃ kiñcit kayāpy eveśvarecchayā .
bhāvanābhāvanam iti sāmānyāsaṅganāmakam ..6.141.7..

ajo 'ham avyayātmāham ananto 'ham anāmayaḥ .
akartāsmīty anicchatvaṃ sāmānyāsaṅganāmakam ..6.141.8..

evam eva pravartante premāṇi ca dhanāni ca .
evam evāvahīyante kasya kevātra kartṛtā ..6.141.9..

āpātaramaṇīyāni vimardavirasāni ca .
kākatālīyayogena sukhāny āyānti yānti ca ..6.141.10..

bhogā viṣamasambhogā bhogā iva phaṇāvatām .
nāham eteṣu naite me jāgarmy ātmani śāntadhīḥ ..6.141.11..

bhogā bhavamahārogās sampadaḫ paramāpadaḥ .
viyogā eva saṃyogā ādhayo vyādhayo dhiyaḥ ..6.141.12..

kālaẖ kavalanodyuktas sarvabhāvān asanmayān .
apy atti vipralambhena svātmānam api mohayan ..6.141.13..

apy asatyāni santīva nāntavanty antavanti ca .
cidratnaraśmijālāni jaganty agaṇitāny aho ..6.141.14..

vicāreṇa na labhyante na santy agragatāny alam .
jāgrati svapnadṛṣṭāni purāṇīva sthitāny api ..6.141.15..

savātavanavallīnāṃ chāyā iva punaḫ punaḥ .
anāratavilolāni bhavanti na bhavanti ca ..6.141.16..

anāsthayeti bhāvānāṃ yad abhāvanam āntaram .

na kartāsmi na bhoktāsmi na vaktāsmi na yāmi ca .

īśvarārpaṇayā yad yat kriyate muktavāsanam .

asaṃsaṅgo 'yam uktas te sāmānyo raghunandana .

anena kramayogena saṃyogena mahātmanām .

pauruṣeṇa prayatnena tāvad abhyāsa uhyate .

yā yodeti manāg icchā tasyās tasyā nipātanāt .

dṛṣṭe sakalasīmānte trijagatkaṇadīpake .

nāhaṃ karteśvaraẖ kartā nāsmi kartā na ceśvaraḥ .
nāyam asmi na cānyo 'ham aham asmītaraś ca vā ..6.141.25..

kṛtvā dūratare nūnam itiśabdārthabhāvanāḥ .
